games.summary: A racing game where the main character is the greed. Several cars battle each other on maze-like rooms trying to get the money bags and avoiding the dangers. In this game, everybody cares just about the money, showing that the money is the "route" of all evil.

games.name: Route-16 Turbo
games.summary:
Take control of your car, MAD X, and evade relentless enemy cars as you infiltrate the secret base of the evil Kanharoo Gang to recover all the stolen money.

Switch dynamically between Maze Mode, where you navigate complex labyrinths, and Radar Mode, which displays the entire stage made up of 16 mazes-delivering a constantly thrilling car chase experience.

This version also includes stages that were unreachable in the original 1985 release.
Now’s your chance to beat the high scores you set back then!

games.name: Route-16: R
games.summary: The Route-16 remake. Beat the revived Kanharoo Gang with your car MAD X-R!

games.name: Sento Survivor: Slip, Grab, and Bathe in Glory!
games.summary: Slide, Shoot, and Send Your Rivals Flying!Chaotic, tumbling shooter battle set in a Japanese Sento (public bathhouse). On these super slippery floors, you'll slide, shoot, and stumble to victory. Defeat your rivals and soak in the sublime bath reserved only for the winner!

games.name: Seven Suns of Orion
games.summary: A fast paced bullet heaven, control your Sci-fi spaceships with semi-newtonian physics. Last 7 minutes against the drone armada until their boss arrives and fight your way to freedom! Use planetary gravity and other hazards to dodge superior numbers. Collect and combine weapons for maximum firepower

games.name: Solitaire World: Anime Waifus
games.summary:
A classical Solitaire game with a waifu twist.
Play classic Solitaire in a exciting, anime-inspired world full of anime waifus.

games.name: Star Haul Tycoon
games.summary:
Star Haul Tycoon is a narrative logistics simulation that blends deep industrial automation with minimalist transport strategy - all wrapped in a layer of dark, corporate sci-fi humor.

You are an AI Unit working for Star Haul. Your directive is simple: Connect planets, run ships, and optimize supply chains to pay off your massive installation fee.

games.name: Street Racing EVO: Car & Moto
games.summary: Get ready for the ultimate driving experience! Street Racing EVO combines the thrill of car and motorcycle racing with the freedom of an open-world simulator. Whether you're a fan of high-speed racing, realistic driving, or immersive parking challenges, this game has it all.

games.name: Summoner's Gambit
games.summary: Summoner's Gambit is an innovative duel game that blends strategy rouguelike with auto-battler positioning. As a powerful summoner, you'll forge a dominant formation and clash against other players on the ever-shifting battlefield, where wit and luck collide.

games.name: Super Bunny Man
games.summary:
A physics-based couch-coop platformer about a guy in a rabbit costume. Beat levels, time attacks, find hidden carrots, all while evading spikes, boulders, pitfalls, and other challenges.

Play campaign mode in singleplayer or co-op with a friend, or play deathmatch with up to 4 players.

games.name: T.K. Punk: G.O.L.D
games.summary: Cyber Three Kingdoms Turn-Based Strategy RPG— As the latest humanoid AI developed, you were kidnapped by Zhang Jiao and joined the resistance organization—GOLD. Develop yourself, accept commissions, research prosthetics, cultivate companions and pursue the love and destruction in your heart!

games.name: Talespinner
games.summary: Enter a captivating realm steeped in the exotic and bizarre tapestry of Japanese mythology with Talespinner, a deck-building roguelike adventure. As the storyteller, you will guide your chosen hero through an ever-changing narrative shaped by your decisions and deck construction.

games.name: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon: Wildlands - Definitive Edition
games.summary:
The Definitive Edition includes:
- Tom Clancy’s Ghost Recon Wildlands
- Season Pass
- Year 2 Pass
- Quick Start Pack
- Deluxe Pack
- Nightfall Protocol Pack
- Cold Eye Pack

games.name: Tomb of Chacal
games.summary: Tomb of Chacal is a first-person horror game with stealth and puzzle mechanics. You are an archeologist who has stumbled upon the discovery of a lifetime - an undiscovered tomb hidden deep in the jungle. But the riches here are being guarded by an ancient evil.

games.name: Traffic Rush: Ultimate Drive
games.summary:
Step into the fast lane in Traffic Rush: Ultimate Drive, a high-speed arcade driving experience where precision, reflexes, and timing are everything.

Navigate through intense traffic, dodge incoming vehicles, and master the road as you push your driving skills to the limit. The longer you survive, the higher your score but one mistake can end it all.

Compete against players worldwide with a dynamic leaderboard system, unlock achievements, and prove that you are the ultimate driver.

Features:
- Fast-paced arcade driving gameplay
- Global leaderboards compete with the best
- Challenging achie

games.name: War Pawns
games.summary: Fast-paced WWII turn-based tactics with team-based multiplayer, objective-driven battles, and a built-in map editor to create and share custom battlefields.

games.name: Watch The Edge Honey
games.summary: Watch The Edge, Honey! is a psychological thriller wrapped in a vertical climbing adventure, built to test your nerves as much as your reflexes. As you climb under Eva's guidance, you'll fight gravity, your fear of heights, and — most of all — the quiet, manipulative pressure she plants in your mind.

games.name: Yellowcreek Stories: The Cabin Watcher
games.summary: A masked killer hunts you in the dark. Manage noise and light, hide quickly, and survive this intense 60–90 minute first-person stealth horror experience inspired by classic 80s slasher films.

games.name: Zingeldinger in "The Cowboy Who Couldn't Shoot"
games.summary: "Zingeldinger in "The Cowboy Who Couldn't Shoot"" is sokoban videogame in which you must solve a series of puzzles using your cowboy abilities in order to recieve encouragement from The Warriors of Encouragevar. Gain enough encouragement to steady your aim and slay the vile beast that has followed them from their realm into The Wild West!

games.name: Is This Seat Taken?
games.summary: Is This Seat Taken? is a logic puzzle game where you play matchmaker for groups of hilariously particular people. Each character has pet peeves that make seating them a delightful challenge. Find the perfect spot for each person to unlock new levels in this cozy, silly, and relatable experience.

games.name: Frozen Ship
games.summary: Frozen Ship is a first-person narrative adventure in the unique blending of survival, build&craft, and economic strategy genres.

games.name: Chop Chop Inc.
games.summary: Build your own furniture empire after getting fired from Furnox Corp . Chop down trees, process wood, automate your growing production lines and sell clever furniture sets for bonus cash. Explore a handcrafted world packed with weirdos, secrets and trees begging for violence.

games.name: Grizzy & the Lemmings: Crazy Party
games.summary: Turn your living room into a chaotic playground! 50 mini-games, 1-4 players on the couch, one goal: grab the Yummy before your friends, while Grizzy does everything to ruin it.

games.name: We, Junk Artists
games.summary: A "collage-and-guess" multiplayer game for up to 6 players. Enjoy collaging ordinary items into outside-the-box "masterpieces," guess each other's creations, and unleash your wild imagination around the campfire. Here, everyone is an artist!

games.name: Dragonhold
games.summary: Dragonhold is a multiplayer dragon and melee extraction game. Soar through the air or charge into the melee with a growing lineup of dragons and warriors. Compete head-to-horn with other dragon riders from around the world.

games.name: Acrodrift: FPV Drone Simulator
games.summary: A high-speed FPV drone simulator that challenges your skills with precision flying, time attack races, and freestyle exploration. Customize your drone, tune flight dynamics, and master the art of acro flying across immersive environments.

games.name: Bodycam Onrecord
games.summary: Experience hyper-realistic visuals and fluid controls from an unprecedented Bodycam perspective. The world's first shooter with truly playable 3DGS environments. Every pulse-pounding firefight and precise tactical move is captured by your chest-mounted camera for unmatched battlefield immersion.

games.name: Expeditions: Samurai
games.summary: The sun rises on another civil war, as you land in Japan aboard a battered Dutch ship. Thrust into command of its motley crew, you must navigate the politics of Sengoku-era Japan using stealth, diplomacy, or violence in this party-based RPG where every choice matters.

games.name: Grain Rot
games.summary: Grain Rot is a horror co-op extraction builder set in a scorched wasteland where everything burns. Descend with your friends into shifting ruins, rip out furniture, and scavenge for loot before the Corrupted close in. Make it back alive, then rebuild the Outpost to better your chances for the next run.

games.name: Hocus Focus
games.summary: A cozy gamified focus tool to help you work, study, or relax to soothing tunes. Customize your space and summon your focus with productivity tools. You’re a student in a magic university - control time and weather, unlock new locations, collect cute Mitzkins, and level up in-game and in real life!

games.name: John Fox
games.summary: John Fox is an elite warrior and super soldier who saved the leaders of various States. He was a professional mercenary who retired with honor. But now his beloved pet, Milo, has been killed. You have to avenge him!

games.name: Red the Cook
games.summary: Help Red the Cook chase his dream - quit his dull job and open the best restaurant in town! Balance time and resources, serve delicious dishes to every kind of customer - fluffy or not. Chop, fry, mix, and hustle your way through busy shifts in this cozy cooking simulator with a pinch of humor.

games.name: SCP: ReEnter
games.summary: SCP: ReEnter is a free, asymmetrical multiplayer FPS set during a massive containment breach. Players are randomly assigned to Humans or SCPs. Fight to secure the facility, escape, or slaughter everyone with seven playable anomalies.

games.name: Together in Forgotten Lands
games.summary: Two souls, one destiny. Embark on a co-op adventure through a forgotten land, where teamwork and wit are the only way to navigate the wonders and dangers of a magical cave.

games.name: 4am
games.summary: A tiny gimbap café in a back alley, lights on until 4 a.m. Lured by oddly high pay, you take the night shift — greet customers, cook, walk home through the dark. Night by night, something slips out of place. Where did the last clerk go?

games.name: Anomalogenos
games.summary: A fishing shooter game where you reel in targets to shoot while dodging enemy bullets! Build diverse strategies using active skills deployable during battle and passive skills that constantly activate!

games.name: Ashes of Vaelmoor
games.summary: A small Indie game made by me and my friends, designed for speedrunning.

games.name: Boba Avoider
games.summary: Rotating twin galaxies - collect tapioca of the same colour while avoiding that of the opposite.

games.name: Bobrix
games.summary: Explore, play, and create on Bobrix. You can create your own games, make friends, and customize your avatar on Bobrix! Every game is multiplayer so invite your friends to join a new small community!

games.name: Captive
games.summary: Leave No Trace. He is Always Watching.

games.name: Car Dealer Simulator: Retro Car for Sale
games.summary:
Become a Car Dealer.
Trade Classic Cars.
Build Your Dealership.

games.name: Cellar Keeper
games.summary: Cellar Keeper is a cozy single-player organizing simulator where you sort 2,448 scattered bottles throughout a forgotten cellar. Return every bottle to its proper shelf, organize collections by type, unlock helpful abilities, and restore perfect order as efficiently as possible.

games.name: Château Pluie: The New Cellar Keeper
games.summary: A cozy single-player simulation game. You've inherited an old vineyard, and a cellar of 1,600 wine bottles, each waiting for its place. Sort, organize, and shelve them all as the new cellar keeper. Relax into the rain and music. Unlock new skills, trust your instincts, and bring the cellar to life.

games.name: Civics Scribble
games.summary: Test your knowledge of U.S. Civics while drawing lines for the inquisitive Mr. Apple to roll on or bounce off of to navigate challenges such as spikes, bouncy blocks and teleporters. Make your way through 96 levels across nine scenic locations based on real-life state and National Parks.

games.name: Clappy Cheeks: Lust and Magic
games.summary: Clappy Cheeks: Lust and Magic is an erotic game where you jump to fly and xxx. You will hear the clap clap voices of them cheeks as you play. Let's fly deep into myserious castle of vampire queen!

games.name: Cloud Golf
games.summary: Putt Above the Clouds

games.name: Cocosic: On Pirates' Trail
games.summary: Cocosic and his brother Viki need to save their sister Aivochka, who has been kidnapped by the evil pirate king. On their journey, they will have to visit different worlds, as well as help restore them after the "Collapse" arranged by the villain on the way to his own world.

games.name: Command Monster
games.summary: Survive as long as possible by entering the fighting game commands that appear one after another.

games.name: Crownborne
games.summary: A fully English-voiced action-romance visual novel. Pulled from the modern world into a kingdom at war, wield an ancient power, romance four heroines, and steer branching battles where every choice you make reshapes alliances, fights, and which ending you reach.

games.name: Dark of the Depths
games.summary: A first-person deep sea exploration game. Use only a torch to navigate through rusted structures, encountering both dangerous and harmless sea creatures. Uncover the mysteries of the trench, and experience the phobia-inducing atmosphere of the ocean floor.

games.name: Don't Knock Again, Sabrina!
games.summary: Don't Knock Again, Sabrina! — a comedic visual novel about a pushy and horny neighbor who's always finding new reasons to knock on your door.

games.name: Dungeons & Donuts
games.summary: Dungeons & Donuts is a co-op action RPG that combines bullet hell dodging with roguelite dungeon runs for up to four players online, and is also playable solo. Between runs, players sell loot in a village, tend a farm, develop the settlement for materials, and craft donuts that act as consumable power-ups shaping the next run. Dungeon runs feature randomized power-up drops and last roughly 10 to 18 minutes, with Delves providing special ores for gear enhancement. Developed by the two-person team at Sas & Sons Game Studio, the game launched in Steam Early Access in August 2026.

games.name: DustCrow
games.summary: DustCrow is a space-salvaging and exploration zero-G VR game where you strip derelict wrecks for scrap, manage your tools and equipment in a zero-G environment, and play in a live, player-driven economy. It's just industrial tools, tactile physics, and the daily grind in the vast emptiness of space.(from steam)

games.name: Era Online: Şeref Savaşı
games.summary: Era Online: Şeref Savaşı is a 3D fantasy MMORPG developed for the Turkish market, featuring full Turkish language support and localized voice acting. Players can explore a vast open world, engage in large-scale guild vs guild (GVG) battles with hundreds of players on screen, choose from multiple classes with awakening and job transfer systems, collect and train over 100 battle spirits (Savaş Ruhu) with strategic team building, trade freely in a player-driven economy, and enjoy a deep social MMORPG experience with guilds, dungeons, and world bosses.

games.name: Gemblades
games.summary: A roguelite deckbuilder where you draft a deck of heroes called Gemblades and create satisfying synergies between them to save the world from the forces of Onyxion.

games.name: Hearse Hero
games.summary: Inspired by classics such as Crazy Taxi and Simpsons Road Rage. You are Heinrich, the enigmatic Hearse Hero. Hit your targets and hurtle them to the hereafter while dodging police, pedestrians and more. 20 action-packed levels, plus a custom map editor with Steam Workshop support.

games.name: Hololive Fantasy Battle
games.summary: -Hololive 3rd Generation Members Unleash Chaos in Battle-

games.name: Horny Waifu: Kaiju Strike
games.summary: Protect the world from giant monsters in Horny Waifu: Kaiju Strike! Pick from a variety of hot and, yes, HORNY waifus and battle kaiju in this epic fantasy adventure story! That story is about to keep you hooked with its twists and STEAMY FUN!

games.name: Ikarus
games.summary: IKARUS blends the bullet-hell chaos of arcade shmups with the strategic edge of a roguelike deck-builder. Dodge, parry, and shoot through waves of hostile machines while crafting game-breaking card synergies. How close to the sun will you fly?

games.name: Japan Stigmatized Property 3
games.summary: Can you survive until dawn? Monitor real Japanese properties and report every anomaly. Miss too many… and you will fail.

games.name: Keep It Contained
games.summary: You’re part of a scientific team in a sealed facility, racing against time to keep dangerous anomalies contained. One scientist handles the modules, while others guide them using manuals and procedures. This local co-op experience requires two or more players.

games.name: Kings Origin
games.summary: A roguelite dungeon-building tower defense. Build your domain on a tactical board, place rooms and units, and survive relentless waves to rise as the Dungeon Lord.

games.name: Kitties Solitaire
games.summary: 340 levels of cozy, cuddly card fun.

games.name: Kobayakawa-san is a Souls-like
games.summary: Talking to the girl you like? You learn by dying.

games.name: Living Shadows
games.summary: In Living Shadows, explore a dystopian future where humans and shadows have been separated. Solve puzzles, face challenges, and dive into a deep narrative as you uncover hidden secrets in a dark world.

games.name: Lowmoor Idle RPG: An Adventurer's Chronicle
games.summary: A zero-player idle RPG in the spirit of Progress Quest, told in a Win9x chronicle. Shape a 2,108-skill tree, face 179 illustrated monsters, earn 100 achievements and find tens of thousands of equipment combinations in two adventures. Watch it run or close the window.

games.name: Lucky Shot
games.summary: The flick-shot roguelite FPS. Sharpen your aim, master different weapons, and break the game to reach massive high scores.

games.name: Make it Meme
games.summary: Make it Meme is the free party game, about creating and rating memes: Each player gets a random meme and has to think of a text for the meme within a given time. After that, the players rate each other's memes and award their Meme Buddy. Whoever has collected the most points at the end wins!

games.name: Mancalero
games.summary: Mancalero is the ancient strategy board game of Mancala, rebuilt as a roguelike deckbuilder. Collect special marbles, stack blessings, discover synergies, and break every table with increasing scores.

games.name: Max Cross
games.summary:
Procedurally generated levels, randomly spawned enemies, this fast paced endless platformer will have you sweating bullets. It's all about timing and reaction speeds, to see how far you can make it and if you can top the leaderboard.

It's easy to play but VERY difficult to master. Incrementally increasing difficulty the long you survive means the challenge grows along with your experience.

Mix and match 10 unique power-ups with 5 game-changing modifiers, creating over 50 possible combinations that can completely transform how you play.

The further you make it, the bigger the score—and the h

games.name: Metroid Prime Origins
games.summary:
A fully complete adaptation of Metroid Prime for the Game Cube in 2D, complimented by a fake-bit aesthetic. This has been lovely to work on, and I had a lovely team of fellow fans by my side this entire time.

This game was made with no generative AI. All sprites and music were created by fans, and all of the in-game lore has been re-written; based on the original NTSC lore.

games.name: Mini Soccer Manager
games.summary: A compact 2D soccer management game that combines squad development, tactical decisions, club progression, and fast live match simulations.

games.name: Miseria
games.summary: Miseria is a dark fantasy–themed idle incremental game in which you lead a party of damned souls through the depths of the world.

games.name: Nandao Ni Shi Gal Gaoshou
games.summary: An introverted girl who is bad at games, an artist who struggles with drawing human anatomy, a wealthy young lady who wants to play visual novels for the rest of her life, and a younger sister trying her best to understand what anime is—you will play their protagonist and start a romantic comedy!

games.name: Nitro Horizon
games.summary: Nitro Horizon is a neon-inspired top-down arcade racing game from InfinitByte Studios. Race against AI rivals across six unique circuits, master high-speed drifting and nitro boosts, unlock seven distinct vehicles, and compete across Arcade Race, Time Attack, and Championship modes. Earn credits, improve your garage, and climb the leaderboard in a fast-paced single-player racing experience.

games.name: No Need for Flowers
games.summary: Dodge through colorful bullet patterns as you shoot down hoards of enemies in this arcade-style scrolling shooter bullet hell about magic dragon girls! Uncover a tragic story about acceptance as you overcome intense challenges that test both your skills and memory.

games.name: No Thoughts Just Dodge
games.summary:
The feed is endless. Your attention span is not.

Take control of one extremely overworked braincell—or bring a second braincell along—and survive a neon storm of doomscroll phones, screaming notifications, weaponized lag, and nonstop chaos.

Collect Thought Crumbs, build combos, choose powerful upgrades, grab Mystery Orbs, and fight to keep your braincells online as the screen becomes increasingly unhinged.

games.name: Okugafuchi Shopping Arcade
games.summary: A timid real estate agent is sent to the abandoned Okugafuchi Shopping District to perform a mysterious ritual for redevelopment. But a wandering female ghost and the town’s cursed past stand in the way. As he uncovers old documents and legends, a buried truth begins to surface.

games.name: One Stroke Hunter
games.summary: A brainy roguelite monster-hunting game fought with a single continuous stroke. Connect grid squares in one unbroken line to build attacks, defenses, and spells, then slay your enemies. Deeper levels bring more complex fields and a new map every run. Draw the perfect path.

games.name: Overstimulacrum
games.summary: You are overstimulated. Explore the annals of Your mind through the lens of an FMV point and click museum experience. Watch sensory memories, find what's real. Receive Your gift.

games.name: Platformer Helmet
games.summary: Achaapur is taken hostage by a local gangster Gundam. You are the only hope left. Each helmet has a unique super power. Switch between different helmets to use those powers. Fight against different goons of Gundam. A Platformer game that has fights and platforming action.

games.name: Prison Escape Simulator 2026
games.summary: Can you dig a secret tunnel before the guards discover your plan?

games.name: Prison Gambit
games.summary: A 4-12 player online social party game about betrayal, cooperation and trust. No teams, only alliances. No traitors, only betrayals. Only one walks free.

games.name: Project Neon
games.summary: Project Neon is a new, vertical / TATE style Shoot 'Em Up (shmup), developed for the original Neo Geo MVS / AES platform. It features a 1-2 player mode, with all the bells and whistles of a classic shoot 'em up that you would expect, spiced up with some modern and unique concepts and game mechanics.

games.name: R.I.P.
games.summary: A co-op horror game where you manipulate your own gravity to traverse a procedurally generated 3D maze filled with supernatural threats. Work alone or with your team to rescue kidnapped victims.

games.name: Restore the Luminous
games.summary:
Restore the Luminous is a free-to-play digital trading card game in which every card is unlocked the moment the game is installed. There are no booster packs, no gacha and no cards for sale; the only purchases planned are cosmetic.

Two players duel one on one with decks of 40 to 60 cards, built from a single card pool shared by every leader, with a limit of three copies of any one card and no colour restrictions on deckbuilding. Cards are paid for with LP, a resource that comes in five colours: red, blue, green, yellow and black. LP grows and fully refreshes every turn, and its colours are se

games.name: Rome: Card Battles
games.summary:
Rome: Card Battles is a free-to-play collectible card game set in ancient Rome and played entirely in a web browser. Players assemble decks from a collection of more than 250 cards drawn from the legions, politics, gods and arenas of the Roman world, then face opponents in turn-based duels where board positioning, resource management and timing determine the winner.

Content is split between "Via della Gloria", a hundred-level single-player campaign against AI opponents, and player-versus-player duels in both casual and ranked ladders. A separate mode adapts Ludus Latrunculorum, the Roman game

games.name: Safe Zone
games.summary: Take a break from the end of the world. In Safe Zone, build and decorate the coziest post-apocalyptic shelter you can imagine. Welcome weary survivors, take care of their needs, discover their stories, and help them find a new place in a world forever changed.

games.name: Sandbox Doodle Playground
games.summary:
Build. Craft. Destroy.
Create Your Own Playground.
Experiment Without Limits.

games.name: Shadow Breakers
games.summary: Play as Ultra, Apola, and Mozez as they battle shadow demons unleashed by the Cursed, a group seeking to restore balance through chaos. With their robot companions, they must split up to stop the demons and thwart the Cursed’s sinister plans.

games.name: Shirohebi and the Tower of Mercy
games.summary: In this roguelite RPG, Nemesis climbs the Tower of Mercy and discovers its secrets. He can meet and team up with other characters, and learn their reasons for climbing the tower. However, he needs to be cautious as he continues, since an entity is taking his strength away.

games.name: Sklime: A Difficult Climbing Adventure
games.summary: Sklime is a difficult single level twin-stick climbing game taking inspiration from Bennett Foddy's Getting Over It. The player must climb over a thousand meters out of The Depths, visiting 7 different colorful zones while playing some minigames along the way.

games.name: Smelly Bubbles
games.summary:
You are in a pool with friends or random players.
One player can fart and others vote who farted, player who got most votes will be thrown out from the pool. Talk to others with voice chat and solve who really farted.

games.name: Super Shout Showdown
games.summary: Write your own incantations and cast spells through your microphone! Battle in duels, team fights, or chaotic free-for-all matches with 25+ unique spells to learn, combo, and master.

games.name: Tailbreak
games.summary: Dinosaurs return in this on-rails action shooter with a feral twist!

games.name: Task Force Ranger: Breakpoint
games.summary: Lead Bravo Team Into Modern Combat Operations

games.name: The Castle of Dr. Hoot
games.summary: Welcome to the mysterious castle of spelling extraordinaire, Dr. Hoot! Explore the classroom, the lab, the library and the...detention dungeon? Put your mind to the test with spelling challenges and logic riddles as you avoid the wrath of the strict, cranky spelling teacher, Dr. Hoot.

games.name: The Dare
games.summary: A horror experience where a simple dare leads you into an abandoned construction site hiding something far darker. Explore, solve environmental puzzles, and survive using stealth as every sound and decision shapes your fate.

games.name: The Forbidden Tomes of Olipos
games.summary: What started as an out-of-town gig quickly turns into the journey of a lifetime for Romina! The young librarian will hunt forbidden tomes, fight powerful foes, and discover ancient mysteries in this classic JRPG adventure. What truth awaits at the end of it all?

games.name: The Prince's Keeper
games.summary: Play as the newest servant to Prince Railan, who's had all of his previous servants fired. While navigating your position, you'll try to pry down his carefully guarded walls as you challenge him on everything he believes about himself and the world. Just try not to get fired in the process.

games.name: Tiana's Fishing Diary
games.summary: This is a pixel art idle desktop fishing game.Catch fish, place them in your aquarium, and let them generate gold for you.Each fish has unique skills—mix and match to maximize your income.Upgrade, customize, unlock new areas, and collect all kinds of fish!

games.name: Tide of Tactics
games.summary: Tide of Tactics is a medieval turn-based tactics game. Choose a commander to play, each with their own unique unit and abilities, then go to battle on a grid-based battlefield. Use the terrain to your advantage, place traps on the ground, and build the right units to counter your enemy.

games.name: Toy Shop: Tidy Up
games.summary: A cozy organizing simulator where you sort over 1,274 toys in a messy toy shop. Every toy has a category. Every display is yours to design. Arrange the toys freely—no timers, no rules, no constraints. Just enjoy the satisfaction of tidy up the messy toys in your own creative way.

games.name: White Rabbit's Wonderland 2: Twisted Worlds - Collector's Edition
Worship Demon
games.summary: Worship Demon is a 2D survivor game blending anime art and immortal cultivation. Choose one of the Four Great Demonic Sects, cultivate powers, hunt lost treasures and spells, defeat foes, and forge your unique immortal journey with hundreds of skill-item combinations.

games.name: Yet Another Avoider
games.summary: Avoid hitting rectangles as long as you can!

games.name: Zooville Detectives: A Read-Along Mystery
games.summary: Discover the secret guardian of Zooville in this heartwarming visual novel.

games.name: Foxwar Mini
games.summary: Mini artillery game

games.name: 1998: The Toll Keeper Story
games.summary: A narrative simulation game where you play as a mother-to-be working as a toll keeper in the fictional country of Janapa, a nation on the brink of chaos. Navigate daily challenges and make difficult moral choices to survive—all for the sake of your unborn child.

games.name: Accident Investigator Simulator: Black Box
games.summary: Step into the role of a federal investigator and uncover the truth behind every disaster. Recover black boxes, cross-reference evidence, expose contradictions, and name the real cause before an innocent takes the fall. Every conclusion matters in this tense investigation sim full of twists.

games.name: Alice and the Devil's Prison
games.summary: Escape adventure game. During a tea party, Alice and her friends become trapped in a world created by demons. Will they be able to escape this twisted realm safely?

games.name: Birb Game
games.summary: A racing game where you play as a bird and race in single player or online multiplayer

games.name: Brave Dungeon: The Meaning Of Justice
games.summary: A sequel that inherits the basic system of the previous Brave Dungeon. You can play in different stories and different systems with the scenarios of the three protagonists.

games.name: Bubble Shooter: Color Splash
games.summary: One shot. Endless bubble fun!

games.name: Catetris
games.summary: Catetris is a captivating puzzle game where players must place falling pieces of various shapes to fill horizontal lines on the board.

games.name: Chessmate
games.summary:
Chessmate is a tactical strategy game that transforms the chessboard with card-based commands, dynasty abilities, traps, and cinematic 3D battles.

Pieces are not limited to traditional chess movement. Each card commands a specific piece type and grants it a unique movement, attack, defense, or support ability. Manage your hand, Command Points, and battlefield positioning to defeat every King in the enemy army.

games.name: Cyberpunk SFX
games.summary: What can be more spectacular than a girl armed with rockets and a sense of humor? Yes, she is about to start solving the problems of the 21st century. And if you want to make sure she doesn’t create a few new ones, you’ll have to show her the way.

games.name: Dead Before Work: The Commute
games.summary: "20 mins to the meeting, or you’re Dead Before Work!" It's Archie's unluckiest day. From broken alarms to a city that’s literally out to get him. Sprint through physics-based chaos, dodge cosmic-level bad luck, and rack up gag points. Can you survive the world’s most lethal commute?

games.name: Deflect
games.summary: A bullet hell parry roguelite where your shield is the only weapon. Catch enemy fire and send it screaming back through 100 waves, endless hybrid-boss gauntlets, and a mountain of loot. Seven Reapers, one rule: Don't Shoot, Send it back!

games.name: Donkey Kong Land Remake
games.summary:
Donkey Kong Land Remake is a fanmade recreation for PC of the original Donkey Kong Land, but with looks, sound and controls in the style of DKC!
Featuring 30+ full sized levels, tight controls and a lot of secrets to uncover, so Donkey and Diddy can get all their bananas back, again!

games.name: Grand Cru: The Wine Maker
games.summary: Grand Cru: The Wine Maker is a turn-based wine-making tycoon set in Bordeaux. Score your terroir, age vintages in oak, and balance the four pillars of quality — then out-negotiate 25 unique buyers with your own pricing strategy while volatile weather RNG threatens every harvest. From terroir scoring to Michelin-star contracts, every vintage is a high-stakes economic calculation where critics and the public pull in different directions.

games.name: Jesus Simulator
games.summary:
Jesus Simulator is more than a game — it is an interactive journey of faith, choice, and spiritual reflection.
Live the story. Become a witness. Discover its meaning.

games.name: Merge Assault
games.summary: Merge Monsters. Smash Every Block.

games.name: Pight
games.summary: Pight is a minimalist puzzle game inspired by the Minecraft redstone system, in which we try to turn on the light block by using piston blocks and different block types.

games.name: Re:Dream
games.summary: Re:Dream is a walking simulator in which the player discovers photographs. A copy of our world, or a world inside a copy. 3 real life characters, who discover their self of our reality.

games.name: Super Smash Asteroids
games.summary: "Super Smash Asteroids" is a high-speed, twin-stick, top-down, rogue-like space shooter. Choose from 6 unique ships, upgrade with 70+ items & blast through epic bosses. Level up for intense, action-packed battles in a futuristic universe. Buckle up for a thrilling journey to glory!

games.name: The Twisted Zone: Foreborn
games.summary: In a future of hyper-advanced technology, the unborn can decide whether they should be born by experiencing their future lives in a simulation.

games.name: Velocrash
games.summary: Velocrash is a party racing game in which players take turns building the track before racing on it together. Each round, every player draws a random hand of cards and places one track piece or trap - such as saw blades, oil slicks, boost pads, or launch ramps - so the track grows longer and more chaotic every round. Finishing a race scores points, but sabotaging opponents is often more rewarding. The game features 3D arcade driving physics, online multiplayer for 2 to 8 players via Steam invite, two game modes (points race and time trial), two worlds, multiple cars and colors, and gamepad sup

games.name: World Climate Lab
games.summary: World Climate Lab is a real-time planetary climate simulator. Import your own terrain or sculpt a world in the topography editor, then watch a living climate emerge from physics: winds, oceans, cloud bands and ice. Every climate is calculated, not painted.

games.name: 100 Mystic Cats
games.summary: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️‍♂️ Can you find them all? ️‍♂️

games.name: Animosity
games.summary: Through claws and bullets, Red must save his friends from the angry ape menace. Procedural levels create a new experience with every play. Companion AI gives you the backup you need. Coop, Deathmatch, and Speedrun for up to 4 player split screen. Xbox controllers recommended.

games.name: Bobrix
games.summary: Explore, play, and create on Bobrix. You can create your own games, make friends, and customize your avatar on Bobrix! Every game is multiplayer so invite your friends to join a new small community!

games.name: Case of 1980
games.summary: A sudden call from your grandfather pulls you back to the family farm. As Nathan, you arrive expecting a routine visit, only to stumble upon a horrifying reality tied to a 1980 crime. Trapped and isolated, you must face the entities lurking in the shadows and survive the night.

games.name: Catch Flex
games.summary:
Catch Flex is a full-body dance rhythm game played in front of a single camera, with no VR headset, no gamepad and no wearables. The camera sees your whole body, your moves are the input, and even the menus are gesture-controlled. Tracking runs locally on the device, or on a phone running the free Catch Flex: Controller app, which sends only movement data over the local network and never uploads video.

Six kinds of move make up a chart. Slash blocks in the direction of the arrow, catch rings with a hand or a foot, kick the balls or knock them back, stomp floor markers on the beat, ride slide

games.name: Cheated
games.summary:
Hack your friends to make them fall.
You are tiny. Reach the attic. It's easy.
2-8 players, or streamer mode.

games.name: Cloud Sculptor
games.summary: Sculpt your way through puzzles and platforming using a frog, a laser beam, and other classic sculpting tools!

games.name: Flavors of Spain
games.summary: Embark on a fast-paced arcade culinary journey! Master the brave bull to shoot iconic dishes to the 52 provinces of Spain. Test your aim and discover the rich gastronomy of Spain in this indie blend of geography, gastronomy, and strategy.

games.name: Graveyard Shift
games.summary: Scavenge, tiptoe, and fight your way to the surface in this dangerously cute puzzle and stealth game where everyone can hear—but not see—everything you do.

games.name: Matchstick: Cosmic Flame
games.summary: A time and space bending cosmic intelligence has found its way to Earth. Your family has been taken. Face the horrors of a twisted world and fight off the infected to save them. Travel through wormholes, explore nightmarish environments, solve cryptic puzzles, and run from demonic entities.

games.name: Oniria
games.summary: When the moon rises, the garden falls with it. The insects succumb to exhaustion, all except one...

games.name: Race! Then Retry...
games.summary: A fast paced, challenging, puzzle based, arcade racing experience. Race on 35 unique tracks as you try to survive, beat the clock and top the leaderboards.

games.name: Samurai Beat Demon
games.summary: A Brotato-inspired roguelike for players short on time, diving straight into combat! Weapon positions unlock 62 unique abilities, each with a buff and debuff. Strategically mix and match based on battle and build for endless playstyles!

games.name: Shibogami
games.summary: Shibōgami is a physics-driven 2D platformer prototype built around rope-swinging momentum. Fire your rope, connect to anchor points, and swing and fling yourself through the world in search of food for your big, dog spirit companion.

games.name: SkullBall
games.summary: Have you ever wanted to play Quake, but also wanted there to be something a little extra? Meet Skullball, a boomer shooter where the aim of the game is to grab the Skull at the center of the map and take it to the opposing team's goal!

games.name: The Black Lily Blooms in Her Eyes
games.summary: This adventure game follows the mystery of a bell said to have the power to grant wishes, as you build your deck and challenge six magicians. A roguelike mode with changing routes and item choices also offers strategic battles separate from the story.

games.name: Welcome to Desal
games.summary: Welcome to Desal is a short psychological horror experience where an ordinary job slowly turns into something deeply unsettling. Forced to work off your debt, you take on simple café tasks-serving customers, cleaning, and following orders-but something about this place isn’t right.

games.name: Backpack Boy
games.summary: Backpack Boy is off on one of his treks when he discovers a peculiar flashlight that changes the world around him. Explore a seemingly abandoned structure in this puzzle platformer built around mode-swapping.

games.name: A Game About Penguins
games.summary: A Game About Penguins is a cozy, online multiplayer experience where you customize adorable penguins and enjoy relaxing activities with friends. Slide, fish, throw snowballs, and socialize in a charming, snowy world!

games.name: Ajnabee: The Unknown
games.summary: Follow Naina’s daily life as it slowly stops belonging to her alone. 🚪 An unseen presence watches ️, remembers , and interferes ️ as her sense of safety slowly collapses. A deeply atmospheric psychological horror set in India, exploring obsession , fear , and emotional vulnerability.

games.name: Megako Punch!
games.summary: “Megako Punch!” is a fast-paced deck-building roguelike!Jump into a world teeming with monsters and beat them to a pulp with your special moves!

games.name: Pax Autocratica
games.summary: Build a grand totalitarian colony and personally storm roguelite battlefields with your soldiers. Shape citizens fears, loyalties, bonds, and feuds. Capture enemies, convert them into true believers. Sacrifice the weak. Feed the strong. Wield absolute power and make every life bend to your will.

games.name: Runt
games.summary: Runt is a rural gothic visual novel mystery where you follow the story of Runt, the youngest of five brothers, surviving a monstrous post-apocalypse.

games.name: The Dungeon Of Horror
games.summary: A dark medieval-fantasy turn-based dungeon crawler where you try to escape the dungeon of your own creation! Place tiles, fight monster and cooperate with friends to find and destroy the pagan shaman Meir to escape this horror!

games.name: Vivid Intrusion
games.summary: A fast paced FPS roguelike with an emphasis on movement. Imbue your weapon with unique effects that make each run different. Survive a variety of arenas, enemies, and boss fights. Are you able to stay ahead of the curve and complete all your trials?

games.name: Ballatory
games.summary: Ballatory is a short, 100%-able incremental idler where you BUY, UPGRADE, PAINT, and watch your BALLS bouncing around, hitting the cores and earning you money!

games.name: Bit Breaker
games.summary: Bit Breaker is a short brick-breaking incremental bullet hell. Collect resources to upgrade your balls and fight back against the nodes taking over humanity.

games.name: Blind Rage
games.summary: The voices command you to commit a burglary! Unfortunately for them, you are blind and finding what they seek is a challenge! Chased after you try your best to not get caught and end up in the asylum.

games.name: Body Sushi
games.summary: Make sushi. With waifus.Create eye-catching, sexy sushi platters in this playful and sensual simulator.Run a sushi restaurant where the serving plate… is a person.Serve VIP guests, carefully arrange your dishes, and unlock new waifus in this unique body-plating experience.

games.name: BookStore Simulator
games.summary: Open your dream bookstore and begin sowing the seeds of knowledge among locals. Push the boundaries of possibility and immerse your business in a world of magic.

games.name: Bottle Cracks
games.summary: Bottle Cracks is a party game where everyone is a bottle. Jump through chaotic levels without breaking! Play solo, online with up to 12 players, or with unlimited local players.

games.name: Car Wash Simulator
games.summary: Build a local car wash into a massive detailing empire! Master advanced cleaning techniques with vibrant active foams, beat the clock for extra tips, and buy or lease new properties. Play it clean or risk everything with high-paying shady deals and secret backroom plantations.

games.name: Circulo
games.summary: Circulo is a fast-paced 2D arena survival game centered around geometric chaos. Players control a small circle while facing waves of hostile shapes in an increasingly dangerous battlefield. Defeated enemies provide resources used to improve stats, unlock combat options and acquire upgrades. Runs feature different projectile types, passive upgrades, specialized abilities, enemy variants, bosses, checkpoints and random events.

games.name: Clan and Crown
games.summary: The game is a strategy simulation game where you start a family, raise children, infiltrate various industries in the city (13 industries, 70 professions), run for mayor to control the city's destiny, manufacture weapons to wage city wars, and ultimately establish your family empire.

games.name: Color Fear
games.summary: Today on the Color Fun Coloring Show they want Viewers to Help them Find out Who is Breaking into Their House.

games.name: Counterweight
games.summary: A social deduction tower-builder for 3–8 players. Stack blocks, raise the tower, and figure out which of your friends is placing them badly on purpose. Grab chaotic items, vote people out, and forge the Impostor Detector before every block hits the ground.

games.name: Crewmate Rush Space Escape Runner
games.summary:
Crewmate Rush Space Escape Runner is a feature-rich, high-octane 3D sci-fi runner where players sprint through high-tech spaceship corridors, dodge lethal hazards, and escape the pursuing Void Hunter.

Designed with deep gameplay mechanics and robust social integration, the game offers a complete multi-platform arcade experience across web and mobile platforms.

games.name: Cult of Pin
games.summary: Flip, nudge, and destroy in this roguelike pinball deckbuilder. Select from 100+ upgrades to create game-breaking builds and smash through the cursed playfields. Complete missions to trigger explosive special attacks and tear the tables apart, one bumper at a time.

games.name: Dead Broke
games.summary: Dead Broke is a frenetic action-arena roguelite with a twist: there is no health bar. There is only your money, draining away with every shot and every hit. Manage your finances while dodging hordes of debtors, bosses that attack your wallet, and a casino that never wants to let you leave.

games.name: Desktop Pinforge
games.summary: A cyberpunk idle pinball game that lives on your desktop. Smash blocks, automate your build, upgrade your Reactor and Launcher, and let your neon machine print profit while you work or play.

games.name: Double Golf
games.summary: In this interdimensional golf game, you swap between shooting the ball and swapping part of the world for another.

games.name: Dungeon Of Dragon Knight Remake
games.summary: Dungeon Of Dragon Knight Remake is a first-person, grid-based, real-time combat dungeon crawler RPG that faithfully revives the essence of classic old-school dungeon exploration. Navigate each corridor step by step, feel the tension of every corner, and strike fast in real-time combat.

games.name: Fat fat evil cat
games.summary:
You are a fat cat, and your goal is to get your owner to feed you. But there is a catch. Its the middle of night and everyone is asleep.
Make as much noise as you can, to wake your owner up and satisfy your greed!

games.name: Father Forgets
games.summary: A short, atmospheric pixel-art story about the late-night moment when a father sees his own mistakes and remembers what really matters. Inspired by a classic essay on fatherhood. A quiet experience in a single sitting — for anyone who's ever thought, "what if I'd done things differently…"

games.name: Figure Shop Simulator
games.summary: Run your own figure shop! Produce figures with 3D printers, stock your shelves, set prices, and offer the best shopping experience to your customers. Manage your storage, expand and design your store. Try to complete collection sets, follow market trends, and grow your business!

games.name: Goblin and Recipes: Match-3 Adventure
games.summary: A cozy fantasy Match-3 where every completed chapter unlocks a real traditional Balkan recipe. Cook, match, and fill your goblin cookbook.

games.name: Goodgame Empire
games.summary: You need a great strategy to become a great king in Goodgame Empire! Turn an insignificant spot on the world map into a mighty kingdom. Produce resources to build your magnificent castle. Recruit an army to protect it and conquer other kingdoms to expand your power. Fight epic battles against other players or forge strategic alliances to help you on your path to the ultimate goal: becoming the most powerful king of all!

games.name: Gravity Grove
games.summary: Gravity Grove is a 2D platformer set on the faces of a 3D cube. Walk over the edges to rotate the entire level, shifting gravity in your favor to open up new paths and uncover hidden secrets from the past.

games.name: Greatlandia Election Simulator
games.summary: An election based sim on a fictional map, 'Greatlandia', and your goal is to win with a majority. It is made by ChairMapping, and the coding is assisted by GPT

games.name: Grimoji
games.summary:
Grimoji is a gothic alchemy puzzle game that blends grid-sliding mechanics with match-3 chain reactions. Set on a dark runic grid, players take on the role of an apprentice alchemist, swiping, merging, and transmuting emojis to discover over 800 unique emoji recipes.

The game combines strategic movement, explosive chain reactions, and recipe collection mechanics.

games.name: Hamster Ballers
games.summary: A short, hilariously unfair, two-player obstacle course that'll more than answer the question: "Would I lose my sanity if I were trapped in a hamster ball with this person and had to climb a stupid hazard filled mountain to get out?"

games.name: Hole Is Mine
games.summary: Hole Is Mine is an incremental adventure about purifying the Hole. Dive inside and launch your Mini'ohs to mine for you. Extract impurities, upgrade your power, and find hidden secrets to grow the Village, customizing your Mini'ohs with incredible powers. The Hole has spoken!

games.name: Homeostasis
games.summary: Navigate a desolate snowscape in your lone vehicle, keep your systems running, and unravel unsettling clues about the last expedition in this short retro survival horror experience.

games.name: Horse Magnifier: The Full Horse
games.summary: Horse Magnifier: The Full Horse is the full and expanded version of the viral puzzle game

games.name: Human Parking Simulator
games.summary: Are you confident in your driving skills? Then come and take on this challenge. The goal is simple: drive the vehicle and park it in the designated space. That's all there is to it.

games.name: Knytt Classic
games.summary: Celebrate the 20th anniversary of the indie freeware classic, rebuilt for modern machines! Explore a maze-like planet as the Knytt, a peaceful being abducted by aliens, find your missing ship parts, and get back home in this zen-like atmospheric platformer.

games.name: Kungfu Card
games.summary: Special Moves! Great Kung Fu! "Kung Fu Cards" is a tactical card battler inspired by traditional Chinese martial arts. This innovative game combines elements of poker and mahjong with Chinese kung fu philosophy, striking the perfect balance between strategy and chance.

games.name: Manala: Equinox War
games.summary:
Manala: Equinox War is a LARP world where you build your combat deck and fight other players. Pick up your foam sword, put on your wizard hat and let's go kill the bad guys.

Depending on your point of view, that's either the person in the orc mask or the dwarf with a glued-on beard. The player characters are modeled on real LARPers' costumes.

If you're losing badly, you can always cheat. Just ignore the rules for a bit and be prepared to live with the shame.

games.name: Rampallians
games.summary: In Rampallians you build a deck of 40 cards from the nearly 400 cards in the game. It is a PvP where you play gatherers to get the resources to play your other cards and build your settlement. The first decision you make each game is your faction.

games.name: Shopenkraft's Quantum Curiosities
games.summary:
Shopenkraft reaches for the stars! Run a traveling tech shop from the back of your spaceship!

The game features over 50 different modules that you can freely mix and match to create all sorts of useful (or dysfunctional) products.

Some modules cancel each other out, but others create unique effects and functionalities. Experiment with different configurations to discover everything!

And if you feel like some of your creations are useless... Remember that the customer is always right!

games.name: Swap Meet
games.summary: Trade items until you get your guitar back.

games.name: T7's Basics in Educational
games.summary: Just don't make anything wrong with this game... because T7 will start finding you after the second laptop you collect it, or make wrong answers on the first laptop.

games.name: Tale of the Bullet Knight
games.summary: All these years, piece was lying around on all of these fields. But one day, a sudden sad moment happened, since by fire and monsters our people got threatened. Nor heroes, nor luck was on our side, but a fallen knight, who had depression on his mind. He lost his home, he lost his sword, but he gain a new weapon, and now he ain't bored. In your hand, dear player, the future of our life, hope that you will be able to save all the people, husbands, kids and wives. The journey will have a lot to tell, but for now we just offer you a trial to tell. Shoot your way through the enemy lines, heal your

games.name: The Crossroads
games.summary: Build the tavern where legends never die. A pixel-art idle game that lives in the corner of your desktop; serve drinks, recruit heroes, send them on quests, and grow from a drink serving shack to a ledgendary tavern.

games.name: The Frog Prince
games.summary: The Frog Prince is a 3D physics-based multiplayer platformer where players climb challenging environments, use their tongues to interact with other players, and work together or compete to reach the top.

games.name: The Severed Gods
games.summary: A fantasy roguelite RPG where heroes reincarnate to stop the mystic dragon Umbra. Master turn-based combat, sever giant bosses, and shape your journey through relics and evolving NPC interactions.

games.name: The Somnolent Prince
games.summary:
Goro Akechi's days have all become the same: He wakes up. He watches TV shows, or he reads a book. He leaves his house. He grabs something to eat. He takes the subway. He visits a sleeping Ren Amamiya. He talks to him. He leaves again. He takes the subway again. He… doesn't go home. He goes to Odaiba. He fights. He dies.

…And then he wakes up back home. Again and again.

Every day he hopes the cycle will break, that he will finally be free… and every day he is wrong.

But You can change this. All you have to do is 'Wish' for it. So, press start, and free him from this Fate.

games.name: Touch of Madness
games.summary:
Touch of Madness is a 2D survival horror with 1-bit art. The game is heavily inspired by genre classics, especially Resident Evil and Silent Hill.

Explore the scenarios looking for information and items. Manage your resources through your inventory and survive the horror while trying to uncover the mysteries of the main story.

games.name: Tower of Scherbenmark
games.summary: A turn-based ASCII roguelike RPG set in the shattered dark-fantasy realm of Scherbenmark. Listen for monsters beyond your sight, survive shifting floors, and follow the echoes left by your missing sister Mara into an ancient rift.

games.name: Vortex
games.summary: You just wanted to play a relaxing game of Sudoku, right? Too bad your PC just got infected. VORTEX is a chaotic deck-building roguelike where malware rewrites the rules of the classic puzzle. Build your deck, adapt to the mutating viruses, and survive the digital chaos!

games.name: Wicked Little Witch
games.summary: A city witch lost in the woods, face enemies both familiar and strange. In this Action Roguelite, unlock new characters, collect spells, and build your own playstyle and uncover the truth.

games.name: Witness the Dark #1: Bloody Burger
games.summary: You escaped a serial killer. Now you're hiding in a small town, working night shifts at a burger joint. But the hallucinations won't stop. The customers seem to know you. And in three days, seven people will die. A psychological horror narrative where reality itself cannot be trusted.

games.name: Grounded 2
games.summary: Shrunk again, but the world is much larger. In this open-world, single-player or co-op survival adventure, craft weapons and armor, build your base, and traverse the playground on your buggy. But something else is out there—and it hasn’t forgotten you.

games.name: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered
games.summary: Explore Cyrodiil like never before with stunning new visuals and refined gameplay in The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered.

games.name: Hell Clock
games.summary: Forge powerful builds with endless loot in this relentless combination of Roguelike and ARPG. Blast through dungeons and unleash inhuman powers in a dark fantasy twist on Brazil’s War of Canudos.

games.name: Agent 64: Spies Never Die
games.summary: Relive the golden era of gaming with a retro FPS that captures the essence of 90s console shooters. Embark on a thrilling journey of espionage and action, tackling various objectives while battling cutting-edge 64bit powered enemy AI. Enter a world where bullets and secrets collide!

games.name: No More Room in Hell 2
games.summary: No More Room in Hell 2 is a terrifying 8 player co-op action horror experience. Find your friends in the dark and survive - in a dynamic, endlessly replayable zombie apocalypse.

games.name: Echoes of Mystralia
games.summary: Mages of Mystralia's award-winning spellcrafting system enters a new era. Free Mystralia from the Shadows of the Past in this action-RPG roguelite. Create an infinite variety of spells to save the Memory of the World.

games.name: Sacred 2 Remaster
games.summary:
Step into the world of Ancaria as one of six heroes. Explore a massive open world and master combat arts and spells for epic loot. This remaster brings a fan-favorite back to life — with hi-res textures, better combat and bugfixes, for longtime fans and newcomers alike.

Includes all expansions and updates in one definitive edition.

games.name: Luminary
games.summary: Luminary is a solo or 3 player co-op Openworld Action RPG that creates a balanced, accessible experience for everyone. Using a unique world and character progression system, explore vast hand-crafted lands together, uncover hidden treasures, level up your town, and push back the darkness with light.

games.name: Riftstorm
games.summary: Storms are coming, and there are rules you must follow. RIFTSTORM is co-op looter-shooter set in a world of myth and secret societies where you can play solo or co-op in a party of three.

games.name: Swordcery
games.summary: A colossal blade has pierced the Earth, unleashing a storm of enchanted swords from the heavens. Collect and wield an arsenal of these spellbound blades, turning them against the very force that summoned them. In this roguelike ARPG, you will defy the Celestial evil consuming the world!

games.name: [Herror] Gas Station Case
games.summary:
[HERROR] is a series of short horror episodes where everyday work routines collide with paranormal threats. Each episode is a unique standalone story lasting 1.5–2 hours.

Dan Cooper, a 25-year-old night shift gas station worker in Ohio, recently laid off from a uranium plant, is trying to put his life back together. But everything changes when his friend Michael discovers a mysterious case by the lake. Soon, people begin to vanish in the surrounding woods, and the cozy gas station turns into a deadly trap.

games.name: Hellbound, Inc.
games.summary: HELLBOUND INC is a hellish 2D platformer where you jump & carry packages to deliver against time, demons and HR. Play as an undead courier trapped in a fulfillment center recently purchased by Satan himself.

games.name: King's Well
games.summary:
King's Well is a steampunk-themed roguelite deckbuilder where players use high-stakes poker logic to power industrial machine combat.

After a kingdom falls into ruin due to a gambling plague, the King casts the most notorious gamblers into The Well; a deep, industrial pit filled with rusted machinery and failed experiments. To earn your freedom, you must salvage derelict weapons and "fuel" them using your gambling skills. This time, you aren't playing for money; you are playing for your life.

games.name: Project Looking Glass
games.summary: 1963. A classified experiment. A grieving mother. A signal that won't stop transmitting. Step through the Looking Glass — a first-person psychological horror told through the static of a Cold War-era apparatus that peers into places mankind was never meant to reach.

games.name: Sente
games.summary: Sente is an abstract strategy board game, with electricity, shields, lasers, and explosions, for 2 to 6 players that move simultaneously, where each move can cause a cascade of consequences while the board seeks to regain balance.

games.name: Shelves and Sorcery: Tidy Up the Enchanted Shop
games.summary:
Shelves And Sorcery is a cozy fantasy organization simulator where every shelf, crate, and display is yours to perfect. Restore order to a magical shop overflowing with hundreds of unique items, from enchanted weapons and glowing potions to spellbooks, fresh produce, and curious trinkets.

Whether you enjoy tidying a small corner or spending hours perfecting every display, Shelves And Sorcery offers a relaxing experience built around the simple joy of bringing order to chaos.

games.name: Sword & Shield Simulator
games.summary: When war overtakes your people, it leaves a cruel imprint in the form of hard sacrifice and the crushing of the village. And here you are on the battlefield, confused and distraught, looking for any way to help your people win the battle. But what can you do if you're a simple craftsman?

games.name: Aipom's Great Pirate Adventure
games.summary: Aipom's Great Pirate Adventure is a roguelite-ish, pirate-themed, grid-less, grid-full, treasure-filled, light-hearted, auto-chess fan-game made for the Eevee Expo Game Jam 2026.

games.name: Bean Wizard Eviscerates the Gonklins
games.summary: The world's first twin-stick anthill shooter! Reign terror down on the Gonklins using every bean in your arsenal. Be careful, warrior Gonklins will strike back with their blasters! Upgrade your legume weaponry and defeat King Donklin the Gonklin!

games.name: Blind Touch VR
games.summary: Experience blindness in VR. Navigate a world of darkness using your guide cane, immerse yourself in a sensory journey through sound and touch.

games.name: Crypto Trading Simulator
games.summary: Trade volatile crypto markets in real time, build automation bots, and upgrade your home-office into a capable trading setup. With bills rising and pressure mounting, every decision can push you toward profit or wipe you out.

games.name: Dawn of Horror
games.summary: Dawn of Horror is a high-intensity Action Horror FPS set in the decaying urban sprawl of Cygnus City. Following the collapse of civilization into a digital Dark Age, step into the role of Kage—a survivor seeking vengeance against hordes of Cyber-Zombies and bio-mechanical monstrosities.

games.name: Deathward
games.summary: Seek Death as you face dangerous foes, solve puzzles, and explore forgotten dungeons to become the ultimate necromancer.

games.name: Déclic
games.summary:
DÉCLIC is a peaceful photography adventure focused on exploration, discovery, and interaction. Travel through a charming black-and-white world filled with villages, forests, beaches, wildlife, and mysterious characters, while searching for the perfect moments to capture with your camera.

Explore three different locations, each with its own atmosphere, inhabitants, wildlife, and photography challenges. Wander freely through the Valley of Bruyère, the Forest of Kiiru, and the Beach of Stanhamn while discovering hidden corners and unique subjects.

The game revolves around photography. Use your

games.name: Deep Water
games.summary: Explore a roguelike RPG set in dynamic, procedurally generated mines filled with diverse biomes. Battle relentless monster waves using a mobile base, gather resources to upgrade your crab, and brave the ocean's depths through shifting weather and day-night cycles.

games.name: Depths of Providence
games.summary: Depths of Providence is a turn-based roguelike JRPG through 100 procedurally generated floors. Your party enters at level 1 with empty pockets. Fight down through instant-death depths and escape with rare loot before you lose it all. Bank blue-chest relics forever and climb the daily leaderboard.

games.name: DreamEcho
games.summary: Dream Echo is an RogueLite ARPG game where players can explore the world of Dreams and acquire various Concepts to engage in nearly completely free-form combination battles. Additionally, you can gather Memories upon waking, allowing you to bring some Concepts into your next dream adventure...

games.name: Eon Empires
games.summary: Create and lead your civilization from the Stone Age to a futuristic era. Shape history on customizable maps through war, diplomacy, culture, trade, science, and religion.

games.name: Farming Incremental But With Guns
games.summary: Plant crops and shoot them down with your trusty gun. Earn money, purchase upgrades, and cultivate your farm. Watch your crops physically evolve to gigantic proportions. GROW them. Never stop growing them until their shadows block out the sun forever.

games.name: Finding Polka
games.summary: Set off on a playful search to track down the wandering pup Polka in this game of exploration and serendipity. Meet charming characters, lend them a hand to make new friends, and explore a cozy world sketched in ballpoint pen. You don't need words on this adventure, just smiles and high-fives!

games.name: FishFishFishFishFish
games.summary: An idle game where you upgrade your equipment and catch fish.

games.name: Ghost Battalion
games.summary: Ghost Battalion is a 1st/3rd person shooter, with vehicles, ships, jet packs, multiple sci-fi soldier classes, space battles, and many other cool features.

games.name: Ghost Battalion
games.summary: Early 2000's inspired 1st/3rd-person shooter, with vehicles, ships, jet packs, multiple foot‑soldier classes, space battles, and so much more. The game features a Single-player campaign with several uniquely designed missions, and multiple Multiplayer modes such as Conquest, FreeForAll, and Escape.

games.name: Heart Sequence
games.summary: Roguelike where skills are executed with heartbeats. Build your deck, analyze your options, order skills, and create synergies. Discover powerful items and fight your way through a map full of enemies.

games.name: Heritage
games.summary: Animount has been seized by Drammul, the Lizard King, and his army. The only one capable of stopping them is Oro, the serpent. Trapped in a cycle of reincarnation, choose Scrolls, skills and equipments, and join powerful Sects in this Auto-Battler Roguelike to defeat Drammul and save Animount.

games.name: Hunt Skeletons Together
games.summary: Take on a cursed church in Hell with 1 to 4 players online — co-op or PvP! Hold the line against running, leaping, bone-throwing hordes. Swing above the dead with your grappling hook. Blast off limbs and unlock cosmetics with every kill. Stand together... or hunt each other down.

games.name: Isaac Desulme
games.summary:
Isaac Desulme ; The Basement of Mom is a dark and humorous roguelike dungeon crawler inspired by classic top-down dungeon games. You play as Isaac Desulme, a frightened child who discovers a hidden trapdoor beneath the carpet after his mother locks herself away.

Descend through a series of randomly generated floors filled with dangerous creatures, locked rooms, obstacles, secrets, and increasingly powerful bosses. Clear each room to unlock its doors, explore the dungeon, collect powerful upgrades, and find the boss guarding the way deeper underground.

Isaac attacks by firing tears in differe

games.name: Landscaper Simulator
games.summary: Lawns are wild. Parks are buried in weeds. Streets are littered. The world needs a hero, and that’s where you come in. As the Landscaper, it’s your job to turn disorder into beauty. With your weed whacker, pressure washer, and trash vacuum, you’ll trim, wash, and restore every space to perfection.

games.name: Lin Ling
games.summary:
Lin Ling is a choice‑driven indie visual‑novel game on PC. Step into a realistic‑style story filled with complicated relationships, tough decisions and hidden secrets.

Players will make critical choices that shape the plot and lead you toward multiple different endings. Every decision carries real‑world consequences, and there is no perfectly safe option.

Featuring original hand‑drawn artwork, atmospheric background music and well‑written character dialogues, this narrative experience is great for streaming. Viewers can watch and discuss your in‑game choices, making each playthrough unique a

games.name: Majo
games.summary: Majo is an apocalyptic witch-cultivation strategy RPG featuring a surreal suspense and bizarre style. In the modern, eerie world of Majo, the senses and minds of all humanity have long been manipulated by a mysterious, higher-dimensional force that transcends human comprehension. To prevent the world from perceiving the truth, 'It' appropriated memory fragments from parallel dimensions and combined them with fabricated responses, disguising reality as the 'dreams, intuition, and sixth sense' that the masses accept without question.

games.name: Meat Grinder
games.summary: You’ve opened your own hot dog shop. Prepare, cook, and serve sausages to your customers. But if you run out of stock… you’ll have to get creative. Discover the town’s dark secrets and decide how far you are willing to go to keep your shop running.

games.name: Moros
games.summary: Moros is a first-person sci-fi survival horror game. Explore a mysterious research spaceship, solve environmental puzzles, battle terrifying clone creatures, and uncover the truth behind a failed consciousness transfer mission orbiting Proxima b.

games.name: Mulligans Golf Game
games.summary: Mulligans Golf Game is an Open Map Arcade Golf Game designed to deliver all the true feelings one gets when playing golf with your friends. The experience has been simplified to allow non golfers to play, but provides depth to challenge those looking for more!

games.name: Omen
games.summary: Infiltrate the remnants of a fallen empire in this dark sci-fi isometric action game where extraction meets base defense. Extract valuable loot, establish defenses against hostile fanatics, and unlock the gateway to a dimension of cosmic dread that defies comprehension.

games.name: Regulars
games.summary: Run a late-night diner with up to 8 friends. Seat customers, take orders, and cook meals. Not everyone is who they seem. Study your regulars, spot the anomalies, and decide who gets served and who gets purged.

games.name: Rooster Booster 3D
games.summary: Rooster Booster 3D is a speedy retro platformer! Play through three unique, vaporwave-inspired zones as you optimize your completion time to unlock new characters and earn the Golden Torus!

games.name: Royalty Free-For-All
games.summary: Royalty Free-For-All is a hand-drawn cartoon Party Brawler featuring an original cast of characters inspired by the public domain! Join Dorothy, Sweeney Todd, Mother Goose, and more as they duke it out in hand-drawn platform fighting mayhem!

games.name: Scraps: Hellmouth Creek
games.summary: A scrapbooking adventure. Ride bikes, float down rivers, and explore the woods while capturing photos and arranging your own scrapbook pages.

games.name: Smugg.io
games.summary:
Smugg.io is a browser-based multiplayer deduction game - figure out your opponent's secret character before they figure out yours. Everyone gets a hidden card, and you take turns asking yes/no questions to narrow it down, reading your way to the right guess.

There's also a mode built for streaming: up to 100 viewers team up to interrogate one player live - chat proposes the questions, votes on what to ask, then votes on the final guess. High-pressure, high-chaos, fully collaborative.

Players can also build and share their own custom decks for others to play. No download - runs entirely in-br

games.name: Sneaky Clean
games.summary:
Sneaky Clean is a social deduction cleaning game where not everyone is squeaky clean.
Scrub down a luxury resort and clean up after the ones playing dirty. Play solo or in co-op, with or without troublemakers and prove you're not all washed up !

games.name: Stonewards
games.summary: Stonewards is a solo or co-op mountain-defense roguelite. Protect a bastion and keep your King alive! Dig for resources to unlock character upgrades and fight off waves of monsters.

games.name: The Carcass
games.summary: A deep roguelike colony RPG inside a dead god's corpse. Procedurally generated events, branching narratives, species with unique traits, and meaningful choices that shape your colony's fate. Every playthrough tells a different story of survival and evolution.

games.name: The Comeback King
games.summary: The Comeback King is a light-hearted, mildly satirical retro boxing management game set in the UK in the 1980s. Take on a has-been boxer and manage his career. Decide who he'll fight, train him up and send him into the ring! Can you guide your boxer to a title contest against the division Champion?

games.name: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered - Deluxe Edition
games.summary:
The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered Deluxe Edition includes:
- Digital base game
- Unique digital Akatosh and Mehrunes Dagon Armors, Weapons, and Horse Armor Sets
- Digital Artbook and Soundtrack App
- Shivering Isles and Knights of the Nine story expansions
- Additional downloadable content: Fighter’s Stronghold expansion, Spell Tome Treasures, Vile Lair, Mehrune’s Razor, The Thieves Den, Wizard’s Tower, Orrery, and Horse Pack Armor

games.name: The Lord of the Rings: War in the North - Legacy Edition
games.summary: Step into a darker, grittier Middle-earth. The Lord of the Rings: War in the North - Legacy Edition expands Tolkien’s epic legendarium, delving into the brutal, untold story of Agandaûr, a Black Númenórean and servant of Sauron who has rallied an immense force in the ruins of Fornost.

games.name: The Spirit of Twelve
games.summary: One summer night a mysterious object crash lands in Nidelium, the kingdom where our tale begins. The King and his Wizard retrieves it and returns it to the castle. The wizard inspects it but does not know what it is. He however has an ominous feeling and decides to consult with his guild. That night a thief, looking to steal from the Wizard, seizes the object but mysteriously decides to commits suicide by jumping from the window in the room where the object was kept. The golden band which surrounds the object is ripped off as it crashes on the ground and break in half. The broken shards of the

games.name: The Unclosed Case
games.summary: A psychological detective thriller. Everyone has already decided who did it. You don't have to. Investigate a double death, question everyone who loved them, and discover how much you can trust your own mind.

games.name: Tiny Monster Haven
games.summary: A cozy idle creature collector that sits on your desktop as you go about your day. Grow crops, care for and level-up your companions and put them to the test in wild monster battles!

games.name: Void Salvage
games.summary: Salvage derelict ships, uncover strange points of interest, and survive hostile ambushes in this incremental auto-combat game. Upgrade your ship, collect loot, stack wild synergies, and become absurdly overpowered.

games.name: Warhounds
games.summary: Warhounds is a turn-based tactics game about an elite mercenary squad with an old-school action movie vibe, inspired by XCOM and Jagged Alliance. Recruit unique fighters, upgrade your base, and fight for Africa’s future. No fake RNG - only true ballistics and lethal tactics.

games.name: Yo Skater
games.summary: A 2D precision platformer/endless skateboarding game that lets you ollie, flip, grind and yoyo your way through an infinite range of terrain, traps and obstacles!

games.name: Z-Sector
games.summary: Z-Sector is an intense zombie wave shooter. Push back endless hordes, get tactical upgrades, and rule global leaderboards. How many waves will you survive? Master your arsenal and become the ultimate survivor!

games.name: Zombie Cam Body Cam Shooter
games.summary: Step into the most intense post-apocalyptic survival experience with ZOMBIE CAM BODY CAM SHOOTER – an action-packed game that pushes your adrenaline to the limit, seen directly through the lens of a body-mounted camera. In a city ravaged by an outbreak that turned most of the population into aggressive creatures, you’ll fight to survive in the most nerve-wracking encounters with brutal, relentless enemies.

games.name: Akatori
games.summary: A colorful action platformer with metroidvania elements and a staff that unlocks unique combat techniques and new ways to overcome obstacles. Explore beautiful worlds, fight monsters, and help Mako stop the amber storms that poison all living things.

games.name: Agefield High: Rock the School
games.summary: Relive your High School days in the town of Agefield. It’s the early 2000s and you have three months left at school. So REBEL with your friends, win over your dream girl and ROCK the school!

games.name: Greedy Greedy Gnomes
games.summary: A short incremental game set in a sleepy RPG town. Smash pots, recruit gnomes, raid mines, unlock upgrades, and optimize everything until you’re FILTHY STINKING RICH!

games.name: Security 51
games.summary: You're a security officer deep within Area 51. Scan the staff, verify clearances, and decide who can enter the elevator and who absolutely mustn't leave. The deeper you go, the less certain you are that anyone standing before you is still human.

games.name: The Cave Diver
games.summary: Crawl down a suffocating cave system using only your arms in this punishing physics-horror adventure. What morbid force is calling you deeper into the heart of the caves?
