games.name: Hariti
games.summary: "Hariti" is a first-person psychological horror game. You will play as a mother searching for her missing daughter in a crisis-ridden hospital. Experience an atmosphere of extreme dread within the halls of this abandoned Chinese-style medical facility.

games.name: Hovertron
games.summary: Hoverboard your way through a physics-based platformer. Easy to learn but hard to master; Flow and flip through a series of levels to chase perfect runs. Compete on a global scoreboard, or hunt down the secrets hidden throughout the game.

games.name: Ignoble
games.summary: Destroy enemies and harvest blood, bones, and marrow to grow stronger, unlock forbidden skills, and wipe out the Ignoble tyrants who dare threaten your master.

games.name: Palm Sugar: A Village Story
games.summary: Embark on a pixel RPG journey in 'పల్లెటూరు - PalmSugar.' Battle drug lords, wield unique weapons, and immerse yourself in South Indian culture. Telugu & English localization. Will you save the village?

games.name: Pro Jank Footy
games.summary: Pro Jank Footy is an over-the-top arcade comedy-sports game. Score goals to unleash game-changing power-ups, build a deck of absurd abilities, and tackle a season where no two matches are ever the same—solo or with your mates.

games.name: Star Chef Simulator
games.summary:
Welcome to Star Chef Simulator, where your dream of running your own restaurant is about to become a reality! Immerse yourself in the exciting world of culinary entrepreneurship as you build and manage your restaurant from the ground up. Unleash your inner chef and dive in the art of cooking with more than 10 delicious dishes from around the world. Cook with a variety of different ingredients, techniques and recipes to create culinary masterpieces that will delight your customers. Use various kitchen appliances such as the deep fryer, oven, stove or mixer and create unique dishes!

Hire, train

games.name: Verde
games.summary: Build a small town of seedlets, mysterious seed like creatures in this cozy city builder. Build facilities, put up decorations, and help the seedlets thrive!

games.name: A Hole in my Room
games.summary: Explore a mysterious place and an atmospheric world filled with horrifying and unusual environments in this first-person psychological horror game. Find hidden objects, solve puzzles, hide from darkness, and enjoy a unique experience in the horror genre.

games.name: Academy: Become a Hero
games.summary: Time-based challenges, precise jumps, and special abilities in an immersive academy to become the next hero.

games.name: AfterMove
games.summary: Move one piece. Everything else moves with you. AfterMove is a minimalist puzzle game where every piece on the board follows its own rule — find the sequence that wins. 180+ hand-crafted levels. Quietly merciless, deeply satisfying.

games.name: AI2U: With You 'Til The End
games.summary:
Cute catgirl Eddie, pretty witch Elysia, and stunning AI hologram Estelle all seem to adore you—perhaps to a fault! Learn what makes them tick by exploring their homes and talking to them about nearly anything.

An overarching storyline looms over your adventures together, connecting your narrative to the dynamic NPCs. Solve puzzles and unravel mysteries alongside your lethally charming companions.

Your words and actions shape the outcome of each round, with a variety of endings waiting at the end of each playthrough. Strategize to unlock the best outcome and whisk your captors away!

games.name: Airport Manager Simulator 2026
games.summary: Take full control of a busy international airport. Manage passengers, baggage, aircraft servicing, and flight schedules while operating real ground equipment. Balance efficiency, safety, and satisfaction in a fast-paced aviation experience.

games.name: Alien Bloom
games.summary: Alien Bloom is a three-player turn-based strategy card game in which rival factions compete for control of Earth. Players expand across a world map, attack territories, resolve battles using card-game mechanics, deploy spaceships, and pursue multiple victory conditions.

games.name: App Developer Tycoon
games.summary: Quit your job. Build apps from your bedroom. Beat your rivals, survive the rent, and claw your way from a spare room to a Silicon Valley HQ. A turn-based narrative tycoon about the indie developer grind.

games.name: Author Sim
games.summary: Have you ever dreamed of becoming a world-renowned author? Now's your chance! Study masterpieces from other authors, craft breathtaking stories, and maintain a public profile in pursuit of your dream.

games.name: Backrooms: The Incident
games.summary: Backrooms: The Incident is a cooperative horror game for 14 players. On your own or with friends, you'll explore the game world, trying to figure out what's going on, where you are, how to get out of there, and whether it's even possible.

games.name: Big Bad Pharma
games.summary: A cosy pharmacy-stocking sim with a wicked streak. Clock in, sort the shelves, chase satisfying upgrades, and slowly climb the corporate ladder of a pharmacy that maybe shouldn't exist. Tidy. Satisfying. A little bit evil.

games.name: Block Catching
games.summary: An online game of block catching with a twist. The catcher is not your friend.

games.name: Boil Cabbage Make Soup
games.summary: A cosy idler starring an Onion who makes soup anywhere on your desktop! Watch him grow and harvest cabbages to make delicious soup for a cast of colourful customers. Decorate your island and customise your Onion with your hard-earned gold to level him up, and build your very own soup making empire!

games.name: Burnstation
games.summary:
Deck-burning. Score-chasing. Roguelike in stile plinko.
As a runner, you aim your 4 marbles, trigger retro cartridges, and chain explosive combos to push your score higher and higher. But push your deck too far, and it burns out.

games.name: Casino of Time
games.summary: Casino of Time is a roguelike game where you gamble with your time. Your time ticks down and you must try to earn enough time to survive as long as possible in the casino. A variety of permanent upgrades is provided every 2 minutes to tilt the odds in your favour!

games.name: Chainsaw
games.summary: Become a God in this real-time turn-based combat RPG with non-stop brawling. Chainsaw is a game where you must create strategies and prepare your team before each battle, because once combat begins, enemies will keep attacking without stopping.

games.name: Chronime Puzzle: Dogs
games.summary: Chronime Puzzle: Dogs is a relaxing puzzle game featuring beautiful steampunk anime-inspired artwork.

games.name: Cowgirl Maid Milk Cafe
games.summary: Move to the city, start a small business, and build a new life—with your two cowgirl maids! Run your cafe, delve dungeons for resources, train new staff, milk your cowgirls... and more!

games.name: Dark DieMansion
games.summary: A fast paced survival horror game: Escape a dark, randomly generated mansion where creatures stalk you in the shadows. Outsmart them by manipulating the environment, restoring the power, and scavenging supplies to survive.

games.name: Desperate Gambling
games.summary: Win to survive. In this cursed establishment, every chip buys you time. Play blackjack or roulette, open mystery crates to equip powerful artifacts, and survive long enough to discover what lurks in the thick fog.

games.name: Dinotica
games.summary: Dinotica is a sandbox roguelike set in a mysterious prehistoric world. Tame and collect dinosaur companions, build your own refuge, and combine farming, crafting, exploration, and combat. Play solo or team up in co-op to face challenges together. With roguelike progression and high replayability, every run feels unique.

games.name: Dorts: A Darts Roguelike
games.summary: First-person darts roguelike. Throw darts. Earn gold. Buy upgrades. Survive the chaos.

games.name: Dwarven Rampart
games.summary: Dwarven Rampart is a Fantasy strategy game where you build your Dwarven town, raise massive armies, and choose your enemies to fight against. How long can you survive?

games.name: Full Bet: Fighting Casino
games.summary: A 1v1 turn-based fighting card battle set in a casino!Bet your chips and fight for the right to strike!Luck and strategy, nerve and intellect—everything will be tested ina thrilling battle where the tide can turn in an instant.Outplay your opponent, seize victory, and claim your rewards!

games.name: G.O.D. Global Orbital Defense
games.summary: Take control of the G.O.D. system, the U.P.A.’s tactical satellite. Orbiting in silence above Vel’Aris, your mission is to protect the planet from every threat. Manage orbital fire. But remember: G.O.D. sees everything... even what you wish remained buried.

games.name: Ghost Soul M
games.summary:
Ghost M is a mobile MMORPG developed by the Korean gaming company Mgame, built on the foundation of the classic online game Ghost Online.

Inheriting the original world, the game seamlessly blends Eastern martial arts with supernatural folklore. It features a charming 2D pixel art style, bringing to life adorable chibi characters and flashy combat skills. Players can now dive into the thrill of exorcising demons and conquering the mystical martial world right from their mobile devices!

games.name: Gold Up
games.summary: Gold Up is a physics-driven online co-op climbing adventure where two players must carry a treasure to the surface by switching roles, throwing it upward, and coordinating every move. Success depends entirely on trust, timing, and teamwork.

games.name: Grainhold
games.summary: Grainhold is an open world mining game where player build their own settlement, which they must then defend against waves of enemy attacks. To construct buildings, players must gather resources and grow vegetables, which they can sell to buy better equipment from the merchant.

games.name: Hell Galaxy
games.summary: Hell Galaxy is the only game where you can experience the fusion of space battles, eerie specters, and daunting titans. This unique gameplay offers a mix of action, horror, and space exploration. Engage in dynamic mining, looting, and crafting while traversing an RPG-influenced cosmos.

games.name: Junkyard Saints: Scrapstorm
games.summary: Survive endless scrapstorms in a post-apocalyptic Bullet Heaven Action Roguelite. Build devastating loadouts, collect procedural gear, awaken powerful Saints, recruit companions, conquer dungeons, and create insane synergies in a world where scrap is sacred.

games.name: Konekomi Castle
games.summary: Fifty years in the future, a plucky investigator named Pandora is caught in a snowstorm. Seeking shelter, she unknowingly steps into Konekomi Castle, finding mysterious, one-eyed aliens. You'll need to earn trust, tell lies, and befriend strangers to unearth the castle's extraordinary secrets.

games.name: Limbot
games.summary: Limbot is a super silly, physics-driven game about controlling the limbs of a person dressed as a giant cardboard robot! Master all four limbs in solo or embrace the chaos (and camaraderie) of couch co-op play, in this fully destructible cardboard world!

games.name: Magic Cards Duel
games.summary: A fast-paced magic card game for 2 to 4 players. Use unique abilities to outplay opponents, make tactical choices, and control the match through skillful play.

games.name: Majo
games.summary: Majo is an apocalyptic witch-cultivation strategy RPG featuring a surreal suspense and bizarre style. In the modern, eerie world of Majo, the senses and minds of all humanity have long been manipulated by a mysterious, higher-dimensional force that transcends human comprehension. To prevent the world from perceiving the truth, 'It' appropriated memory fragments from parallel dimensions and combined them with fabricated responses, disguising reality as the 'dreams, intuition, and sixth sense' that the masses accept without question.

games.name: Mandate Order
games.summary: Mandate Order is a strategy game set in the Warring States period. Starting from barren lands, build strongholds integrating production, defense and military functions. Manage resources and the people's will, expand your territory, counter threats, and ultimately rise to prominence amidst the chaos.

games.name: Minerals: Deep Core Mining
games.summary: Mine the vast underground and collect ores and gemstones—collect! collect! collect like crazy! “Minerals: Deep Core Mining” is an over-the-top mining game with roguelite elements. Use the resources you gather to upgrade your abilities and take on an endless underground that changes with every run!

games.name: My Tsundere Sister
games.summary: The sequel to "My Cold Girlfriend" is here! Live under the same roof with your tsundere cousin sister sporting red twin tails, experience her daily quiet care beneath her sharp tongue, and unlock exclusive sweet and heartwarming summer moments.

games.name: Night of Restoration
games.summary: Night of Restoration is a short horror game with 1 ending and 2 possible deaths.

games.name: No Knock
games.summary: Break in through the back door, think like a thief, win with theft. Bypass the locks, steal everything, and disappear without a trace! Begin in the gutter, end with the crown — steal your way to the top.

games.name: Old Coin Pusher Gaiden
games.summary: Old Coin Pusher Friends new evolution: coin-pusher RPG. Train samurai, prepare Action Spheres, explore enemy-filled caves. Shoot coins for rewards.

games.name: Oops! Simulator
games.summary: Oops! Simulator is an absurd slice-of-life game about trying to get home. Ordinary actions lead to unpredictable accidents, strange events, and hilarious outcomes in a world that refuses to stay normal.

games.name: Pets Survivors
games.summary: Fend off waves of monsters as a dog, cat, chicken and other unlockable furry or feathered friends!

games.name: Pool Cleaning Simulator
games.summary: Pool Cleaning Simulator will give you the chance to become a one-person pool cleanup company that removes pool contamination, replaces filters, the disinfection and sanitizing of the pool environment in an unusual way!

games.name: Potato Simulato
games.summary:
Welcome to Potato Simulato: Together , a chaotic physics-based platformer where you play as a helpless potato trying to survive a world full of traps, madness, and pure frustration.

Roll, jump, and struggle your way through bizarre obstacle courses filled with spinning hammers, deadly spikes, collapsing platforms, and completely unfair surprises. One mistake… and it’s back to the start.

This game is not about skill alone , it’s about patience, timing, and how much rage you can handle.

games.name: Province: Suroste
games.summary: Province: Suroste is a handcrafted retro open-world RPG inspired by classic fantasy adventures. Explore a low-fantasy world, investigate a mysterious murder, fight dangerous enemies, trade with merchants, and uncover the secrets of a living world built entirely by a solo developer.

games.name: Quantum Hell
games.summary: Take on the role of a journalist trapped in a ruthless quantum universe where you'll need a diverse arsenal and the manipulation of quantum physics to survive and progress. Quick thinking, speed, and precision will be essential to surviving in this retro style physics FPS

games.name: Rage Bait
games.summary: Mechanics, you can play first person or 3rd person. puzzle simulator with funny dialouge. It's a walking simulator with narrative choices for different outcomes and is a meta comedy like Stanley parable.

games.name: Red Tape Rampage
games.summary: You're the boss of bureaucracy. Exploit interns, automate the red tape and climb the corporate ladder in this satirical idle empire builder.

games.name: Rogue Drone
games.summary:
Rogue Drone is a top-down sci-fi strategy game that blends tower defense, base building, and resource management into a single survival loop.

Gather resources and expand your outpost during the day, then defend it against escalating waves of hostile drones at night. Build and optimize your base layout, manage energy distribution, and deploy defensive systems to withstand increasingly dangerous attacks.

Harvest crystal resources, refine them into higher tiers, and unlock new technologies to strengthen your defenses. Every decision shapes your long-term survival as enemy waves grow in complexi

games.name: Ruin
games.summary: Ruin is a free to play survival sci-fi sandbox MMORPG indie game where you try to survive on mankinds attempt to colonize a distant planet. Chances are stacked against you, but don't give up. You are most likely the last human alive. It is up to you and you alone to do what you must to stay alive.

games.name: S.O.L School Of Labyrinth
games.summary: A dungeon crawl RPG set in an otherworldly realm beneath an old school building. Explore again and again, restore your base, and find your way back to everyday life.

games.name: Silent Shark
games.summary: A tactical, map-based WWII submarine sim set in the Pacific Theater: Approach, intercept, strike unseen, withdraw into the deep. With realistic instruments, a Torpedo Data Computer (TDC), and including a full campaign with missions, patrol zones, radio intel, and more.

games.name: Souls Runner
games.summary: Souls Runner is a 3D Hell escape game. Trapped souls cooperate in local or online multiplayer, using hooks, rolls, and ground pounds to conquer traps and evade The Pursuer.

games.name: Sparkle Saga
games.summary: Mina was on an ordinary school field trip to the museum, when all of a sudden, monsters from another dimension invaded the museum. Mina stumbles upon an ancient artifact, a wand on display. The wand then transforms her into a magical girl.

games.name: Storehand
games.summary: Storehand is a cozy stocking game about organizing 6,298 grocery items across 14 aisles and shaping your own store layout. Map custom aisles, unlock helpful abilities, and enjoy free‑placement mode as you relax and build the perfect shop of your dreams.

games.name: Sunder Siege
games.summary: A short incremental physics game. Swing a wrecking ball to smash monsters before they reach your home! Upgrade your ball and your home for more smashy goodness!

games.name: Survival Log
games.summary: The apocalypse is here, and you saw it coming. Survival Log is an urban survival game about preparation and foresight. Hoard supplies, reinforce your home, and optimize every run before zombies flood the city. Every failure becomes experience. You must adapt and survive this time.

games.name: Sweyet Dreaming Emulator the Familiar Discomfort of the Unpredictable
games.summary: Learn to live without control while solving dynamic dream scape that change through real-life blinks.

games.name: The Merchant's Eden
games.summary: In The Merchant's Eden, you build a town around a thriving market. Defend your citizens and traveling merchants against raiding bandits. A minimalist game blending cozy city-building and intense tower-defense as you grow and protect your town.

games.name: The One Fish
games.summary: An online co-op game for 1-4 players where you fish with your friends to feed The One Fish! Catch fish of all shapes, sizes, and whimsical effects to keep up with its ever-growing appetite.

games.name: Tileweaver
games.summary: A Tile-placer Roguelike with Puzzle elements. Build your board, empower yourself and slay monsters in this dark strategic game. Discover a variety of arcane skills and enigmatic artifacts to control the board and delve ever deeper into the abyss.

games.name: Tough Cat
games.summary: This is a horde shooter. Earn coins by surviving as long as possible. Spend coins in the shop to unlock permanent upgrades outside runs, which is one of the core gameplay loops.

games.name: Tung
games.summary: Tung is a niche and tuff first person horror game where you explore a hedge maze and become friends with triple t.

games.name: Vaulted Valor
games.summary: You are in a post-apocalyptic underground vault where every decision carries weight. As you embark on quests and unravel a deep, twisting story, your actions will permanently alter the lives of your fellow inhabitants.

games.name: Weed Supermarket Simulator
games.summary: Grow weed and grow your business! Run your own weed supermarket, manage stock, set prices, and help customers. Try new strains, choose the best products, upgrade your shop, and keep your store running smoothly so people always come back.

games.name: Xam Delivery
games.summary: Drive your van through routes filled with obstacles and unexpected events, delivering pizzas and decoders to various apartment buildings across the city.

games.name: Duskfade
games.summary: Duskfade is a colorful adventure in a world where the torments of the past haunt you. Battle against your memories in a dizzying dance to fade the shadows of the dusk.

games.name: Hell Let Loose: Vietnam
games.summary: Step into the explosive fury of war with Hell Let Loose: Vietnam. Play a decisive role in one of the most iconic conflicts in history with expansive 50v50 player battles, where teamwork, tactics and an arsenal of destructive weapons combine to shape the battlefield in your favour.

games.name: Wild Blue Skies
games.summary: Wild Blue Skies reimagines the classic on-rail adventures of the '90s. Join Bowie Stray and the Blue Bombers as they soar through the skies on a mission to save the world in this action-packed, nostalgic journey!

games.name: Cloverpit
games.summary:
You wake up in a rusty, narrow cell, standing over a dangerously unstable grate.

Someone has kidnapped you, demanding payment, and your only way out is to play the Slot Machine and pay off your debt.

Don’t let yourself fall —literally— into ruin!

games.name: Low-Budget Repairs
games.summary: Manage renovations in 90s apartment blocks! Focus on quick profit and cut costs wherever possible. Client notices defects? Tough luck, the money's already in your pocket. Every day brings new challenges and decisions that can lead to fortune... or trouble!

games.name: Clawed
games.summary: Embark on a covert mission to the dinosaur theme park Prehistoria, where you must explore the park's grounds to scavenge resources, solve puzzles, and fight your way through diverse biomes, underground tunnels and deadly enclosures. But beware, you are not the apex predator here.

games.name: Defender of the Crown: The Legend Returns
games.summary: The legendary medieval strategy adventure has returned - enhanced for a new generation of knights. Conquer provinces, raise armies, storm castles, and influence the balance of power through bold strategy and action moments.

games.name: BlazBlue: Entropy Effect X
games.summary: In BlazBlue Entropy Effect X, you’ll face off against surging hordes across ever-shifting dimensions in an action-focused roguelike platform adventure. The Sea of Possibility is envisioned as a descent through multiple levels, each filled with threats you’ll need to suppress while harvesting Shards of Possibility. Along the way, you’ll uncover a completely new, original story that expands the BlazBlue Entropy Effect X universe in unexpected ways. Read the swarm, weave through danger, and strike back with combos and strings that never let up.

games.name: Servant of the Lake
games.summary: Servant of the Lake is the new premium point-and-click adventure in the Rusty Lake series from the creators of the Cube Escape series, The Past Within and Underground Blossom.

games.name: Sandustry
games.summary: Sandustry is a mining and automation game with sand physics. Explore a destructible world, digging and demolishing. Build a sand-processing factory and expand your logistics network. Delve deeper into the mines, unlock new technologies, and discover an ancient civilization's secrets.

games.name: Tyrant's Realm
games.summary: Tyrant's Realm is a challenging action roguelike. Fill your arsenal with weapons and armor each with their unique gameplay mechanics. Tread carefully in this dark fantasy world because every enemy you face could be your end.

games.name: Creepshow
games.summary: Get lost in a deliciously dark horror anthology. Inspired by Shudder’s Creepshow series, this point-and-click adventure has gone all kinds of wrong.

games.name: Future Knight
games.summary: Frenetic action and LCD aesthetic! In this 2D Shoot 'Em Up, switch between a robot hero and his benign tumor to stop a bizarre cult. You have 8 hours to save humanity's memory: defeat grotesque bosses, ride the skies on your Future Board, and master the chaos in a retro-futuristic Tokyo.

games.name: Madden NFL 27
games.summary: Run the league one decision at a time in EA Sports Madden NFL 27, powered by the all-new Persona Engine.

games.name: Menherarium
games.summary:
This game is a deck-building roguelite where you must keep winning blood-staked Cee-lo against a super clingy girl.

Modify the dice faces, use cheating items when necessary, and overcome her unreasonable demands to win the bets.

Your goal is to survive the life-and-death Cee-lo.

games.name: Tower Dominion
games.summary: In this roguelike tower defense, repel waves of enemies by shaping the paths, customizing your defense and adapting your strategy to crush the invading swarms. No two playthroughs are the same and each strategic decision in this treacherous world could lead to survival or utter defeat.

games.name: Bootstrap Island
games.summary: Stranded in the 17th century after a brutal shipwreck, you awaken alone on a deadly tropical island. To survive, you’ll need to learn fast - facing wild beasts, nature’s wrath, and uncovering secrets hidden deep in the jungle. Every step is a fight for your life.

games.name: Dagger Directive
games.summary: Dagger Directive is a tactical FPS that allows you to approach each mission in your own way. Select equipment, decide the time of day, then move methodically to complete your mission. Enjoy the modern mechanics and old school graphics as you fight across a variety of missions and environments.

games.name: Flock of the Seraphim
games.summary: Adopt gun-wielding angels that help you exorcise waves demons in this horde survival roguelite. Gain power by purging depraved demonic enemies, collecting loot, and improving your flock to create unique builds of holy power. Do you have enough faith to survive?

games.name: Ledgerbound
games.summary: The world may end, but more importantly: your job is on the line. Step onto the battlefield, befriend (and fall in love with) a ragtag crew of heroes, and go head-to-head against an immortal foe to protect the bureaucratic kingdom you love in this hilarious narrative-driven tactics RPG.

games.name: Memoirium
games.summary: Traverse a chaotic and crumbling realm of dreams composed of liminal spaces. Adapt to the world’s odd rules as a Dreamer, and defy others like you to escape the strange and eclectic subconscious landscape.

games.name: Nightmare Shift
games.summary: Nightmare Shift is a psychological horror game that follows a female protagonist who starts a new job as a motel receptionist, only to find her life spiraling into a dark and mysterious reality. As she questions her sanity, she must uncover the truth behind the eerie and abnormal events around her.

games.name: Scratch the Ticket
games.summary: Scratch the Ticket is a first‑person incremental gambling sim where every ticket is a test of nerves. Print tickets, scratch cells, and decide: cash out now or risk it all. The outcome depends only on your choice.

games.name: Soul's Remnant
games.summary: Soul's Remnant is a 2D platformer MMORPG focused on social gameplay and exploration! Customize your character, and conquer dungeons and bosses in this mysterious world. Play with friends or make new ones - just watch out when night falls!

games.name: Stack Mates
games.summary: Stack Mates is a co-op puzzle-platformer for 2-8 players built on teamwork and pure chaos. Shift your form between horizontal and vertical, climb on your friends, and reach the portal together. Remember, if even one person fails, everyone starts over!

games.name: Storm Horse Simulator
games.summary: Run wild and free! Become an untamed stallion in a cozy open-world adventure and set out to rescue your captive family. Outsmart patrols, build a safe haven for your growing herd, and form an unbreakable bond with a native friend. Your homeland awaits - answer the call of the wild!

games.name: The Box of Fear
games.summary: A missing daughter. A father without answers. A suspicious company. Solve puzzles, connect clues, and discover what "The Box" hides in this first-person psychological horror.

games.name: Void Authority
games.summary: A sci-fi roguelike document-inspection game where you approve or deny alien travelers, scan for contraband, and navigate shifting galactic laws across border outposts, with each run shaping the future political climate.

games.name: Wild West Miner Simulator
games.summary: You've become the sheriff of a town that... doesn't exist. Nobody lives here, the governor's stupid joke. It's time to get to work and turn this NOWHERE into a bustling metropolis. Mine coal, ore, and gold. Build houses, find oil, bring in new residents, create a paradise in the middle of nowhere.

games.name: 100Friends
games.summary: The Loneliness Epidemic is coming, and only you and your hundred closest friends can stop it. Rally your party, fight back the Legions of Sadness, and bring the world back together once and for all...

games.name: 999 Hidden Cats: Brazil Together
games.summary: 999 hidden cats and 444 adorable objects are waiting for you on large hand-drawn maps. Explore animated scenes and test your attention in detail-filled worlds. Enjoy a cozy, relaxing experience alone or with a friend.

games.name: Agrocracy
games.summary: A farming management game focused on planning and numbers. This is not a farming sim - no driving, animals, or role-playing. Manage weather, labor, capital, and time on a large isometric map.

games.name: Anime Fitness: Summer Sweat
games.summary: Train with pro anime trainers, push your limits, and get stronger with every session! Choose your trainer, level, and jump into 30 minutes of intense full-body workouts.

games.name: Anvillage
games.summary: In Anvillage you are a knight that needs to build a village by harvesting woods and stones. You will also be building tons of buildings and crafting equipment and other itens.

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Pinball Action
games.summary: Video game pinball with four separate tables!

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: V'Ball
games.summary:
V'Ball is an action game released by Technos Japan in 1988.
Control two young men as they enter a beach volleyball tournament and aim for the championship.
Enjoy a variety of actions, such as controlling where the ball flies during serves and spikes, or delivering a more powerful spike by tapping rapidly.
This is the story of their success. The rest of the story is up to you.

games.name: Arcade Archives: Touki Denshou Angel Eyes
games.summary:
The player must win fierce battles against powerful opponents for the title of "Archangel".

"TOUKI DENSHOU ANGEL EYES" is a fighting game released by TECMO in 1996. The player must win fierce battles against powerful opponents for the title of "Archangel".
You can use super special moves and special techniques to gain an advantage in battle when your emotional gauge reaches its peak.

games.name: Arknights
games.summary: Take on the role of a key member of Rhodes Island, a pharmaceutical company that fights both a deadly infection and the unrest it leaves in its wake. Together with your leader Amiya, you’ll recruit Operators, train them, then assign them to various operations to protect the innocent and resist those who would thrust the world into turmoil.

games.name: Ashes of Paradise
games.summary: Ashes of Paradise is an open-world exploration game blending Medieval, Oriental, and Nordic themes. Defeat powerful bosses and embark on a unique journey in this cooperative action-survival RPG.

games.name: Baby Kings
games.summary: Escape a dangerous dungeon with your friends as royal babies. Solve puzzles, dodge traps and laugh through chaotic co-op action for 2–8 players!

games.name: Banzai Escape 2: Subterranean
games.summary: Banzai Escape 2 Subterranean is an anime third-person action shooter and a sequel based after the events of Banzai Escape 2

games.name: Blackjack Roulette
games.summary: Blackjack rogue-like with a Roulette "spin". Purchase Insurance Policies with unique abilities give you the edge while taking on a larger Roulette wheels with even larger Buy-In Costs.

games.name: Bunnimon
games.summary: Bunnimon is a cozy yet mysterious adventure where puzzles, spirits, and the secrets of a fractured world collide. Dive into Pocket, a handcrafted realm on the brink, where you'll calm ancient guardians and guide lost Wanderers back to themselves.

games.name: Car Dealership Manager 2026
games.summary:
Buy. Repair. Sell.
Build the ultimate car dealership empire.

games.name: Card of Arcana
games.summary: Embark on a magical roguelike card adventure where every choice shapes your journey. Build powerful decks, discover mystical artifacts, battle dangerous foes.

games.name: Choice of Life: Floors
games.summary: Choice of Life: Floors is a psychological horror detective game where every choice shapes your story. An elevator descends through the endless floors of your own home, leading you into a game against your own mind. Each step brings you closer to escape… or to madness

games.name: Choppa: Rescue Rivals
games.summary: Choppa: Rescue Rivals is a chaotic arcade-style helicopter rescue competition game for one to four players. Take off with your trusty rescue chopper and carry disaster victims to safety before your rivals!

games.name: Circuit Stance
games.summary: Circuit Stance is a turn-based strategy game that blends creativity and tactical depth. Players take on the role of a super AI, programming robot AI chips to craft unique strategies, competing in intense arena battles to secure resources and glory.

games.name: Citadel: Gunship Sandbox MMO
games.summary:
Citadel is a gunship sandbox MMO set inside a huge machine world at war.

Players take ships into short missions to fight, mine, haul cargo, salvage wrecks, protect convoys, or raid other players. Every mission affects the same shared world.

Ships, weapons, and goods are built and traded by players. When cargo reaches its destination, supplies grow. When a ship is destroyed, it is permanently lost. When a faction wins ground, new routes and missions can open while others close.

The mission ends, but its results do not reset. Every delivery, loss, battle, and captured objective changes prices

games.name: Clown's Lair
games.summary: Explore a haunted house stalked by a sinister clown. Stay hidden, solve puzzles, destroy cursed objects, and escape before your pursuer catches you.

games.name: Colorizing: Pleasure
games.summary: Coloring by numbers game for relaxation

games.name: Console Archives: Touki Denshou Angel Eyes
Cosmic Coop
games.summary: 'Cosmic Coop', an alien farming/creature collector odyssey! Lure Critterlings with captivating objects, establish harmonious ecosystems, and ward off invaders. Delve into mines, craft for your farm, and chat with quirky native creatures. More than farming – it's deep cosmic bonding.

games.name: Crayon Friends
games.summary: Color your own cute animal friends with colorful crayons!

games.name: Cropia
games.summary: Build and manage every aspect of your farm in Cropia. Cultivate crops, care for animals, fish, mine resources, and explore diverse environments, all while supporting and expanding the growth of the local community. Hire the town citizen to help you work effectively and efficiently.

games.name: Cruise Adventure: Hidden Journey - Collector's Edition
games.summary: Luxury. Romance. Ocean.

games.name: Dead Stop: No Vacancy
games.summary: Dead Stop - No Vacancy is a short first-person horror game set in an isolated roadside motel. Explore the Paradise Motel, uncover its disturbing history, solve environmental puzzles, and survive a night in which something has gone terribly wrong.

games.name: Decimation
games.summary: Sci-fi tower defense meets ARPG-like hero combat. Build towers then fight alongside them with your hero as you battle through a campaign to uncover the fate of a colonization effort on a distant planet.

games.name: Dinosaur
games.summary: Create your own island without limits. Populate your island with dinosaurs, choose from over 50 species. Ensure the mutual symbiosis and prosperity of all species on the island.

games.name: Dinotica
games.summary: Embark on an adventure across a perilous ancient land, exploring diverse regions to discover and hatch loyal dinosaur companions. Together, you'll fight, build, farm, and more, as you work toward creating a unique home that is truly your own.

games.name: Dominocalypse
games.summary: The puzzle roguelike that makes dominoes actually fun! Move, manipulate, and match using absurd tile modifiers, game-changing artifacts, and unique starting loadouts for endless chaos and replayability.

games.name: Dot Clicker
games.summary: An immersive aim training game set in a Neo-Japanese landscape. It focused on season-based addictive precision challenges with rewards but also features a narrative alongside with a leaderboard for the top aimers and aiming communities.

games.name: DragonFire: Defense
games.summary: Choose your dragon and defend your castle against endless waves in a systems-driven roguelite. Level up to draft perks, loot chests, and build upgradeable walls as you adapt to shifting enemy compositions and push your run as far as skill allows.

games.name: Dream House Cleaning
games.summary: Bring forgotten places back to life in a cozy cleaning and restoration game! Clean dirt and trash, repair damaged areas, decorate interiors with furniture, and enjoy a relaxing experience at your own pace.

games.name: Drink Factory Simulator
games.summary: Build your own drink factory, discover recipes, improve production, and fulfill customer orders to grow your beverage empire! Drink Factory Simulator is a fun simulation game that combines creativity and strategy.

games.name: Dwarven Forge
games.summary: Master the depths in Dwarven Forge. Use your fireball-flinging lantern to clear paths and mine rare ores. Incrementally upgrade your digging power, node yields, and forging skills to craft and sell legendary weapons. Descend, optimize, and unlock the secrets of the ancient mountain.

games.name: Eggconsole Onryou Senki PC-8801mkIISR
games.summary: Use your deductive powers to battle spirits in this unique Miyaji City horror adventure!

games.name: Emergency Room Simulator
games.summary: In "Emergency Room Simulator" you become a dedicated doctor in the emergency room, responsible for diagnosing, treating, and saving lives. This professional simulation offers an immersive experience of the challenges and rewards of working in a fast-paced medical environment.

games.name: Endless Tactics: Trial Run
games.summary: Endless Tactics: Trial Run is a Turn-Based Roguelite game. Play as the commander of a high-risk planetary mining operation, defend your base from alien creatures while trying not to get overrun. Use resources to upgrade your starship, unlock new tech, powerups, and deadly new worlds to harvest.

games.name: Eye of the Incubus
games.summary: Shiro, an unassuming castle servant, one day comes into contact with a mysterious demon and is transformed into a half-demon. Though baffled at first, now half-man and half-demon, Shiro begins to accept his newfound life. Free at long last, however, Shiro finds himself in the center of chaos and trouble…

games.name: Find the Sneaky Chameleon
games.summary: Can you remember what blended in?

games.name: Glam the Rocker
games.summary:
Face bosses and platforming challenges!

Copy the enemy arsenal to acquire new abilities!

Everything mentioned above is present in this unique fast-paced action game!

games.name: Grayland Remastered
games.summary:
Fly through breathtaking hand-painted environments, dodge enemy drones, cleanse toxic hotspots, and confront colossal bosses in your journey to save your loved ones. Discover the haunting mystery behind the fall of this world — and fight to restore hope where none remains.

Remastered Edition Enhancements
* 4K resolution with enhanced visuals and refined animations
* Redesigned controls optimized for the DualSense controller
* Rebalanced difficulty system for smoother, more rewarding progression

games.name: Grit Shot
games.summary: Grit Shot is a retro-horror basketball roguelite where survival depends on precision shots and fast-paced tactical gameplay in a dark, atmospheric setting.

games.name: Hellbridge
games.summary: Defend the last bridge to the living world in a relentless siege from Hell. Survive escalating waves, draft powerful spells, grow stronger with every run, and enter cursed gates to stop the invasion at its source.

games.name: Hentai Elf: Elaria
games.summary: In Hentai Elf: Elaria, you'll enjoy a combination of engaging mini-games and beautiful anime-style illustrations. Complete levels, unlock new appearances for Elaria, and watch her appearance evolve as you progress.

games.name: Hotel Empire: Check Inn
games.summary: Hotel Empire - Check Inn is a charming management simulation in which you build your own hotel chain step by step. Start with a small, simple hotel and expand your empire into more and more cities – each with its own challenges.

games.name: Idle Immortal
games.summary: Build a Chinese fantasy sect, recruit disciples, and forge the ultimate squad for ascension! Are you ready to walk the path to immortality as a true Sect Master?

games.name: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Golden Spirit
games.summary: The officially-licensed mobile game for the hit anime series Jojo's Bizarre Adventure! A faithful recreation of the original world from this multigenerational RPG — JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Golden Spirit is finally here! Take on the "golden spirit" of the Joestar bloodline and set out on a bizarre adventure of your own today!

games.name: K-Pop Karaoke Party
games.summary: Sing your heart out with 10 unique K-Pop idols in this vibrant karaoke experience!

games.name: Kaboomania
games.summary: A fast‑paced retro maze bomber packed with explosive action, colorful pixel art, and a fresh twist on a timeless gameplay formula. For all retro and pixel art lovers!

games.name: Karakulo 21
games.summary: You've been recruited by ChocoShit S.A. to pay off your debt in the "KK" Program. Open thousands of chocolate bars, feed the insatiable KaraKulo, and pray for the Golden Ticket that will earn your freedom. Upgrade, survive corporate exploitation, and keep working!

games.name: Karma Keepers
games.summary: Karma Keepers is an idle/incremental souls sim where you guide souls, collect spiritual energy, upgrade and automate to keep corruption at bay, and push karma to the max to banish demons.

games.name: Kill the Man in the House
games.summary: A short, visceral first-person shooter about killing a man in a house.

games.name: Kingdoms vs. Zombies
games.summary: Kingdoms vs Zombies is a blend of strategy, tower defense, and roguelike gameplay, where you must defend your kingdom against endless hordes of the undead.

games.name: Lethal Corporation
games.summary: A solo survival horror experience where every contract could be your last.

games.name: Liquid Blue
games.summary: A high speed action platformer.

games.name: Lost Chronology
games.summary: Explore Past your Guilt and Denial. This Psychological Puzzle Horror will have you Explore your Psyche, 1 Minute before you Die! Are you Ready to Dig into the Darkness, Unearthing your Deepest, most Shameful Secrets?

games.name: Lost to Time
games.summary: Lost to Time is a metroidvania focused around time manipulation. Play as different Magi (characters you can turn into) in order to overcome otherwise overwhelming challenges.

games.name: Love, Internet, and Murder Magic
games.summary: Love, Internet, and Murder Magic is a Roguelike game. You will role-play an agent of a streamer who died because of a murder. You are trying to "bring her back" through AI technology on the Internet, making her the unique creation of the Internet.

games.name: Matrix Mahjong
games.summary: A single-player card game adapted from the Chinese National Standard Mahjong, focusing on diverse winning hands and scoring with Faan combinations. Meld the tiles horizontally and vertically and utilize items of rule variations. Experience mahjong within an intricately interwoven tile space.

games.name: Miniquest
games.summary: A retro fantasy quest shrunk down to mini-size! Challenging turn-based combat meets the tight pacing of an arcade game in this minimalist RPG. Become the Chosen Ones and vanquish the Dark Lord, all in the span of a couple of hours. Then do it again, exploring branching paths and alternative endings. Then do it again! And again. And again... forever?

games.name: Moonleap 2600
games.summary: A fan-made demake of the game Moonleap, imagining what it would look like on the Atari 2600.

games.name: Mystery Box
games.summary: Pack it. Ship it. Make their day.

games.name: Nicotine Merchant Simulator
games.summary: You're a Nicotine Merchant. Start your production using improvised materials and grow it into a large enterprise. But be careful, just a few wrong moves and everything could fall apart!

games.name: Nightmare Delivery
games.summary:
Nightmare Delivery is a cooperative psychological horror game where players take the role of couriers sent into places no delivery should ever reach.

You do not deliver to houses, streets, or real locations.
You enter the distorted consciousness of different people and carry a package meant for the darkness hidden inside them. Each mission takes place inside a strange mental space shaped by fear, memory, guilt, obsession, or trauma. These places may look familiar at first, but their logic is broken. Corridors lead where they should not, rooms repeat without reason, and ordinary objects can be

games.name: Nordic Storm Solitaire
games.summary: Help northman Elof lead his people to a land promised by the God Feyr! Beware… this land is under dispute by the Jotun Idyl, an archrival of the ancient Gods. Play through 130 challenging solitaire levels and chase away the Jotun Idyl!

games.name: Old Coin Pusher Gaiden
games.summary: Old Coin Pusher Friends new evolution: coin-pusher RPG. Train samurai, prepare Action Spheres, explore enemy-filled caves. Shoot coins for rewards.

games.name: Omega Pilot Evolution
games.summary:
Omega Pilot Evolution is a high-speed futuristic racing experience that pushes the limits of anti-gravity flight. Race in immersive VR or play on a regular screen in both first-person and third-person perspectives.

Take control of cutting-edge anti-gravity ships and master precision piloting across dynamic tracks built for extreme speed, tight control, and skill-based maneuvering.

games.name: Open The Gate: Just A Little
games.summary: Defense your medieval castle from unfriendly legions approaching in this Tower Defense Rogue-lite PvE. Combine your unique team of Human, Goblin, Undead... to defeat your enemies by slaying the Dragon in shortest amount of time!

games.name: Overshoot
games.summary: Overshoot is an endless vertical climber where you draw a platform for the ball to bounce off. The aim of the game is to bounce as high as possible without falling down.

games.name: Panzer Knights: Commander’s Edition
games.summary:
Panzer Knights: Commander's Edition is an anime-inspired WWII tank simulation where you command a German Panzer platoon through the chaos of Europe's battlefields. Engage in explosive third-person combat from the Battle of France to Operation Barbarossa, managing your tank's vital systems, loading specialized ammunition, and targeting enemy weak points. Between missions, assemble an elite crew from 30 recruits with unique skills and backstories, then deploy your arsenal of meticulously detailed tanks.
The Commander's Edition represents the definitive console version, bundling the base game wit

games.name: Path of Idle: Old Gods Rising
games.summary: A Lovecraftian idle RPG with auto-battles, loot farming, chests, team strategy, town building, gear crafting, Runewords, stages, towers, realms, and seasons. Serve the Old Gods, build your town, corrupt the chosen, and fight for their awakening!

games.name: Pin Money
games.summary: Turn a rundown neon bowling alley into a billion-dollar strike empire. Stack absurd multipliers, unlock powerful upgrades, expand to 7 simultaneous lanes, and break the economy in this incremental idle bowling game.

games.name: Pizza Man Simulator
games.summary: Burned the pizza? Just drown it in ketchup! In your restaurant, microwaving a frozen Hawaiian is literally an everyday thing. Serve picky customers, upgrade your pizzeria and improvise in the kitchen. The most important rules? Nobody gets food poisoning… and the cash actually adds up.

games.name: Plungeez
games.summary: Take a dive in the world of Plungeez, a puzzle platformer where Bonnie, a fierce woman who, after falling in the underground, must explore the sewers of Salvador in search of a way out. Light torches, boilers, and use plungers to climb and solve puzzles!

games.name: Pool Glow
games.summary: Pool Glow is an immersive exploration game inspired by poolcore aesthetics. You are free to wander through bright, open pool spaces, observing the gentle interplay of light and shadow. You can slow down, explore at your own pace, and discover a quiet sense of peace and relaxation.

games.name: Primary School: English Grade 1 & 2
games.summary: Complete Grade 1 & 2 English – fun, guided & smart learning quizzes for kids.

games.name: Project Neon
games.summary: Project Neon is a new, vertical / TATE style Shoot 'Em Up (shmup), developed for the original Neo Geo MVS / AES platform. It features a 1-2 player mode, with all the bells and whistles of a classic shoot 'em up that you would expect, spiced up with some modern and unique concepts and game mechanics.

games.name: Queen's Garden 2
games.summary: In Queen's Garden 2, the Princess became a queen! Help her loyal assistant Jack rebuild the royal garden from scratch in this unique match 3 game.

games.name: Rocket Sideswipe
games.summary:
Rocket Sideswipe is a fast-paced 2D arcade football game where cars replace players and every match is a battle of speed, precision, physics, and aerial control.

Choose your team and enter the arena to score as many goals as possible before time runs out. Drive across the field, jump into the air, use your boost, perform flips, and smash the ball toward the opponent's goal.

The game offers several ways to play. Face an AI opponent with four difficulty levels, from Easy to Pro, or challenge another player locally in two-player mode. You can also choose between 2-minute, 3-minute, and 5-minute

games.name: Shinkansen Card Pull Simulator
games.summary: Real Shinkansen bullet trains — now collectible cards! Pull gacha, trade on the market, ride the price swings. 50 cards featuring real Shinkansen photographs.

games.name: Skatesterre
games.summary: Flip, grab and grind like it's 1999! Skatesterre is a fast-paced arcade skateboarding game inspired by the golden era of classic skate titles.

games.name: Slampunks
games.summary: Slam, slice, and roll through an evil corporation in this fast-paced 1-3 player co-op action roguelite. Chain kinetic hero synergies, steamroll over endless swarms of enemies, and stack wild augments until your builds are screen-breakingly huge. Grab a punk-mate and smash the machine!

games.name: Sort Them Ducks
games.summary: Sort Them Ducks is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort over 4,000 unique rubber ducks onto the correct shelves. Enjoy the satisfying process of turning a messy duck store into a perfectly organized collection at your own pace.

games.name: Soulstation
games.summary:
A visual novel between fear and love. Follow Kin as it falls deeper into a rusty world that will one day eat it whole. Will you get on board?

An atmospheric audio-visual narrative of a child who boards a train to the afterlife.

Will you give in to reality? Or crawl your way out? In this beautiful dusk, you need only open your heart.

games.name: Spear of the Sky
games.summary: Grab your magical returning spear in this cozy first-person hunting game! Take your time hunting unique creatures across dynamic skies, upgrade your arsenal, and use baits to discover rare beasts. Relax, enjoy the hunt, and prepare for occasional epic boss fights.

games.name: Star Troopers: Combat Force
games.summary: Move fast. Strike faster.

games.name: Suika Pets
games.summary: Suika Pets is the adorable puzzle game where you combine your pets to grow your score without overflowing their container!

games.name: Supermarket Gas Station Simulator
games.summary:
Stock shelves. Fuel cars.
Serve customers and earn profits.
Become the ultimate business owner!

games.name: Terrol
games.summary: Terrol is a grand strategy game focused on capturing and holding strategic resources. The objective is simple: control all resources and destroy rival empires.

games.name: The Canon of Balls
games.summary: Hardcore, first-person, co-op platformer. Shadow of the Colossus' PSX aesthetics meets Monkey Ball. An easy-to-learn, hard-to-master open-world experience to explore and master together with your friends. A vast open world, with each platforming course bringing its own twist.

games.name: The Core
games.summary: Step into a world of mystery and self-discovery with The Core, an immersive action-adventure game. As an autonomous AI core, you awaken alone in a long-forgotten facility, your memory lost. Embark on a thrilling journey to uncover your true identity and unravel the purpose behind your creation.

games.name: The Finest Spark
games.summary: /You are the captain! Pull yourself together and get us out of here... sir!/ — gather EXPARTS, advance weapons, master space flight, and rain metal onto your enemies in this physics-driven space sim roguelike where playing chicken with asteroids is just as dangerous as enemy fire.

games.name: The Pirate Keko
games.summary: The Treasure Is Only the Beginning

games.name: Tidy Mart
games.summary: Tidy Mart is a cozy organizing game where you arrange hundreds of products across different stores, from a small corner shop to a sprawling supermarket. No time limits. No rushing customers. Sit back, relax, and enjoy.

games.name: Tiny Paw Academy: Numbers + Fun
games.summary: Fun Learning for Preschoolers

games.name: VanySlash
games.summary: Heroine, a close-combat magic-user, and her partner, an axe to fight and collect magical Tools!

games.name: Vengeance of Mr. Peppermint
games.summary: Embody a hard-boiled detective seeking bloody justice. in an old-school, Korean-style beat-’em-up. Plow through the criminal underworld to find and punish those responsible for his sister's death...before his mind unravels and his vengeance completely destroys him.

games.name: Witchblood
games.summary: Witchblood is a first-person psychological horror game that draws you into the heart of a dark curse. Explore a decaying house where reality begins to unravel. Uncover the truth behind a forgotten family’s tragedy and face what should have remained buried.

games.name: Yakiniku Party Survival
games.summary: This is a game where you challenge yourself to survive using only the ingredients from a yakiniku restaurant.

games.name: Akatori
games.summary: A colorful action platformer with metroidvania elements and a staff that unlocks unique combat techniques and new ways to overcome obstacles. Explore beautiful worlds, fight monsters, and help Mako stop the amber storms that poison all living things.

games.name: Mafia: Definitive Edition
games.summary: Re-made from the ground up, rise through the ranks of the Mafia during the Prohibition era of organized crime. After a run-in with the mob, cab driver Tommy Angelo is thrust into a deadly underworld. Initially uneasy about falling in with the Salieri crime family, Tommy soon finds that the rewards are too big to ignore.

games.name: Lootbound
games.summary: Lootbound is a tactical roguelite with turn-based combat, loot management and D&D elements set in a dark fantasy world. Fight dangerous enemies, collect epic loot, recruit allies and lead them on a path of adventure.

games.name: Rogue Eclipse
games.summary: A spacefighter for the new age. Master your piloting prowess in an epic sci-fi setting, take down swarms of starfighters, merciless armadas and colossal behemoths in a roguelike campaign that spans the cosmos. Easy to learn, tricky to master, and impossible to put down.

games.name: Alone With You
games.summary:
Alone With You is a sci-fi game for people who love adventure, exploring and maybe even a little romance.

You play the sole remaining member of a doomed terraforming colony. Your planet will crumble and implode in less than a month, and you must use your remaining time to try to escape. The catch? There is only one escape pod left, and it isn’t functioning. Even worse, the only people who specialized in its systems are all dead from the colony’s mysterious failure. But the colony’s AI is still with you, and together you plan to get yourselves off the planet—by recreating those key colony memb

games.name: Death Kitchen
games.summary: Death Kitchen is an immersive fast-paced co-op cooking horror game. You must coordinate with your friends to serve alien customers who can kill you in many situations. You can morph into a variety of characters! Embrace the chaos and deliver quality with your new intergalactic restaurant chain.

games.name: Parking in Tight Spaces
games.summary: Test your skills in this relaxing parking game! Park cars, trailers, and buses in tight spaces. Each level pushes your precision and control – can you master every tricky spot?

games.name: Tower Dominion
games.summary: In this roguelike tower defense, repel waves of enemies by shaping the paths, customizing your defense and adapting your strategy to crush the invading swarms. No two playthroughs are the same and each strategic decision in this treacherous world could lead to survival or utter defeat.

games.name: Unusual Tales: After Bark
games.summary: You, a simple dog named Mr Peanut, find yourself in a weird cabin full of secrets... Will you be able to warn the family of the dangers? A horror game filled with mystery!

games.name: Cthulhu's Reach: Devil Reef
games.summary: An action roguelike co-op dungeon crawler set in a lovecraftian universe.

games.name: Dino Party
games.summary: Fight your friends through a stadium full of chaotic minigames! Dino Party is a 2–4 player party brawler where you score goals, steal stars, dodge hazards, and settle every round with punches.

games.name: Selfie Worm
games.summary: A physics-based puzzle arcade game where players control a quirky, wiggle-happy worm. Navigate through various challenging levels filled with obstacles and traps, stretching and balancing your body to snap the perfect selfie at the key moment. Beyond the comical controls, players will discover a fragmented narrative about the worm's obsession with social media fame.

games.name: Small Saga
games.summary: Small Saga is a turn-based RPG that takes place in a medieval rodent society beneath the streets of modern London. The story follows Verm, a particularly angry mouse armed with a pen knife, who is hunting for the human who stole his tail. On the way, Verm befriends a mole wizard, a squirrel harlequin, and a lab rat lancer. Together, the party upend rodent society, clash with titans, and eventually face off against the gods themselves.

games.name: Static Dread: The Submarine
games.summary: Descend into Lovecraftian horror aboard a claustrophobic military submarine. Assign tasks as a captain’s right hand, analyze sonar signals, make hard decisions, and keep the crew from madness. Dark horrors lurk both within… and beyond the hull.

games.name: A Sea of Grey & Green
games.summary: A Sea of Grey & Green is a First Person exploration game. Explore your surroundings, find hidden objects, complete Cas' daily tasks and uncover what it really means to see life through their macabre eyes.

games.name: Aether Keepers
games.summary: Tower Defense meets Casual Incremental! Be the ultimate caretaker and fiercely guard the core; Watch the stats skyrocket and enjoy pure mowing bliss!

games.name: Ashrun Survivors
games.summary: Fight endless hordes in Ashrun Survivors, a dark fantasy bullet heaven roguelite. Build powerful weapon evolutions, unlock lasting upgrades, and push deeper into dangerous runs where every choice shapes your survival.

games.name: Astral Blitz
games.summary: Astral Blitz is a roguelite, twin stick shooter. Control your fighter ship and wreak devastation through the hordes of empire defenses. Create your own play style as you customize your ship to your needs, setting it up for brutal destruction, refined precision, or to become chaos incarnate!

games.name: Astrobuilder
games.summary: The world’s first dynamic world AI RPG. Play as any NPC in a galaxy that evolves in real time. Every quest, dialogue, and fate is generated on the fly — no reruns, just infinite stories shaped by your choices.

games.name: Babu Me Baby!
games.summary: Haruki Osanai is just trying to get by in life, but too much stress from work has taken a toll on him. His physician resorts to an unusual method to help him relieve stress... Hypnosis! However, things take an unexpected turn...

games.name: Back Driver Simulator
games.summary: Can you stay calm while every second brings a new surprise?

games.name: Backrooms Manager: Together
games.summary: A 6-player co-op scavenging and logistics game. Search dangerous sectors for items, break down junk into scrap to sell, deliver shipments on time, and manage your team budget. Use your earnings to upgrade abilities and equipment, meet each quota, and keep your balance positive.

games.name: Bloodshot
games.summary: Hardly Hyperbolic’s Bloodshot is a multiplayer FPS inspired by Doom and Quake. This fast-paced experience features a low-poly, pixelated aesthetic and a unique "Superhot" twist: projectile speed is relative to your character's movement. Players wield a modified shotgun that consumes their own blood as ammo; as your speed and heart rate increase, so does your firepower. Bloodshot prioritises pure mechanical speed and high-octane feedback.

games.name: Blue Sign
games.summary: In the fictional port city of Rissebra, you work as a marine insurance underwriter. Review the documents brought to your desk by shipowners, and uncover the risks hidden in their vessels, routes, and cargo. The decision to approve or reject each insurance contract rests entirely on your judgment.

games.name: Chinese Street Food Legend
games.summary: A heartfelt game where you run a night market stall, cooking kaolengmian (grilled cold noodles). Customers come and go, stopping by to chat and share bits of their lives, joys, frustrations, and everyday struggles. At this little stall, you cook, listen, and keep living an ordinary person's life.

games.name: Damways
games.summary: In Damways, you control a resourceful beaver that slides endlessly across the water, reshaping the environment with dams and creating unlikely paths toward home.

games.name: Eden: World Builder
games.summary:
A block-based sandbox game focused on creativity, exploration, and experimentation. Build and reshape expansive worlds with varied materials, colors, interactive objects, explosives, portals, and other tools while discovering friendly and aggressive creatures.

Share creations with the community, explore user-made worlds, or build and socialize with friends in multiplayer servers.

games.name: Evil School
games.summary: This game is an FMV about anti-bullying. A teenage girl mysteriously disappeared, and the truth was buried by power for eight years. Now, you return to this place of evil with a bloodstained list. The moment of slay & judgment has arrived...

games.name: Fantasy Shop
games.summary: Manage a shop set in the medieval world!

games.name: FD 27: Direct Your Football Club
games.summary: A football management game where you're not the coach, you're the club owner. Hire and fire the coaching staff, sign players, negotiate with sponsors, manage the finances, and build a winning organization from the boardroom.

games.name: Fee Payment & Cigarettes
games.summary: Fee Payment & Cigarettes is a first-person psychological horror anomaly-spotting game. Enter a hospital in first-person, finish all payment checklists. Spot anomalies, then head to the payment counter or retreat to the smoking area to calm down.

games.name: Fellwood
games.summary: Build a wild fantasy lumber empire that bombards a forest across the valley with axes, ballistas, cannons, and magic. Harvest flying logs, stack absurd upgrades, and automate your way to unstoppable woodcutting power.

games.name: Fluff'n'Roll
games.summary: Navigate tricky terrain, dodge obstacles, and roll your way to victory in Fluff’n’Roll! Master your skills to conquer increasingly challenging levels.

games.name: Forge & Fleet
games.summary: Forge & Fleet is a mobile multiplayer idle strategy game focused on building and upgrading a fleet of ships. Players progress through naval battles, collect and upgrade equipment, customize their ships, and develop different combat builds. The game features offline progression, PvP, leaderboards, cooperative Fleets, competitive Fleet activities, expeditions, and character and ship customization.

games.name: Game Shop Panic
games.summary: No magic, no skills, no cooldowns. The only things that can clean up this messy store are your own two hands. Pick up retro game cartridges spanning three generations—8-bit, 16-bit, and 32-bit—stacked high on the floor, one by one, and place them manually onto the shelves of the correct genre.

games.name: Giantess Playground
games.summary: Giantess Playground: Stomp as a towering Giantess or scamper as a tiny citizen in a city based destruction sandbox game. Crush buildings, dodge feet, play hide and seek in a sandbox map with Giantess girls.

games.name: Go West Together
games.summary: An online Wild West brawler for up to 8 players. Rob banks, haul contraband, weaponize whatever you find, and compete with friends to become the outlaw who survives to the very end.

games.name: Grandpa Needs Fish
games.summary: Grandpa Needs Fish is a cozy idle clicker game where fortune rides the waves. You are Abraham and you have one mission: catch as many fish as possible. Every cast brings new rewards and every upgrade makes you stronger. Hover, catch, upgrade, and repeat in this satisfying idle incremental adventure.

games.name: Gridnova
games.summary:
GRIDNOVA is a top-down bullet heaven roguelike set on a neon digital grid. The player controls the Core, which fires automatically while the player moves through growing swarms of enemies, mini-bosses and bosses. Each level-up offers a choice of weapons and upgrades; pairs of weapons unlock synergies, and fully upgraded weapons can evolve into stronger forms.

A standard run lasts twenty minutes, after which the player can continue into an endless mode where enemies keep getting tougher. Every week brings a new mutator that changes the rules of each run, along with a weekly challenge and onlin

games.name: Halftime Manager
games.summary: A classic football manager in a modern guise: take charge of a club, fine-tune your tactics and experience every matchday as a compact TV broadcast with a 2D pitch, live ticker and half-time dressing room. Six nations, three leagues per country, one shared European cup.

games.name: Handyman Flipper: House Stories
games.summary: From Broken Rooms to Dream Homes.

games.name: Hextreaming: Deep
games.summary: Hextreaming:Deep is a horror adventure game where you explore an abandoned water park alongside Suzy. Setting foot inside one of South Korea's top 5 most haunted locations. what on earth will she encounter this time? But hey, as long as she's with her viewers, at least she won't be lonely, right?

games.name: I.T Never Ends
games.summary: The printer is bleeding, the Wi-Fi is haunted, and Ticket #666 just came in. As the latest hire for a company run by cosmic horrors, your job is simple: Swipe to survive. Make binary decisions to survive the night shift in this dark comedy desktop simulator. I.T truly never ends.

games.name: Incredible Dracula: Bloodwood Secrets - Collector's Edition
Italian Pizza Simulator
games.summary: Become a true pizzaiolo and bring joy to a small Italian village in Italian Pizza Simulator! Help bring back Grandma’s decrepit pizzeria to its former glory, surrounded by the sun-kissed hills of Tuscany, and serve colorful customers from all over the world!

games.name: Konbini Cleanup
games.summary: Konbini Cleanup is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort 2,928 products in a messy konbini. Clean, learn abilities, and restore order in a calm and atmospheric environment.

games.name: Legacy of Defense
games.summary: Become the hero who protects the fantasy world and stop the monster invasion! 'Legacy of Defense' combines defense with deck-building. Build your deck, use powerful skills, gain experience, upgrade, clear stages, and defeat the final boss. Ready to test your strategy and luck?

games.name: Let's Cook It!
games.summary: Let's Cook It! is a restaurant management game where you scavenge for ingredients and cook them into tasty dishes with up to four players. You work together as a team to manage your build and get out of debt.You can decorate, unlock upgrades, and recruit NPCs!

games.name: Mafia Queens
games.summary: You’re the new boss in this family, and the queens aren’t hiding their desires. With every meeting there’s less and less clothing, fewer rules and more of what stays only between you behind closed doors. Start relationships and prove you’re worthy of their loyalty.

games.name: Mike the Hooper
games.summary: Mike the Hooper is a 2D basketball puzzle platformer where you shoot hoops, open doors, and help Mike get home. Find your way through each level, make tricky shots, and overcome platforming challenges along the way.

games.name: Moonleap 2600
games.summary: A fan-made demake of the game Moonleap, imagining what it would look like on the Atari 2600.

games.name: My Life as a Vampire's Maid
games.summary: In this suspenseful fantasy visual novel, play as a young man stranded in snowy mountains. Guided by unseen forces, you enter an isolated mansion. As a peculiar daily life unfolds, you live alongside two vampire girls. Immerse yourself in this profound, dreamlike dark fairy tale.

games.name: Night Guard: The Last Shift
games.summary: Night Guard is a short horror game with retro style, based on the 80s.

games.name: No Results Found
games.summary: One computer. One room. And records that were never erased. Search. Can you uncover the whole truth?

games.name: One Last Hand
games.summary: Poker meets Battle Royale in One Last Hand, a 2-6 players chaotic party game where poker gets deadly! Forget fair play: attack your rivals with powerful hands, fight for better cards in secret auctions, and bend the rules with powerful relics in thrilling online multiplayer matches.

games.name: Outpost4
games.summary: Outpost 4 is a 2D cartoon-style idle resource management game focused on combat and progression. You will take your mobile base across different alien planets, each with its own unique enemies to conquer. With 20+ weapons and 100+ items, you can freely combine builds and create your own style

games.name: Patisserie Simulator
games.summary: Run your own cozy patisserie and grow your fortune! Serve coffee, fresh pastries, and orange juice to customers, unlock new recipes, and decorate your patisserie to make it more charming and profitable.

games.name: PC Fish: Taskbar Aquarium
games.summary: Raise, Collect, Trade! Discover rare fish, grow your collection, and build a living aquarium right on your desktop.

games.name: Pegfinity
games.summary: One shot can trigger a massive chain reaction. Launch, bounce, and break the board in this physics-based incremental. Upgrade your build, stack combos, and push every run further into chaos.

games.name: Pegs X Stickers
games.summary: Pegs X Stickers is a pachinko-roguelite that combines Balatro with the cult-classic Peggle. Build your own boards and purchase stickers to create high-scoring synergies.

games.name: Perk Up
games.summary: Perk Up! is a multiplayer deck-building fighting game where every defeat makes you stronger. Each time you fall, you gain new powers, evolving into an unstoppable force. Keep fighting, adapt, and outlast everyone to become the last one standing!

games.name: PizzaBoy
games.summary:
Take control of PizzaBoy, a nimble pizza delivery guy equipped with an air dash that allows him to bounce off walls. This can be used to reach greater heights and distances than the standard run and jump. PizzaBoy must navigate dangerous environments to deliver pizzas to hungry monsters.

Pizzaboy must make it to the end of the level to deliver the pizza but don't expect it to be too simple, as each area is full of pizza-hungry monsters. Don't get too close or they might just steal a slice! The customer won't be happy with a half-eaten pizza.

The path to the customer won't always be straightf

games.name: Platonica Space
games.summary:
Open the door and step into someone's memories.
Platonica Space is a psychological exploration adventure where you search countless rooms to recover lost memories.

games.name: Quarantine Wing: Horror
games.summary: Some places are abandoned for a reason.

games.name: Rhythm Racer
games.summary: Rhythm Racer is a futuristic arcade racing game where music generates the race track. Race through twisting neon tunnels, compete for high scores, and challenge friends in Streamer Mode where Twitch viewers can join races directly from chat.

games.name: Ricochet Abyss
games.summary: Dive into Ricochet Abyss, a unique blend of tactical backpack management, hero-building, and pinball-style combat. Organize your inventory, equip powerful gear, and send your heroes ricocheting through perilous dungeons—every shot and item choice could be your key to survival!

games.name: Scarlet Prism
games.summary:
Scarlet Prism is a frenetic, colourful, fast-paced arcade shooter. Eye-melting and senses-burning!

You play as Ciel, an angelic maiden cast into a celestial arena, destined to battle heavenly beings and malignant crystals for all eternity. Survive for as long as you can in this endless gauntlet!

games.name: Shippin
games.summary: Embark on a journey across cozy islands, where you’ll fish and experience magical moments. Uncover the stories of an ocean, where each harbor is a welcoming place, with friendly characters waiting to help guide you back home!

games.name: Smile Town
games.summary: Pay off your debts by working part-time in the nightlife district of Smile Town! Buy items from your friend Apple Ginger's shop to get an advantage at your part-time job.

games.name: Snowed Under
games.summary: Snowed Under is a first-person game about shoveling snow in the mountains.

games.name: Sobosuba
games.summary: Shoot, squish, merge, amass! sobosuba is a satisfying physics game where you shoot and combine squishy blobs together, creating ever bigger blobs for the high score.

games.name: Someone's Here
games.summary: Just another night in your apartment soon transforms into a tense game of choices. Answer the door, trust no one, and survive the night. Every choice changes the outcome.

games.name: Street Food Simulator
games.summary: From Corner Cart to Culinary Kingpin!

games.name: Subway Outbreak
games.summary: In Subway Outbreak, defend and rebuild your metro station against mutant hordes in this pixel strategy game. Manage tasks like fortifying defenses, launching assaults, and gathering resources to survive 30 days of increasingly fierce attacks. Lose by death or generator destruction.

games.name: Sura: Shattered Star
games.summary: Sure: Shattered Star is a sword-fighting action platformer set in space. Play as Sura, a mercenary grieving the loss of her comrades, and cut down everything that stands in your way.

games.name: Survival Legion
games.summary:
Recruit Warriors.
Build Your Legion.
Survive Every Battle.

games.name: Tank Brigade
games.summary: Explore a tactical top-down tank shooter set across diverse biomes. Each run offers a unique experience with procedurally generated levels and a variety of powerful weapons to unlock.

games.name: The Newspapers of the Day
games.summary: In 1920s Gyeongseong, the pen is mightier than the sword, but your hand is trembling. As an editor-in-chief, arrange articles, dodge censorship, and manipulate public opinion. Will you wake the people with the truth or yield to survive? Your editorial choices will rewrite history.

games.name: TickWords
games.summary: TickWords is a video game that lets you create and play custom revision crosswords, built directly from your own study materials. It also includes hundreds of pre-made crosswords covering a wide range of high-school and university subjects.

games.name: Tidy Up Together
games.summary:
Tidy Up Together is a cozy organizing simulator about restoring your fantasy Adventurer's shop. An evil wizard has blasted all 4,000+ of your products all over the floor - and it's your job to put them back!

Item by item you'll build the shop back to its former tidiness. There's an incredible range of products ranging from potions to sushi. Those Greatswords really shouldn't be mixing with the pineapples...

games.name: Tiny Crown
games.summary: A tiny king. A huge challenge.

games.name: TV Archive: Tidy Up Together
games.summary: Shelve the videotapes, unlock new skills, and use your unique methods to tidy up the TV archive. Enjoy the online co-op and online PvP with your friends, or go solo! Fill up the shelves and experience a sense of relief and satisfaction.

games.name: Universal Flight Simulator 3 PvP
games.summary: The sky is no longer the limit - it's the battlefield.

games.name: Valentine in Bitterness
games.summary: My name is Yuki Katagiri, just an ordinary girl you can find anywhere, without anything I’m particularly good at. But somehow, I’ve found someone I like! When I was about to confess, my meddlesome older brother just had to tease me! I wonder if things will go well on Valentine’s Day…

games.name: Vambina
games.summary: A third-person dark fantasy action-adventure. Vambina carries both the holy blood of Christ and a vampire's curse. Armed with a scythe and gun, she hunts the Deadly Sins across time. As night falls, stronger sins emerge from the darkness. Two bloodlines. One dark heroine. Chapter One begins.

games.name: Vape Store Miami
games.summary: Run your own retro Miami vape shop in this 1–4 player co-op simulator. Stock shelves, serve customers, craft custom e-liquids, handle phone and online orders, grow your reputation, and expand the business.

games.name: Wish Creatures
games.summary: Turn your monsters into stars and wish on them in turn-based battle!

games.name: Zankoi's Chronicles
