games.summary: A 2D roguelike action game fused with deep deckbuilding. Fight in grueling real-time duels, shatter your enemy's Poise to freeze time, and unleash devastating, custom-built card combos. No meta upgrades — only skill, synergies, and mastery define each run.

games.name: Infinite Backrooms
games.summary: The first truly infinite Backrooms game. Explore a seamless, procedurally generated world with a seed system across interconnected environments. No loading screens. No boundaries. Just fluorescent lights and something waiting in the dark.

games.name: Anime Angels feat. Luca Brasil
games.summary: Solve tile-swapping puzzles to unveil pretty anime girls by the artist Luca Brasil.

games.name: Anime Angels feat. Tomozero
games.summary: Solve tile-swapping puzzles to unveil pretty anime girls drawn by the artist Tomozero.

games.name: Antibiotic Adventures
games.summary: A teaching game for general microbiology.

games.name: Blink
games.summary:
This is an indie horror game where you have to inspect 6 statues from a mental hospital but there is something waiting for you!

Explore the horrific structure with real time eye detection, so if you blink in real life, you blink in the game too..

games.name: Bounty Hunters
games.summary: Fight in a top down 2d shooter adventure with resource gathering / bullet heaven/hell mechanics.

games.name: Bratki
games.summary: They rule the city, master the art of protection rackets, and carve up territories. They are the scourge of street kiosks, cooperatives, and black market dealers.

games.name: Deeds Were Done 2: Project Ascend
games.summary: A PS2-style indie game about government studies on humans. they were subjects of experimentation to gather "crucial" data for military and medical purposes. you got assigned to work with the other scientists.

games.name: FairyLand
games.summary: A casual endless dungeon crawler rogue-like RPG that tasks players with getting the highest score possible, as fast as possible.

games.name: Five Nights In The Backrooms
games.summary:
After 12-Link Labs discovers 'The Backrooms', they also find a terrifying creature. This creature is very hostile, and no matter how hard they try... They can't contain it.

So they’ve sent you, a very dangerous convict to watch over it and analyse its behaviour. Will you survive five nights in the backrooms?

games.name: Flowers and Deities
games.summary: Flowers and Deities is a strategy deckbuilder roguelite where you command a blood-soaked lizardkin army through escalating arena battles, spending every drop of spilled blood to cast spells, summon creatures, and survive long enough to claim the favor of the Gods.

games.name: Fungi Simulator
games.summary:
Become a Fungi and spread your spores as much as you can.

Unlock different kinds of Fungi and express yourself.

Take over the world by spreading your spores globally.

A clicker game where you try and get as much spores as you can,
and unlock different types of mushrooms with increasing difficulty.

games.name: Hide & Seek
games.summary: An online multiplayer party game with a colorful twist: hiders paint their own bodies to blend into the world. Seekers must find and tag them all before time runs out. Play with friends on PC.

games.name: Lovesick
games.summary: Lovesick is a psychological horror experience exploring the dark aftermath of "love".

games.name: Memo to the Underlord
games.summary: A rogue-like dungeon crawler where you play as a disgruntled employee just trying to quit his job - by force. Battle your way through a corporate hell, full of hostile co-workers, feral creatures, and everything in between.

games.name: Monster Girls: You Can't Say No
games.summary: Adult adventure set in a monster college where desire is survival. Host an incubus, manage rising “heat,” flirt, and build relationships to stay alive. Explore, upgrade abilities, and unlock scenes in a mix of dating sim and resource management.

games.name: Moonleap 2600
games.summary: A fan-made demake of the game Moonleap, imagining what it would look like on the Atari 2600.

games.name: Mr. Swop
games.summary: Help Mr. Swop find stars by swapping tiles around.

games.name: Sands of Skullcreek
games.summary: Sands of Skullcreek is retro style FPS. Your travels have brought you to this town that has been overrun by a gang. You decide to swear in as a deputy and restore order to this once peaceful place.

games.name: Shark Simulator: Ocean RPG Survival
games.summary: Will your shark become an unstoppable hunter?

games.name: Sister Other Paranoia
games.summary: A dark visual novel created by the team behind NEEDY GIRL OVERDOSE. Overly sensitive to other people's emotions, the protagonist—a light novel writer—develops the ability to read minds, only to be driven even deeper into isolation. His sole remaining comfort is his younger sister, gifted yet lonely.

games.name: Stellar Odyssey
games.summary: An Idle Space MMORPG where you progress at your own pace, but the universe is built together. Explore a procedural galaxy of nearly 50 million star systems alone — or join a Squadron to pool resources, raise space stations, upgrade shared buildings, and expand across the stars as one.

games.name: The Legend of Mala Tokmachka
games.summary: Build, expand, and arm a towering 2D fortress to withstand endless waves of ground and air attacks. Set in a nameless frontier village where a siege has lasted so long it became a legend, "The Legend of Mala Tokmachka" turns survival into myth.

games.name: Trick x Trick
games.summary: Supernatural × Mystery × Death Game: Twelve high school students awaken trapped in a mysterious building. To escape, they must identify the mastermind by vote—choose wrong, and someone is executed. Each student has a unique supernatural power. Uncover the truth and reveal the mastermind.

games.name: Wired Witch
games.summary: Play as a witch who is trying to recreate a potion based on digital clues. Read emails, search online, and look through downloaded files to finish the recipe.

games.name: Witchpop
games.summary: Witchpop is a physics based matching puzzle game where you cook soup by juggling ingredients. Collect curses over time and try to survive as your dish becomes an increasingly chaotic mess.

games.name: Zombolion
games.summary: Zombolion is an arcade zombie shooter where you're the last damn sheriff in the whole county, mowing down undead freaks, holding the line at a top-secret bunker, and trying to science-and-peace-talk your way through a full-blown viral apocalypse - if there's anyone left to talk to.

games.name: Brainrot Autobattler
games.summary: Brainrot Autobattler is a chaotic roguelite auto-battler/autochess where you buy brainrot units, evolve them into stronger forms, trigger trait synergies, and survive a run full of shops, bosses, boons, and bad decisions.

games.name: Eggscape
games.summary: You’re a chicken escaping the slaughter line. Find your stolen chicks and free your fellow chickens as you fight through the factory, and survive the hunt from workers and failed lab creations.

games.name: Gift From God
games.summary: Gift From God is a visual novel told through the eyes of Ryosuke Nikaido and Akane Yamamoto. As they face three missions from God, their hearts, pasts, and choices begin to intertwine, leading them toward the true meaning of God’s “gift.”

games.name: Goblins and Gunslingers
games.summary: Deal spells and six-shooters across a seven-lane frontier. Goblins & Gunslingers is a western-fantasy card duel where gunpowder meets magic — draft 8 outlaw factions, hire deputies, flip Gnomes into Golems, and outdraw rivals in ranked play or a roguelike Frontier Run.

games.name: Internet Survivor Survivors
games.summary: A top-down action roguelite Touhou fangame featuring Flan, who's... started streaming and has taken the internet by storm!? Collect likes and coins to power up your weapons! Your very viewer count becomes your life! Annihilate the constant hordes of enemies and survive, survive, SURVIVE!

games.name: Jewel Match Solitaire: Cats and Cards - Collector's Edition
Peganomics
games.summary: A roguelike pachinko about building outrageous synergies with pegs, balls, and buckets. Chase massive scores, discover chaotic combos, and break the economy of pegs in your quest for the ultimate run.

games.name: Sally Face
games.summary: Delve into a dark adventure following the boy with a prosthetic face and a tragic past. Unravel the sinister mysteries of Sally's world to find the truth that lies hidden beneath the shadows.

games.name: Shinkuu, Shoujo Namida wo Koboseru ka
games.summary:
In June, a girl throws herself from her school rooftop. As class president, Shimabara witnessed her death and becomes determined to uncover the truth behind it. Her investigation leads her to Kusamizu Yuusui, a mysterious girl hiding a dark and troubled past.

But through another perspective, we discover Yuusui’s connection to the girl who died: a fragile bond shaped by loneliness, bullying, and fleeting moments of warmth. As past and present slowly collide, the truth behind the tragedy begins to emerge.

games.name: Stage Fright
games.summary: A short story about a musician called Rose finding the confidence to accept who she is.

games.name: Steam Trigger
games.summary: A riveting steampunk 2.5D platformer set against the backdrop of the sprawling metropolis. Immerse yourself in a mesmerizing fusion of industrial progress and Victorian aesthetics as you embark on a journey throughout the city.

games.name: Stellar Odyssey
games.summary: A sci-fi space combat game where you pilot customizable ships, fight alone, team up, or challenge other players in free-movement Arena battles, climb leaderboards, and develop your pilot for a growing Persistent Online Universe.

games.name: Woahblade
games.summary: Be the last uncontrollably-spinning bandicoot standing, in this unofficial chaotic multiplayer spin-off fan game that blends Crash Bandicoot with Beyblade. Build up outrageous RPMs and Dash, Bash, n Crash your opponents off the stage!

games.name: Mortal Shell II
games.summary: Their Flesh Is Your Weapon. Mortal Shell II is a standalone sequel action-RPG with adrenaline-charged, high-stakes combat. Possess warrior Shells, dethrone false gods, redeem a ravaged world.

games.name: The Sinking City 2
games.summary: The Sinking City 2 is a terrifying Lovecraftian journey, powered by Unreal Engine 5. Experience a heart-pounding survival horror as you explore the flooded city of Arkham and fight eldritch monsters beyond human comprehension.

games.name: Discounty
games.summary: Manage your own discount supermarket! Get caught up in small-town drama, organize and plan your shop's layout, and strike lucrative trade deals as you expand your secretive aunt's business empire. Selling more frozen fries will surely heal this broken community...right?

games.name: Tukoni: Forest Keepers
games.summary: Tukoni: Forest Keepers is a cute and cozy puzzle adventure, based on a series of award-winning books by the Ukrainian artist Oksana Bula. Play as the forest spirit Tukoni as you meet unique characters, solve captivating puzzles, brew fragrant tea and explore a magical world filled with kindness.

games.name: Dawnfolk
games.summary: Minimalist and relaxing survival builder perfect for short gaming sessions. Rebuild and manage your realm, collect resources and decide the fate of your people. Explore the darkness and unveil the secrets of the black monoliths to bring back light to the world.

games.name: Feed It
games.summary: A first-person, PSX-style horror game about living with a monster. Do as you're told... or don't. Just be ready for the consequences.

games.name: Nimbit Frontier
games.summary: Embark on daring adventures into wild biomes to uncover fragments of long-lost creatures. Bring them back to life by hatching their young. Build them habitats, and release them into the wild. Become the star Nimbiteer you dream of surrounded by lovely folks in a small cozy town.

games.name: Provoron
games.summary: It's an adventure game about black&white crows.

games.name: Excremental Game
games.summary: You're a little poop flushed away on a revenge mission to cover the world in poop! A chaotic incremental Poop-Shooter where bouncing poop earns points! Level up your poop, and unleash explosive, multi-poop madness!

games.name: Ploink
games.summary: A plinko roguelike where you create crazy setups with random objects then drop balls and watch the chaos unfold. Discover creative interactions, create cross-dimensional setups, break the game, feed cats and ploink it.

games.name: PROFITS 2167: Planetary Resource Optimization & Freight Infrastructure Technician Simulator
games.summary: Deliver minerals. Earn tokens. Meet deadlines. Upgrade your infrastructure. Grow the numbers. Deploy human resources. Manipulate the token market. Automate the network with delivery drones. Enjoy the grind. Enjoy the future. Enjoy the profits.

games.name: Slots & Daggers
games.summary: A retro-fantasy roguelike inside a slot machine. Steady your blade - and spin!

games.name: Submerge
games.summary: A deep-sea exploration company sends you and your friends to investigate a research facility that has mysteriously gone silent. Face terrifying events together, survive as a team, and uncover the truth hidden within the depths.

games.name: The Lantern of the Laughless Saint
games.summary: A solo or co-op RPG inspired by Morrowind. Drawn by a shared dream, you awaken on an isolated island crowned by a silent Tower. Unravel the mystery of the Laughless Saint, confront the weight of human desire, and decide what deserves to be saved when the light beneath the world finally stirs.

games.name: Void Pachinko
games.summary: Build your own pachinko! Upgrade pins and balls, unleash powerful synergies, and help a shattered village rise again in this incremental adventure.

games.name: Apple Faces Up
games.summary: Alter the inscribed laws and unravel mysteries with knowledge and wisdom. Welcome to the Infinite Library, where all past, present, and future phenomena are recorded. As the one with the power to rewrite these books, you must face 13 trials bestowed by the angel Mimir.

games.name: Argonauts Agency: The World on His Shoulders
Balls & Gamble
games.summary: Balls & Gamble is a casino-inspired incremental game where you shoot a LOT of balls, earn money, buy upgrades, gamble, unlock new balls, and eventually break reality itself.

games.name: Ballskin
games.summary: BALLSKIN is a goofy, n64 horror themed foddian game, where the goal is to make it to the top, with simple yet deep mechanics, where every fall is punishing. Can you make it out of skinball purgatory?

games.name: Beat Vector
games.summary: Beat Vector is a 360 degree fully immersive synesthetic rhythm game where each beat makes the environment come alive based on the player's performance. Each genre featured in the game has its own unique environment such as the Club for EDM, the Ballroom for Electroswing or the Alleyway for UK Grime that the player progresses through as they clear levels.

games.name: Black Flower
games.summary: Black Flower is a strategic roguelike about surviving and growing a fragile garden through a magical calendar. Make tough daily choices, face unpredictable weather, and uncover the secret of a mysterious black seed.

games.name: Bloodletter
games.summary: A grim medieval deckbuilder where you use your dubious healing methods to protect bizarre villagers from the corrupting influence of ancient evils.

games.name: Budget Renovation Simulator
games.summary: Turn "Trash" into "Cash"! Buy wrecked houses, hunt for the cheapest materials, and fix them up for a massive profit. Spend the least to make the most in this renovation challenge! Can you finish the job without going broke?

games.name: Buster Breaks Out
games.summary: A block-breaking roguelite where every upgrade helps you smash more blocks and climb to higher floors. Help Buster grow stronger, defeat the wardens, and break free from his prison.

games.name: Crownhold
games.summary: Noble Rulers — grow your realm and expand your castle in this short incremental game! Manage resources, discover foreign lands and build up an army to lay siege to your enemies.

games.name: Cursed Ciddy
games.summary: Follow Betty as she explores the abandoned ruins of Comical Entertainment in search of answers. Solve puzzles, uncover forgotten secrets, and survive the dangers hidden within a once-beloved entertainment center concealing a dark mystery below. Nothing is as it seems.

games.name: Dash'n'Drops
games.summary: Blast your way through Dash'n'Drops, a platform-fighting inspired roguelite. Build your own moveset, max your stats, and defeat the 7 Eternals!

games.name: Draft Day Sports: College Football 27
games.summary:
Build the college football program you've always envisioned. Draft Day Sports: College Football puts you in complete control of every aspect of running a successful program—from assembling your coaching staff and recruiting future stars to managing the transfer portal, developing players, creating game plans, and competing for conference championships and the national title.

Every decision shapes the future of your program. Scout prospects across the country, build relationships with recruits, evaluate talent that fits your system, and construct recruiting classes capable of competing with th

games.name: Dual Cat: Max
games.summary: Join Max, the brave and clever cat, on a puzzle-platformer adventure to save his best friend, Erwin

games.name: Encroacher: Snakes
games.summary: A snake-tossing cryptic adventure. Visuals that remind you of schooltime spent in computer lab. The snakes will not tolerate failure.

games.name: Farewells Clicker
games.summary: Farewells Clicker is an addictive blend of clicker and city builder! Expand your island, develop your city, and produce resources endlessly. Upgrade your buildings and skills through a vast skill tree to progress further and further!

games.name: Fleetfall: Galaxy Domination
games.summary: Fast real-time space conquest for 1-4 players. Capture planets, launch missile salvos, and outmaneuver friends in 10-minute Deathmatch blitzes — or scheme through 30 minutes of diplomacy, trade and betrayal in Hegemony mode. Cross-play with mobile; bots fill empty seats so a match always starts.

games.name: Gutted: Infested Crypts
games.summary: Descend into infested crypts beneath a cursed cemetery in this visceral action-horror FPS. Fight through rotting horrors with heavy gunplay, brutal dismemberment, and only a dying flashlight between you and the darkness.

games.name: Hacker vs It
games.summary: DOS old school game showing how a hacker and an IT workers do their jobs. The idea of this game is show the hacking and the IT process with less fantasy elements. Shows a WAY closer perspective the actual hacking strategies.

games.name: Home Store Simulator
games.summary: Run your own home goods store! Sell sofas, refrigerators, TVs and more. Purchase products, set your prices, take payments, design your layout, handle shoplifters, and expand your store to build a successful retail business.

games.name: Is That a Human Organ?
games.summary: This is a horror-themed anomaly-hunting game. As a black market cargo inspector, you must carefully check each item to ensure its normal. Please note that when I say cargo, Im referring to organs.

games.name: Jarnasmal
games.summary: Survive a bullet hell where your Wi-Fi signal is your lifeline. Delve into underground facilities, fight off massive swarms of enemies, and strategically build a mesh network of signal repeaters. If your connection is strong, you're a powerhouse. If the signal drops, all you have is a shovel.

games.name: Lantern of the Laughless Saint
games.summary: A solo or co-op RPG inspired by Morrowind. Drawn by a shared dream, you awaken on an isolated island crowned by a silent Tower. Unravel the mystery of the Laughless Saint, confront the weight of human desire, and decide what deserves to be saved when the light beneath the world finally stirs.

games.name: LifePaths
games.summary: LifePaths is a browser-based narrative life simulation game. Players live from birth to death in a dystopian 2076, making decisions whose outcomes are determined by their character’s attributes and dice rolls, then narrated by artificial intelligence.

games.name: Little Sim World
games.summary: Little Sim World is a cosy 2D life sim set in the heart of a little city full of charm, dreams, and surprises. Design your perfect home, meet quirky locals, build your routine, and live life at your own pace. A gentle world, a fresh start, and a story only you can write!

games.name: Lurk in Abyss
games.summary: After moving to the village, Lurk begins a new, independent life. However, the place turns out to be no ordinary village on the outskirts of the city, but something far more mysterious... Are you ready to dive into this abyss?

games.name: Medieval Horse Dealer Simulator
games.summary: Trade horses, formulate feed, and breed generations of elite stallions, racehorses, draft horses, war horses, and more. Mine ores, forge equipment and weapons to sell in your store, or equip them to your horses. Dominate the medieval horse trade.

games.name: Mega Man X Regenesis
games.summary: Mega Man X fan-game, featuring an original story set in an alternate Mega Man X timeline.

games.name: Megaris
games.summary: The core is simple and satisfying: rotate, drop, clear. But the expanding grid changes everything. Strategies that worked five minutes ago fall apart when you're suddenly dealing with 30 columns. Adapting on the fly is the whole game.

games.name: Moon and Away
games.summary: A short, atmospheric, story-driven experience about a young woman searching for meaning in a world that no longer feels familiar.

games.name: Mothership Down
games.summary: 130+ unique goals to achieve in over 50 levels in this physics-based retro puzzle game! Control a fleet of tiny, colorful lunar landers, piloting through puzzling moon caves. Scrape by with scrappy first flights, then re-engineer a perfect solution to earn bonus stars.

games.name: Orbit One
games.summary: Take to the stars and explore the solar system. Master the orbital mechanics of N-body physics. Plot a careful course to complete your mission.

games.name: Pachinko Farm
games.summary: Pachinko Farm is a cozy yet chaotic incremental game where you drop balls to grow your farm in a fully physics-based pachinko world. Bonk → Produce → Sell

games.name: Palianytsia
games.summary: In this game, you are a palianytsia — a traditional Ukrainian bread. You escape from the kitchen, solve puzzles, and explore your own nature. Over time, the game shifts from bright and cheerful to eerie and unsettling, and your goal is to uncover what is really going on.

games.name: Planet Harvester: Incremental Odyssey
games.summary: Planet Harvester is a relaxing low-poly incremental game. Pilot your crawler across beautiful worlds, chew through resources, unlock new tools, hire drones, and customize your machine for ever bigger hauls. Turn small numbers into massive ones!

games.name: Project DeepWeb: Eternal Nightmare
games.summary:
Project DeepWeb: Eternal Nightmare is a desktop-like adventure game about exploration of the Deep Internet, a sequel to Project DeepWeb. Inspired by Internet lore and real netstalking experience, it tells a story of a person who got stuck in the wrong place at the wrong time.

The Show’s over. Time to wake up.

games.name: Rag Doll
games.summary: Fighting based on physics. Rag Doll is a 2D game with cartoon graphics, where you control the character's head, and the body moves according to the laws of physics! Play Story Mode, fight in multiplayer or local battle 1 vs 1!

games.name: Rhythmkill
games.summary: Rhythmkill is a super-fast rhythm action game where your every kill strikes on the beat. Wall-run, dash, slide, and chain lightning-fast katana kills through neon-drenched arenas. Master the rhythm, maintain your momentum, and fight your way to the boss who imprisoned you.

games.name: Solar Wave
games.summary: A large-scale 4X strategy game with indirect control and a focus on simulating a space empire. Capture systems, develop your economy and logistics, call up hundreds of powerful fleets and watch them incinerate enemies of the Solar Empire.

games.name: The Eternal Woods
games.summary: The Eternal Woods is a short, fast paced incremental about an adventurer trapped in a never ending Woods. Sharpen your axe, upgrade your skills and conquer the different Forests to escape the Woods!

games.name: The Pale Mimic
games.summary: The Pale Mimic is an atmospheric horror set in the untamed Alaskan wilderness. As a high profile fugitive on the run, it's just you and your dog surviving in the chilling forests, until something else shows up uninvited.

games.name: Tremble of Towers
games.summary: Tremble of Towers is a CO-OP tower defense game where you can build any structure with any resource. Countless of combinations are waiting for you and your friends to be discovered in order to protect your beloved Goal Stone from all kinds of enemies in various maps!

games.name: Upbeat
games.summary: Jump, bounce, and drum your way up an infinite climb. Build a beat, spawn platforms with your drum machine, and chain physics-powered combos to outclimb the competition in this rhythmic precision platformer.

games.name: Vice Vision Runner
games.summary: Prepare, Vice! Prove you are able - to navigate terrain, in pitch-black shadow beneath the canopy. Discover routes, and estimate time to complete. Immersive walking sim about Hellgate peninsula exploration. Ambient slow-paced runner

games.name: We Are So Dead
games.summary: A co-op seance horror game where one of you died first, and only you can see what's killing the others. Your only voice is a Ouija board your friends keep misreading. Guide them through a haunted house and banish the demon before sunrise. 2-8 players.

games.name: Working Class Monsters
games.summary: Do you HATE YOUR JOB? Well, these monsters don't have to. Place workers, open packs, make gold pile up. Ultra-casual incremental strategy where failure doesn't exist.

games.name: World of Clashes
games.summary:
World of Clashes is a pixel-art desert MMORPG set in a fictional Najd. Two factions — the Light of Sun City and the Dark of Moon City — divide a living open world of dunes, oases, bazaars and snowbound poles.

Players farm mobs for gear across six rarity tiers, take on quests, buy and ride camel mounts, and descend into Kahf Al-Arwah, an endless cave that carves a new maze on every run and supports four-player parties. Open-world faction PvP runs across two realms.

The centrepiece is the ranked arena: two 1v1 ladders, Open and Mirror, where gear is normalized so duels are decided by skill rat

games.name: The Sinking City 2
games.summary: The Sinking City 2 is a terrifying Lovecraftian journey, powered by Unreal Engine 5. Experience a heart-pounding survival horror as you explore the flooded city of Arkham and fight eldritch monsters beyond human comprehension.

games.name: Starsand Island
games.summary: Leave the hustle of the city behind and embrace life on Starsand Island. Fish, farm, raise animals, and befriend or fall in love with locals to learn their secrets. Customize your world with our DIY system, and invite friends to help build your dream paradise!

games.name: Twisted Tower
games.summary: Blast your way through an abandoned 1950s theme park crawling with fairy-tale mascots, twisted puzzles, and deadly traps. Uncover the dark secrets of your past as you race to the top to win back the love of your life.

games.name: Onimusha: Dawn of Dreams
games.summary: A port of Onimusha: Dawn of Dreams, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

games.name: Entropy
games.summary: Entropy is a tactical turn-based RPG inspired by classic JRPGs. Assemble your party of mercenaries and forge your own path towards an expedition into hell to stop the demonic incursion. Choices you make along the way will determine the fate of your world.

games.name: Stars Reach
games.summary: Explore a living galaxy in Stars Reach. Discover new planets, build settlements, and shape environments that react to everything you do. Players work together to transform untamed worlds into thriving civilizations across a single shared universe.

games.name: BeastLink
games.summary: BeastLink is a giant multiplayer Kaiju experience where humans, vehicles, and colossal Beasts collide in urban environments at unprecedented scale where absolutely everything you see can be destroyed. Build your Link and unleash your power before it consumes you!

games.name: Exark
games.summary: Exark is an engine builder about building a city aboard a gigantic ark-ship. Construct buildings, staff them with crew members, and maximise your ark's resource production by exploiting powerful synergies. Lead your Great House to safety at the rim of the world.

games.name: HyperCore: Rhythm Bullet Hell
games.summary: HyperCore is a “Rhythm Bullet Hell”, mixing the frenetic action of classic bullet hell Shoot'em Up with semi-procedurally generated encounters based on the music. As PRISS, survive the action-packed levels in sync with the music and protect what is left of Humanity.

games.name: Dead Age 2
games.summary: The successful indie survival RPG "Dead Age" (84% very positive) is back with a vengeance! No other game offers this mix of role-playing, rogue-like, fast-paced turn-based combat and survival all in one.

games.name: Grit
games.summary: Grit is a battle royale shooter set in the wild west. Build the best poker hand from found weapons and ride your horse to escape the oncoming calamity storm.

games.name: Last Pirates: Die Together
games.summary: Last Pirates: Die Together is a cooperative pirate-themed horror game designed for up to 4 players. Join a loyal crew of scallywags on a high-stakes mission to scavenge mysterious islands and make your old captain rich.

games.name: Lugal: Bronze Age Survival Game
games.summary: A survival craft game with RTS elements. Build a base, become the leader of a tribe → village → city → state. Conquer neighboring settlements and become king.

games.name: Ragnarok Zero: Global
games.summary:
Rediscover the original excitement of Midgard as Ragnarok Zero’s exclusive UI and simple controls allow all types of players, both new and seasoned, to easily and enjoyably experience the classic Ragnarok journey.

Ragnarok Zero: Global presents an evolved gameplay experience that sets itself apart from the original, including Ragnarok’s first-ever UGC content, localized maps, and Zero-exclusive episodes.

Operating under a subscription-based model designed for the PC MMORPG experience, Ragnarok Zero: Global focuses on balanced progression and long-term gameplay while preserving the spirit of

games.name: Voidface
games.summary: Face off in a challenging bullet-hell arena shooter to try and clear bite-sized boss rush challenges. Learn to dodge their attacks, cast spells to gain an upper hand, and kill everything that gets in your way.

games.name: Anaria: Reborn
games.summary: ANARIA: Reborn is a first-person psychological horror where you're trapped in the mind of a mysterious girl, searching for a way out through endless doors and a haunting nightmare.

games.name: Assault Wing 3
games.summary: Top-down arcade skillbased multiplayer PvP space-shooter game. Setup your loadout (Ship, Two weapons, Utility and Passive mods) and blast out other players in different game modes.

games.name: Ayakashi Yokocho no Natsuyasumi
games.summary: A browser visual novel with the main cast of Hatsune Miku: Colorful Stage based on japanese folklore.

games.name: Bullet Spell
games.summary: Dodge, weave, and coordinate your way through bullets and enemies in this magical spy-thriller! Stress-test your ability to multitask by controlling the twin sisters Aurora and Solana simultaneously, or share control with a second player to coordinate the twins' survival.

games.name: Chiaroscuro Lovers
games.summary: A domineering CEO-like older sister who’s gentle only to her sister, a childhood friend who became her doctor, and a cheerful girl only she can see… Who was Chu Hebai before losing her memories, and how did she become entangled with them? A melancholic yuri AVG about regret and unspoken love.

games.name: Circulo
games.summary: Circulo is a fast-paced 2D arena survival game centered around geometric chaos. Players control a small circle while facing waves of hostile shapes in an increasingly dangerous battlefield. Defeated enemies provide resources used to improve stats, unlock combat options and acquire upgrades. Runs feature different projectile types, passive upgrades, specialized abilities, enemy variants, bosses, checkpoints and random events.

games.name: Cook with Card
games.summary: Run your own cozy restaurant, prepare orders and create efficient kitchen workflows using your cards in this relaxing cooking management game.

games.name: Crown Chase
games.summary: Crown Chase is a fast-paced multiplayer party game where you compete against friends to grab and hold the magical crown. Run, dash, and use unique abilities in stylized 3D arenas to outsmart your opponents and claim the ultimate victory.

games.name: DDD: Demons Double Down
games.summary: Sometimes loneliness pushes us into strange, risky choices. A nightclub that wasn’t here yesterday. Mysterious strangers—each leaving more questions than answers. Just one short night that simply won’t end. What could possibly go wrong?

games.name: Dig to China Simulator
games.summary: Dig to China Simulator, is a game about digging a hole in your back yard, until you get to China. Find ores in the holes you dig, sell them, upgrade your equipment to dig faster.

games.name: Disney's Atlantis: The Lost Empire
games.summary:
A port of Disney’s Atlantis: The Lost Empire, originally released on the PlayStation console, enhanced with upscaling, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Disney's Atlantis: The Lost Empire is an action-adventure game based on the 2001 animated film. Players follow Milo Thatch and the expedition searching for the lost city of Atlantis, controlling several members of the crew across 12 levels. Gameplay combines platforming, combat, environmental puzzles, swimming, and vehicle sequences, with different characters providing abilities needed to overcome specific obstacles.

games.name: Doctrine: C.U.L.T.
games.summary: Build your own religion from the ground up. Forge dogma. Recruit followers. Expand your influence. Every decision shifts your power - and every power has a price. Will you be a savior or a tyrant? The world awaits your move.

games.name: Escape Sequence
games.summary: Escape Sequence is a synthwave highway racer where the traffic is a song and the wild drivers play it with you. Weave an ocean-side freeway at sunset, chain near-misses, outlive AI rivals who drive like you do — solo, LAN, or online with friends and public lobbies. Everything glows.

games.name: Fallin' Glocks
games.summary: Fallin' Glocks is a 2D skydiving action shooter with procedural levels and power-ups. Drop into the pits of a post-apocalyptic Earth and fight against hijacked, classified government weapons controlled by the master weapon, Ares.

games.name: Finding Ruby
games.summary: A cozy hidden object adventure inspired by classic puzzle books. Join Ruby and her loyal friends on a journey across the world to uncover the mystery of her missing archaeologist parents through beautifully hand-crafted and highly detailed scenes.

games.name: Gridiron Football League
games.summary: Call plays and take control on the field in a retro American football game backed by a deep franchise simulation. Draft, trade, and develop players, build custom teams and rosters, and chase championships across multiple seasons.

games.name: Grim Hand
games.summary: Grim Hand is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder built for phones: portrait, one-handed, fully playable offline. The weapon you carry decides your hand of cards, so a bow and a sword play like two different games, and rebuilding your loadout each run builds a new deck. Enemies fight in formation across front and back rows; you can snipe their leaders, sweep the front line, or break their morale so the survivors flee. The fully voiced four-act story follows a blacksmith who can't feed his family and takes up the only work left to him. It's a tragedy, not a power fantasy. Runs are procedural wi

games.name: HeroInc
games.summary: Can you evolve from a street thug into a savior? Manage your time and stats in this tactical Auto-Battler. Clear threats to stop the rising Fear before the city collapses. Build your hero, decide your fate.

games.name: Hook Party Arena
games.summary: Hook, ricochet, rescue, and outplay your rivals in a fast top-down multiplayer arena. Pull enemies into hazards, save teammates, trigger two-hook Headshots, and shape each short match with upgrades and tactical items in customizable Steam lobbies.

games.name: Inken
games.summary: Explore mysterious office building suspended in a desolate world! Inken is a multi-genre roguelike that can be a deckbuilder, topdown shooter, auto runner, puzzler, or idle game! Knowledge is the power that can slay the gods that consumed your world!

games.name: Jabb
games.summary: Jabb is an action game where every weapon you see is a possibility if an enemy has it so can you. Play as this leaf thingy and dash through unique levels and fight some bosses.

games.name: Last Drop
games.summary: Last Drop is a story you need to experience. Welcome to Nykylä Finland 1994. Seppo Sahtivaara and friends are waiting for you. This is an openworld action game with a story that has an impact. We bring back old good games and action from the best movies from that era. We want you to enjoy!

games.name: Loot Dungeon
games.summary: "Loot Dungeon" is a dark fantasy incremental roguelite ARPG where death is progression. Crawl deadly dungeons, collect loot, pick perks, and die... to get stronger. Go deeper, unlock new characters, upgrades and features. Will you make a deal with Death?

games.name: Morningstar
games.summary: Undertale Morningstar is a fan-game of Toby Fox's UNDERTALE made by Geno. Made specifically for people who still hold a "perverted sentimentality" towards UNDERTALE.

games.name: Néro & Sci ∫ Integral Edition
games.summary: In Néro & Sci, players explore a poetic world inspired by mathematics, where shapes, colors, and symbols form the backdrop of a unique adventure. Through the original “White Dimension” mechanic, they uncover a simplified version of the world that reveals new solutions to puzzles.

games.name: Nocturnal Echoes
games.summary: Nocturnal Echoes is a dark fantasy 2D action RPG set in the haunted world of Elaris. Explore cursed villages, forgotten towers, flooded barrows, and corrupted sanctuaries as a mysterious book pulls you into a story of memory, sacrifice, and ancient Wards beginning to fail.

games.name: Nudge
games.summary: nudge is a cozy organization-sim about finding space for your work, mom, and huge assortment of gacha toys. Unbox over 50 collectibles from 8 unique sets, decorate your first apartment, and try to find room for everything in your life, including mom.

games.name: October: Survivor's Guilt
games.summary: October: Survivor's Guilt is an first-person psychological horror game where you explore an unsettling house, interact with objects, and try to survive a terrifying night after a simple favor goes wrong.

games.name: Pet Street Story
games.summary: Jinyu, also known as Xiaoli, worked on Pet Street to repay her owner's debt as a way of expressing gratitude for the owner's life-saving kindness. During this time, she made various friends and experienced unusual events. As she matured, Jinyu decided to revive the increasingly depressed Pet Street.

games.name: Polluted Flesh
games.summary: Very short on-rails collector game where you're stuck in the guts of a cosmic sea creature, polluted by waste.

games.name: Project Sekai: Ayakashi Yokochou no Natsuyasumi
games.summary:
Before you knew it, you found yourself in an unfamiliar place.
It was a mysterious SEKAI inhabited by the ayakashis.
It seems you’ll need to make the summer festival a success to return to your original world!?

Work together with the ayakashis—who look familiar for some reason—to make the summer festival a success!

games.name: Raze
games.summary: Raze is an action roguelike based on randomization. Destroy thousands or tens of thousands of enemies in a single run, adapt to random events, and survive through to your cat reflexes. There are no easy paths here, and no room for mistakes.

games.name: Ready or Nowhere
games.summary: Can you survive the mission without making a single mistake?

games.name: Real Backrooms
games.summary: Explore the deepest parts of the Backrooms in an attempt to escape alive, alone or with your friends! Are you ready to face this dangerous world? Or will you accept your fate and die? Choose, or the Backrooms will choose for you!

games.name: Red Tanks vs Lizard
games.summary: Defend the base. Burn the lizards. Take three stars.

games.name: Spongebob Squarepants x One Piece
games.summary: A short two-stage game where you pilot a ship/bubble and collect coins. This was part of a McDonald's Happy Meal promotion.

games.name: Stackmon
games.summary: Stack, train and collect 100+ powerful Stackmon in this creature-collector with a card-stacking twist! Build your camp, challenge rival Scouts in combat and face the mysterious corruption spreading throughout your land.

games.name: Tail and Сhaos
games.summary:
Tail and Chaos is a colorful top-down action roguelite about a caravan of meerkats crossing a dangerous world. Choose one of three heroes, combine weapons and upgrades across eight shared slots, unlock synergies and evolutions, and survive 30-minute acts filled with branching routes, events, elite enemies, and bosses.

Journey through scorching dunes, a moonlit riverbed, and the Plateau of Dawn in three standalone acts or connect them in an Expedition. Choose a Caravan Law and a rescued specialist, carry one non-starter item between fresh builds, and continue later from a saved camp. Earn coin

games.name: TFC2: The Fertile Crescent 2 - Collapse of The Bronze Age
games.summary: Lead your small caravan on a great journey across the ancient world, in a story-driven RTS where protecting your family and friends matters more than conquest.

games.name: The Sovereign's Board
games.summary: The Sovereign's Board is an online 1v1, 3D, turn-based strategy game. Battle against your rival by utilizing a team of 3 unique characters all with their own strengths and weaknesses.

games.name: The World Well: Blood of Caro
games.summary: 814 R.E; the war is approaching. In Redimus, the chaotic world where magic, technology, slaves and vampires coexist, a young girl happens upon a magic gun that sets her on a journey of revenge. There is a burning manor behind her, and the road ahead disappears in the jungles of the night...

games.name: This Is Golf
games.summary: This Is Golf is a casual but challenging first-person golf game with randomly generated holes. Shot shaping and distance are based entirely on mouse motion. Play solo or in lobbies of up to 8 players, and enjoy a fun, competitive, and slightly goofy golfing experience.

games.name: Toll: The Ferryman's Ledger
games.summary: You are Charon. You take the coins from the eyes of the dead — and one of them, someday, must be your own. A short incremental with a real ending: five rivers, a tribute owed to Hades, and a price on your own freedom. It ends. That is the whole point.

games.name: Torment Hexus
games.summary: Technofascist cyberpunk CEOs must die! Charge spells with the match-3 grid, then cast them on your enemies in turn-based tactical roguelike combat. Climb the tower, kill the boss, and maybe make the world a better place.

games.name: Untergrund Raceways: Arena
games.summary: Untergrund Raceways Arena (short: URA) is a kart arena fighter from Vantech Studios, developed in cooperation with the AAP. URA covers a scope that seems somewhat atypical for a first PC game.

games.name: Wheelchair for Two
games.summary: Start a chaotic co-op adventure in one wheelchair. Two players control different sides of the chair and must work together to survive brutal obstacles, dangerous jumps, and physics-based challenges. Play solo, local co-op, or online with a friend — one small mistake can send you both falling down.

games.name: Steins;Gate Re:Boot
games.summary: STEINS;GATE returns! Rebooted for the modern era! Featuring fully updated visuals, UI, and an all-new story that breathes new life into the streets of Akihabara.

games.name: Project P.I.T.T.
games.summary: Feed rubber ducks to a corporate void. Build physics contraptions. Chain combos for profit as the Maw grows hungrier... and larger. Brutalist PSX satire meets first-person sandbox chaos.

games.name: Tic-Tac: Twelve O’Clock
games.summary: Tic-Tac: Twelve O’Clock is a survival horror game. Monitor corridors and rooms through surveillance cameras to counter vengeful ghosts. Keep the lights on, the generator charged, and fuses replaced… and don’t get caught!

games.name: Deadlock Station
games.summary: Turn the battlefield into your ally in this tactical rogue-like with indirect controls. Assemble a unique squad, destroy the alien invaders with precise planning, and uncover the truth about the Event and the mysterious disappearance of humans.

games.name: Vapor World: Over the Mind
games.summary:
To escape the twisted world, the boy begins his journey.

Vapor World is an action-adventure game that unfolds the inner world.

games.name: After Inc: Revival
games.summary: Can you rebuild civilisation after a zombie apocalypse? From the creator of Plague Inc. comes a unique blend of strategic simulation, survival city builder and ‘mini 4X’. Build settlements, harvest resources and shape society as you lead Humanity out of the darkness.

games.name: Rekindling
games.summary: Rekindling is a settlement building and management game. You are tasked with rebuilding society after the ZTD virus has taken over and turned the masses into mindless creatures. Build, Harvest, Mine, and Fight with your survivors to build a sustainable society and take steps towards finding the cure!

games.name: T.W.I.R.L.
games.summary: It's 3am in your childhood home. Everyone's asleep, but you. Sneak out of your room to do what you always do - "T.W.I.R.L." - whatever that means.

games.name: 100 Goblin Cats
games.summary: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️ Can you find them all? ️

games.name: Arcade Shop Simulator
games.summary: Run your arcade shop! Bargain for machines, set them up, and let kids enjoy the fun. Earn money, keep your shop clean, and customize it with stylish accessories. Need more space? Expand your shop and build the ultimate arcade empire, then play your Arcades after hours and compete with other players!

games.name: Ashes of the Damned: The Forgotten Ward
games.summary: Trapped in a looping asylum, stalked by something in the dark. Explore, uncover hidden truths, and survive in this first-person psychological horror.

games.name: Bendy's Nightmare Run
games.summary:
Dodge deadly attacks, collect weapons, and defeat terrifying cartoon bosses in a nightmare-fueled Bendy runner.

Bendy's Nightmare Run is back!

Run as Bendy, Boris, or Alice in a nightmare-fueled endless runner where the goal is simple: survive the chase and defeat crazy cartoon bosses.

games.name: Blood in the Panopticon
games.summary: Enter an ASCII-Art bullet hell war-zone! Guide and maintain your android and enact vengeance upon this corrupted world. Upgrade C424, keep her loyal, and use her to paint the Concrete Plains red. But remember: Panopticon always stares back.

games.name: Crownrats
games.summary: Crownrats is a co-op colony RPG where mouse heroes explore locations, capture rooms, mine resources, build a home colony and resist rival warrens. Play solo with bots or together in quick tactical runs.

games.name: Desktop Detective
games.summary:
Search for clues in this idle detective RPG that lives quietly in the corner of your screen.

Investigate crime scenes, gain clues, upgrade your stats, and grow stronger across ascensions while you go about your day.

games.name: Dreamcards
games.summary: Build your deck during the day and at night fight the monster that haunts your dreams. Will you be able to escape the nightmare in this roguelike deckbuilder that combines strategy, occultism and psychology?

games.name: Dungeon Antiqua 2
games.summary: Relive the golden age of dungeon RPGs with Dungeon Antiqua 2! A retro 2D dungeon crawler bursting with SNES nostalgia. Hack, slash, and survive relentless side-view encounters! With 10 jobs and endless skill combos, forge the ultimate party and conquer the depths—if you dare!

games.name: Eggventure
games.summary: Eggventure is a 2D Metroidvania platformer where you play as Egbert, an egg on a mission to rescue his friends from becoming breakfast.

games.name: Escape the Grind
games.summary: Can you retire before 65?? A realistic financial life sim across 10 real economies. Real salaries, real housing markets, real investment products. Every month is a real decision. Three difficulty levels + Play Your Life mode. Six native languages. Play your way to freedom.

games.name: Furniture Fu
games.summary: Furniture Fu is a home-makeover, demon-hunting, hoard-fighting roguelike. Lay out furniture strategically to make awesome synergies and cosy houses - all in a day’s work for America’s first suburban ninja.

games.name: G-Mode Archives+: Kishinden Strike-G-
games.summary: This title is a simulation RPG, originally released for Japanese flip phone application, in which players control robots. The story unfolds through lively exchanges between a colorful cast of characters, with a scenario by Hachirō Izumi.

games.name: Gangstar Mirage City
games.summary: Enter Mirage City — a living open-world city built on heists, garages, street clashes, and underground power. Join your crew, take the right jobs, drive anything that can get you out alive, and build a name the whole city will recognize.

games.name: Hearth and Hamlet
games.summary: Gather resources and grow your settlement from a humble camp into a vibrant, magic-filled kingdom! Hearth and Hamlet is an incremental citybuilder game in a cozy pixelart style. Assign workers, unlock new buildings, policies, and magic, trade with faraway lands, and construct your ideal settlement!

games.name: Holey
games.summary: Holey is a co-op horror game where you are part of a crew sheltering in a collapsed tunnel, scavenging loot across maps filled with deadly creatures born from a biological war. Feed the creature, convert its waste into fuel, and reach the radio tower

games.name: Hoshizora he Tatsu Hi
games.summary: ────On that day, the girl rewove the fabric of the world. A Mystic Suspense Visual Novel.

games.name: Hoshizora he Tatsuhi
games.summary: An occult suspense girl-meets-girl story in which a rumor-loving girl 'interviews' a serial killer.

games.name: Incident Archives: Flight 882
games.summary: Incident Archives - Flight 882 is a first person psychological horror game inspired by true events, set on a night flight.

games.name: Keep Her Safe
games.summary: Keep Her Safe is a survival shooting game. Gather resources, fortify your base, and withstand zombie hordes to keep the rocket project alive and bring an end to the acid rain apocalypse. Besides the hard life in wasteland, you can also chill up with friends in different multiplayer gameplays.

games.name: Lablue Horror
games.summary: LaBlue Horror is a first-person psychological horror game set in a dark Backrooms-inspired maze. Explore, hide, survive and find the exit before the creature finds you.

games.name: Light & Glory
games.summary: Light & Glory is a short indie horror game where the main gimmick is you can only move when you are completely blind. There is a significant amount of lore and story. "What would you do to become Jacob the second"

games.name: Linerunner
games.summary: A minimalist time trial game. Race down the straights, weave through the turns, and see if you have what it takes to be a world champion.

games.name: Manorism
games.summary: Solve its secrets or become one in this third-person cozy-horror puzzle adventure about home and belonging. Explore quirky rooms, test unspoken rules, and use magic to solve playful puzzles as strange secrets unfold within a mysterious manor. Refuge is only the beginning.

games.name: Ministry of Truth: False Memory
games.summary: Ministry of Truth: False Memory is a story-driven simulator in a totalitarian society. Become an official, manipulate facts, rewrite history, and provide the ‘truth’ to the public. Choose: obey or fight against the regime. The Great Father is watching you!

games.name: Money Trails
games.summary: Become a billionaire as you venture out in your limousine. Decide what to buy and build to grow your endless procedurally generated island. Add up your money, incrementally increase your passive income and receive random alerts on your Personal Digital Assistant while you travel.

games.name: My Singing Monsters Karaoke
games.summary: Choose your favorite Monster and hop on the karaoke stage for the performance of a lifetime! Hit the notes, conduct the chaos, and watch your favorite Monster performers squish, stretch, and contort through every song. Whether you’re pitch-perfect or off key, every karaoke concert will be memorable!

games.name: No Case Should Remain Unsolved
games.summary: Twelve years after Senior Inspector Jeon Gyeong's retirement, she is visited by a young police officer: a woman who pleads with her to reexamine Seowon's case. But with each uncovered memory, only one thing becomes clear: everyone in Seowon's vicinity was lying.

games.name: Pizza House Simulator
games.summary: Run your dream pizzeria solo or with up to 6 players in chaotic online co-op multiplayer. Cook authentic pizzas, automate your kitchen, customize your restaurant, survive disasters, invest in stocks, gamble and build the ultimate Italian restaurant empire.

games.name: Plodding Recovery
games.summary: "Why did it come to this?" That's what the protagonist asks, his body and mind worn to the breaking point. From there begins a journey of rediscovering the self he had long neglected. A small action at a time, he plods forward — slowly, haltingly — toward recovery.

games.name: Pocket Furies
games.summary: A deck‑building card battler where players take turns collecting treats to tame new Furies, expanding their arsenal and ramping up their power until they finally overwhelm the opposition.

games.name: Ringwold: The Last Collector
games.summary: Ringwold, the last of his kind, is trapped aboard a strange collector ship. Explore the ship, earn credits, use specialized machines, unlock upgrades, and collect creature cards reconstructed from corrupted Earth biology.

games.name: Shake It Co!
games.summary: Grow your orchard by shaking trees! Literally shake your mouse! Join Co, a friendly adventurer with a can-do spirit, and plant unique saplings for bountiful fruit. Collect coins, invest in upgrades, and harvest in a charming 2D style!

games.name: Space Tales
games.summary: Space Tales is a real-time strategy game set in a retro-futuristic environment. Take on the role of a commander in the Intergalactic Planetary Expansion (I.P.E.) and immerse yourself in a thrilling mission to explore and conquer new planets, pushing the boundaries of the Human Empire.

games.name: Spring at Dawn, I Am a Monster.
games.summary: "Spring at Dawn, I Am a Monster." is a psychological horror adventure exploring themes of salvation, dependency, morality, and ruin, featuring multiple endings shaped by your choices.

games.name: Still in the Fog
games.summary: A first-person horror adventure that combines environmental exploration, combat, strategic puzzles, and intense encounters in a fog-covered town that refuses to let you escape. Can you find a way out? Estimated playtime: 4–7 hours

games.name: Sudoku Mansion
games.summary: A story-driven Sudoku adventure by puzzle setter Nurator, featured on Cracking the Cryptic. Explore a mysterious mansion of handcrafted Sudoku variants, master increasingly intricate puzzles, and uncover the secret hidden beyond the grid.

games.name: Super Algator Bros
games.summary:
Super Algator Bros. is a fast-paced 2D platformer following Algator on a chaotic adventure across eight unique worlds. After the Rabbids trap Harleen on another Discord server, Algator must travel through dangerous environments, collect likes, eat crêpes, defeat enemies, and unlock powerful transformations to rescue her.

Jump across platforms, break blocks, collect rewards, dodge traps, and take on enemies such as Rabbits, Hog Riders, and flying Canaries. Throughout the adventure, Algator can obtain special power-ups including the Crêpe transformation, the powerful MODE R9, and a temporary GO

games.name: Swarm of the Sea
games.summary: You are a humble lighthouse keeper, working alone on a remote island. Being isolated for months on end really gnaws at your sanity. All those uncanny shadow figures and ghastly noises must be figments of your mind, right? Follow the signs on your path, find meaning in the madness and Save Our Souls.

games.name: The Hidden Camp
games.summary: The Hidden Camp is a multiplayer social deduction survival game for 9 players. Work together, complete tasks, identify the hidden traitors, and survive tense rounds filled with suspicion, strategy, and betrayal.

games.name: Tomato Dealer
games.summary: An illegal shop keeping game. Grow tomatoes, dry and sell to customers. Broaden your customer network but be careful, there are undercover cops! Deal with police attention with the help of the mafia.

games.name: Toy Tactics
games.summary: A physics-based RTS game with a unique control system. Lead legendary warriors from distant ages in their quest for glory! Command your troops by just drawing your formations on the battlefield. Surround, ambush, deceive.. faster than ever! Your imagination is the limit.

games.name: Ultradimensional
games.summary: Explore over 40 interconnected levels, evade over 20 unique entities, solve puzzles, manage scarce resources, and survive a nonlinear backrooms horror experience with multiple routes, and extreme replayability.

games.name: Vitalis
games.summary: Vitalis is a TTRPG-inspired Roguelike and Dungeon Crawler where you try to escape an occult forest. Cast your die to move, fight, and flee. Scale your character, collect items, and weapons. Defeat the boss and leave the forest, or run away and bide your time.

games.name: Wild Ice
games.summary: When the world froze over, humanity's final stand to survive is left to the blades of it's most unlikely heroes - small town hockey players. Play solo or local co-op as best friends Max and Finley as they take on the frost and whatever lurks within it. Welcome to the a-puck-alypse!

games.name: Mortal Shell II
games.summary: Their Flesh Is Your Weapon. Mortal Shell II is a standalone sequel action-RPG with adrenaline-charged, high-stakes combat. Possess warrior Shells, dethrone false gods, redeem a ravaged world.

games.name: Mexican Ninja
games.summary: A frantic fast-paced beat 'em up roguelike full of crass, brass and incredibly badass. Become THE Mexican Ninja as you slice your way through the streets of Nuevo Tokyo in this retro 2.5D arcade throwback. So what’chu waiting for? Show me your skills pinche ninja!

games.name: Another Crab's Treasure
games.summary: Another Crab’s Treasure is a soulslike adventure set in a crumbling underwater world plagued by a mysterious curse. As Kril the hermit crab, you’ll need to wear the trash around you as shells to withstand attacks from enemies many times your size. Embark on an epic treasure hunt to buy back your repossessed shell, and discover the dark secrets behind the polluted ocean.

games.name: Brigador Killers
games.summary: Isometric insurgent simulator. Fight on foot and in vehicles, build and steal a private arsenal and bring the war home to the businessmen who started it all in this continuation of the Brigador saga.

games.name: Puppergeist
games.summary:
Play as Claire, a witch who journeys into the mysterious Doggie Underworld with one simple goal: Finding her lost Pup!

As you travel through Doggie Underworld, you'll encounter countless souls, each with a story to tell. Share moments with them, play together, and listen to their heartfelt tales. Use your sense of rhythm to lift their spirits and ease their troubles, bringing you one beat closer to reuniting with your own lost Pup.

games.name: Vacation Cafe Simulator
games.summary: Cozy Italian Vacation Cafe ️ No timers, No stress cook traditional dishes upgrade and customize just drink prosecco, relax and grow your dream cafe

games.name: Gallipoli
games.summary: Land on the battlefields of the Middle Eastern Front of World War 1! Gallipoli brings the most authentic WW1 FPS battles yet, with desert warfare, beach landings, historical classes and realistic weaponry.

games.name: Grim Trials
games.summary: Prove your worth. Hack and blast your way through the Grim Trials. Explore the (after)life of the Academy – a training ground for aspiring Grim Reapers. Befriend fellow Reapers, learn from your mentors, and uncover the secrets of your life and love before your death.

games.name: Mine Defense
games.summary: Mine Defense is a 2D action-adventure game inspired by sandbox survival games. Explore a dangerous world, gather resources, craft weapons and equipment, fight hostile creatures, and build your own base. Progress through the game by discovering new materials, improving your gear, and facing increasingly powerful enemies and bosses.

games.name: Over Requiemz
games.summary:
“Whatever pain awaits, I won’t regret this choice.”

A dark fantasy game about overcoming grief as you wander into the “Land of Oz.”

games.name: Cozy Marbles
games.summary: Cozy Marbles is a comfy game about building marble runs on a sunny afternoon. Using a huge range of bits and pieces, fit together the marble course you’ve always wanted to build and play with. Unwind to a lo-fi ASMR soundscape and roll with the nostalgia.

games.name: Frog Island
games.summary: Frog Island is a fully hand-drawn, cozy Frog Collection and Life-Sim game. Start your new life as a caretaker for an island of frogs in this cozy creature-collector! Build your dream island, discover magical wildlife, and uncover the island's many hidden secrets, to try and piece together the past life you've somehow forgotten.

games.name: How to Fish
games.summary: A 1-4 player physics based fishing simulator. While drinking and boating you suddenly crash into a small island. To work your way back home you have to learn How to Fish.

games.name: Pipistrello and the Cursed Yoyo
games.summary: Are you ready for the first Yoyovania?! In this 2D top-down adventure you'll explore a sprawling urban landscape, reinterpreting your surroundings through your mastery of yoyo tricks. Combine moves for traversal, fight the city's rival crime lords, and regain the influence of the Pipistrello family!

games.name: Theropods
games.summary: Face dinosaurs, solve puzzles and travel back to the time of ginormous lizards and pixelated adventure games.

games.name: DeadEye
games.summary: Stop time and master your revolver in this intense 2D roguelike shooter. Face relentless hordes, defeat brutal bosses, forge powerful pacts, and collect artifacts and pets as you fight for survival.

games.name: Dogpile
games.summary: Dogpile is a roguelike deck builder about merging cute dogs into bigger dogs. Play dogs, get money, customize your dogs with special Traits, refine your deck, PLAY MORE DOGS! DOGS!

games.name: Driving Is Hard
games.summary: Challenge yourself in Driving Is Hard! Drive a bathtub on wheels through steep, unforgiving terrain where every mistake costs you progress. Master tough physics-based gameplay, sharpen your patience, and uncover Jeff’s journey of self-doubt, family struggles, and emotional growth as he finds strength, self-acceptance, and hope for a brighter future.

games.name: Entity Research Group
games.summary: First-person psychological co-op investigation horror. Players act as researchers, completing tasks and gathering evidence to identify various entity types.

games.name: Ground Zero Hero
games.summary: Kill mutants. Absorb their remains. Mutate into something stronger every run. Stack insane power combos and survive overwhelming hordes in this fast, chaotic, highly replayable action roguelite bullet hell.

games.name: Ironsand
games.summary: Ironsand is a hardcore rogue-lite FPS. Your team lands on a desert planet full of various enemies. You are given 10 attempts to capture each of the cities and destroy desert monsters, cyborgs and the main goal - the huge Titan combat robots

games.name: PengPong
games.summary: PengPong is a survival roguelike shooter in a vintage cartoon world. Use a hockey stick to deflect pucks and weapons, stop swarms, and test your luck. Spend chips for safe upgrades or risk it at the roulette. New builds and quirky synergies challenge survival every run.

games.name: Repterra
games.summary: Repterra is a base-building survival game set in a world overrun by dinosaurs. Fend off massive hordes while building your colony. Manage resources and grow your army to survive in this dino-infested land.

games.name: Silent Breath
games.summary: Silent Breath is a horror experience powered by Unreal Engine 5. Featuring photorealistic graphics, fully dynamic scares and microphone detection.

games.name: Slayblade
games.summary: Build your ultimate Slayblade and become King of the Streets! Collect 60+ parts for battle, and combine them for wicked power combos. Skate around the city in all its PS1 glory, making bank on your way to the top. And if you die in the game, you die in real life.

games.name: Spirited Line
games.summary: Spirited Line is a boss rush hack ‘n’ slash action game where every hit you take is fatal. Master precise, skill-based combat against unique spirits in a surreal, minimalist subway world. Fast-paced duels demand focus, timing, and patience to survive.

games.name: Swarmdustry
games.summary: Build a living factory and automate the Swarm. Harvest resources, build mega factories and evolve organic industry. Balance growth, efficiency, creep spread, and survive in a world that fights back.

games.name: 1000xResist
games.summary: 1000xRESIST is a thrilling sci-fi adventure. The year is unknown, and a disease spread by an alien invasion keeps you underground. You are Watcher. You dutifully fulfil your purpose in serving the ALLMOTHER, until the day you discover a shocking secret that changes everything. The game blends visual novel, walking simulator, and third-person exploration as you navigate nonlinear memories and unravel the mystery of what really happened—and what’s still being kept from you.

games.name: 2nd Eve
games.summary: In 2nd EVE, a sci-fi side-scrolling combat RPG, you're Zola, Sister Superior of the colony spaceship ARGOS. After a catastrophic hyperspace event, battle rogue machines, twisted crew, and deadly anomalies to protect humanity's last hope—the cryo sleepers.

games.name: Aerialia: Wings of Delivery
games.summary: Take to the skies, deliver with care, and connect a peaceful world one package at a time.

games.name: Agro Simulator: Season 26
games.summary: Agro Simulator: Season 26 is a modern farming simulator where you operate machinery, grow crops, protect your fields, and expand your business. Turn a small plot of land into a thriving agricultural empire.

games.name: AI Learns To Drive
games.summary: Train AI to drive! Create your own neural network and watch it evolve from chaos to mastery with the power of evolutionary algorithms and natural selection. Fine-tune the learning process to craft the ultimate AI driver, and test your creation in campaign challenges or on custom-built tracks.

games.name: Aluminium City
games.summary: Crush empty cans and sell the aluminium, buy upgrades, automatic can presses, and robots to automatize and speed up your process, and pay off your debt.

games.name: Amata
games.summary: Rage across the mad realms of a dead god as Charlet, the immortal artificer. Explore a vast, arcane desolation wrought by hatred. Cleanse the twisted inhabitants of ancient, forgotten worlds. Help Charlet find a way home using her powerful and varied suite of combat and platforming abilities.

games.name: Apex Ascent
games.summary: Apex Ascent is a fast-paced climbing platformer where danger lurks on every wall. Dodge deadly boxing gloves that punch out from the surfaces, leap over spinning obstacles, and time your moves to avoid searing lasers. Reach the top or fall trying.

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Cyber Cycles
games.summary:
"CYBER CYCLES" is a racing game released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1995.
This game featured a large bike-style cabinet design that stood out at arcades at the time.
Set against the backdrop of near-future motorcycle racing, choose from a lineup of unique machines with different performance features, and cross the finish line ahead of all your rivals!

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Ninja Emaki
games.summary:
Ninja Emaki is a shooter released by Nichibutsu in 1986.
Take control of the young hero Shinbei and fight to rescue the princess from the evil spirit army.
Pick up scrolls to gain access to 8 different kinds of Ninja Magic. Use them wisely, and they'll be the key to advancing through the game!

games.name: Arcade Archives: Cyber Cycles
games.summary:
"CYBER CYCLES" is a racing game released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1995.
This game featured a large bike-style cabinet design that stood out at arcades at the time.
Set against the backdrop of near-future motorcycle racing, choose from a lineup of unique machines with different performance features, and cross the finish line ahead of all your rivals!

games.name: Ascent DX
games.summary: Crashed on a desolate but mysterious planet you find yourself eye to eye with an ancient civilization. Explore the planet, find powerful upgrades, and fulfill your destiny.

games.name: Awaken in Fear
games.summary: Awaken in the middle of the night to a terrifying nightmare. Explore a haunted house, solve puzzles, avoid sinister creatures, and fight to survive until dawn.

games.name: Backrooms: The Deep Dark
games.summary: Backrooms: The Deep Dark is a 4-player cooperative horror game where you will survive in a mysterious scary atmospheric world, wander through unknown dark corners and get scared of every nook and cranny!

games.name: Beach Volleyball Boys: Hot Spike
games.summary:
The roster's stacked. One spot open. Every match could change everything.
Think you can win them over before the season starts?

games.name: Beetle Sumo
games.summary: Beetle Sumo turns Japanese rhinoceros beetle wrestling into a fast couch-party battle. Charge, shove, scramble, and survive as up to 8 beetles fight to be the last one on the table.

games.name: Berry Bury Berry
games.summary: A juicy first-person incremental game about growing berries and tossing them down an ominous hole. Earn money and upgrades. Make new friends with sentient berry pals. Grow and control the hole as you unearth why nobody leaves this accursed garden. Bury it all, Berry everything.

games.name: Build My Arcade
games.summary: Build your dream arcade from the ground up!

games.name: Can Your Otaku Cabinet Grow a Beautiful Girl?
games.summary: Players will take on the role of a savior transported to a miniature world, rescuing flowers through battles and trials, protecting and caring for them, and embarking on a new harem life in a perilous fantasy world.

games.name: Capote
games.summary:
Capote is an online card game for 2 to 6 players that mixes classic trick-taking rules with bold bets and chaotic special cards. Each match is set around a casual card table full of colorful characters—and in Capote, no win is guaranteed, and any card can flip the game.

Players bet how many tricks they think they’ll win, then play their cards round by round to hit that number exactly. If you win more or fewer tricks than you bet, you’ll take a virtual shot for each one off. Hit four shots and… you’re out. Capotado!

If the cards aren’t in your favor, don’t worry—messing with your friends is a

games.name: Chai Glide
games.summary: Slither, collect ingredients, and brew tea inside your snake. Complete cozy shifts in this modern twist on a classic. Classic score attack mode included!

games.name: Closing Shift
games.summary: An online co-op horror game where you're a fast food employee in Hell. You'll need to serve customers, cook food, and meet your night task quotas to keep your job.

games.name: Console Archives: Rhapsody II - Ballad of the Little Princess
games.summary:
Rhapsody II: Ballad of the Little Princess was released by Nippon Ichi Software in 1999 for a 32-bit home console.
Set 12 years after “Rhapsody: A Musical Adventure”, this musical RPG follows Kururu—the daughter born to Cornet and Prince Ferdinand—as she sets off on a journey to find her ideal prince.
Enjoy the world of the Marl Kingdom brought to life by richly expressive characters and a newly revamped battle system that adds deeper tactical depth.

games.name: Cozy Pages: Comfy Coloring for All Ages - Paint, Draw & Relax
games.summary: Your cozy corner. Cute, calming coloring for all ages.

games.name: Dark Reflection
games.summary: "Dark reflection" is a mix of good old-fashioned aesthetics of pixel games, black humor and light philosophy with cool and catchy music.

games.name: Deep Blue Sushi
games.summary: Deep Blue Sushi is a casual 1–5 player co-op adventure where you explore the ocean, catch fresh fish, prepare sushi, serve customers, and grow your restaurant while uncovering the secrets of the mysterious Deep Blue.

games.name: Demonworld: Hell Boss Fight
games.summary: Two distinct levels with the idea of escaping hell. In the first level you control a mosquito in a multi-stage boss fight with a sword throwing demon. The second level is a dark platformer puzzle where you must find the exit.

games.name: Dice Nights
games.summary: Roll the dice, chase high scores, and master classic combinations, a colorful and relaxing board game experience for players of all ages.

games.name: Dino Hex Trap
games.summary: Traps, Dinosaurs, and Strategic Chaos

games.name: Drive Me Broke
games.summary: Build your dream car! The cops are always on your back, so stay on good terms with them... Also, be prepared to do any job that requires money.

games.name: Dungeon Antiqua 2
games.summary: Relive the golden age of dungeon RPGs with Dungeon Antiqua 2! A retro 2D dungeon crawler bursting with SNES nostalgia. Hack, slash, and survive relentless side-view encounters! With 10 jobs and endless skill combos, forge the ultimate party and conquer the depths—if you dare!

games.name: Eggconsole The Legend of Heroes III: "White Witch" Renewal PC-9801
games.summary: The dawn of the Gagharv Trilogy. Join Jurio and Chris to uncover the truth behind the White Witch!

games.name: Emoji Killer: Casino Massacre
games.summary: Shoot, dodge, kill, upgrade, unlock... do not let a single emoji escape!

games.name: False Alarm
games.summary: False Alarm is a 2D stealth adventure where you enter each level with nothing, and use whatever you can find to complete your mission. Throw a crowbar, blow up a microwave, brew some coffee, drop a chandelier on someone's head. Stay out of the light and distract your enemies however you can.

games.name: False Love: Ghost or Not?
games.summary: Can love survive when you can no longer trust reality? Emily and Ethan leave the city behind to rebuild their relationship in a quiet countryside home. Far from the noise of everyday life, they hope for a fresh start.

games.name: Feed The Scorchpot
games.summary: A dice roguelike about feeding a dragon for twenty years. Roll ingredients, build your island, and fuse absurd recipes into combos that break the score wide open. Miss a meal and you're next on the menu.

games.name: Fluffy Friends: Cute Preschool
games.summary: Count and discover with lions, monkeys and exotic animals in a magical forest!

games.name: Gangstar Mirage City
games.summary: Enter Mirage City — a living open-world city built on heists, garages, street clashes, and underground power. Join your crew, take the right jobs, drive anything that can get you out alive, and build a name the whole city will recognize.

games.name: Gargantua
games.summary: Build your spaceship-city Gargantua. Forge industries, bend the free market, trade between planets, and defend your growing wealth. Every bullet is bought or produced in a simulated economy where a single mistake can shatter supply chains and trigger interstellar crises. In Gargantua, war is money.

games.name: Get Fit: Furry Edition
games.summary: Train with hot furries, push your limits, and get stronger with every session!

games.name: Ghost Buster:Village
games.summary: An extreme blogger travels to an abandoned village that, according to legend, was deserted in a single day. While exploring, he encounters rituals and entities rooted in Slavic mythology. But the truth waiting there is far more terrifying than any legend.

games.name: Graph TD: Cosmic
games.summary: It is a strategy roguelike game. Use cards to form a graph of towers and nodes, tweak heat, power and other mechanics, and minmax what's in your hand. Reverse Earth's fate from the end of time.

games.name: Gun Shop Manager
games.summary: Gun Shop Manager is a 3D simulation game where you run a gun shop with help from the mafia. Clean, customize, and test weapons to satisfy your shady customers. Order parts, create unique designs, and close risky deals with gangs just be careful not to catch the police’s eye.

games.name: Hedgehog's Dilemma
games.summary: A story of love, connections, and separation, a story about philosophy and science. Marharyta and Mykhailo try to figure out their relationships - and cannot help but fall in love over and over again.

games.name: Hollow Hide
games.summary: Hollow Hide asymmetric hide-and-seek with new mechanics. Gather resources for disguise, signal your friends, run from the hunter. Or play as the hunter track down escaped test subjects and shoot them with your rifle

games.name: Hotel Tycoon
games.summary: Welcome guests, upgrade rooms, hire staff and build the hotel empire of your dreams!

games.name: How to Kill a Fly
games.summary: You are a corporate flesh object with no way to speak on your own trying to pose as a human by mimicking what other people say. Serve the corporation that owns you, complete your assignment.

games.name: Hyper Primate
games.summary: Speedrun as a Hyper Fast Ape in this parkour focused FPS. Dash, grapple, and blast through deadly obstacle courses using a massive arsenal of weapons. Master momentum, dodge death, and dominate the leaderboards.

games.name: IAH: Internet War
