games.summary: "IAH: INTERNET WAR" - a roguelike Turn-Based RTS hybrid survival game. Battle through the internet’s depths and survive as long as possible.

games.name: Japan Stigmatized Property 2
games.summary:
Can you survive until dawn?
Monitor real Japanese properties and report every anomaly.

games.name: Just Anomaly: Hospital
games.summary: 15 floors. One hospital. How careful can you be while shaking with fear?

games.name: Kerf: Sawmill Tycoon
games.summary:
KERF: Sawmill Tycoon is a first-person sawmill sim where nothing happens without you. Every tree is felled by your hand, every plank comes off a saw you operate, and every coin is earned at a counter you built up from nothing. You start with an axe and a single clearing at the foot of a waterfall.

Fell trees with your own hands, saw logs into planks, chop firewood, craft furniture and sell it all to your customers. A first-person sawmill tycoon where you do the work yourself: take on commissions, hire a crew, replant the forest and grow a humble yard into a timber empire.

games.name: Kingdom II: Shadoan
games.summary:
Point and click adventure with cartoon animation and magical puzzles.

Sequel of Kingdom: The Far Reaches aka Thayer's Quest

games.name: Kotamon: My Sis Found a Super-Rare Card in Her Cereal Box, so I Became a Garbage Man to Find the Entire Collection and Earn $1,000,000
games.summary: Clearing trash can feel even better when you not only make the world cleaner, but also find extra-rare cards that have suddenly increased in price! Rummage through garbage, fulfill the orders from the dump site owner, look for hidden treasures... and collect all the Kotámons!

games.name: Labyrinthos: The Depths Want You
games.summary: Ascend the sunken labyrinth called the Tower and choose your path to escape to the surface. Battle foes, forge relationships, and find power in this roguelite dark fantasy RPG.

games.name: Left Not Right
games.summary: Control Lefty with your left hand, and Righty with your right. At the same time! Don't worry — it's a single-player game. No friends required. Use both hands to control two characters at once and escape the underground research facility!

games.name: Lumber Tycoon Island
games.summary: One axe. A whole island. A logging empire.

games.name: Maze of Doors
games.summary: Maze of Doors is a psychological horror puzzle game where every door leads to a new impossible room. Explore a shifting maze, solve puzzles, survive terrifying encounters, and uncover the secrets hidden beyond each door.

games.name: Media Basket Manager
games.summary: Media Basket Manager is a single-player basketball management simulation game where you take full control of a basketball club. Manage transfers, develop young prospects, create tactics, and make key decisions to build a championship-winning team.

games.name: Meikyu
games.summary: Meikyu is a free daily deduction game played in the browser. Each day, the dungeon hides a five-resident lineup drawn from a cast of thirty-six. You have six sorties to identify the cast and place everyone in the right slot.

games.name: Meowmories
games.summary: Our memories will bring us back together. A bittersweet and heartwarming "Meowmare" adventure about a cat's journey to find its owner. This is your story, and the story of your beloved cat.

games.name: Metaneurosis
games.summary: A turn-based RPG blending strategy, surreal worlds, and dark humor. Customize your character, shape the story with your choices, and explore worlds where absurdity meets heart.

games.name: Midnight Anomaly Mystery
games.summary: Can you spot the anomaly?

games.name: Nested
games.summary: Nested is a cute grid-based puzzle game made around the concept of russian nesting dolls. Come twist your brain as you stack, push and interact with the various objects you'll find in each levels. Let's see if you can reach the right combination of nesting dolls to solve every one of them!

games.name: Odd's Job
games.summary: Jump, bounce, and roll through jobs to unite his family in their new home. Unlock quirky relatives, grab collectibles, and explore differently themed worlds in this wholesome platforming adventure.

games.name: One Last Clip
games.summary: You are locked inside a cinema. Your only way to escape is to follow the instructions of your task: Watch the same film clip repeatedly and search for flaws to break free. But this may sound easier than it is, every wrong decision or death will set you back. So be careful!

games.name: Peaceful Bug Catching Story
games.summary:
Pick up your bug net and set off on a grand summer adventure.
Your bug-collecting summer vacation is about to begin!

games.name: Play Faster
games.summary: Play Faster is a precision platformer built for fast movement, instant retries, and endlessly replayable runs. Master movement, optimize routes, and climb online leaderboards with built-in speedrunning tools.

games.name: Plinkomancy
games.summary: PLINKOMANCY is a roguelite that turns a simple ball drop into explosive chaos. Hit pegs, rack up massive numbers, and unlock upgrades as you push the arcade cabinet to its limits. How far can you go before the machine pushes back?

games.name: PokeRank
games.summary: PokeRank is an interactive live-stream quiz and progression game for Twitch communities. Viewers identify hidden creature silhouettes in chat, earn points and XP, unlock entries in a personal Pokédex-style collection, complete daily and seasonal missions, join cooperative Boss events, and compete across monthly leaderboards.

games.name: Re:Store the Record Store
games.summary: Re:Store the Record Store is a game about tidying up an indie record store after the owner had to run off to chase down his escaped monkey. Featuring over 1000 items to pick up, sort through and return back into the crates where they belong. Take your time to look through everything or speedrun it!

games.name: ReDraft: The Fantasy Football Simulator
games.summary: A Fantasy Football simulator for PC: make your draft, create your team and win your fantasy league.

games.name: Rip N Ship Simulator
games.summary: Build your own card-breaking empire in Rip N Ship Simulator. Open packs for viewers, manage live orders, grow your simulated stream, collect and grade cards, run giveaways and auctions, upgrade your setup, and create custom cards, packs, and complete sets.

games.name: Risky Business
games.summary: A fast-paced adult clicker where every tap brings stunning bombshells to life. Unlock animated scenes, grow your gallery, and enjoy a sleek, one-hand thrill packed with fun stories, gorgeous girls, and very spicy visuals.

games.name: Road Line Puzzle: Connect the Paths
games.summary:
Can you connect every path?
Twist panels, train your brain!

games.name: Roll to Ruin
games.summary: Roll to Ruin is a medieval dice roguelite. Roll, hold, bank or farkle — Farkle rules with a deckbuilding twist. Battle through seven taverns, build your dice deck, wield 34 badges to flip the table. Outscore your rival or lose it all. Dice are fate. Every wager counts. Just one more... right?

games.name: Roomballs
games.summary: Soccer meets air hockey with an incredible twist: fast-paced, zany robots inspired by your favorite pop culture icons. This isn’t just about speed and strength; strategy, quick moves, and clever plays are the keys to victory. This game guarantees endless fun and high-octane action.

games.name: Scavenger Mouse
games.summary: A 3D exploration game where you guide a lonely mouse person named Bruise through a lonely forest area, scavenging for anything you can find.

games.name: Screw Drivers
games.summary: Crazy physics and high-speed races! Craft vehicles cleverly by combining building blocks and mechanical parts to create powerful drivetrains. Unlock new parts, race for the gold, and challenge your friends in multiplayer.

games.name: Screw Drivers
games.summary: Crazy physics and high-speed races! Craft vehicles cleverly by combining building blocks and mechanical parts to create powerful drivetrains. Unlock new parts, race for the gold, and challenge your friends in multiplayer.

games.name: Sensory Overload
games.summary: A dropper game designed to overwhelm your senses. Twisting tunnels, psychedelic patterns, and breathing walls assault your sense of balance as the chaos escalates with every level.

games.name: Sleep Aid
games.summary: Not every game is meant to be fair. Not every player is meant to survive. Bluff, adapt, and outsmart your opponent in tense poker matches where the cards don't always play by the rules.

games.name: Slime Soup
games.summary: Run a grimy fantasy soup kitchen where you drop and link bouncing slimes to trigger messy chain reactions. Build wild combos with strange ingredients, serve bizarre customers, and turn your filthy cauldron into a chaotic score machine.

games.name: Slot & Learn: World Flags
games.summary: How many flags can you spot?

games.name: Smithsonian: Digging For Dinosaurs
games.summary: A interactive adventure where young explorers excavate fossils, discover prehistoric creatures, and learn through play in a safe, engaging experience designed for curious kids.

games.name: Spot the Difference Ukiyo-e: Fifty-Three Stations of the Toukaidou
games.summary: Can you spot the change?

games.name: Steins;Gate Re:Boot - Limited Edition
games.summary: Contains an artbook, DVD-ROM soundtrack and the "Steins;Gate 15th Live - One World -" event live DVD & Blu-ray Disc

games.summary: Celebrate the original game but collect 7 cakes and get out to win!

games.name: Type Ride
games.summary: "Type Ride" is a typing-based tower defense game where you summon units by typing. In a world overrun by ink lifeforms, the protagonist—once known as the "Type Rider" for her high-speed typing skills while riding a motorcycle—decides to ride her beloved bike once again to resolve the chaos.

games.name: America Against Ants
games.summary: The year, 1951, the place, Nevada, USA. Take command of Task Force Sable and battle through 30 increasingly challenging missions to defeat giant, mutant ants as they swarm from atomic test sites in the desert. AAA features a unique, narrative driven blend of tower defence and real time tactics.

games.name: Combolands
games.summary: A mini citybuilding roguelike. Place buildings, stack combos, and master deep strategy in short bursts to create a tiny thriving metropolis!

games.name: Nerd Simulator
games.summary: It’s never too late to turn your life around! Step into the shoes of a 40-year-old finally ready to leave the nest in this hilarious RPG-Life Simulation mix. Tackle wacky challenges, embrace absurd adventures, and prove that with determination (and a bit of chaos), you can start fresh at any age.

games.name: Trial by Chat
games.summary:
Trial by Chat is a crowd-judged party game built for Twitch streamers. Players answer a prompt with the funniest card in their hand, but instead of players judging each other, live chat decides the winner. Every viewer, across every connected streamer's channel, votes in real time using simple chat commands.

Play solo with your own community, or team up with other streamers for a true crossover session where every connected chat votes together. An OBS-ready overlay displays the game live on stream, and hosts get full control over game settings, pacing, and content.

Trial by Chat is designed

games.name: Ultrapool
games.summary: The pool bar is always open! Ultrapool is a colorful roguelike about playing pool with a bunch of wacky balls with crazy effects. Carefully craft a perfect build and get the craziest trickshots!

games.name: 100 for Justice
games.summary: 100 lives, one justice. Manage 100 citizens in a country falling to shadow forces. Your choices shape a collective timeline across decades. Lead unions, survive assassinations, and leave a legacy of resistance in this text-based political strategy sim. Words are your greatest weapon.

games.name: Afterlight: The Apartment
games.summary: Explore an mid-2000s Korean apartment complex in this short first-person psychological horror experience.

games.name: Amazing Trip to Europe 4: Search for Cats
Backyard Paintball
games.summary: Multiplayer FPS game with cross-play to mobile players.

games.name: Banana Republic
games.summary: In Banana Republic, guerrilla fighters seize the supreme court. Neutralize terrorists, rescue hostages, choose to serve your country. Uncover a history of corruption and violence.

games.name: Bar After Bar
games.summary: Bar After Bar is a co-op game where 5 friends drive to the top of a mountain. You will be mixing drinks and throwing them at each other the whole way up. The drunker you get, the harder it is to drive. How far can you make it?

games.name: Bililitz
games.summary: Bililitz is a vertical roguelike with procedurally generated worlds. Explore mysterious depths, collect items, and discover portals to new challenges. Compete in the global ranking system to prove your skill and reach the top!

games.name: Bit
games.summary: In Bit, you play as Bit. A little pixel alone in the void. Bit has the urge to climb. Why does he want to climb? Find out with him across 10 unique worlds and help him find his purpose.

games.name: Blasterbug: Last Bug Standing
games.summary: Bzz bzz! Hop in chaotic bomb-fueled battles inspired by arcade action classics we all love! Blaster up to 8 players locally with ant-astics Pome-grenades in this bomb-em-up party game and bee the last bug standing!

games.name: Burned Horizons
games.summary: A gritty, turn-based tactical sandbox set in 2002. No XP grind. No class rails. No buy-your-way skill trees. // 'They said it wasn't our war. So we made it ours.'

games.name: Chuck Bonesteel & the Alien Apocalypse
games.summary: Shoot, loot, upgrade, repeat. Fast-paced, gib-filled, over-the-top arcade shooter with stripped-down roguelike gameplay.

games.name: Company is Watching
games.summary:
Dear new employee, we are thrilled to welcome you to our production line. Here, your mission is simple, repetitive, and essential: maintain our quotas. Let yourself be lulled by the routine. Obey the instructions. Screw, clean, and destroy what you are told to destroy.

Optimization is our priority.

games.name: Din's Champion
games.summary: Mine and gather resources, craft useful items, and explore a dynamic, evolving world all while fighting off the evil gods' minions and machinations in this side scrolling, action RPG. Become a Din's Champion and stop Valta's new scheme to destroy the world. Oh, and beware of exploding barrels...

games.name: DualVerse86
games.summary: A 2D retro speedrunner where every second counts. Switch between worlds, dodge traps, beat the clock.

games.name: Ecrazeus Castle
games.summary: A 3D action RPG looter with dual-wielding weapons inspired by arcade games! Run, jump, loot, power up, and defeat monsters before time runs out, then prove your might by dethroning the owner of the castle!

games.name: Eslabong
games.summary: Arena combat meets mercenary club management. Recruit from a dynamic market, build your squad, and compete season after season in leagues and cups.

games.name: Feed the AI
games.summary: Feed the AI. Collect data. Unlock upgrades. Watch the algorithm grow beyond your control. An active incremental where you feed an evolving AI with data and shape what it becomes. Will it save the world… or take it over?

games.name: Forge & Fleet
games.summary: Forge & Fleet is a mobile multiplayer idle strategy game focused on building and upgrading a fleet of ships. Players progress through naval battles, collect and upgrade equipment, customize their ships, and develop different combat builds. The game features offline progression, PvP, leaderboards, cooperative Fleets, competitive Fleet activities, expeditions, and character and ship customization.

games.name: Guardians of Restoration
games.summary: Top-down robot action game combining action and bullet hell.

games.name: Hell Cleaners
games.summary: A first-person automation game set in hell. Suck up demon bodies, feed them into the Grinder, fuel your Purifier, and deploy a swarm of Doombas to build a cleaning operation that runs itself and takes the rot back one zone at a time.

games.name: Iron Blight
games.summary: Iron Blight is a survival horror game set in a cold, rainy Eastern Bloc town. You are trapped in a room as abominations claw at your door, with nowhere to run. You must survive the feverish night, uncover the horrors lurking in the shadows, and above all, find your wife, Valeria.

games.name: Kick the Ball
games.summary: Kick The Ball is a physics-based side-scrolling platformer where both you and the ball must reach the goal. Master precise movement, overcome challenging obstacles and beat your best times.

games.name: Little Doll Village
games.summary: A Wretch travels to the Holy Land in search of a good time.

games.name: Loot Frog
games.summary: Loot Frog is an incremental action bullet hell about breaking pots, collecting gems, and fighting an evil cult. Upgrade your gear, unlock new abilities, explore diverse biomes, and push deeper into increasingly chaotic battles.

games.name: Lovebyte.exe
games.summary: A parasocial VTuber dating chatsim where you join a friendly degen discord group to chat about your oshis together, but is your kamioshi actually one of your new friends? Chat, uncover irl identities, & romance a fellow fan - or maybe a VTuber. Inspired by Mystic Messenger, online communities, and internet spam

games.name: Melon on a Mission
games.summary: Being a watermelon has never been this dangerous. Climb your way to the top by jumping across everyday objects, balancing on tricky platforms, and avoiding a juicy disaster. Every fall could mean a long trip back down — or a smashed watermelon. Stay calm, keep climbing, and complete your mission.

games.name: Money for Girls: Amortized
games.summary: Fashion. Corruption. Malice. A girl detective faces her darkest mystery yet, in this horror-romance visual novel with stickers, outfits, and bad ends.

games.name: Monster Academy: An Interactive Story
games.summary: A heartwarming visual novel for children featuring a rich story and valuable life lessons.

games.name: Oil Island Hustle
games.summary: An Empty Island, Full of Oil, and your ON IT! Build your Oil Empire and Dominate the World Market! Create oil factories, produce oil barrels and sell them to different countries and earn Lots of Money! Hire workers to automate and remember to pay your 1 million loan to your co-worker

games.name: Olinda Fighters
games.summary: Olinda Fighters is a brawl style fight game inspired by Brazil's northeastern carnival characters. Featuring two different play modes: rounds or last man standing, for 1 up to 4 players. Use power-ups and energy drinks to move faster and hit harder your opponents. Remote Play multiplayer compatible!

games.name: Overtrick
games.summary: A trick-taking roguelike with style! Outplay your rivals, purchase special abilities, and dazzle 1920s high society with your unstoppable cardplay. Call your contract, follow suit, flush trumps, and claim the hand. This isn't your grandma's bridge club... this is Overtrick!

games.name: Peg Champ
games.summary: Take your best shot in this Pachinko puzzle game! Break pegs, earn money, and unlock a huge upgrade tree in this satisfying physics puzzler.

games.name: Purrrifiers: Cleaning Chaos
games.summary: Purrrifiers is a hilarious 4-player co-op game about cleaning while causing chaos. Solve puzzles, drive quirky vehicles, use an array of cleaning tools and team up with adorable cats. Experience absurd humor, diverse locations, and non-stop fun as you collaborate or troll your way to cleaning glory!

games.name: PW7A
games.summary: This is a short, top-down adventure game (with some puzzles) starring a robot.

games.name: Scribble Grounds
games.summary: A small game where you can draw on anything, in a 3D space that you share with your friends

games.name: Shelve the Potions!
games.summary: Shelve the Potions! Organize 2000+ potions on shelves after the witch's cats have knocked them over, using clues around an enchanted cellar. Learn strange symbols, decipher cryptic notes, and uncover the correct shelf orders in a cozy organizational simple puzzle game.

games.name: Smashing Bottles
games.summary: Smashing Bottles is a short and satisfying incremental game where you break bottles to earn money, upgrade your bat, discover new bottles, and cause chaos! Will you smash enough bottles to buy the universe?

games.name: Table Space: Board and Card Game Sandbox
games.summary: The ultimate tabletop games sandbox for mixed reality, designed for Steam Frame and SteamOS. Make and play board games, trading card games, and more with friends on any compatible XR headset. Use the Boxtree Builder to bring your own decks or create entirely new custom game modes.

games.name: The Dream Office
games.summary: Welcome to "The Dream Office," an immersive game that allows you to step into the shoes of a master office designer and renovator. Prepare to embark on a thrilling journey where you'll transform drab and cluttered workspaces into stunning, productive havens that would make anyone's dreams come true.

games.name: The Last Road
games.summary: In this narrative-driven casual strategy RPG, you take on the role of The Driver, sworn to deliver goods along The Last Road. With each journey bringing different semi randomized events to challenge the player, you will need to manage your resources carefully in order to survive.

games.name: The Library on the Lake
games.summary: Library on the Lake is a narrative multiverse where players take on the mantle of the Archivist. Undo a magical curse by traveling into different books to repair corrupted stories. Explore other worlds, meet a unique cast of characters, and play engaging mini games.

games.name: The Shadow Cosmos
games.summary: A 3D metroidvania with retro aesthetic. As master peacock, delve into a mysterious, dream-like world with non-linear exploration and progression, stylish and challenging fights with a powerful halberd, tricky parkour and puzzles. Collect shadows, unleash darkness.

games.name: Titanic Escape Simulator
games.summary: Investigate a dark mystery aboard the RMS Titanic before the final night becomes a fight for survival. Explore, solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and make impossible choices as history’s most famous ship sinks beneath the Atlantic.

games.name: Trade the Crash
games.summary: A no-rewind trading survival sim set during the dot-com crash. Manage $50,000, pay living expenses, and trade 63 fictionalized instruments across 818 market days. Choose a career path, manage risk, and learn from 86 built-in lessons while every decision carries forward.

games.name: Traveler Stories: Journeys of Real People
games.summary:
“Are you really okay with living like this?” For the players just getting by in their everyday lives.
This is a visual novel with simulation elements. About 80% of the story is based on true events, and depicts the stories of real-life travelers such as Rieko Ayumi, who has traveled to 98 countries as of now.
As a staff member at a bar where travelers gather in Tokyo, you will encounter their unconventional lives and grow alongside them.
In the process, your rigid values and assumptions are bound to be shaken.
This is a simulation for lost souls like you to encounter a new version of yourself.

games.name: Travellin Cats in USA
games.summary: Find hundreds of cats hidden in multiple iconic cities of the United States of America in this cute hand-drawn hidden object game by Travellin Cats - the original viral hidden cat game creator!

games.name: Union of Rivals
games.summary: A deep colony sim and city builder. Manage resources and production chains to build the railroad from East to West. Found towns, harvest and refine the goods that fuel the line, then persuade or outlast the settlements in your path. Every citizen has a name, a trait, and a breaking point.

games.name: Volkolak: The Will of Gods
games.summary: Volkolak: The Will of Gods is an epic 2D soulsvania in a dark Slavic fantasy setting, with hand-drawn animation. Explore an enchanted world full of secrets and enemies. Your choices will lead to several endings: become a warrior, a werewolf, or join the darkness.

games.name: Wordless Forest
games.summary: You are alone in the forest. You remember nothing. In this live-action interactive survival thriller, the story is written not by dialogue, but by your choices.

games.name: Y2kill
games.summary: A top-down arcade zombie roguelite set in 99's New York City. Build broken combos, unlock a million-dollar arsenal, slay four monster bosses, and survive the party at the end of the world.

games.name: 1666: Amsterdam
games.summary: Every 333 years, something stirs. 1666: Amsterdam is a 3rd person Dark, Story-Led, Action-Adventure where Noa, the Collector, wields witchcraft to uncover demonic entities hiding behind human faces. Investigate by day. Face your demons at night.

games.name: Once Human
games.summary: Once Human is a multiplayer open-world survival game set in a strange, post-apocalyptic future. Unite with friends to fight monstrous enemies, uncover secret plots, compete for resources, and build your own territory. Once, you were merely human. Now, you have the power to remake the world.

games.name: Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2
games.summary: This is a fight for survival. Xenomorphs swarm in overwhelming numbers. Every room could be your last.

games.name: Blood Dungeon
games.summary: From the creators of Nidhogg, murder hordes of monsters in this 2D platforming autoshooter with a killer soundtrack. Collect Blood, gold, and bones to increase your powers. Can you survive the Blood Dungeon?

games.name: Box Knight
games.summary: A funny, silly and irreverent action RPG roguelike. A mix of ‘the Office’ and ‘Lord of the Rings’ with a comic like aesthetic.

games.name: Funguys Swarm
games.summary: Funguys Swarm is a cartoony survivor bullet hell where the forest is on fire—and it’s very much not fine. Become a Funguy, arm yourself with forest-crafted weapons, and unleash some bonkers powers on the Fireking’s army. And maybe—just maybe—save the day if you’re skilled (or lucky) enough.

games.name: A College of Thirst & Claws: Season 1
games.summary: An immersive, story-driven adult visual novel. As a werewolf joining a supernatural college, you'll be thrown into the deep end of a sinister conspiracy in the town of Lanstone. Develop relationships with beautiful women as you shape the story with your choices.

games.name: Crabs: Chef's Story
games.summary: In this Multiplayer Party Brawler, play as one of 'Chef's' crabs! Launch crab ass with 'Crab-fu' and battle online in a number of crazy game modes designed to push your crabs abilities to the limit.

games.name: Lawn Order
games.summary: There are 50,000 leaves on this lawn and every one of them is your problem. A first-person leaf blower sim with obsessively real leaf physics and some fun surprises.

games.name: Leon&Suharto
games.summary: An interactive dramatic thriller novel with immersive elements. Immerse yourself in a dark tale of revenge, where you must find those responsible for the horrors of the Kapella Estate, survive despite your own fears, and face the irreversible consequences of your choices.

games.name: Sludgineers
games.summary: Clean, mine and refine pollution in this active incremental game. Cruise through the countryside earning cash and resources, build a refinery, process materials, upgrade equipment, unlock new areas and complete quests.

games.name: Ultrapool
games.summary: The pool bar is always open! Ultrapool is a colorful roguelike about playing pool with a bunch of wacky balls with crazy effects. Carefully craft a perfect build and get the craziest trickshots!

games.name: Vertigo Rush
games.summary: Vertigo Rush is a high-speed VR racing game where your hands are your engine. Climb, swing and fly through visually stunning tracks. Race against AI, compete in global Time Trial leaderboards, or challenge up to 10 friends online with polished, precision hand-based movement.

games.name: Western Rye
games.summary: Welcome to the harsh and lawless world of the Wild West, where a mysterious fever called the 'Rye Fever' has turned the once-proud frontier into a lawless wasteland. In this world, survival is the only law, and you'll need to be tough, quick-witted, and deadly if you hope to make it out alive.

games.name: A Border With No End
games.summary: A Border with No End is a horrorpunk adventure RPG set right in the middle of your normal everyday insanity, psychotic depression and a surreal nightmare, that is both meaningless and interpretive. Fight for nothing and loose it all.

games.name: A Couple Nights at the Chud House
games.summary: You fell asleep first at the sleepover, and now your friends aren't acting quite the same. Defend yourself from the Chuds in this point-and-click style horror game, uncover forgotten memories, and discover what's really happening.

games.name: A Tower Full of Cats
games.summary: A Tower Full of Cats is a hidden object game where you need to pet cats through the whole history of mankind... and beyond!

games.name: Alcyone: Chemistry Puzzle
games.summary:
Alcyone: Chemistry Puzzle is a deterministic, grid-based logic puzzle built around real chemical formulas and reactions.

Players synthesize valid chemical compounds by aligning elemental tiles horizontally or vertically. As identical molecules trigger reactions, puzzles demand precise deductive reasoning across dynamic board mechanics:

Synthesis & Match: Construct authentic chemical formulas across grid lines to trigger reactions and clear space.

Phase Shifts: Ambient temperature controls state changes—gases rise, while liquids and solids settle with gravity.

Reaction Cells: Specialized ti

games.name: Apidya' Special
games.summary: Apidya is making a comeback in this authentic 24-bit pixel remake, built from the ground up, but utterly faithful to the original.

games.name: Artificial Bloodline
games.summary: Artificial Bloodline is a single-player horror escape game. Explore an abandoned hospital, scavenge for resources, and use your environment to evade terrifying monsters as you search for an escape route and uncover the secrets hidden within. Escape before it's too late!

games.name: Astral Court DX
games.summary:
Astral Court DX is an arcade precision platformer! Taking place in Heaven, you play as "The Prisoner" - an infamous criminal who's been to prison one too many times and is sent to death-row! Heaven's one and only court, the Astral Court, is an... odd one... and decides to grant The Prisoner with a series of deadly trials that, if completed, will allow them to get out of prison scot-free!

In these trials, you platform on top of the Scales Of Justice, well several of them, collecting little stars named "Shinies" that spawn around the arena. You must collect a certain amount of Shinies all whils

games.name: Bard’s Fault
games.summary: Bard’s Fault is a co-op Action Roguelike where you and your friends fight back-to-back against relentless swarms. Craft new builds, sync your abilities, and break the timeline in this multiplayer bullet heaven. Death is just the beginning, go back to the past and unravel a time-travel mystery.

games.name: BoHeM
games.summary: Live an anti-cozy life on the sidewalks of Rainy Street. Fix apartments, tend bars, thrift for clothes, and uncover the wacky mysteries surrounding the eccentric yet seemingly normal tenants as they go about their daily lives.

games.name: Cherry Blossom
games.summary: The game "Cherry blossom" is about a cute little bear who went to save a wise tree from darkness.

games.name: Chronicles Puzzle: History Path
games.summary: Piece together the shards of time in this historical sliding puzzle game. Experience a journey from the Big Bang to the future through 80 unique levels and 320 challenges. Choose from four difficulties, collect trophies, and unlock the wonders of the world - available in 14 languages.

games.name: Clutter 19: Survey Says What? - Collector's Edition
games.summary: Clutter 19: Survey Says What? - Collector's Edition delivers the most entertaining and challenging Clutter yet, featuring over 1,800 puzzles! Tackle new Clutter Gaps Diamond Style, Rotation Matters, Pop-Ups and Clutter Pics (Pic Jong) Variations, and more in this endlessly replayable challenge.

games.name: From Below
games.summary: A first-person mystery horror game where you explore a mysterious mansion, interact with objects, collect evidence and records, and uncover the truth behind a past incident.

games.name: Gold Coast Gambits: Boca Raton & Palm Beach
games.summary: A turn-based digital board game set in Boca Raton and Palm Beach, Florida. Compete for Prestige through property, Luxury Cards, and strategic map play. Tackle 50 Solo Gambits with increasingly challenging bots and varied objectives, or play the full board game solo against bots or with friends.

games.name: Guardians of Dreamstate
games.summary: Guardians of Dreamstate TCG is a fantasy trading card game where both players share every turn. Draw, Set, LVL UP and battle across five lanes every turn. Your goal of the game is simple, damage your opponents 7 card life deck while they have none remaining and you win the game!

games.name: Hapunan
games.summary: A balut vendor's simple life turns into a nightmare—can you survive the shadows of Barangay Sak Dudol?

games.name: Hero Mania
games.summary: Hero Mania is a bombastic, comic-book themed multiplayer party game where players don the spandex of unfamed, super-powered heroes as they brawl their way to the top using their abilities, wits, and even each other!

games.name: Hide and Moo!
games.summary: Somewhere in this field, someone is doing their best animal impression. It’s you. Record your own animal sound, then try to match it under pressure while hunters close in. A chaotic voice-mimicry hide-and-seek party game with proximity chat.

games.name: Holey Ship
games.summary: Holey Ship is a chaotic co-op game for up to four players. Where you and your crew fix boats under pressure. Repair damage, solve fast tasks, and keep customers happy in a fun and chaotic world. Work together or mess with your friends but can your crew stop everything from sinking!

games.name: How Asian Parents went to School
games.summary: An online 1-4 player co-op adventure where you experience the legendary struggle of getting to school as an Asian parent. Fight a psychopathic bear, defy physics, and survive the emotional damage from Tablo Escobar : an NPC who roasts you every time you fail.

games.name: Inseco
games.summary: Para sobrevivir a un mundo agonizante, debes presenciar el fin de la humanidad. Vive un tenso horror point-and-click donde cada decisión brutal sella tu destino. Mientras el mundo muta en un monstruo, ¿cuánta de tu humanidad sacrificarás para sobrevivir al enjambre?

games.name: Koikata: How Our Love Grows
games.summary: An all-ages remaster of Koi Suru Kimochi no Kasanekata, with upgraded resolution, new features and Ichika route, which was not present in the original game.

games.name: Ling House: Echoes Within
games.summary: Ling House: Echoes Within is a first-person psychological horror experience. Uncover the hidden tragedy beneath the surface of a haunted house. As reality breaks down, your video camera reveals images of an alternate space. You must see through the connection between both worlds to escape.

games.name: Lord of Tokens
games.summary:
Lord of Tokens is a free browser-based massively multiplayer management simulation
set in the artificial intelligence industry. Each player runs a competing AI company,
hiring researchers, scraping datasets, purchasing server infrastructure, training
models and releasing products to acquire users. Companies can also research
unexplored technologies, contribute to open source and invest on a stock market.

Players compete for market dominance within a shared zone, where prices and market
share emerge from the collective decisions of everyone playing. The simulation runs
on a one-to-one time sca

games.name: Lorne
games.summary: In a wartorn world you are key to restore peace and order to the lands of Lorne. Equip Evelyn with the right tools you can find, craft or upgrade in this ARPG featuring interactive combat, open world exploration and intimidating temples filled with puzzles. End the corruption and keep Lorne safe.

games.name: Magic Market World
games.summary: "Magic Market World" is a PvP rhythm game with strategic elements. Place your advertisement spells, sell your products and make sure to stay ahead of the competition!

games.name: Modularis
games.summary: Modularis is a roguelike space shooter where you pilot prototype ships built to contain the chaos of space.

games.name: Open Up, Michael!
games.summary: Balance strange offerings on a door handle, remember its unsettling note sequences, and find out who Michael really is. A short first-person comedy-horror game about five rituals, readable puzzles, two endings, and one suspiciously well-balanced cheese wedge.

games.name: OverInfected
games.summary: OverInfected is a tactical roguelike auto battler featuring parasite management mechanics, where your life is on a timer. The stronger you are, the faster your ‘weapon’ kills you. Death isn’t an option – it’s a core gameplay element. During a run, you’ll need to find hosts to transfer into, freeing yourself from your problems. Sooner or later, your life will start all over again.

games.name: Pattern Pulse
games.summary: Put your mind and reflexes to the test in this retro-futuristic challenge!

games.name: Polylithic
games.summary: The Polylithic is a 3rd person crafting survival set in the Paleolithic/Neolithic era where the player crafts items, unlocks technology, discovers the world, builds bases, and can either grow the tribe and command the settlement or play the game solo.

games.name: Portrait Painter
games.summary: Paint portraits to help a struggling art museum in this relaxing painting game.

games.name: Quizumba
games.summary: Quizumba is a browser-based, live multiplayer trivia platform that lets players easily build and customize Jeopardy-style quiz games in minutes. Players can join game nights using a simple room code to compete individually or in teams with real-time buzzers, custom categories, and live scoreboards.

games.name: Rotting Grief
games.summary: A short psychological-horror narrative in which your choices matter. Journey through the give stages of grief as Liam, a man who just recently lost his wife due to... unknown... circumstances.

games.name: Satawn
games.summary: Satawn aims for a more complete village life experience: farming, building, inventory, scene-based exploration, transitions between zones, day and night cycles, cinematics integrated into gameplay, and a task system ranging from simple requests to neighbors

games.name: SlapGains
games.summary: Train in a neon gym, walk into the arena, slap your way through five leagues. Every rep is on the beat, every slap counts. Your body visibly grows with you: thicker arms, broader shoulders, stronger legs, depending on what you train. Bronze to Diamond. One hit decides it.

games.name: Slum Z
games.summary: Slum Z is a horror incremental roguelike featuring tower defense elements. Fight through relentless zombie hordes, a single-player in a dark survival shooter where every bullet counts. hunt for rare cursed blood, and upgrade your arsenal and prepare yourself.

games.name: Snack Invaders
games.summary: Slipping into a junk food‑induced coma during a late‑night movie marathon, you wake up as an astronaut stranded in a galaxy overrun by living junk food! Play solo or co‑op online with up to 3 friends (4 players max) to battle hordes of junk food and Souls‑like bosses as you fight to escape alive!

games.name: Snap the Cat
games.summary: An incremental game about taking photos of cats. Upgrade your account, unlock new cats, and take photos of them so everyone on the planet will follow you!

games.name: Sokogram
games.summary: Sokogram merges Nonogram logic grids with Sokoban box-pushing puzzles. Each level blends both systems into one unified challenge with handcrafted designs that reward deduction over guessing.

games.name: SVETIK
games.summary:
SVETIK is a top-down dark fantasy adventure RPG where the player explores a world plunged into darkness after the sun has been sealed away. The protagonist, Iskra, awakens in a prison with no memory of her past and encounters Svetik, a living fragment of sunlight that becomes her only source of illumination.

Together they travel through the dark lands of Lucida, facing creatures that lurk in the shadows and discovering the truth behind the disappearance of the sun. Light plays a central role in both exploration and combat, allowing players to reveal hidden paths, weaken enemies, and survive i

games.name: Synthalgia: Retro Arcade Racing
games.summary: Synthalgia is an arcade racing game set in the summers of the 1980’s. Drive dangerously, drive fast, earn credits, buy and upgrade cars all while jamming out to 80’s inspired music in a neon retrofuturistic world of fast cars, beaches and bright lights!

games.name: Tatlone
games.summary: Our protagonist lives an ordinary life, yet something continues to spark their curiosity. One day, a close friend calls and invites them to visit a place where their grandmother also lives. Before long, they begin working on a shared project together.

games.name: Tsugunohi: The Thread That Beckons to Heaven
games.summary: Just keep walking left. The latest Tsugunohi returns to the series’ roots with its early visual style and atmosphere. On a sweltering summer day, a girl walks home past “righteous” people, a thread of salvation, and her mother beneath a white umbrella. Is that hand salvation—or a curse?

games.name: Twisted Party
games.summary: Survive. Sabotage. Style on your friends. Twisted Party is a retro horror party game stuffed with deadly mini-games and buckets of blood. Betray your way to victory and unlock crazy skins by conquering brutal challenges. Last one standing wins

games.name: Unbroken Valor
games.summary: In this dark ink‑wash roguelike card game, build your 3‑person squad. Freely combine Eight‑Gua elements, 12 Blessings, treasures, talismans and mental insights. Fight and grow within endless time loops; every sword swing is a new unknown adventure.

games.name: Everything Must Fall
games.summary: Everything Must Fall is an action-packed physics puzzle game in VR. You are an outcast among the tinies working your daily job as a demolitioner at Blow Big Stuff Up Ltd. Before you know it, your life is turned upside down. You must save your parents. A Journey of a lifetime begins.

games.name: States of Power
games.summary: Command your nation's armies, economy, and diplomacy in this WWII grand strategy wargame. Easy to start, hard to master and a full match fits in one session. Play singleplayer and multiplayer, or create, play and share your own custom scenarios with the built-in scenario editor.

games.name: MudRunner
games.summary: Like Spintires before it, Spintires: MudRunner puts players in the driver seat and dares them to take charge of incredible all-terrain vehicles, venturing across extreme Siberian landscapes with only a map and compass as guides! This edition comes complete with a brand new Sandbox Map joining the original game's 5 environments, a total graphical overhaul, a new Challenge mode with 9 new dedicated maps, 13 new vehicles and other comprehensive improvements.

games.name: 7 Nights Keeper
games.summary: In 7 NIGHTS KEEPER, take a job to watch over a mansion for 7 nights and uncover a horrifying secret: the elderly occupant is possessed by a demon. Survive the escalating terror and keep the darkness at bay, or become its next victim.

games.name: Brigandine Abyss
games.summary: The king of Solginat is dead, and a new would-be emperor stands over the corpse. Confront the dark in one of six different storylines as you manage resources, rally your monsters, and stand against the empire

games.name: BrushHammer Miniature Painter
games.summary:
BrushHammer Miniature Painter is an innovative mixed-reality experience that lets you live your miniature painting hobby.

Paint virtual miniatures using a robust suite of digital tools. From spray cans and airbrushes to shade washes, edge highlights, dry brushing, decals, high-gloss finishes, and more.

Access original miniature collections crafted by our artists here at Soliton. Each collection includes several models with interchangeable poses, all equipped with various accessories and many basing options.

games.name: Find My Frogs: Branches
games.summary: Find My Frogs: Branches is a cozy hidden object game where you search for frogs and toads in a hand-drawn village nestled high in the branches of an ancient tree. Explore charming corners, discover tiny secrets, and help Uncle Froger find his missing hat.

games.name: Little Chef: Cozy Cooking
games.summary: Little Chef: Cozy Cooking is a physics-based cooking game full of discovery and playful chaos. Experiment with everything in the kitchen and unlock around 300 recipes on your way to becoming a master chef!

games.name: Outerplane
games.summary:
Anime-style Isekai Grand Adventure right at your fingertips!
Check out the Burst-Action Strategy RPG, OUTERPLANE

games.name: A Studied Seduction
games.summary:
Arthur Ruthven's thirty-fifth birthday is fast approaching, but he's worried that his life has started to stagnate.

Arthur was once a history teacher in Edinburgh, but an incident with a former pupil causes Arthur to retire early. Newly uneasy about teaching, and unsure if he can pursue the career he once loved, Arthur returns to live with his mother in their old family bookshop. He would prefer to forget his days as a teacher, and the anxieties that came with them...

But Arthur can only keep his past at bay for so long, and his life takes an unexpected turn when his mother hires a new helpe

games.name: A Tower Full of Cats
games.summary: A Tower Full of Cats is a hidden object game where you need to pet cats through the whole history of mankind... and beyond!

games.name: Axis Football 2027
games.summary: Axis Football 2027 is a complete American Football Simulation featuring fluid gameplay, endless customization, and the industry's best franchise mode.

games.name: Barbarian
games.summary: Soulslike-inspired open-world survival RPG for 1-10 players. Master fluid combat with precise parries and dodges, defeat epic bosses, craft & upgrade gear, build your base, and share items with friends. Your progression persists across every world — play solo or with friends.

games.name: Beware the Depths
games.summary: Get in. Get Loot. Get out. Countless misguided souls have delved into the unknown Depths. Some seek riches, others, long-lost arcane secrets, and for a few: heroic glory for the sake of mankind. No matter what it is that you seek - if you want to stay alive, always remember to Beware the Depths.

games.name: Brick: One Block at a Time
games.summary: Start with a brick and build a life in a Newark-inspired urban survival sandbox. Scavenge the city and forest, unlock blueprints, build and raid bases, drive stolen cars, command recruits, outsmart rival clans and police, or survive with friends in co-op.

games.name: Cartoon Crime
games.summary: Cartoon Crime is an open-world action crime game with third-person and top-down gameplay, story missions, police chases, recruitable bodyguards, enterable shops, and bowling, billiards, and arcade mini-games.

games.name: Click the Button
games.summary: Click the Button is an incremental game about clicking a button to receive chests that deliver incredible rewards. Improve your skills to become the strongest.

games.name: Comfy Corners: Unpack and Decorate
games.summary:
Unpack your perfect life in this cozy, hygge-inspired home simulator.
Design the apartment of your dreams in a relaxing and meditative experience focused on creativity, comfort, and personal expression.

Create a unique home with two layers, decorate each room to match your mood, and even design your garden or outdoor area. Arrange furniture, experiment with color combinations, and customize the atmosphere outside your window with changing light and weather.

games.name: Console Archives: Bubble Bobble
games.summary:
Bubble Bobble was released by Taito in 1988 for an 8-bit home console.
This is an action game where Bub and Bob, transformed into Bubble Dragons, go on an adventure to rescue their girlfriends, Betty and Patty, who have been kidnapped by a wizard.
The game features 100 stages in total. What will happen if you clear Stage 100 and see the "True ending"...?

games.name: CQ: Calling Any Station
games.summary: An idle/incremental game about a lone radio operator keying into a silent universe. Click or walk away, both work just as well. Build your station, log distant contacts, retune to grow stronger, and slowly decode what answers back.

games.name: Crown of the Nile: Cleopatra's Choice
games.summary: Become Cleopatra VII in a historical romance visual novel of power, betrayal, and forbidden desire. Reclaim your throne, navigate Rome’s ambitions, and rewrite the fate of Ancient Egypt through your choices

games.name: Crystalyn
games.summary: Start with one bullet. End with hundreds. Crystalyn is a fast-paced top-down bullet-hell looter shooter about pushing your build to its absolute limits. Fight monsters, defeat bosses, and turn their loot into unstoppable firepower.

games.name: Doors Closed
games.summary: To save your sick son, you take a job as a security inspector at a secretive lab, the very place rumored to be causing his illness. Inspect IDs, scan for contraband, and weed out impostors. Do your job, earn your paycheck, and save your family. Just don't let the wrong people in.

games.name: Electio
games.summary: Five live rounds, a blank, and a choice. Electio is a short narrative horror game where death carries permanent consequences.

games.name: Endless Silent Night
games.summary: An all-ages port of 12 no Tsuki no Eve.

games.name: Express 404
games.summary: Drive a storm-ridden night train, manage your speed and your passengers — one of them is a mimic. Build powerful upgrades between stations, reach dangerous quotas, expose the monster, or profit from chaos in this roguelite paranoia simulator.

games.name: Fatal Claw
games.summary: FatalClaw is a high-quality 2D Metroidvania game. Explore the mysterious underworld in your own way with cat “Kisha” who rise from the dead, and find the key to the ground with other survivors through absorbing the power infected enemies.

games.name: Fell & Sell
games.summary: Slay. Loot. Sell. Survive! Dive into a first-person blend of hack'n'slash roguelike and shop management. Plunder deadly dungeons for loot, escape with your life, craft, and stock your shelves. Then risk it all once more for profit!

games.name: Flyra: FPV Drone Simulator
games.summary: Flyra is a high-speed FPV drone simulator with Racing, Freestyle, and Survival challenges. Test your reflexes, explore unique environments, and fly a range of drones with realistic physics. Discover the thrill of flying free.

games.name: Folk Emerging
games.summary: Lead nomadic families through the Stone Age in this turn-based 4X strategy game with in-depth characters, cultures, and ecosystems. Explore the wilderness, hunt megafauna, outsmart competitors in trade & autobattler combat. Discover fire, agriculture, politics... and survive to tell the tale.

games.name: Fractured Worlds
games.summary: Fractured Worlds is a dark fantasy action RPG set in the shattered remnants of a ruined reality. Master weighty, precision-based combat, explore diverse realms, and face challenging bosses alone or together with other players of the realm

games.name: Gem Party
games.summary: Match 3 or more gems to channel their power into your cute animal party. Defeat the endless bosses charging toward you.

games.name: Ghostflippers
games.summary: Flip haunted houses with your friends… before the ghost flips you. Reach your quota, grow your business, and survive the night.

games.name: Goblins Can Conquer
games.summary: From a small pack of goblins to a mighty horde: conquer the lands turn by turn! Strategize your expansion, build your village, and collect powerful spells to empower your army. Recruit new goblins and crush your foes: the age of the goblin has begun!

games.name: Hide and Fuse
games.summary: Turn into a lamp. Freeze. Pray. One player carries a live bomb and hunts the room — everyone else is furniture. Blend in, hold your nerve, and pass the bomb before it blows. A party game of disguise, panic, and betrayal for 2–10 players (or grab a few and let the chaos fill the rest)

games.name: I am an Air Traffic Controller: Airport Hero Centrair EX
games.summary: You are the Air Traffic Controller! Issue commands and ensure airport safety!

games.name: Idle Fleet
games.summary: Build your mining fleet in a persistent online universe where every player helps shape the economy. Train 7 skills, automate production with drones, trade on the player-driven market, and forge the legendary Vanguard hull while your fleet keeps working on the server.

games.name: International Obsession
games.summary:
It's signing season for the Provisional Government, and Kissy and Torture Ball have their sights on the most valuable free agent of all. But who else is staking out a claim to the transfigured earth? What is "the millennium", and is it over yet or not?

Part 1 in the Future Jumpers series of pulse-pounding action storygames.

games.name: Kesu-Ji
games.summary: Kesu-Ji is a game featuring 6 modes centered around various "merge" mechanics. (Puzzle Mode、Action Mode 、Shooting Mode) You can aim for high scores on the online leaderboards in each mode and earn rewards. Enjoy a satisfying merging experience set in a chill, relaxing atmosphere!

games.name: Mahjongus: The Warlock Within
games.summary: Help Victor Graves break free from a warlock’s control and save the Academy of Magic through classic mahjong puzzles

games.name: Make My Sandwich
games.summary: Make My Sandwich is a cute puzzle game about assembling sandwiches by hand. Read the order cards and drag ingredients onto the board, stacking them carefully layer by layer. Consider your guests' diets and tastes, pick the perfect drink, and follow all order requirements to clear the level!

games.name: Model Debut 4
games.summary:
Trendy items for full styling and production fun!
Step into the world of modeling, try out different jobs, and chase your dreams — and maybe even love.

games.name: Model Debut4
games.summary: A fashion game packed with the latest trends! Enjoy styling, modelling jobs, and romance as you aim to become the No.1 model, "Top of nicola"!

games.name: Night Rolls Cozy Store
games.summary: Run a cozy late-night store. Prep fresh sushi and rolls, stock the shelves, and serve customers until dawn. A chill store management game where every night shift is yours to own.

games.name: Optasia: The Last Visit
games.summary: A first-person psychological experience set inside a fading mind. Explore an empty asylum, shifting memories, and the quiet weight of promises left behind. No puzzles. No escape. Just one last visit.

games.name: Pickle Pete
games.summary:
A mysterious substance has turned Pete into a pickle!
Darkness has settled over the world, and our hero must find a way to survive against the waves of evil forces. Stack up, gear up, and create countless combinations of unique builds to become stronger than your enemies. Find the antidote and save the world!

games.name: Police Officer
games.summary: Police Officer is a first-person police station simulator where you manage a police station: process suspects, hear citizens' pleas, and manage the daily chaos of law enforcement—one decision at a time.

games.name: Poncik's Little Tragedy
games.summary: Explore an abandoned theater consumed by a mysterious fungal infestation. Use Poncik Bot to solve puzzles, restore power, and uncover the secrets hidden within. Something terrible happened here, and the truth is still waiting to be found.

games.name: Quickie Takeout
games.summary: Adult-Only Visual Novel about fast-food shenanigans with your three quirky coworkers. Get into questionable scenarios in this light-hearted, slice-of-life NSFW comedy.

games.name: Ragdoll Fists
games.summary: Ragdoll Fists is a 2D physics-based fighting game designed for mobile devices. Players control martial arts fighters with ragdoll physics, engaging in fast-paced brawls against AI opponents or other players. The gameplay focuses on timing, momentum, and chaotic movement across various arenas, featuring multiple fighting styles, customizable characters, and regular updates with new content.

games.name: Roots in the Sky: The Hand of Glory 2
games.summary: After five years in hiding, former Miami detective Lazarus “Lars” Bundy is swept up in another globe-trotting supernatural mystery whose origins trace back to a legend about the creation of Earth itself.

games.name: SCP: The Beginning
games.summary: A first-person survival horror game set inside a collapsing containment facility. Explore restricted sectors, read unreliable reports, and survive hostile entities where following procedures can be just as deadly as breaking them.

games.name: Scum's Errand
games.summary: Raid cursed dungeons, claim powerful loot, and escape before it's too late. Scum's Errand is a top-down roguelite horde shooter with extraction mechanics where every run makes you stronger, but greed can cost you everything.

games.name: Seconds Until You Die
games.summary: Incremental survival game where you add seconds to your life by eating and drinking increasingly surreal foods, while trying to avoid getting burnt, crushed, dehydrated, distorted, destroyed, and many other things.

games.name: Shadow Dungeon
games.summary: Nightmarish monsters crawl forth from the darkness, while the Demon Lord lurks beneath the abyss. Venture into the Shadow Dungeon, carve your way through blood and chaos, and forge your own legendary epic.

games.name: Slay the Berserker
games.summary: Slay The Berserker: A solo developer's 3D hack and slash dark fantasy game with 2000's retro style. Find your path with stylish platforming movements as you slay enemies in half. Face challenging bosses across diverse biomes in your quest to Slay The Berserker.

games.name: Sniper Camouflage Orange Spy Warrior I Buried Two Bodies in the Garden and the Police Haven't Figured Out Yet That They're Missing Because They Were a Lonely Old Couple Who Had No Relatives Simulator 2026
games.summary: Sniper simulator game with sponge bob graphics

games.name: Tales of Medieval Duelists
games.summary: Ditch the animations. In Tales of Medieval Duelists, every swordfight is a unique physics-based clash. Master precise, skill-driven combat where timing a perfect parry is your key to victory. Build your legend with deep progression, gear, and a high-risk win streak multiplier.

games.name: The 1% Club World Challenge
games.summary: Do you have what it takes to answer a question only 1% of people get right? Test your brainpower and compete against players worldwide!

games.name: The Grand Slamboree
games.summary:
The Grand Slamboree is a 2D Platform-Fighter, where every hit is lethal for intense, fast-paced rounds. With simplified movesets, anyone can join in the brawl, while leaving plenty for dedicated players to master!

Bash, blast and chomp your way to victory in this tournament of creatures, weirdos and not-quite-heroes.

games.name: The Lands of Hyberian
games.summary: Welcome to The Lands of Hyberian. The kingdom of Tydrall is ruled by the king and queen who have claimed all The Lands of Hyberian. It is up to the brave knights of Tydrall to answer the kings summon! Prepare your training and bring your wisdom as the king seeks an audience with you.

games.name: The Legend of Dark Witch Renovation
games.summary:
The Legend of Dark Witch is a 2D platform action game. Zizou can learn new attacks by defeating bosses. She will need every one of those attacks if she is going to save the world.

Updates in Renovation include:
- New character illustrations and revamp pixel art spites to high-resolution
- New Animations
- Added the minigames "Avoid Runner" and "Breakers"
- New Boss arrangements to change attack patterns
- Added Capacity System from Ep2
& more!

games.name: The Memory Library
games.summary: Found the card you need? Then combine it. Even a card that looks completely useless might become surprisingly useful once you combine it. Probably. Collect and synthesize cards, create unexpected synergies, and take on 10 story chapters and an endless dungeon.

games.name: Thumps & Blows
games.summary: Chaos and fun are guaranteed in this fighting game, where a quirky cast of stickmen battle each other using ridiculous techniques in fast-paced fights with easy-to-learn yet unexpectedly deep mechanics.

games.name: Tóng Dāo Yín Jiàn
games.summary: During the Xining period of the Northern Song Dynasty, a treacherous prime minister wreaked havoc on the imperial court. He engaged in militarism without regard for the rich and the poor. Using his position as a court official, he obstructed the lending practices of landlords, favoring the common people over the gentry. Undeterred by the will of Heaven, he attempted to divert the Yellow River, a move that would etch his name in history. Fearing this move would destroy the lifeblood of the Song Dynasty, the underworld rallied around a general, a knight-errant, an assassin, and a thief, known as

games.name: Tough Love Arena

games.name: Tower's Gate
games.summary:
A third-person aether-punk open world RPG for PC

You wake on a foreign world with a character you built — not a hero on rails. The world has dozens of creatures and thousands of dungeons to discover and conquer.

Character Leveling, Skills-based, Large Open World (107,000+ Square Kilometers), and over 13,000 Weekly Rotating Dungeons. Multiplayer capable for up to 8 players on a private server.

games.name: Truck Manager Australia
games.summary: Build a car-transport company across Australia. Take freight jobs, plan tours, manage trucks, drivers and running costs, track profit and loss, and expand your fleet step by step with a clean desktop UI. Play offline.

games.name: Water You Doing?
games.summary: Your ride is dead, and rough waters lie ahead! Survive aboard a musty boat in a totally chaotic co-op. Collect scrap, patch up leaks, swap your catch for cold brews, and use harpoons to break the laws of physics!

games.name: White Rooms
games.summary: White Rooms is a first-person puzzle game where every room teaches you a rule... then punishes you for believing it. No combat. No reflexes. Just trust, and the moment it breaks.

games.name: Zong
games.summary: Zong is a first-person VR adventure game that takes you on a journey through ancient Eastern history and culture.

games.name: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy
games.summary: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy is an upcoming action-adventure game developed by Asobo Studio and published by Focus Entertainment. Set 15 years before A Plague Tale: Requiem, it follows Sophia, a young plunderer, as she travels to Minotaur’s Island and searches for answers about her past. The game is described as an original story set in the A Plague Tale universe, featuring combat, puzzles, and mythological elements tied to the series’ wider history.

games.name: Star Wars Zero Company
games.summary: Command an elite squad through a gritty and authentic story in Star Wars Zero Company, a single-player turn-based tactics game.

games.name: Lou's Lagoon
games.summary: A cozy exploration-and-crafting adventure: fly your seaplane between tropical islands, collect resources with the Swirler 2000, rebuild storm damaged communities, and unravel the mystery surrounding Uncle Lou’s disappearance.

games.name: Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots - Master Collection Version
games.summary:
The extreme tension of infiltrating without being detected.

Metal Gear series, the pinnacle of “stealth action” Immerse yourself in the Metal Gear series, the pinnacle of “stealth action” where you can infiltrate and elude your enemies to complete missions.

The game takes place five years after the Big Shell incident in Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty, in a world where war has become a business.

To stop Liquid Ocelot's uprising, Solid Snake throws himself into his final battle.

The battle against Liquid and the Patriots draws to a close, and the mysteries woven throughout the series ar

games.name: Hyperdimension Neptunia Unlimited
games.summary: Hyperdimension Neptunia ∞ (Unlimited) is an upcoming entry in the series where the world faces an apocalyptic loop triggered by a mysterious “meteorite.” As reality repeatedly resets, Neptune awakens alone in a white void and gains the power to “retry” fate itself. Alongside new allies, she must endure countless defeats, uncover the truth behind the cycle, and challenge the ultimate ending to save the world by venturing into a new spacetime.

games.name: Tearscape
games.summary:
Discover a Gothic world in this 2D top-down action-adventure, blending fast-paced combat, exploration, and pixel art inspired by Game Boy Color classics. Fight monstrous foes, unlock new abilities, and explore a non-linear map filled with hidden secrets and dangerous challenges.

Master precise combat, where every strike and dodge matters. Strategically manage your stamina by carefully considering each move as you face off against grotesque enemies. You have a limited number of healing flasks—use them wisely and plan your moments to recover carefully. Upgrade your character's stats to remain e

games.name: Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker - Master Collection Version
games.summary:
The extreme tension of infiltrating without being detected.

Metal Gear series, the pinnacle of “stealth action” where you avoid combat and complete missions while hiding.

The game take place 10 years after Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater.

Amidst the swirling conspiracies behind the East-West Cold War, Snake confronts them while leading a private military force.

This is the story of how one soldier, “Snake”, becomes “Big Boss”.

games.name: Mind Diver
games.summary: Restore a broken mind to solve a twisted case. Investigate a couple's most intimate moments and piece together the events of a fateful night. Pick what to investigate, deduce awful truths, and solve a dark mystery. But most of all, Mind Diver: find the lost love. Before it's too late.

games.name: The Cabin Game
games.summary: The Cabin Game is a 1-4 player, chaotic horror game where you are trapped inside a cabin and the only way out is through a game of cards. Just beware, as the cards you play have a surprising twist on this humble abode...

games.name: Whisper of the House
games.summary: What's happening in this seemingly peaceful town? Strange residents, bizarre incidents, and unexpected storylines! Please be sure to let go of all your human lifestyle preferences and strive to meet the special requests of your otherworldly employers. Decorate this house with peculiar furniture!

games.name: Aggelos 2
games.summary: With the gods of light about to lose the great battle against the gods of darkness, you must master two powerful forms. Dive into a challenging Metroidvania set across contrasting worlds filled with secrets, puzzles, and intense 2D combat in this action-packed sequel

games.name: AstroScaper
games.summary: A minimalist puzzle city-builder where every placement counts. Build colonies on asteroids using strategic proximity-based mechanics and minimal resource management. Relax in freebuild mode or chase high scores in challenge mode – all against a serene cosmic backdrop.

games.name: Chou Shin Jikuu Geimu Neptune: Unlimited
games.summary:
Hyperdimension Neptunia!
The latest installment in the numbered series!

The Gamindustri world is facing an impending doom.
With the addition of a new goddess,
Eleven of them will face the giant meteorite together.
A hopeful adventure woven by goddesses
Now, the grand curtain rises.

games.name: Gawr Gura: Quest for Bread
games.summary: Gawr Gura: Quest for Bread is an action-platformer fan game where you jump, spin, and fight through unknown lands to help Gura reunite with her lost bread!

games.name: Ghetto Zombies: Graffiti Squad
games.summary: Expect blasts of green zombie goo painting the screen in this top-down shooter packed with crazy guns that blow the heads off some… freaky zombies. Your mission is simple: graffiti the whole city before these mutants dog-pile you.

games.name: Horripilant
games.summary: Horripilant is a chilling incremental dungeon crawl through the horrors of a forgotten underworld. Combining idler, puzzle and autobattler elements, you'll fight, mine, and think your way through the depths of a forsaken dungeon.

games.name: Race Jam
games.summary: Experience the thrill of the 1990s with Race Jam - an action packed arcade-style racing game! Featuring retro-inspired tracks, high speed gameplay and an authentic throwback vibe. Race Jam: Exhilarating 90's Arcade Racing like you remember, But BETTER

games.name: 1x1 Street Football: mini soccer PvP
games.summary: 1x1 Street Football: mini soccer PvP is a vibrant arcade game where every match turns into a real fight! PvP sports battles, mini football and the spirit of street playgrounds inspired us to create this online game. Here you are a football manager, a goalkeeper, and a striker - in short, a true football star! These are not just football games - players of all ages will enjoy them!

games.name: 9mm Roulette
games.summary: Step into a chaotic bar where every turn is a deadly gamble. Spin the revolver, smash tables, dodge bullets, and turn bar items into weapons. With destructible environments, ragdoll physics, and dark humor, it’s all about luck, strategy, and surviving the madness.

games.name: A Taste of Home
games.summary:
Horror Game Movie in this time is いえのあじ A taste of home (Horror Game)

A taste of home is a short exploration-based horror game set in the Japanese countryside.
Keita must keep the promise with his mother. He must not make friends. He must not go outside. He must not speak to anyone. But Keita breaks his promise with his mother and goes to play at his friend's house.

That was the beginning of everything.

games.name: Animal Falling
games.summary: Animal falling is a multiplayer party game featuring cartoon animals in ball form, engaging players in a platform race filled with strategic obstacles and traps to hinder opponents. Unleash your mischief, obstruct rivals, and navigate the chaotic hilarity to victory in this wild, furry showdown!

games.name: Anomaly Tunnel
games.summary: You are trapped in a tunnel where the entrance and exit have vanished. Examine the clues left behind and escape safely.

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Satan of Saturn
games.summary:
" Satan of Saturn" is a shooting game released by SNK in 1981.
Fire your missiles and laser beams to take down the UFOs and rockets coming to invade Earth. Clear the Earth stages and blast off for Saturn! Win the decisive battle against Satan of Saturn!

games.name: Arcade Archives: Satan of Saturn
games.summary:
"Satan of Saturn" is a shooting game released by SNK in 1981.
Fire your missiles and laser beams to take down the UFOs and rockets coming to invade Earth. Clear the Earth stages and blast off for Saturn! Win the decisive battle against Satan of Saturn!

games.name: Ars Mechanica
games.summary: A PvE idle strategy game where auto-battles unfold on a 10×5 grid battlefield. Customize and position your humanoid mechanical soldiers, defeat the enemies that stand in your way, and build the strongest mechanized army.

games.summary: Explore a mysterious alien planet filled with abandoned facilities, breathtaking landscapes, and hidden secrets waiting to be discovered.

games.name: Be Kinder and, Like, Be a Rewinder, Dude!
games.summary: 1995, Summer. "Get a job or you're joining the military" shouts your dad. Get your ticket to an incremental game where you'll rewind, loan, buy tapes, buy rewinders, buy food, move to better locations, hire your mates and make a mint at Planet Rewind! Video tape rentals will be around forever!

It’s a fresh new game dressed in pastel, cute visuals—nostalgic in spirit, yet with noticeably improved controls.

games.name: BreakEven: Idle
games.summary:
BreakEven is an idle action RPG for those players who enjoy the cycle - kill, loot, power-up, and destroy even harder.

The battle is automatically happening while you are making all the right decisions regarding the equipment selection, skill building, and overall strategy.

The game plays like an action RPG but values your time just like an idle game does.

The complexity is always ready when you need it but never interferes with you otherwise.

games.name: Bump Guardian
games.summary: Bump Guardian is a casual deck-building defense game about protecting a growing life. Build your deck, repel incoming threats, and progress through the stages of pregnancy.

games.name: Can I Come In?
games.summary: Your parents have left, and you're home alone. What begins as an ordinary evening after school slowly turns into a living nightmare, where every little sound makes your heart race. Remember the most important rule: don't open the door for anyone.

games.name: Can I Not Fall for Idols?
games.summary: You’ve become the manager of a brand-new idol group—only to find yourself drowning in romance flags from the start! Love with idols is strictly forbidden. Can you survive this chaotic, no-love-allowed romcom—the first of its kind in the otome world!?

games.name: Chew Chew Mimic
