Play as a hungry mimic in this head-scratching puzzle game where you have to guide unsuspecting knights to their doom.

Lay down traps to get all the knights to the mimic and try to collect each level’s 3 coins for an extra challenge.

games.name: Chomp Chomp Carnage
games.summary: Eat everything. Grow big. The ocean's never looked this cozy and deadly at the same time. A fish-eat-fish arcade chomper where every creature is crafted from wool. Devour your way up the food chain in Chomp Chomp Carnage.

games.name: Cocoro
games.summary: "Please make me human." A visual novel about a robot longing to become "human" in a world torn apart by rampaging AI. An unforgettable summer unfolds between a boy who has nowhere to call home and a humanoid girl who dreams of marriage...

games.name: Court of Darkness: Adoration's Kiss
games.summary: In this world of magic, your kiss is an irresistible temptation.

games.name: Cozy Farm Defense
games.summary: Build your farm by day and defend it by night! Grow crops, raise animals, recruit farmyard defenders and build walls to stop hungry enemies.

games.name: Cozy Farm Life Simulator
games.summary:
Turn a quiet patch of land into your own little farm, complete with crops, animals and pets, and watch it flourish.

Start with just a few planting beds and some basic tools. Buy seeds, plant each crop by hand, care for them, wait for the right moment and then sell the harvest for a profit. As your farm grows, you can unlock more space, upgrade your equipment, increase production and become more efficient every day.

games.name: CozyCat Simulator
games.summary: Experience a cozy and atmospheric feline adventure in "CozyCat Simulator." Defend your territory or form alliances in this cinematic Victorian world. Engage in dynamic mechanics, from hunting mice to mischievous antics.

games.name: Crayon Story: Thumbelina
games.summary: An emotional, creative children's game where you color your own storybook and write your own tales.

games.name: Cursed Objects: Find and Seal
games.summary:
What object caused the haunting?
Read the scene
Seal the curse!

games.name: Cyber Breaker
games.summary: Welcome to the 'Breaker System'. Fight back against the system through a game of cards and free humanity from its systematic embrace as BREAKER. Combine the use of skill cards and powerful artefacts alongside tactical thinking to best the system and break through the advancing array of robots.

games.name: Dave the Diver
games.summary: Dave the Diver is an action-adventure and management simulation game developed by Mintrocket. In the game, players control Dave, who spends his days diving into underwater environments to catch fish and gather resources, and his nights managing a sushi restaurant. The gameplay combines real-time underwater exploration and combat with restaurant management mechanics.

games.name: DoDonPachi Resurrection Reignite
games.summary: Cave's arcade bullet hell shooter returns as DoDonPachi Resurrection Reignite. New stages, a new character, new music, and other new elements set the stage for a new challenge.

games.name: Dr. Bowlatzo's Crazy Bowling
games.summary: A quick-play roguelike bowling game. Get strikes, get achievements, get high scores. Try different ball combos for different gameplay strategies. See if you can defeat Dr. Bowlatzo!

games.name: Dungeons of Alethrion
games.summary: Dungeons of Alethrion is a dungeon crawler roguelike game based on the Youtube animated series, Tales of Alethrion. Play as epic heroes from the show, each with unique abilities. Play it alone or grab a friend to join you in the dungeons!

games.name: Escape game R00m16
games.summary: Explore 3D space and escape

games.name: Escape Room: The Secret Portal Puzzle
games.summary: The deeper you go, the darker the truth becomes*

games.name: Fernkeep
games.summary: Discover the quiet charm of a medieval castle town.

games.name: Flekkia
games.summary: A Roguelite board game where every tile counts. Play as an Archer torn between the purity of the Angel and the rage of the Demon. Build your equipment, manipulate the terrain, and turn your movement into a devastating attack. Dying is only the beginning to rewrite your destiny.

games.name: Fractured Universe
games.summary: A Turn based RPG with a focus on team building and character development. Explore the Fractured Universe, and what life would be like if the multiverse was destroyed. Featured various art styles and aesthetics.

games.name: Giraffe Raising Game: Reach for the sky
games.summary: This giraffe's neck grows!

games.name: Glow Box
games.summary: A 60-minute adventure where all you do is glow.

games.name: Golftacular!
games.summary: Mini-golf turned upside down! Abuse wild items on a variety of challenging golf tours. Shoot, fly, explode, and whatever else you can to get in the hole! It’s golf… barely.

games.name: Grimveil
games.summary: A classic-style MMORPG built solo from scratch. Pick from 6 classes, grind real progression, loot your gear, and team up with a party or guild in an actively developed world made by someone who loves the genre.

games.name: Hidden Cats in Barcelona
games.summary: Explore Barcelona, with plenty of cats and characters. Enjoy a relaxing, cozy journey—now with bonus stages featuring a new progressive colorization effect that gradually reveals the map’s colors as you play.

games.name: Hidden Photo Mysteries: The Truth Gets Scary
games.summary:
What should never
be in the photo?

games.name: I Did Not Buy This Ticket
games.summary: A short horror story about losing your identity. Face your traumas while riding a mysterious bus.

games.name: Infected Escaped
games.summary: A co-op PvE survival game where you team up with other survivors to scavenge resources, fight infected enemies, uncover the map, and reach the final extraction point.

games.name: Inside the Cube
games.summary: Lost between endless rooms.

games.name: IQ Logic Codes: Number & Letter Puzzles
games.summary: Can you crack the hidden logic?

games.name: Just Keep Fishing
games.summary: A short incremental game about catching a lot fish.

games.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Baekje Military Museum
games.summary: This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed.

games.name: Late Order
games.summary: Night shifts at a cursed 24/7 diner. Every night — new rules and unsettling events. Fulfill orders, don't annoy the bizarre monster in the mascot's body, and maybe you'll have a chance to survive until dawn.

games.name: Like a dog
games.summary: Inside an infinite laboratory where inhumane experiments were conducted on dogs, a concise story about loneliness, perseverance, and madness is told...

games.name: Lyrvane Park
games.summary: Lyrvane Park is a first-person meta-horror puzzle adventure. Use the Radar of Emotions to harvest children's emotions, power up the train, and unlock the path forward. Beyond the Staff Only signs, the park’s darkest secrets await

games.name: Magic Chess
games.summary: Magic Chess, inspired by Chess and Chinese Chess, breaks free from traditional boundaries by introducing brand-new pieces and items, resulting in over 1,000,000 possible combinations. The game supports Single Player, Custom Matches, Local Multiplayer, and Online Random Matchmaking.

games.name: Magnetail
games.summary: Think Like a Genius, Solve Like an Inventor

games.name: MegaBattle
games.summary: Build robots and enter the arena to battle! Robots have taken control of the galaxy and now humans must build bots to fight in the MegaBattle Arena. MegaBattle combines the best of the CCG with innovative mechanics such as unique mana mode, opponent reading attack and a fast card draw system.

games.name: Metahustle One
games.summary: MetaHustle One is a fast-paced, frantic FPS with horror elements. Fight through hordes of wicked horned foxes and other corrupted familiars of the «Great Meta-Druid» to escape a glitchy simulation before it turns into a surreal nightmare.

games.name: Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 2 Bonus Content
games.summary: As purchase bonuses for the collection edition, it includes Metal Gear: Ghost Babel—the series first title for handheld consoles, released in 2000—and Metal Gear Solid: Digital Soundtrack Vol.2, featuring numerous iconic tracks that enhanced Snake's missions, ranging from BGM used in the games to vocal songs.

games.name: Mimic Party
games.summary: A 1-5 player online voice party game. You hear a sound, the whole table gets one shot to imitate it all at once, no turns. Your take is scored on pitch and rhythm, then the wheel decides who gets a bonus and whose take becomes a fart.

games.name: Mining and Dwarves
games.summary: An incremental game where you mine rocks, gather ore, and recruit dwarves. Play actively for maximum gains, or idle and let the dwarves do the work.

games.name: Monst
games.summary: Players take on the role of an alien monster, devouring humans on Earth with various transformations, fighting against human armed forces, and annihilating the world.

games.name: Murders on the Yangtze River
games.summary: "Murders on the Yangtze River" is a horizontal axis Chinese-style whodunnit detective game developed by OMEGames Studio. Players will find out the hidden truths of the final case through investigating and reasoning a pile of fantastic cases.

games.name: My Party Is Grinding
games.summary: A desktop idle RPG where your party of five heroes fights, loots, and grows in a small window while you work.

games.name: Mythical Creature Personality Quiz: 16 Types
games.summary: Which myth suits you?

games.name: Nightlatch: Haunted House
games.summary: A low-to-mid poly horror escape game across 3 different houses. Find the keys you need room by room, hide from a stalking presence, and uncover the story through scattered notes - each house with 4 difficulty tiers of 10 levels.

games.name: Nitrokill
games.summary: An action-packed futuristic hovercar racing game in the spirit of legendary Hi-Octane with online multiplayer up to 8 players.

games.name: Orb Breaker
games.summary: An incremental bullet hell about shooting orbs at enemies, collecting resources, and becoming powerful!

games.name: Orbital Checkpoint
games.summary: Orbital Checkpoint is a sci-fi border control simulator. Check alien documents, scan suspicious luggage, detect contraband, and manage your tight budget on station GSA-42. Regulations change daily, but bills for oxygen and coffee always arrive on time. Will you risk letting the Acid Lemons pass?

games.name: Package Piles: Tidy Up The Warehouse!
games.summary: Package Piles: Tidy Up The Warehouse! is a relaxing placement simulation where you organize a huge warehouse full of boxes. Stack packages on pallets, use transport vehicles to place them on shelves, and enjoy turning a messy space into a perfectly organized warehouse step by step.

games.name: Palabras en inglés para aprender en la primaria
games.summary: Build first English words with a fun quiz!

games.name: Patagon
games.summary: Patagon is a first person open world VR Steam Punk adventure shooter. It's fun and easy to play. The game takes place in an alternate steampunk reality where the British empire has never ended. Battle giant monsters and dinosaurs while you explore Sand Dollar island.

games.name: Pesky Orcs!
games.summary: In "Pesky Orcs!" you take part in medieval fantasy battles between ancient foes: Orcs and humans. Dive into a unique mix of Autobattler, RTS and Roguelike in real retro pixelart fashion!

games.name: Peter The Stash Hunter
games.summary: A business sim + looting + strategy hybrid. Outbid rival hunters at storage auctions, ransack what you win, then run the shop that bankrolls Peter's search for his missing grandfather. Sabotage cards, Dutch vs English bidding, harpoon chases. Every box could hide a secret.

games.name: Plasma Dome
games.summary: Plasma Dome is a tactical tower defense with roguelite progression and no predefined paths. Defend your city from an aerial assault of geometric entities from another dimension.

games.name: Platonica Space
games.summary:
Open the door and step into someone's memories.
Platonica Space is a psychological exploration adventure where you search countless rooms to recover lost memories.

games.name: PNR: Point of No return
games.summary: You don't dodge. You push through. PNR: Point of No Return is a space opera roguelite where you blast through enemy fleets head-on, forging a new loadout every sortie. Build your arsenal mid-battle, come back alive, hit the jackpot on the Slingshot, and do it all again.

games.name: Project City
games.summary: Drive, drift, hustle, and survive a city that reacts to every bad decision.

games.name: Project II: Silent Valley
games.summary: Project II: Silent Valley is a linear, semi-open world dystopian visual novel with card combat and explore. Play as US Navy Officer Hierophan, joining the docile humanoid weapon Osprey to uncover a conspiracy at the underwater base "Silent Valley" and the hidden truths of his missing friend, Ochira.

games.name: Puzigo
games.summary:
A relaxing jigsaw puzzle for people who want to slow down. Choose your preferred difficulty and enjoy the game at your own pace, from a casual 100-piece puzzle to a long-term challenge of up to 2,000,000 pieces.

Without being rushed by time limits or score ratings, immerse yourself in the small satisfaction of each piece clicking into place and enjoy a calm puzzle experience.

games.name: Quest of Dungeons
games.summary: Choose your hero and enter the dungeons!

games.name: Question Roulette
games.summary: Prove your wits and composure in this ultimate fast-paced trivia challenge where knowledge, speed, and strategic risk-taking determine victory.

games.name: Rabbit Claw Party
games.summary: Catch lively rabbits with a claw in a cute scoring stage game. Read each rabbits movement, clear levels, complete tasks, collect stickers, decorate your photo wall, fill the rabbit catalog, and enjoy local two-player co-op or competition.

games.name: Research Story
games.summary: Set out to discover and record plants and creatures for the Violet Archive. Grow crops, tame animals, and build the perfect farm! Forge friendships along the way as you begin your life as a researcher!

games.name: Retrobot: 2085
games.summary: Retrobot: 2085 is a fast, frantic twin-stick arcade shooter with endless robot hordes, survivor rescues, high-score chasing, extra lives, and chaotic 4-player local multiplayer.

games.name: RGB Switcher: Color Roguelike
games.summary: RGB Switcher: Color Roguelike is a fast-paced action-puzzle roguelike set in a dying black-and-white world. Players control a customizable geometric Painter and must master the RGB spectrum by manipulating Red, Green, and Blue switches. Through mixing colors and utilizing hundreds of ability combinations, players restore corrupted grid-based arenas while surviving dynamic, real-time combat encounters.

games.name: Save the Eggs
games.summary: Save the eggs from breaking

games.name: Scary Stories Grotesque
games.summary: A short horror visual novel inspired by internet ghost stories and urban legends, where familiar places become home to inexplicable and disturbingly real horrors.

games.name: School Sweets Discovery: Granulated Sugar Edition
games.summary: A beautiful girl 2-choice quiz adventure game where you can experience a little variety of languages! Enjoy multi-end collection and online ranking in Challenge Mode!

games.name: Shifting Sands
games.summary: Welcome to the Nexus. You died, the sandpit brought you back, and now you have a shift to finish as a scrapper. Scavenge crashed ships, cram your pack with dangerous salvage, meet odd survivors, and make it home each day through a weird desert world before the storm resets the sands and you with it.

games.name: Shrimp Game: Overkrill
games.summary: Become a pilot of a SHRIMP - Submersible Hydrodynamic Research Integrated Marine Platform. Krill your friends, explore areas for loot and customize your SHRIMP!

games.name: Simulador StreamHub
games.summary: Simulador StreamHUB is a browser-based career simulation game about building and managing a streaming career. Players make quarterly decisions while managing audience growth, money, energy, community, equipment, staff, employment and streaming platforms. Random events, quick-time events, crises and different career outcomes make each playthrough unfold differently.

games.name: Smack Talk
games.summary: Smack Talk is a 1-4 player online pvp platform fighting game where you must say your moves out loud. Beat your opponents with one liners and finish them off with ultimate moves in this chaotic new fighter!

games.name: Splash of Color
games.summary: Fill the world with color one puzzle at time!

games.name: Super Real Mahjong Venus Returns
games.summary: The legendary strip mahjong game is back with the latest VR technology! Play two-player mahjong against Shoko, Mizuki, Aya, and Akira, and each time you win, they'll take off a piece of clothing. Experience zero-distance stripping!

games.name: Supermarket Electronic
games.summary: Build your electronics empire! Stock the latest gadgets, serve customers, set prices, upgrade your store, and become the ultimate electronics retail tycoon.

games.name: The Blood Mage II
games.summary: The Blood Mage 2 is a turn-based Puzzle/Dungeon Crawler RPG hybrid. You play as a blood mage, so your health doubles as mana pool. Fight against different creatures and explore the environments to reach your goal!

games.name: The Last Ladybug
games.summary: Fly forward and save your swarm in THE LAST LADYBUG - a rail shooter set in a colorful world where the skies are ruled by mechanical monsters and the lands are scorched by destruction!

games.name: The Magical Girl Childhood Friend Lives Next Door
games.summary: A story-driven romance visual novel where your choices shape relationships, uncover secrets, and lead to multiple endings with your childhood friend.

games.name: The Old Flesh of Nuraga
games.summary: First person psychological horror game about treasure hunting with Grandpa. Search among the sands of Nuraga to unearth what's driving him mad.

games.name: Therian Crush: Wild Animal Boys
games.summary:
These guys are wild by nature.
Get close, earn their trust, and unlock what they don't show just anyone.

games.name: Thoughtless
games.summary: A dark sci-fi psychological Visual Novel where your choices shape who you are. The world has ended and it's been dominated by mysterious aliens who roam the city. Despite that, you only think of what you've lost. Will you be able to rebuild your relationships? Or even... the world itself?

games.name: Tiny Misery
games.summary: A sick mother and her young son move into the home of a lonely old woman. A tragic story inspired by the dark puppet animations of the 80s and 90s.

games.name: Touhou: Lost Branch of Legend
games.summary: Welcome to Eientei, combine multiple colors of mana to build your ideal deck, duel with gensokyo girls, and chase back the mysterious moon treasure. Also, enjoy the unpredictable Roguelike with fantasy Danmaku!

games.name: Tradesman: Deal to Dealer
games.summary: TRADESMAN: Deal to Dealer is a game about a merchant who rides around in his horse-drawn (or bear-drawn) cart. Starting his journey in his home village of Grampstead, the Tradesman heads off to the other towns and villages of the world. Stock up on marine morsels in Fishpool, quench your thirst at Grubgrog Village's renowned tavern, sell basic necessities in Hoboken, and trample the dirt in Normingham, the capital of these lands!

games.name: Train Plus Japan: Drive Western Japan Trains! - Rapid Service Edition
games.summary: Drive real JR-West trains! An authentic, officially licensed railway driving game.

games.name: U Tsu Tsu Tsu
games.summary: Roam a quiet late-night city in this chill point-and-click adventure. Click anything that catches your eye, check your phone, and reply to viewer comments only if you feel like it. Take your time and enjoy a slow, unhurried night—free from anyone's expectations.

games.name: Vanishing Evidence: Mystery Cases
games.summary:
Can you spot every trace?
Choose it, erase it
A dark mystery puzzle

games.name: VCuber
games.summary: Control the light ball and crush the bricks! Nara the girl can destroy the bricks by hitting the light ball and controlling its direction of movement, using the ball to clear all the bricks in the scene, but be careful of the enemies and their bullets.

games.name: Wild Justice
games.summary: Wild Justice is a 3D first-person Western action-adventure game inspired by the 1985 ZX Spectrum classic The Wild Bunch. Set in the Wild West, players navigate the frontier while managing survival mechanics, tracking down outlaws, earning gold, and clear their name in a modern reimagining of classic retro gameplay.

games.name: WordHive 3
games.summary: Build words, score points, and master the hive.

games.name: Zumba: The Pharaoh's Marble Revenge
games.summary: Awaken the Pharaoh’s curse—match, blast, and conquer the sands of time!

games.name: Elden Ring
games.summary:
Elden Ring is an action RPG developed by FromSoftware and published by Bandai Namco Entertainment, released in February 2022. Directed by Hidetaka Miyazaki, with world-building contributions from novelist George R. R. Martin, the game features an expansive open world called the Lands Between. Players assume the role of a customisable character known as the Tarnished, who must explore this world, battle formidable enemies, and seek to restore the Elden Ring to become the Elden Lord.

The game builds on the challenging gameplay mechanics familiar from the Dark Souls series but introduces a more

games.name: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4
games.summary: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is a first-person shooter and the follow-up to Modern Warfare III (2023), continuing the rebooted Modern Warfare storyline. The campaign is set during a North Korean invasion of South Korea and features dual perspectives: a young South Korean soldier named Private Park facing his first combat deployment, and Captain Price operating outside official channels on a personal mission. The game also includes multiplayer with 6v6 core maps, large-scale vehicle combat maps, and a dynamic map system called Kill Block that reshapes layouts between rounds. A DMZ extraction

games.name: House 2
games.summary:
As a terrible storm approaches, two young girls spend a fateful night watching TV and playing games…

House 2 is the sequel to the hit indie horror game, House. In House 2, you play as Tabby & Melody, finally free from their cursed home, in the next chapter of the House saga.

games.name: Allumeria
games.summary: Explore a vast and hazardous cave network and uncover mountains of loot. Build a town and trade with NPCs using advanced building and lighting tools. Fight bosses and raid dungeons to unlock abilities. Play with your friends, and build, fight, thrive, in the fully destructible world of Allumeria!

games.name: Big Ambitions
games.summary: Big Ambitions is a revolutionary role-playing business sim. Go from nothing to the biggest entrepreneur in New York by opening small businesses or slowly building huge corporations any way you like.

games.name: Captain Tsubasa II: World Fighters
games.summary: The next episode of Tsubasas riveting adventure is here! Enjoy the thrill of spectacular soccer actions with 110 playable characters and new sensational super moves. Challenge a friend in the field or support Tsubasa on his Journey, the ball is yours.

games.name: Divinum
games.summary: Divinum is an action-adventure that blends stylish, expressive combat with rewarding exploration. Master devastating combos and craft unique builds to fight back mysterious invaders and uncover your island’s hidden truth.

games.name: Garden of Witches
games.summary: Garden of Witches is a cute roguelike action game full of danger. Help the protagonist, Sil, as she tries to round up her unruly fellow witches and save the Garden.

games.name: Inferno Protocol
games.summary: Trapped in a deadly labyrinth, you and 5 friends must scavenge, craft, and survive. Harvest monster parts for gear, inject experimental syringes to gain unique skills, and navigate trap-filled corridors. In this 6-player horror survival, you must evolve to escape.

games.name: BattleGroupVR2
games.summary: BattleGroupVR2 is a virtual reality real-time space strategy where you explore the galaxy and lead a fleet of powerful warships from the bridge of your flagship. Explore, mine, trade, hunt. Grow your fleet, upgrade your ships, train your captains, and battle the enemy from the captain's chair.

games.name: Board Game Society
games.summary: Take on an ever-changing tile-based board with up to 6 players, and see just how much treasure you can scavenge before the big bad boss is defeated! Beware though, your friends might want some of that treasure for themselves.

games.name: Cyber Cleaner Simulator
games.summary: Vacuum space junk, polish derelict ships, and clear alien worlds of debris as you upgrade your high-tech cleaning gear.

games.name: Hoversteppers
games.summary: Hoversteppers is a freestyle hoverboard skating game. Flip, spin, and test your boarding skills with timed challenges across multiple stages.

games.name: Mall Rivals
games.summary: Competitive mall simulation. 1-8 players open stores in the same mall, fight for customers, crush rivals. Team up or go solo. Fair play or dirty tricks? Your call. Procedural maps, employee system, physical mechanics.

games.name: NBA 2K27
games.summary: The hustle doesn’t stop and the run never ends in NBA 2K27. Chase greatness around the clock in MyCAREER, MyTEAM, and MyNBA, and make your hoop dreams a reality.

games.name: Once Alive
games.summary: A story-driven, first person adventure game with a cinematic experience. Set off for a journey to HaustVille, an abandoned settlement in a post-apocalyptic world. Explore your surroundings and unveil the mystery of how the last survivors vanished.

games.name: Russian Survivors
games.summary: Fight versus unlimited hordes of lizards and italian brainrot animals in post-soviet environment.

games.name: Ski Yeet
games.summary: Bomb down an endless, wraparound mountain in this arcade ski roguelike. Chain tricks into huge combos, stack 60+ power-ups across six rarity tiers, and outski a pack of hungry cryptids!

games.name: Streets of Miami VR
games.summary: Streets of Miami VR puts you in the middle of 1980s Miami—sun, sweat, and crime. Whether first-person in full VR or third-person classic view, you’ll work your way up from nothing, navigating the Vice strip as a new immigrant trying to survive in a city run by dealers and corruption.

games.name: The Abandoned House in Yeongdeok
games.summary: She was sent to the abandoned house in Yeongdeok as part of a viewer punishment challenge. But the joke ended the moment the door slammed shut.

games.name: 100 Mushroom Cats
games.summary: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. Can you find them all? ️

games.name: 1964 Operation Velvet Twins
games.summary: A retro-style action-platformer that blends the stealth shootouts of Rolling Thunder with the raw brawling of Double Dragon. The result? A thrilling 2D spy adventure set in the 1960s — packed with fists, bullets, and classic arcade energy!!

games.name: 20 Trials to Heaven
games.summary: In Purgatory, death is not defeat, but surrender is final. A lost soul must face twenty trials with one life and no checkpoints. Will your soul endure the journey, or fade into darkness?

games.name: A Game About Creating The Universe
games.summary: An idler game where you get to build up the universe from scratch. You are a part of an advanced space civilization that builds universes.

games.name: A Little Age
games.summary: Build and expand a network of settlements, each with its own little economy. Manage the flow of resources between them at your own pace, and watch a civilization emerge in this minimalist settlement builder.

games.name: Age of the Fallen
games.summary: A fast-paced dark-fantasy bullet-heaven roguelite where you battle endless hordes of demons across a medieval world. Choose from 10 unique heroes, collect and combine hundreds of cards, evolve powerful attacks, and create massive character builds as you fight through challenging scenarios, bosses, and story missions. The game also features two-player local co-op, letting you team up with a friend to take on Hell together.

games.name: Alfred's Alien Abduction Adventure
games.summary: Join Alfred in this 3D adventure game set onboard a scary alien mothership. In space no one can hear you s#!t yourself, thankfully.

games.name: Alice's Gaze
games.summary: This is an eerie clicker idle game with light puzzles and idle combat. Alice wakes in darkness, trapped in a strange mansion, seeking escape. The Cat God's altar drops gold, Rabbitfolk gather carrots, and dungeon monsters block the way... Can you accompany Alice to the final truth?

games.name: Arena Blues: Requiem for 35
games.summary: Set in a medieval Roman arena, this is a simultaneous turn-based psychological strategy game. Experience intricate and intense combat based on weapon physics and realistic collision detection. Choose 3 out of 15 slave gladiators, each with their own unique backstory, to form your team.

games.name: Arrow Puzzle Games
games.summary: Arrow Puzzle Games is a single-player puzzle game where players clear arrow-filled boards by removing each arrow in the direction it points. Classic and Expert levels focus on path-clearing logic, while selected Art puzzles reveal a hidden picture when completed.

games.name: Art of Drift: Cozy Drift Simulator
games.summary: Feel the drift, not the rush

games.name: Beast Market
games.summary: The hunt is automatic. The reading is yours. Build a stockpile while away, compare values, holdings, and sources in the Market Terminal, then choose the next beast to hunt in this free-to-play idle hunting RPG.

games.name: Bomb Farm
games.summary: Bomb Farm is a free-to-play idle RPG in which a squadron of bombers gathers resources on its own. Players destroy rocks to collect materials and hunt for rare items, forge and upgrade equipment from +0 to +15, and develop their characters through a large skill tree. Squads are built from heroes of different rarities, each with its own set of upgradeable passive abilities. Progression spans five worlds and five difficulty levels across 600 stages. Items can be traded with other players through the Steam Community Market.

games.name: Can I Take Your Order
games.summary: You and your friends play as part time waiters in different restaurants. Use your bare hands to deliver food, taze a raging cowboy who just shot someone and dispose of the body before it starts to stink. Keep your customers happy on your own, or with up to 3 friends in online co-op.

games.name: Captain Tsubasa II: World Fighters - Deluxe Edition
Cards of Destiny
games.summary: Cards of Destiny is a VR puzzle game that brings the tabletop experience to a unique interactive environment! Turn your inner child into a god as you draw one-time-use cards that can save or condemn the tiny humans on your desk – and the aliens chasing them. Adapt to different levels and situations as your randomized deck, ticking clock and looming alien threats all keep you on your feet!

games.name: Catnip Wars
games.summary: Catnip Wars is a 1-4 player co-op tower defense game in which players control Catbots defending a catnip farm from waves of monsters. Turrets, walls, farms, windmills and repair stations are placed freely on a hex grid, and the farm doubles as the economy: catnip fields fund weapons and windmills power turrets. Fourteen monster types attack the farm, ranging from swarming chompers to armored giants and boss Necros. Players can man a heavy BFG turret, revive downed teammates, and progress through a 43-node tech tree across matches. The game includes eleven playable Catbots, 100 achievements and

games.name: Cats and Seek: Zoo
games.summary: Let’s roam the zoo, meet the animals, and spot those sneaky cats hiding among them.

games.name: Chronicles of Childhood
games.summary: A story-rich, platform, side-scroller in the coming of age genre. Travel around the Fantasy World of "Chronicles of Childhood", with your slingshot at hand. Fight and avoid imaginative creations, to finish all the levels and discover what does it really mean to grow up.

games.name: Cleaning Simulator: Ultimate Mess
games.summary: Clean, organize, and restore different environments in this level-based cleaning simulator. Every level introduces new mechanics, tools, and satisfying ways to turn mess into perfection.

games.name: Command Doctrine
games.summary: Describe a battle and AI builds it. Describe a war and get a whole campaign. Command Doctrine is a turn-based wargame with endless generated scenarios. Command armies across seven eras and outthink your enemy with supply, morale and terrain. Will your doctrine hold?

games.name: Cycle01
games.summary: A minimalist game about washing contaminated laundry. Wash, sell, upgrade, and buy new equipment. Keep the contamination in check. A small mystery is waiting for you at the end.

games.name: Dealmaster
games.summary: DealMaster is a board game where every property is won through auctions. Time your action cards, invest smartly in stocks, build or destroy houses, and strike trades. Master it all across 6 unique roles to outwit your rivals.

games.name: Destined Notes: The Written Fate
games.summary: A massacre. A past that won’t stay buried. As Daniel, dive into a chilling investigation that spirals into pure horror. Explore, solve, survive—but something is watching. The deeper you go, the lesser you escape.

games.name: Dicetris
games.summary: Dicetris is a falling-block puzzler with depth. Stack dice in columns, sum to hit the target, combo colors to clear overloaded stacks. Twist your strategy around special dice and rule-bending map conditions. Easy to learn. Built to master.

games.name: Dictocracy
games.summary: Take charge as the President of a newly independent country, Adelphia. Build infrastructure, approve policies, juggle between conflicting priorities of the public, your ministers and other countries' leaders - All with only one action per turn and a different political landscape in each playthrough

games.name: Dirtnap
games.summary: Dig, fly and fight through fully destructible maps in multiple game modes. Every character has its own unique ability, every biome its own hazards, and the weapon arsenal runs from machine guns to banana bombs to airstrikes. Play with friends, strangers, bots, or all of them.

games.name: Dragonlance: Veil of the Last Sanctum
games.summary: Survive the collapse of reality in a dark fantasy turn-based RPG where worlds collide and planar rifts unleash ancient horrors. Explore frozen seas, ruined kingdoms, and blighted realms as you gather powerful souls to restore or destroy the Veil between worlds.

games.name: Drown in Yesterday's Sea
games.summary: Xiamen,Fujian Province,2024. Gu Mengzhi, a 19-year-old student at Xiamen University, encounters a "sea spirit" named Coral—who hails from the ocean—and the two quickly become close.However, just as their bond deepens, an uninvited guest known as "The Stranger" arrives and disrupts everything.

games.name: Duelgrounds
games.summary: Duelgrounds is a fast-paced 1v1 FPS where every round brings a new weapon and every decision matters. Master the entire arsenal, manage limited resources, and outplay your opponents through skill, strategy, and adaptation.

games.name: Eat the Rich
games.summary: Be a billionaire, team up and betray your friends all at once in EAT THE RICH! A social party game for 6-10 players where you play mini games, vote out the competition, conspire to get ahead, all in a bid to be the richest!

games.name: Echoes of Kyria
games.summary: Fight solo or with up to 4 players co-op to take on massive bosses in this stylized 3D action rogue-like bullet heaven. Step into Kyria, battle against relentless hordes, and master the dynamic, fast-paced combat.

games.name: Escape Hatch
games.summary: Build and operate your own escape room. Seal your friends inside, guide them, give them hints, or leave them in the dark.

games.name: Floors of Fate
games.summary: Challenge your skills in Floors of Fate, a single-player Action RPG. Battle through 50 handcrafted floors, customize your character, and piece together the lore of a ruined world. Every floor brings new enemies and tougher trials.

games.name: Fluff's Adventure: A Tale of Fur and Steel
games.summary: Fluff's Adventure: A Tale of Fur and Steel is a 3D third-person puzzle game with platforming elements. The game is focusing on non-textual storytelling, exploration and puzzles centered around fluffy furballs called "Fluffs". It creates a wholesome atmosphere in a stylized and colorful environment.

games.name: For Stella
games.summary: For Stella is an interactive narrative game centered around psychological disorders. “Why would someone who has spent their entire life suppressing their emotions suddenly pull you aside to talk about love?”

games.name: Ghostly Simulator: Your Neighboring Ghost Story Collection
games.summary: Welcome to an immersive horror fiction reading simulator. Every tale within is rooted in the chinese mundane, familiar moments we all live through —like the annual Spring Festival Gala You can shut down the simulator at any time. But remember: reality is always far more horrifying than any story.

games.name: Happy Endings
games.summary: Run an adult pixel-art massage parlor in a fast-paced incremental clicker. Hire hostesses, play pressure-point mini-games, unlock 40+ explicit scenes, automate your parlor, upgrade rooms, and manage heat and raids to build the city’s hottest parlor.

games.name: Healer
games.summary: Heal your party as you defeat the leaders of the demon lord army. Find your unique playstyle by combining upgrades. As you die, you will learn the patterns and mechanics. Maybe one day you won't have to come back to life to save the world!

games.name: Hell Apartment
games.summary: Paranormal streamer Shunya Takahashi sneaks into a cursed apartment where a family vanished. When the door of Room 101 shuts, escape becomes impossible without solving its riddles. Clear the rooms one by one and face the truth of "that day" beyond Room 203.

games.name: Jonah Lomu Rugby Challenge 4 Remastered
games.summary:
One of rugby gaming’s greatest experiences is back! Re-released and remastered in tribute to the legendary Jonah Lomu.
Enhanced in stunning 4K with massively upgraded visuals, improved lighting and smooth 60 FPS gameplay on modern hardware. Jonah Lomu Rugby Challenge 4 Remastered brings the thrills, spills and intensity of rugby to a new generation. No licensed teams, just fast, hard-hitting rugby and pure sporting fun.

games.name: Just Keep Fishing
games.summary: A short incremental game about catching a lot fish.

games.name: Knowtorious
games.summary: Knowtorious is a live trivia gameshow built for in-person game nights. One screen for the whole room: cast it to a TV, split into teams, and one player hosts while the app runs the clock, the scores and the swings. Five original shows, each a different way to play: Classic (straight trivia on a category board), Heist (steal points from the other team), Vegas (wager everything on one answer), Carnival (forfeits, surprises and swings) and Siege (fight for control of a hex map). Teams pick six categories from a library of 450+ covering film, football, music, history, anime, geography and more, wi

games.name: Last Breath
games.summary: Last Breath is a tense side-scrolling shooter in a fungal-ravaged world, where humanity has become “Spore Zombies.” As the older sister Guan Jin, fight through the ruins to find your lost sibling. Scavenge, adapt, survive. But what awaits: redemption or a deeper nightmare?

games.name: Lost Hopes: Day of Betrayal
games.summary: 19 year old Chloe was left at her grandparents George and Helen's country house for a few days due to her parents' trip abroad. Little did she know that this short vacation would turn into a nightmare where she must pay the price of an old betrayal.

games.name: Make Her Real
games.summary: A young inmate is given a faded body pillow of a girl from an old romance VN. Then she starts speaking... and becomes the only person who still sees him as human. A short psychological horror VN about isolation, guilt, parasocial comfort, and the terror of choosing freedom.

games.name: Malignant Survivors II
games.summary: Enter a world consumed by nightmares, ancient ruins, forbidden magic, and mountains of loot. Battle relentless enemy hordes, grow stronger with every run, and uncover the dark secrets of a forgotten land.

games.name: Meow Box City
games.summary: Meow Box City is a multiplayer, strategy-focused game where, ahead of the upcoming local elections, you build your own lobby against rival parties, thwart your opponents’ plans with devious schemes, and try to boost your popularity in the city by making the right moves at the right time. Collect cards, place your buildings, balance satisfaction–population–revenue… and secure the ballot boxes on election night. Let’s keep this between us: we’re winning...

games.name: Minesweeper 3D
games.summary: Classic Minesweeper across four true 3D fields: a cube, cylinder, hexagonal prism, and tetrahedron.

games.name: Momoiro Okami no Honoka-san: Ikenai, O-mo-te-na-shi
Moorage
games.summary: Moorage is a fishing roguelite where you must travel the ocean to find a way off a desolate island. Meet people stranded like you, level up each time you fail, and catch a bunch of fish!

games.name: Nowhere Road
games.summary: Nowhere Road is a winter-themed driving and taxi game set in a post-war city. Drive through quiet nights, deliver passengers, and experience a calm, atmospheric world focused on immersion and slow-paced driving rather than speed or competition.

games.name: OBITT: Escape From the Room
games.summary: You stray from a shrine into a room and become a palm-sized person. This is an escape action game to find your way out through trial and error from a miniature perspective. Manage your HP to survive and break free from this giant room! A time attack mode is included for an extra challenge.

games.name: Oshikake Oku-sama to, Kimi no Uso
Package chaos
games.summary: Package Chaos is a cozy package sorting game where you turn a messy warehouse into a perfectly organized delivery center.Pick up, inspect, sort thousands of unique packages and enjoy the satisfying feeling of a perfectly organized warehouse.

games.name: Pastimes
games.summary: Pastimes is a calm 2D logic puzzle based on Pieter Bruegel the Elder's painting Children's Games (1560). Players fill a large numbered grid where each clue indicates how many cells must be filled in the surrounding 3×3 area. Solving the puzzle gradually reveals the full painting, divided into scenes that unlock short notes about the historical games depicted. The game can be played solo or in local split-screen co-op on the same shared puzzle, with support for Steam Remote Play Together.

games.name: Peekablock
games.summary: The hide-&-seek party game where the props fight back. Build and paint your own disguise block by block, melt into the map, and pray the seeker walks right past you. Round after round of betrayal, taunts and very bad hiding spots.

games.name: Pro Soccer Manager 27
games.summary: Become the manager of a football team and take full control of your club. Manage scouting, training, facilities, and squad development. Choose your philosophy: focus on coaching and tactics, or invest in developing the next generation of stars. Success depends on your decisions.

games.name: Project: Station
games.summary: A 4-player co-op sci-fi horror game where you stealth through unstable research stations, scavenge vital resources, complete high-risk contracts, and extract before the facility overwhelms your team.

games.name: Puzzles Fruit
games.summary: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

games.name: Puzzles Magic
games.summary: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

games.name: Puzzles Snow
games.summary: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

games.name: Resort Island Simulator
games.summary: A world filled with tricksters, pirates, zealots, and treasures. An ocean full of danger and prize. Face dilemmas and encounters. Manage a resort in this wild world and build a thriving business. An Explorer, a Survivor a Resorter or a Trader? Forge your own path to wealth. Make Resort Prosper!

games.name: Rocket Engineer
games.summary: Rocket Engineer is a simulation game about designing, testing and launching your rockets to explore. Rocket Engineer focuses on the engineering aspect of rockets, while allowing a fun exploration experience.

games.name: RunOut: Hothead Paws
games.summary: RunOut is an online party platformer game for 2 to 6 players! Pick a cute animal character, race through unpredictable obstacle courses, collect coins, and be the first to grab the stuffed bear. Prepare for a fun, fast-paced mix of running, fighting, and partying!

games.name: RUVN Contest Reboot
games.summary: Experience the heated philosophical debate between Orika and her gang in this kinematic visual novel.

games.name: Saga of Yurina
games.summary: A 2D action platformer of graceful duels and perfect parries under the falling sakura.

games.name: Skye's Repose
games.summary:
Skye's Repose is a chill Exploration Farming Sim inspired by Myst and Stardew Valley where you gather materials, seeds, and magical elementals from across the land and use them to rebuild, solve puzzles, and unlock new areas to explore.
In your exploration, you'll meet the mages who arrived and escaped from Skye before you ever arrived. And while they'll try to help you, they are deeply broken themselves and in need of restoration and hope. Can you really bring light to others from so far away?

games.name: Skyland
games.summary: In this gorgeous FTL-inspired tactical RTS, you and your crew must take command of a flying castle, and defend it from sky pirates while fighting enemies of increasing difficulty. Originally developed for Gameboy Advance, now available on Steam!

games.name: Slick As The Devil
games.summary: An experimental psychological-horror tabletop game based on 3-Cup Shuffle. Keep your eye on the ball, buy special items between rounds, and see if you can beat the devil himself at the ultimate conman game.

games.name: Smash Cat
games.summary: Four paws and 192 targets!

games.name: Solipsistic
games.summary: Solipsistic is a free psychological horror game. Manipulate the game's files. The game knows you're there. The people inside it know it too.

games.name: Sunward
games.summary: A deep, relaxed space-industry sim. Mine asteroids, refine raw ore into valuable goods, and trade on a living market while you build a modular station, grow a colony, and expand across the solar system and beyond into a freighter-linked empire.

games.name: T7's Basics Plus
games.summary: This is a game of the T7's Basics, but includes cool stuffs like flooding event and more. Players collect 7 laptops and esacpe the schoolhouse to win.

games.name: Tactical Annihilation
games.summary: Experience turn-based strategy with free-form base building, multi-unit control, colossal units, and powerful battle skills. It captures the depth of an RTS in turn-based form, like Advanced Wars with massive super units!

games.name: Taro Is Back
games.summary: A video you must never play. What happened to the influencer who vanished?

games.name: Teaching Simulator: Elite Class
games.summary: Jump into the world of teaching with Teaching Simulator: Elite Class. Help your students learn, improve, and graduate from primary school. Decorate your classroom to make learning more fun and exciting. Bring in new students, support your team, and keep your principal happy. Every choice you make affects your classroom, your school, and everyone around you.

games.name: The Brave Hearts II: False Skies
games.summary: The Brave Hearts II: False Skies is a fully voice-acted, story-driven arcade shoot 'em up. Four years after the Cruabar War, advanced autonomous drones begin appearing across former war zones and civilian airspace. As a newly assigned Brave Heart pilot, players defend Uflein's skies, uncover the origin of the drone threat, and fight through campaign missions featuring aerial combat, boss encounters, QTE moments, and visual-novel-style cutscenes.

games.name: The Escape From Dungeon Keep
games.summary: A classic text RPG: type commands to explore, fight turn-based battles, manage inventory, upgrade gear, and finish side quests. Chase multiple endings, New Game+ content, achievements, and moddable Workshop maps.

games.name: The Last Cosmonaut
games.summary: The Last Cosmonaut is a first person survival horror puzzle game set in an abandoned lunar outpost. Collect parts, repair the escape vehicle, and keep the lights on, as something lurks in the shadows...

games.name: The Too-Cute Girl Who Moved in Next Door
games.summary: A 3D romance simulation game with point-and-click exploration and interaction with the heroine. The story branches into a pure romance route or a revenge route, leading to multiple endings.

games.name: Too Many Toys
games.summary: Too Many Toys! is a cozy organizing simulator where you'll sort 5,517 toys in a messy toy shop. Put every toy back in its correct place, complete rows to gain points, and spend them on upgrades that make organizing faster and more satisfying!

games.name: Trapped Out
games.summary: Get ready for an epic showdown in Trapped out! - the ultimate family-friendly action party game where chaos, fun, and laughter collide in a 3D battle arena!

games.name: Undying One
games.summary: Undying One is a tactical action RPG where every defeated enemy can be claimed for your army. Unlock new spells, raise the dead, command your forces, and endure ever-growing waves of power.

games.name: Unicycle Journey
games.summary: One wheel. Many challenges. Grab your unicycle, overcome tough obstacles, and make it to the end — alone or with friends.

games.name: Ventreville: A Cure for Sorrow
games.summary:
Ventreville: A Cure for Sorrow is a fantasy visual novel game with a colorful cast of playable characters, each with their own unique mechanics, and all of whom are necessary in solving this mystery. But be careful, as your choices will determine whether their stories end in ruin or victory.

Interrogate your own player characters in this six-chapter murder mystery! Your decisions determine how many clues are uncovered for the final player character, the detective. Explore each stage of grief: Chapter 1 stars Orven as he navigates the shocking deaths of his dream and his hero.

games.name: Void Cargo: Equilibrium
games.summary: A first-person sci-fi cargo flight sim. Pilot a physics-driven lander, plan risky routes, manage fuel and heavy cargo, and save deliveries by repairing system failures mid-flight. Earn credits and upgrade your ship.

games.name: Warscape Alpha
games.summary: Pilot your Hovertank through 60 levels of old school arcade style action in both single and multiplayer modes. Collect new weapons and bonuses during battle to defeat, outrun and confuse your enemy.

games.name: Where To?
games.summary: Drive a late-night taxi through a city where no one can be trusted. Pick up suspicious passengers, follow unsettling routes, and face strange conversations and irreversible choices. Tonight, who you take, where you drop them off, and where you go next are all up to you. A retro horror taxi game.

games.name: Wild Story: Primal Secrets - Collector's Edition
games.summary: A wildfire scarred the reserve — now poachers and buried secrets threaten what remains. Explore the wilderness, rescue wildlife, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover the truth hidden deep within the forest.
A horror visual novel about urban legends of Russian town in 2007.

games.name: Astronaut Simulator
games.summary: Drifting in the silence of space, you awaken aboard a damaged orbital station. Systems are failing, oxygen is running low, and every sound echoes through cold metal corridors. This isn’t a story about conquering space—it’s about surviving it.

games.name: Backfools
games.summary: One ordinary moment, you suddenly find yourself lost in a strange and unfamiliar place. There, you encounter the beings who inhabit it. Backfools is a first-person adventure game.

games.name: Catch Flex
games.summary:
Catch Flex is a full-body dance rhythm game played in front of a single camera, with no VR headset, no gamepad and no wearables. The camera sees your whole body, your moves are the input, and even the menus are gesture-controlled. Tracking runs locally on the device, or on a phone running the free Catch Flex: Controller app, which sends only movement data over the local network and never uploads video.

Six kinds of move make up a chart. Slash blocks in the direction of the arrow, catch rings with a hand or a foot, kick the balls or knock them back, stomp floor markers on the beat, ride slide

games.name: Der Anzeigenhauptmeister
games.summary: Slip into the role of the advertising master! Detect illegal parking in a big city and select the correct offense from a list. Collect money for the state and punish traffic offenders for their actions! Law is law!

games.name: Eternal Levels
games.summary: Explore and survive in this 2D game set in the urban legend of the backrooms, with a wealth of objects, entities, levels, and sublevels at your disposal. Will you be able to survive and escape, or will you be trapped forever in this new reality?

games.name: Every Step Has a Sound
games.summary: An atmospheric horror puzzle game where an independent programmer answers a request from a gold mining company and finds himself alone inside mysterious caves hiding dangerous secrets

games.name: Formic Fortress
games.summary: Formic Fortress is a local co-op tower defense party game with rogue-like elements. Scavenge and throw blocks to build your anthill and fend off waves of nasty bugs! Protect your queen, survive the swarm, and unleash the dormant strength of your ammo through powerful upgrades resetting every run.

games.name: Frogborne: New Lands
games.summary: A colorful adventure awaits!

games.name: Heroes of Lust and Magic
games.summary: A fantasy idle RPG where desire powers the world. Recruit dangerous companions, cross fractured realms, outmaneuver rival factions, and uncover the truth behind the vanished goddess Amura.

games.name: Imperial Knights
games.summary: Become an imperial knight to reclaim your family's honor and discover what drove your sister to abandon her country!

games.name: In Search of Freedom
games.summary: In Search of Freedom combines close-quarters and ranged combat with environmental puzzle solving. The game rewards creativity: using the environment, combining different Blaster chargers, and coordinating enemy waves are the keys to survival. This isn’t just about shooting — it’s about thinking, improvising, and adapting your arsenal to every threat.

games.name: Insectorama
games.summary: A mobile rogue-lite about defeating bugs and collecting upgrades with a Kirby Pinball inspiration

games.name: Kinetiks
games.summary:
Kinetiks is a futuristic competitive arena sport game combining fast-paced action, tactical teamwork and physics-based gameplay.
Players compete in intense matches where movement, precision and strategy are essential. Control the energy disc, outmaneuver opponents and use teamwork to dominate the arena.
Designed as an esports-oriented experience, Kinetiks focuses on skill-based competition, dynamic gameplay and memorable team battles.

games.name: Last Term, First Love
games.summary: Last Term, First Love is a dating-focused visual novel where you balance romance, academics, and wild campus life. Manage your GPA, navigate social challenges, and pursue love while facing the realities of modern campus culture and the international student experience.

games.name: LeManager
games.summary: LeManager is a fast football management simulation where you build squads, scout and negotiate transfers, train players, set tactics, handle player egos and incidents, and play endless seasons without losing the speed of classic management games.

games.name: My Friendly Little Island Deluxe
games.summary: A sunny little island, a handful of new friends, and all the coconuts you can carry.

games.name: Pawned Souls
games.summary: Pawned Souls is a 3D soulslike action game mixed with chess, where players control a pawn fighting hostile pieces bound by strict chess movement through real-time sword combat, precision parries, and spatial positioning.

games.name: Pirate Havoc
games.summary: Unleash Chaos on the High Seas

games.name: Push and Pull
games.summary: The Push and Pull is a co-op only puzzle platformer about playing as two dualistic bunnies.

games.name: Skullchef
games.summary: Skullchef: The Wooden Soup — a cozy idle clicker. Stir the magical cauldron, summon quirky helpers, collect hundreds of charm skins, and ascend through prestige. Relaxing ASMR vibes, daily missions, achievements and global leaderboards. English & Spanish. By SmallCreek.

games.name: Tame Me Hard!
games.summary: Take on the role of a female adventurer with debts to pay in this side-scrolling dungeon crawler. Head into different types of dungeons to encounter various creatures. Fight them, capture and train them, then sell them for profit. Pay off your debt before time runs out!

games.name: Toaplan Arcade Garage: Flying Fire Shark
games.summary:
Beasts of the Sea, Soaring through the Skies!
Shoot 'em up arcade classics Flying Shark and Fire Shark together at last!

games.name: Volatility
games.summary: You are a PnL number on a Bloomberg-style terminal. Nothing more. Deep in debt to the creditor whose money you now trade, you read the filings, build the thesis, and work the whole desk — equities, options, futures, bonds, FX, swaps — to trade your way out. Or you don't.

games.name: World Sweeper
games.summary: Each build starts with one unique skill. You have a flag limit. Tap right-click to flag. Hold right-click for skills. Level up to rank skills, steal others, or stack bonuses.

games.name: Zombie Arise
games.summary: Zombie Arise is a Zombie Retro FPS based on console classics from 1990.

games.name: Don't Drop The Cake
games.summary: Let's deliver a cake to our customer. To reach them, you must traverse a space filled with monstrous creatures. If fear makes you tremble or you drop the cake in panic, you'll face the customer's wrath. This challenge isn't for cowards. Only the brave and composed will succeed. Are you up for it?

games.name: Sightings of Beyond
games.summary:
After a recent encounter with something undeniably non-human, you are forcibly reassigned to a long-abandoned government SETI program—Project SILO—revived solely to keep you contained and quiet.

You play as Dr Kai Mercer, an untrained, non-certified civilian whom the government labels “Doctor” for convenience and credibility. With no real preparation, you're dropped into a valley near the coast in Washington State. You are stationed in a facility that was used to detect ocean UFO and UAP anomalies back in the 90s, when its previous technician mysteriously vanished without a trace.

Your task

games.name: Ball Boy Simulator
games.summary: A first-person lost-item exploration simulator set in a Japanese high school baseball club. Search for missing baseballs while enduring the strict hierarchy and unreasonable treatment from coaches and upperclassmen.

games.name: Banana Kingdom
games.summary: An addictive retro strategy simulation! Simple rules with deep strategy. A powerful, highly flexible map editor. Built by a developer who has sunk countless hours into strategy games, with one concept in mind: the perfect companion for an immortal life.

games.name: Fablewood Chronicles
games.summary:
Fablewood Chronicles is an idle strategy game about a civilization of moveable regions that keeps running whether or not you are watching it.

You buy a region and put it somewhere. Every region type reaches a certain distance, so two placed within reach of each other open a road between them. Money cannot improve that road. It improves because people walk it, and a worn road is faster and kinder to the traveller on it. Wear enough of them in and the lines stop being lines: roads bundle into trunks, crossings collapse into junctions, and highways curve between the places your people actually g

games.name: Fortune Factory
games.summary: Fortune Factory is a luck‑based game where you create dice, sell crates, upgrade your factory and slowly build your fortune. Roll the perfect crate to win — or progress step by step. It’s just you and your luck.

games.name: Get Upstairs
games.summary:
Have you ever had the urge to run upstairs after turning off all the lights? Did you pretend something was going to "get you" if you weren't quick enough?

Anyway, here is a short game about turning off all the lights before heading upstairs.

games.name: Grey Cloaks of Aron: The Sleeping Village
games.summary: A story-driven 2D detective adventure set in a mysterious medieval village, where two royal investigators are sent to solve a seemingly ordinary missing-person case that quickly takes a stranger turn. Explore the village, question its inhabitants, investigate crime scenes, and piece together clues to uncover the secrets behind the mysterious events, either alone or in local co-op.

games.name: I Thought I Knew You
games.summary: A coming-of-age yuri visual novel set in a university. Players take on the role of a female protagonist and deepen their relationships with three girls. The game features a multi-ending format where the story branches based on the player's choices.

games.name: Keywraith
games.summary: An arcade typing game where enemies drift down carrying words. The first letter you press locks onto the most urgent matching enemy and every letter after that fires at it, so choosing a target and typing are the same action. Some enemies change what typing the word requires: one must be typed backwards, one re-rolls its word until you commit, one splits in two when destroyed, and one erases all your progress on a single wrong key. Three paces, six handcrafted levels with a boss, and a daily challenge shared by every player. Free, no ads, no account needed, and it needs a physical keyboard.

games.name: Legends of China: Chang'e Flies to the Moon - Collector's Edition
MSO FreeCell Arena
games.summary: Multiplayer FreeCell — same deal, every player, race to solve. Live leaderboards, daily challenges, head-to-head rivalries. Free to download and play, no ads. Free for everyone during beta; the competitive layer becomes an optional subscription later. One flat tier, no microtransactions.

games.name: My Fire Is Bigger Than Yours
games.summary: Grow a tiny fire until it's bigger than the Sun! A short incremental game about throwing things into a fire, starting a cult, experimenting with builds, and creating chaotic chain reactions.

games.name: Tank Odyssey
games.summary:
Enter fast-paced tank arenas where sharp movement and quick decisions are the keys to survival. Fight relentless enemies, switch between four distinct weapons and take on a new challenge in every level - hunt for hidden keys, capture zones, complete time trials and more!

Battle through 20 increasingly difficult levels across the Arcade, Void, Paper and Distort arenas, then test your skills in four objective-free Endless modes. Stay mobile, master every weapon and survive the chaos in Tank Odyssey.

games.name: Tranniversary Death Drive
games.summary: Tranniversary Death Drive is an experimental kinetic novel which explores the links between transgender identity, poverty, and insanity. It is inspired by surrealist poets and 'pataphysics. The game is presented as "an account of the last chapters of the Holy War".

games.name: Unbaitable
games.summary: After fishing becomes outlawed by the Fish Protection Bureau, a young fisher decides to continue the sport and illegally fish.

games.name: Word Quest Nature
games.summary: Find your calm. Discover the wild.

games.name: Breathedge 2
games.summary: Sent on a reckless mission, you find yourself in outer space filled with numerous dangers and things to explore. Build, craft, manage your crew, look after the chicken, and defeat the evil space corporation in this new breathtaking survival game.

games.name: Serious Sam: Shatterverse
games.summary: Serious Sam: Shatterverse is a co-op roguelite FPS for 1 - 5 players. Blast through shifting universes, stack wild boons, bend the rules with run modifiers, and hunt Mental's deadliest forces. Fall fast. Come back louder.

games.name: Lady Death Demonicron
games.summary: Lady Death Demonicron is an all new side-scrolling, sword slicing, magic wielding, 15 level, multiplayer beat-em-up that takes the best aspects of the 1990's arcade classics - all mixed together with a killer 90's industrial-metal soundtrack!

games.name: Project Reignition
games.summary: Project Reignition is an on-rails platformer developed by KumaPauZ. This unofficial remake of Sonic and the Secret Rings, originally developed by Sonic Team and published by SEGA in 2007 for the Wii, aims to bring the classic game to modern systems. Built using the Godot engine, this free and open-source project features enhanced graphics, refined controls, and a smoother frame rate, offering a fresh experience while staying true to the original.

games.name: Luminous Jigsaw Puzzles
games.summary:
Step away from the noise of the world and enter the enchanting realms of Luminous Ages. This isn't just a puzzle game; it’s a journey through a vibrant multiverse brought to life by the breathtaking, hand-illustrated gallery of renowned fantasy creator Anthony Christou.

Wrap yourself in a cozy atmosphere of magic and myth. Whether you are piecing together a majestic dragon or a celestial horoscope, you’ll find a serene sanctuary designed to spark wonder. From the first piece to the final click, experience the satisfying glow of vibrant colours and hidden details emerging under your fingertips

games.name: Deadline Savior
games.summary: This idle RPG adventure is based on the "Pomodoro Technique." Complete focused work sessions to advance your character's exploration. To reclaim the Goddess's Hourglass and restore peace, the hero must defeat the evil dragon "Procrastination" and its minions. The world’s fate is in your hands!

games.name: Forest of Deceit
games.summary: Forest of Deceit is a 4-8 player social deduction game where you use your phones to play!

games.name: JunkTok: Paranormal Investigators Challenge
games.summary: Another 3-player co-op horror slop. But it’s set in 2016, baby!

games.name: Pikmin 3 Deluxe
games.summary:
Prepare yourselves, brave explorers, and set-off for the lush planet PNF-404!

This new version for Nintendo Switch features multiple difficulty modes, new side-story missions featuring Olimar and Louie, and all the DLC from the original release.

games.name: Sucker for Love: Crush Landing
games.summary: Put the ‘love’ in 'Lovecraftian horror!' When a captivating comet named Hheily crashes into your apartment, you are drawn into an interplanetary conflict between light and dark. Feed Hheily's fire to save the world in this horror-comedy visual novel… and maybe even win a smooch!

games.name: Unwanted Experiment
games.summary: Unwanted Experiment is the second chapter in the Hidden Town escape game series. You will have to interact between two characters who have to help each other to escape together from the mysterious laboratory in this great adventure full of adrenaline.

games.name: Wonders of Waldwea
games.summary: Take on the role of a struggling museum's curator who receives a mysterious challenge to identify artifacts from the ancient civilizations of Waldwea. Dive through a broad range of academic texts in order to identify the artifact's culture and the era it was produced in. Will you save the museum?

games.name: Aegis Force: The Scorian War
games.summary: Aegis Force is a single player, story-driven, strategy RPG (SRPG) that has an engaging grid-based tactical combat system. It is designed in a breathtaking 2.5d pixel art style. Players can recruit for and customize their party, using gameplay that includes full world and town exploration.

games.name: Agile Cube
games.summary: In Agile Cube, you control a cube. You jump across platforms. You reach the portal. That's it, but the challenge is in the timing, the spacing, and getting better each time.

games.name: Another Shadow
games.summary: Another Shadow is the sixth chapter in Hidden Town escape game series. You will have to interact between two characters in this mysterious point and click adventure. But remember, what you do in one world will affect the other, so make the right decisions.

games.name: Automon Arena
games.summary: Capture creatures with trash bags and scrap your way to the top! Automon Arena is a fast auto-battler where you bag wild animals and fight other kids until only one survives!

games.name: BeatChip '95
games.summary: You find a beat up old PC in a hidden room with an arcane piece of music software. Can your beats lead you to success? Create tapes, get cash and upgrade your setup against the clock in this offbeat music-making simulator

games.name: Behind the Sword
games.summary: Behind the Sword is a fresh take on the turn-based strategy genre, featuring a fast-paced approach to conquering the world.

games.name: Beyond the Room
games.summary: Beyond the Room is the eight game by Dark Dome. In this point-and-click game, you will explore an abandoned building and unravel its mysteries.

games.name: Blast Horizon
games.summary: A single-player arcade-style shoot 'em up focused on precise positioning and dodging. Players face waves of enemies approaching from multiple directions, collect energy dropped by foes to temporarily slow time, and use bombs to clear the screen when overwhelmed. Includes a practice mode and emphasizes score-based replayability.

games.name: Bloodbath
games.summary: Bloodbath is a suspense and investigation game with elements of horror, in which you take on the role of an operator responsible for controlling an android.

games.name: Cherry Blossom
games.summary: The game "Cherry blossom" is about a cute little bear who went to save a wise tree from darkness.

games.name: Cloud Runner
games.summary: Cloud Runner is a casual First Person 3D platformer that tests your skills with relaxing fun levels and arenas. Collect coins to boost your speed and multiply your combo.

games.name: Dong Wu: Odyssey
games.summary: Dong Wu is a challenging RPG about legendary beasts. You will form a 4-person party and fight a battle of succession to claim the throne. In this thousand-year war, your enemy could be the noble or Miasma. Your fate depends on your strategy, luck and courage. Good luck!

games.name: Dungeon Bucko
games.summary: Dungeon Bucko is a retro styled dungeon crawler an homage to games like Dungeon Master. Based on Amiya Aranha's community. It was created for the 2026 Buckojam and turned into a full release.

games.name: Edge of Evil
games.summary: Edge of Evil is a first-person psychological horror game with a focus on story and exploration. Solve puzzles, meet interesting characters and unwrap and ancient mystery in this game of terror where an ancient seal has been broken upon entering a locked crypt and now the shadows of darkness have been unleashed into the mortal world.

games.name: Escape from the Shadows
games.summary: Escape from the Shadows is the seventh installment in the Hidden Town series of escape games. Embark on a thrilling point-and-click adventure and solve puzzles and riddles trying to escape from the shadow world.

games.name: Fading Reality
games.summary: Tormented by the disappearance of his wife Emily, Thomas returns to an abandoned place where reality and nightmares begin to blur.

games.name: Fantasy Miner: Idle Depths
games.summary: Dig for ore, discover new resources, smelt ingots, and unlock hundreds of upgrades in this fantasy mining idle game. Mine faster, dig deeper, and watch your progress grow.

games.name: Fantasy Waifu Collector
games.summary: Fantasy Waifu Collector is an exciting game about collecting "Waifu" in order to build an army to build a town and restore the world from decay! Players will recruit many different characters as they explore a fascinating world filled with monsters. Defeat the Demon King to win, right?

games.name: Fenrir
games.summary: The Nine Worlds are crumbling. Fenrir is free. Build your warrior from hundreds of items, master a deep build system, and fight your way through Midgard to Asgard — before the beast devours everything.

games.name: Flashpaper
games.summary: You are the unseen hand — the resistance's digital arm inside a regime that has begun burning books. Crack the Concord's networks from a green-phosphor terminal, cover every log you touch before the trace fills, and get paid off-grid. 24 missions. Three you are not meant to win.

games.name: Folk Hero
games.summary: Folk Hero is an action-slasher with rogue-lite elements set in the world of Slavic fantasy. Explore the ever-changing island, find treasures, combine weapons and artifacts to defeat mythical enemies. Challenge your skills! One life, one attempt.

games.name: Gathera
games.summary: Gather materials to craft and craft to gather more materials! Open new locations to explore the world, build a cozy home and decorate it with your collections. Build manufacture to optimize gathering and crafting. Survive against the monster raids if you want!

games.name: Ghost Case
games.summary: The Ghost Case is the fourth episode of the Hidden Town escape game series. You will have to go through different parts of the city investigating and looking for clues that will help you solve the mysterious case. Interview the suspects involved and discover the murderer.

games.name: Go Up
games.summary: How high can you go? Find out in this Cookie Clicker inspired journey that never stops. Collect golden dust to unlock new skills to go up even faster. Keep your game running so you don't go down. Compete with your friends and the world to ascend to the greatest heights.

games.name: Grave New World
games.summary: A tactical Tetris roguelike set in a dark Lovecraftian world. Build a powerful deck of shape cards, outsmart the undead, and master fast-paced runs where every piece can change the battlefield.

games.name: Haunted Laia
games.summary: Haunted Laia is the fifth episode of the Hidden Town escape game series. In this point and click game, you must navigate through your memories to discover how you got to where you are and escape to rescue your family and return home.

games.name: Headspace Reverie
games.summary:
Explore the end of the World through a decaying virtual space.

Do you feel like something isn't quite right with the World? Do you feel a crippling sense of unease weighting you down a little bit more every day? Do you wanna scream for no particular reason? Do you look around and feel like everyone is doing okay except you? Are you a prisoner in your own head, with everything piling up with no way to prevent this?

This is the future, and it is terrifying.

games.name: Hidden Memories
games.summary:
What happened last night? Dive into your memories to unravel the mystery.

Hidden Memories is the ninth game of the Hidden Town series by Dark Dome.

games.name: Housekeeper: Anomaly
games.summary: Scavenge abandoned apartments, cut on broken glass, fight anomalies, trade with the merchants, deceive them into buying bad products and most importantly - try to stay alive and care about yourself!

games.name: Idiots In The Das
games.summary: Idiots in the DAS is a 2D platformer combined with a turn-based RPG with a particular sense of humor that mocks internet old and new culture and a battle style that focuses a lot on Hit or Miss and gradual HP loss.

games.name: Isle of Flesh
games.summary: Short retro horror game inspired by H. P. Lovecraft’s “Dagon.” Focused on atmosphere and story.

games.name: LA: Streets of Sorcery
games.summary: A detective visual novel where magic, sex, and comedy collide: solve cases, duel wizards, and flirt with danger.

games.name: Last Pill Bar
games.summary: A virus is spreading. You can't afford to pickle everyone. Keep the bar open and decide who gets pickled before the outbreak decides who dies.

games.name: Leapbound
games.summary: A precision platformer where every jump matters. Master a fixed-height jump, avoid deadly falls, and descend through five floors filled with dangerous challenges.

games.name: Legend of Idle
games.summary: In this incremental game, you must rebuild your kingdom! Gather resources, construct numerous buildings, and set out to conquer everything with your army! A game in the style of the SNES!

games.name: Long Dives
games.summary: Sink a mining outpost into the deep and keep it growing while you're away. Dive through ten depths, automate everything, decode the Archive, and strike covenants with the dark. A layered idle-incremental with 50 achievements, full offline progress, illustrated in pixel-art.

games.name: Maestro's Cold War 2
games.summary: Revive the Cold War in this simple yet effective strategy game, offering depth and great replayability.

games.name: Minimon: Tiny Idle Tactics
games.summary: A tiny monster-taming auto-battler that lives in the corner of your screen, and they never stop grinding. Catch 90 Minimon, build busted team comps, and rake in loot while you work, browse, or play something else entirely. They battle. You profit.

games.name: Neon Howl
games.summary: Neon Howl is a fast-paced neon arcade shooter featuring a campaign, bosses, Boss Rush and Anomalies.

games.name: Nexus: Quantum Industries
games.summary: A sci-fi incremental about industrializing the universe, collapsing it into Stardust, and rebuilding stronger. Automate twelve tiers of impossible machines, chart a finite galaxy, draft run-changing Cosmic Laws, light five constellations, and descend into the endless Abyss

games.name: Nowhere House
games.summary: Nowhere House is the third chapter in the Hidden Town escape game series. You will have to interact between three parallel worlds and seek help from the characters trapped in the house. Only with their help you will be able to escape.

games.name: Nozomu School Daze
games.summary: Your choices matter in Nozomu School Daze, a 90s shonen anime-meets-rom-com visual novel! As a college girl, Sari wants to attend school in peace. Too bad the martial artists in her life have other ideas! These 3 idiots get into a knock-down brawl, which YOU control! New genre: BATTLE ROMANCE

games.name: Pawned Souls
