games.summary: Pawned Souls is a 3D soulslike action game mixed with chess, where players control a pawn fighting hostile pieces bound by strict chess movement through real-time sword combat, precision parries, and spatial positioning.

games.name: Potential Man
games.summary: Potential Man is a role-playing experience where you must navigate the whims and woes of a humble seed. This wacky story features fully hand-drawn visuals, zany characters, and a classic JRPG-styled soundtrack to boot. Are you ready to achieve your true potential?

games.name: Promised Harvest
games.summary:
Promised Harvest is a catch-the-dark game where your objective is to collect as much food as possible that falls from the sky, thus increasing your score! However, it won't be so easy! There are rotten foods and enemies that will hinder you, so keep an eye out for each one!

Choose your harvester and start harvesting!

games.name: Pyro
games.summary: An exciting 2D action platformer where you control crazy pyrotechnics, face frantic challenges, and create epic explosions while testing your skills and reflexes at every level.

games.name: Slaymeji: Roguelite Desktop Survivor
games.summary: Build a ring of weapons and fight through 25 waves in a 2D fantasy bullet heaven. Prefer to watch? Let Auto Mode take over. Outside the arena, your hunter lives on your desktop and turns completed to-dos into permanent game progress.

games.name: Spell Magic
games.summary: Craft, cast, and master magical spells using mathematical concepts. Explore, battle, and solve puzzles in a thrilling adventure that combines arithmetic, geometry, and algebra with fast-paced action and strategy.

games.name: Steelborn: Tank Idle RPG
games.summary: Gear up for tank battles in Steelborn: Tank Idle RPG, the ultimate build your tank game! Equip your warrior tank and duke it out in world of warriors duels as you explore dungeons and win big in the PVP arena.

games.name: Stillflow
games.summary: Rotate minimalist lines and connect every port across 100 calm, handcrafted puzzles.

games.name: Super Night Riders S1
games.summary: A full remake of the 2016 retro-inspired checkpoint arcade racer Super Night Riders.

games.name: Tails & Trails
games.summary: Explore cozy 3D worlds, follow the trails, solve playful puzzles, and photograph every hidden cat you can find.

games.name: The Adventurers
games.summary: The Adventurers is a turn-based tactical RPG where every decision shapes your legacy. Lead your party of heroes in an open world filled with random events that affect your story. Survive a high fantasy landscape where your epic saga is waiting to be written.

games.name: The Dream Of Winning The Lottery
games.summary: Find clues to lucky numbers through prophetic dreams and various events, then buy lottery tickets each week. Keep chasing the jackpot and fulfill your dream in this simple 2D point-and-click lottery simulation game.

games.name: The Girl in the Window
games.summary: The Girl in the Window is the first point and click game the Dark Dome with which the series of a dark town called Hidden Town would begin surrounded by ancient mysteries. In this game you play Dan, a curious guy who has entered an abandoned house and has been locked up. You will have to solve riddles and puzzles, open drawers and decipher codes, everything in your power to escape the room.

games.name: The Wickers House
games.summary: An atmospheric first-person horror game. You wake up after a road accident. Before you stands a house where you thought you could find help. But this house is a trap for those who dare enter...

games.name: Tidewrack
games.summary: A few logs, one harpoon, no land in sight. Pull driftwood from the sea, turn your raft into a floating town, and rise from lone survivor to leader of a colony. Dive to the ocean floor. Raiders strike at night, sharks circle, and somewhere out there, a leviathan is waiting.

games.name: Tokyo Desire: Deck Builders
games.summary: "Tokyo Desire" takes the deck-building roguelike genre in a bold and innovative direction, inviting players to weave their own narratives deep within the neon-lit depths of Tokyo.

games.name: Trick or Freak
games.summary:
You spend the night of Halloween at a monster party and are involved in a game of truth or dare with four handsome monsters ! With your actions and answers, you can earn their favors and by the end of the game, conquer their hearts.

However, be careful... Who knows what monsters might do to some reckless human...

games.name: Unsolved Case: Whispers of Elderwick - Collector’s Edition
games.summary: A killer hides behind familiar faces. Solve puzzles, uncover hidden clues, and expose the conspiracy tearing the village apart before fear consumes it whole.

games.name: Until North Ends
games.summary: Explore a fantasy themed open world. Together with your friends or alone build your safe haven to craft gear, prepare equipment, refine resources to go on a journey. Visit different biomes, fight enemies, gather resources, plunder dungeons or caves and obtain loot!

games.name: Vibe City Islands Architect
games.summary: The mayor has given you a budget; people need housing, jobs, parks. The city needs a tourism boost, now! It's actually a chill game.. 10 gangs, each with their own radio station. Build for the city, or for your favourite gang.......... You are the architect.

games.name: Words Of Power
games.summary:
Words Of Power is a fill-in-the-blank roguelike deckbuilder. Travel deep into the dungeon and fight using the power of words. Construct sentences of devastating power and rewrite your foes.

Rewrite reality one sentence at a time!

games.name: XR22-Seaguard
games.summary: XR22-Seaguard is a PC and VR game that reimagines the classic grid-based game of Battleship. This immersive PC and VR game puts you in the heart of a dynamic 3D industrial environment, where you'll strategically place and sink ships using state-of-the-art weapons and defenses.

games.name: Young Suns
games.summary:
Young Suns is a 1-4 player narrative life sim set on Jupiter in an optimistic alternative future, intended for one-to-two hours of daily play, alone or with friends.

Build your home among the stars, and take it with you on adventures!

games.name: Zenonia
games.summary: Remember the RPG that defined a generation? ZENONIA is back—faithfully restored and now on Steam. Relive the adventure that kept you playing for hours, or experience it for the first time.

games.name: Crimson Moon
games.summary: A gothic action-adventure RPG of violent angels and dead gods.

games.name: WheelMates
games.summary: Dive into a 2-player co-op driving adventure with RC cars. With Friend’s Pass, your friend joins for free. Explore the professor’s home laboratory, solve puzzles, find hidden paths, and uncover what happened inside.

games.name: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe
games.summary: Hit the road with the definitive version of Mario Kart 8 and play anytime, anywhere! Race your friends or battle them in a revised battle mode on new and returning battle courses. Play locally in up to 4-player multiplayer in 1080p while playing in TV Mode. Every track from the Wii U version, including DLC, makes a glorious return. Plus, the Inklings appear as all-new guest characters, along with returning favorites, such as King Boo, Dry Bones, and Bowser Jr.!

games.name: Masters of Mayhem
games.summary: Masters of Mayhem is a free-to-play social deduction game with roguelike twists for 4–15 players. Work together to restore abandoned facilities and contain terrifying monsters — unless you're an impostor, in which case… have fun unleashing mayhem!

games.name: Salvation: Echoes of War
games.summary: Explore a haunting purgatory in this third-person stealth adventure. Injured and trapped in a nightmare after war, solve puzzles, outsmart enemies, and rely on your loyal companion to find a way back to life. Can you escape your past and survive the echoes of war?

games.name: Cognition Method
games.summary: Cognition Method is a story-driven, first-person puzzle game inspired by Space Odyssey 2001 and Solaris. Discover an innovative mechanics of altering gravity and dive into the surreal setting. Find your way within a mysterious artifact and unveal a non-ordinary story.

games.name: Fleet Hunters
games.summary: Find and sink battleships in a fast grid-based duel with real-time firing and retro visuals.

games.name: Monke Survivor
games.summary: You are a Monke beating up endless waves of office workers with brutal melee combat and ragdoll physics. Smash props for rare buffs, stack game-breaking items and compete on the Global Leaderboards in this aggressive action-roguelite.

games.name: Plushy Store Tidy Up
games.summary:
Turn a messy plushy store into a cozy little world of perfectly organized cuddly toys!

In Plushy Store Tidy Up, every plushy has a place but figuring out exactly where everything belongs is up to you. Pick up plushies, carry and organize them, solve satisfying shelf puzzles, and gradually restore the entire store.

As you tidy your way through the store, you'll discover new plushies, encounter trickier layouts, unlock new areas, and improve your abilities to make organizing faster and more satisfying.

games.name: Shelldiver
games.summary: Take a deep breath and dive right into this cozy incremental game about a senior turtle trying to start a business selling jellyfish. Upgrade your equipment, explore biomes, and help your turtly village!

games.name: We Are Gum
games.summary: A puzzle game about goofy alien bubble gum trying to find their way home. They move together because they're aliens. They stick to things because they're bubble gum. They're silly and goofy because they're alien bubble gum! Don't question the science.

games.name: 8AM: The Warehouse
games.summary: "8AM: The Warehouse" is a suspense game set in a massive distribution center late at night. Monitor security cameras as strange incidents occur among the remaining workers — and decide if it’s exhaustion, system error, or something lurking between the shelves until 8:00 a.m.

games.name: A Girl A Rain
games.summary: After pushing open the door, or perhaps before, the world has transformed. Will you be able to escape this rainstorm? Or will you stay...?

games.name: Absolution
games.summary: Absolution is a full 3D first-person adventure game where story, graphics, animation, sound and original music intertwine to put a spell on you as you immerse yourself in the non-linear gameplay, with captivating environments and interesting characters. The characters in the game do indeed want absolution, from an unfavourable past where tinkering with the unknown has given birth to the "Entropy", an uncontrollable vortex. As the main character asks for your help, you are confronted with a giant theme park guitar that has been ripped apart, while the Entropy pulsates dangerously in the backgro

games.name: Adventure Land: The Code MMORPG
games.summary: Adventure Land is an experimental Indie MMORPG. ANYONE can Code not just one, but up to 4 characters! You can play manually, use the given default Code, or learn programming to do more! Going open-source at 50,000 installs!

games.name: Aerial_Knight's MrFreezy
games.summary: Play as a woman who's an axe-wielding serial killer in this light-hearted puzzle game about decapitating men, uncover the disturbing story behind New Detroit’s infamous serial killer, Mr. Freezy.

games.name: Agebringer
games.summary: The Crimson Core has been stolen. The end of the world draws near. The thief hides high atop the Infinity Tower. Gather your courage, take up your weapons... The Red Crusade has begun.

games.name: Angry Chef World Tour
games.summary: A fast paced mix of solitaire, mahjong, and match puzzles where explosive chefs challenge you to survive chaotic global kitchens.

games.name: Armada Fighters
games.summary: Armada Fighter is a fast-paced arcade shoot ’em up focused on reflexes, movement, and intense action.

games.name: BlameChat
games.summary:
BlameChat is a browser-based interactive collection of multiplayer party games played in a shared room. One player hosts and puts a room code on screen; everyone else joins from a phone, tablet, or computer browser. No download or account is required to play.

Most games set the host against everyone else, with the room's move decided by majority vote — the host plays the board while the room votes its reply. Others are played between all participants. Supported player counts range from 2 to 100 depending on the game.

Games include board games such as Chess, Checkers, Connect Four and Battles

games.name: Bloomon
games.summary: As the Agriculture Department's chosen (unlucky) one, you dreamed of graduating through farming. Instead, you're put in charge of a magical farm that attracts wild Bloomon raves. Now farming, fending off creatures, and handling quirky NPCs is your new normal.

games.name: Bojan
games.summary: You think you have it bad? Try getting thrown into a quest with nothing to protect yourself, except your wits! In this trial and error adventure game, patience is key. Explore the castle including 6* bosses and 18 levels complete with their own layouts, enemy paths, buttons, doors and coins!

games.name: Bounty Trail
games.summary: It is the fall of 1881 and your bounty hunting agency is in dire straits. Your no-good partner, Edward Thorne, took out a $10 000 loan and then took off. The debt must be paid by the end of the year so you’ve got no time to waste. Pick a target from the board, mount up, and set out on the Bounty Trail!

games.name: Cage Grind
games.summary: Cage Grind is a free, browser-based MMA career simulation. Players create a fighter, choose opponents, and set pace, offense, and tactics for simulated bouts decided by knockouts, submissions, or judges’ decisions. Victories earn permanent attribute upgrades, while followers, sponsors, collectible gear, and Aura shape career progression. A shared roster, asynchronous player challenges, world championship bouts, and the Cage Feed connect individual careers. Open Gym offers practice matchups and coaching reports without affecting official records.

games.name: Carol and the Bells: A Cozy Strategy Game
games.summary: Carol and the Bells is a cozy, turn-based strategy roguelike Minesweeper-style game played on a grid. Build a deck to shape what appears on the board, manage risk, and decide when to ring the bell and move on.

games.name: Catch Flex
games.summary:
Catch Flex is a full-body dance rhythm game played in front of a single camera, with no VR headset, no gamepad and no wearables. The camera sees your whole body, your moves are the input, and even the menus are gesture-controlled. Tracking runs locally on the device, or on a phone running the free Catch Flex: Controller app, which sends only movement data over the local network and never uploads video.

Six kinds of move make up a chart. Slash blocks in the direction of the arrow, catch rings with a hand or a foot, kick the balls or knock them back, stomp floor markers on the beat, ride slide

games.name: Chaos Warrior
games.summary: Chaos Warrior is a retro JRPG inspired by the NES era. Fight deadly monsters, explore dangerous locations, and gain the strength to become the hero that saves the world!

games.name: Corposlop
games.summary: Corposlop is an automation game that lives on your desktop. Harvesting resources using bureaucracy, and refine it into components to feed the corporate machine. Make advanced factories and efficient pipelines to make the most out the limited land you have.

games.name: Craft. Sell. Goblin. Repeat.
games.summary: Build and manage your own goblin shop! Craft unique weapons and negotiate their prices! Send out explorers in to gather resources and become the richest merchant in the kingdom!

games.name: Critical Descent
games.summary: Master the high-stakes catch of the SpaceX Starship! Execute precise maneuvers to stick the landing in the tower’s arms, complete missions, compete on global leaderboards, and race your own ghost for the best time in Critical Descent.

games.name: Čtyřka
games.summary:
Čtyřka is mariáš – the Czech trick-taking card game – for four players, in the browser against three computer opponents.

The game is usually played two against two, but the partnership is hidden: the forehand picks trumps by naming a card, so only one other player knows whose side they are on, and the rest have to work it out from the play. Around that sits the bidding that can multiply the stake before a card is led.

The game is free to play and installs as an app. It deals every contract the rules allow, keeps the money, speaks the calls aloud, and tells you why a card is not legal – or le

games.name: Cute Country
games.summary: You can build your own royal city. With over 100+buildings and massive home decorations, create an unparalleled kingdom. There are many mysterious races in the alternate world, and you can recruit humans, elves, beasts, or even rarer demons, dragons, etc. to build your kingdom together.

games.name: Deck & Conn
games.summary: Take command of a nuclear-powered space corvette in a Cold War-flavored sci-fi campaign. Balance tactics, crew, and limited resources in a dynamic forever-war. Retro pixel art meets deep strategy fifteen minutes into the future of 1989.

games.name: Devil's Liminal
games.summary: DEVIL'S LIMINAL is a branching slow-burn horror and yuri romance visual novel. In a life of poverty and violence, Margo Silva has one last summer in Arizona before college. Make choices to maintain a normal facade at work, romance an enigmatic new girl, and stop the occult plot to take Margo's life.

games.name: Digital Survivor
games.summary: A neon bullet-heaven survivors roguelite. Outrun the swarm as 4 hunted programs, forge 20 weapons into ultimate forms, master build-defining synergies, raid extraction vaults, climb leaderboard seasons — and face ROOT, the administrator that wants you deleted.

games.name: Dimension Defenders
games.summary: Tower Defense Redefined. Race friends in ranked 1v1, defend together in 2-player co-op, or solo your way through dimensions of escalating chaos.

games.name: DreamHero
games.summary: DreamHero is an overhead action-adventure game focusing on hero capture and diverse combat. Players can turn defeated enemies into controllable heroes, experiencing single-player stories, Roguelike, 1V1, 5V5, 20-player battle royales, and cooperative dungeons, blending strategy and operational fun.

games.name: Dub Together
games.summary: Up to six players redub video clips and give them a whole new meaning. You record the scene, then watch every result together and vote. With voice effects, a built-in clip editor and live voting from your Twitch chat.

games.name: Dvor
games.summary: A falling-block puzzle game rooted in Soviet aesthetics. Lock concretes into a living facade as the seasons turn and the music shifts with them. Dvor means courtyard – the place where Soviet children played, where life happened. The version the falling blocks game always deserved.

games.name: Dying Reign
games.summary: Disease spreads across your lands, destabilizing regions, draining your resources, and testing your authority. Quarantine cities, draft troops, balance fear and order… but every choice comes at a cost. Hold the line for as long as you can. There is no victory, only survival…

games.name: Explorers of Palan
games.summary: Battle in turns: Gain EXP to become stronger with each victory as you calm agitated creatures. Defeated in battle? Don’t worry — besides recovery skills and items, your companion Feyrie can restore you.

games.name: Fatberg
games.summary: You, a lowly janitor, have been forced to go into the sewers to remove blockages that will cause a flood. But the inhabitants of this dark, slimy, stinking, writhing underworld do not like to be disturbed and will not let you leave alive.

games.name: Fillo
games.summary:
Fillo is a browser-based multiplayer word game where a host creates a room and players join with a code. Each round, everyone completes the same fill-in-the-blank prompt. Players score highest by matching exactly one other person, while bigger group matches earn fewer points.
After each round, answers are revealed for reactions, and at the end Fillo awards players based on the room’s funniest, sharpest, and most memorable patterns.

games.name: Fireboy & Watergirl 2: The Light Temple
games.summary: Fireboy and Watergirl need help to explore the Light Temple. Solve the puzzles, beat the times and collect all the diamonds!

games.name: Fireboy & Watergirl 3: The Ice Temple
games.summary: Fireboy and Watergirl in The Ice Temple is a cooperative platformer and the 3rd entry in the Fireboy and Watergirl series. You navigate characters Fireboy and Watergirl - either alone or with a friend - through various puzzles. Fireboy can walk in lava, but not in water. Watergirl can walk in water, but not in lava. Turn levers, press buttons, push boxes, and more.

games.name: Fireboy & Watergirl 4: The Crystal Temple
games.summary: The fourth game in the series. You navigate characters Fireboy and Watergirl through various puzzles. Fireboy can walk in lava, but not in water. Watergirl can walk in water, but not in lava. Turn levers, press buttons, push boxes, and more in a total of 39 levels.

games.name: First Light
games.summary: A story-rich arcade brick-breaker. Break through the Fog to restore a family's century of memories — 132 fully voiced levels, four generations, one old machine that refuses to forget. Play calm. The bricks are somebody's wall.

games.name: Fjordal
games.summary: A Viking colony sim with production chains and resource management. Establish a Norse village and refine the land's resources. Pay tribute to the King, or grow strong enough to fight back.

games.name: Galactum Meridian
games.summary:
Galactum Meridian is a research-first space strategy game about leading humanity’s first deep survey beyond Sol.

Command the ISA Far Horizon, a deep-survey cruiser sent into nearby star systems where the map is incomplete, the data is uncertain, and every discovery changes what comes next. You are not here to paint borders across space with fleets. You are building the first working picture of humanity’s interstellar future.

Galactum Meridian begins with real astronomical structure: nearby stars, confirmed exoplanet data where available, and catalog-backed system information drawn from sourc

games.name: Grail
games.summary: In this deckbuilder your deck fights for you. Upgrade, enchant and stickerize your cards to create clever cascading effects that defeat monsters and other players. Can you reach the Grail?

games.name: Gravitaws
games.summary: Gravitaws is a retro-style stage shooter inspired by Jaws (NES). Explore a dynamic overworld map. Collect research materials and upgrades, while evading an Alien invader. The story is delivered in classic style cutscenes. Fight bosses, survive, collect, fish, and bomb your way to victory.

games.name: Gun Shop: Tidy Up
games.summary: Gun Shop: Tidy Up — a tidy-up simulator where you need to put more than 2,700 items back in their places. Pick up, arrange, upgrade and just relax while restoring order in a gun shop.

games.name: Headrush Arena
games.summary:
Play the fastest, quirkiest VR Shooter on Quest. The AI bots have gone rogue, harvesting humanity’s knowledge and suppressing creativity. Your mission: Join the rebellion, blast the bots and take that knowledge back. Every bot you terminate drops valuable Knowledge-Orbs, absorb them and your head gets bigger, your voice gets higher and then you can jump further. The more knowledge you carry, the more powerful and ridiculous you become... But don’t get greedy: bank your Knowledge-Orbs before the bots take you out and steal them back.

Play solo or multiplayer across Free-for-All, Team Deathmatc

games.name: Insurance Fraud
games.summary: A blackjack roguelike where hands pay for their shape, not just their total. Build absurd combos from upgrades and cards that have no business in a deck, then take five dealers for everything they’ve got. The insurance is not entirely legal.

games.name: Just a Stupid Room
games.summary: Explore 30 rooms filled with original puzzles in this first-person puzzle game. Observe, experiment, and doubt the obvious. The door won't open itself.

games.name: Lamp Clicker
games.summary: Build your lamp empire, one click at a time!

games.name: Launch Them All
games.summary: A high-stakes turn-based missile duel where every shot matters. Spy, bluff, and deploy powerful tactical abilities to destroy enemy military assets while avoiding civilian casualties. Casual strategy in an approachable, classic style!

games.name: Laura Bailey Mysteries
games.summary: Join mystery writer Laura Bailey as she investigates two gripping murder mysteries. Search crime scenes for clues, interrogate suspects, solve puzzles, reconstruct torn notes, and make your final accusation. Includes a murder mystery-themed card game.

games.name: Lunokhod
games.summary: A simple retro sci-fi base builder with a socialist twist. Mine resources, build structures, prepare for crisis. Launch the Buran rocket, and usher in a new era of socialist production.

games.name: Magic Shop Simulator
games.summary:
Magic shop simulator: is a first-person, open-world sandbox simulation game where players manage and expand a magical store. The core gameplay revolves around foraging for ingredients, brewing potions, and selling goods to customers. Players can automate their shops daily operations by hiring workers to help handle foraging, brewing potions, and serving customers.

A central mechanic of the game is a risk- and-reward system involving four ward stones that protect the shop from monsters. Players must try to balance the cost between keeping the stones charged, allowing threats into the plaza, so

games.name: Match: Isekai Journey
games.summary: Welcome to Match: Isekai Journey—where your "magical destiny" is to align three identical icons before you run out of turns.

games.name: Metal Garden
games.summary: Travel through an overgrown megastructure, and discover what lies beyond it. Metal Garden is a short, atmospheric singleplayer FPS game.

games.name: Monster Ops 22
games.summary: Season 2 of Monster Ops! Black Ops soldiers Wraith and Tide know the world is against them, and they can only rely on each other. Two soldiers, forced to go rogue, with a desperate mission. There's no one left they can trust. A NSFW Gay Visual Novel Dating Sim put out in Monthly Episodes!

games.name: Mutagenic
games.summary: Mutagenic is a rogue-lite with simple controls, yet engaging mechanics. The rules are simple: mutate, kill, collect, unlock, die. Repeat. Kill monsters, collect mutagen, spend mutagen to upgrade characters. Mutagen is not permanent, how will you spend it?

games.name: NoodlePunk
games.summary: Forced into a corporate-mandated work program, you must run a noodle shop in a dying cyberpunk city to pay off your crushing debt. Prepare orders fast, manage your ingredients, and upgrade your operation while keeping up with relentless customer drones.

games.name: Not Quite Dead
games.summary: Open world zombie survival Coop game with base building, looting, crafting, vehicles, and exploration

games.name: Out Of Water
games.summary: OUT OF WATER is a visual novel about survival, myths, love, and choice. In 1 CE Watarholt, a quiet village prepares for winter - until bodies begin to surface. Shape your path through bonds, ancient horrors, and a fading peace. Will you fight, plead, or surrender to the waters?

games.name: Pop Float a-way
games.summary: POP Float a-way is a multiplayer party platformer for up to 8 players where you dash through obstacle-packed tracks by yelling into your mic, knock rivals off course, and try not to pop before you cross the finish line.

games.name: Populus Run
games.summary: Populus Run is a goofy runner with sugary obstacles. Watch out for massive falling cupcakes, rolling donuts, and rapping macarons in FiftyTwo's new game.

games.name: Quetzal
games.summary: Control a Mesoamerican god who must escape the underworld in this challenging 2D pixel art platformer, dodging dangers to recover the sacred bones of humanity.

games.name: Reliquary
games.summary: Reliquary is a free-to-play online trading card game with over 1,000 cards. Build decks around a hero, summon Reliquaries from your Extra Deck when the board is right, and call forth Incarnates by offering your monsters. Play ranked and quick matches against other players, climb the solo Tower, draft a deck from scratch, challenge friends, and watch or replay duels. Available in nine languages.

games.name: Roadside Reseal
games.summary: A roadside store where the night never feels safe. Flickering lights, endless aisles, whispers from the dark. Each task feels like research into fear—you restock, you lock, you fight to keep the seal closed.The silence breaks, the air is heavy, and every moment is research into survival.

games.name: Smile Your Day
games.summary: Two Players, Two Perspectives, One Cult. You and a friend explore the opulent cult known as Lifted Spirits in Boston, 2014. One player is the Hacker, controlling the cult's cameras and communications. With their aid, the other player stealths around the office hoping to discover the cult's secrets.

games.name: Starwalker
games.summary: Starwalker is a space-exploration survival rpg focused on surviving a massive alien invasion on planet Earth. You'll be able to explore the solar system and beyond. You are the last human standing - ready to start a new life.

games.name: Stream Clicker
games.summary: Stream Clicker is a community-driven browser clicker game built around Twitch streamers. Each streamer has their own community page where viewers click together to grow their community, complete timed missions, unlock trophies and compete in global and seasonal leaderboards.

games.name: Tales of Fear: Episode Zero
games.summary: Can you tell the difference between reality and tale? Experience three short horror stories and gather clues as to which are true and which are just part of our imagination. Immerse yourself in the protagonist's perspective and discover eerie tales from around the world.

games.name: The Cat in Yellow
games.summary: An adorable cat turns creepy. Take care of it, explore the house, and survive the night.

games.name: The Death Game Report
games.summary: Identify how every participant in the death game died, and submit your report.

games.name: The Inn Between
games.summary: A modern fantasy BL Visual Novel following a young mans journey into a parallel world to recover the past he's lost, and find his missing family. Alongside 3 attractive romance options, Myka Riley delves into the unknown.

games.name: Total Victory
games.summary: A grand strategy World War II wargame engine. The main scenario is World Conflict 1939-1945. Players get to play any combination of the big 8 major powers during World War 2.

games.name: Train Station Tycoon
games.summary: A punctual train is never an accident. In this immersive management game, take control of a bustling railway station with your friends. Assign platforms, coordinate teams, expand your infrastructure from 2 to 30 tracks, and manage real-time crises to keep the traffic flowing smoothly!

games.name: Unnamed Pogo Game
games.summary: Trapped in a surreal world, your only way out is to bounce your way to the top. Master brutal physics, survive impossible obstacles, and face the climb alone or with friends in this unforgiving pogo-stick challenge. One bad landing is all it takes to lose it all. Can you reach the peak?

games.name: Vector Surge
games.summary:
Vector Surge is a fast, uncompromising twin-stick arena shooter set inside a reactive signal field. Move, aim, dash and detonate your way through geometric swarms while the grid bends, pulses and fractures around every collision.

Almost everything you see is constructed live. Ships, enemies, projectiles, formations, effects, grid reactions and combat patterns are drawn from procedural vector geometry rather than conventional sprite sheets. Encounters remix enemy families, elites, hazards and formations on the fly. In Universe mode, procedural objectives, loot, mutations, routes and escalating

games.name: Venera 31
games.summary: Collect soil on Venus. Photograph the surface. Mark every rock. Log any unusual rock as harvester. Do not keep looking at it

games.name: Wartheon
games.summary: Wartheon is a fast-paced 2D roguelike adventure set in a world on the brink of elemental collapse. Take control of one of four unique champions to match your taste. Customize your build, master your skills, and adapt to ever-changing layouts and enemy patterns.

games.name: Woah Dave!
games.summary:
From the folks behind the BIT.TRIP series comes the frantic insanity that is Woah Dave! Help our hero, Dave Lonuts, survive an insane alien invasion and line his pockets with shiny pennies.

Hurl alien eggs, skull bombs, and explosive WOAH blocks to stay alive and sky rocket yourself to high score fame and fortune.

The Steam and PS4 versions of Woah Dave! also feature a local two-player competitive mode, where two Daves can go head-to-head in a battle to collect the most coins. We aren’t exaggerating when we say it could very well result in ruined friendships and unsalvageable marriages. Comp

games.name: Woolmates
games.summary: Two balls of wool, one thread, one big adventure! Jump, swing and puzzle your way together through more than 50 interwoven levels — in co-op or multiplayer.

games.name: Zad Archery
games.summary: Shoot down waves of targets, collect their loot, and grow stronger through upgrades and skills in this endlessly expanding incremental game.

games.name: Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault
games.summary: Live the double life of a fearless adventurer and a crafty merchant! Dive into vibrant dimensions brimming with shiny loot and pesky enemies. Grow your shop, tinker with weapons and gadgets, as well as make your mark among a ragtag community of castaways.

games.name: Angeline Era
games.summary:
Pick up your sword and hit the road!

Every level is hidden in plain sight in this nonlinear 3D Action-Adventure game! Travel a vast country's unmarked overworld in search of the next challenging fight, humorous encounter, or mysterious landscape. YOU decide what you discover next in this world of Fae, Humans and Angels!

The Angel's mothership, Throne, lays dormant behind a fierce storm. To reach it, unlock its secrets, and usher in the future, you must explore the land of Era and survive its trap-filled ruins, primordial forests, treacherous mountains, mines, and more! Overcome intense battl

games.name: Bombanana!
games.summary: Bombanana! is a chaotic, explosively funny co-op multiplayer game for three, where each player has only part of the information - blind monkey, deaf monkey and mute monkey must work together to defuse a bomb, or everyone goes BOOM! Will your friendship survive the ultimate test?

games.name: He Who Watches
games.summary: Walk on walls. Manipulate gravity. Discover secrets. In this first-person puzzle game, delve deep into an ancient labyrinth of intricate conundrums, seeking an imprisoned god at the centre.

games.name: The No Jumpscare Show
games.summary:
Welcome to The No Jumpscare Show!
Brought to you by Polypaw, this is a narrative comedy short horror game that promises a 100% jumpscare-free experience! ...Hopefully.

This release is the first part of the story, offering a playtime of around 30 minutes.

In a world where the paranormal is normal, the horror industry has gotten incredibly lazy.

Jumpscares have become the most boring cliché on earth, and Illy is completely unimpressed. She signs up for a shady haunted house promising true psychological horror... without jumpscares? At least, that's what the waiver says.

Run by yours truly, "

games.name: Category 6
games.summary: Brace yourself for the ultimate open-world survival craft experience. Welcome to a world shattered by the relentless fury of the most colossal hurricane in history. You are thrust into the eye of the storm, tasked with not just enduring, but thriving in the aftermath of nature's wrath.

games.name: Staged
games.summary: Staged is a co-op first-person physics party game for 1–4 players. Play mischievous goblins, rebuild stage sets from reference photos, haul oversized props through tight backstage spaces, and get every placement right before the curtain rises.

games.name: Super Woden: Rally Edge
games.summary: The spin-off of the acclaimed Super Woden saga, blending classic arcade essence with great depth and a genuine love for car culture. With a unique personality, Rally Edge takes you back to an era where fun goes beyond realism.

games.name: Tyr
games.summary: Tyr is a tank shooter where strategy beats twitch reflexes. Pilot heavy-armored vehicles with unique capabilities and upgrade them as you battle for victory with your team.

games.name: Beggar Simulator: Istanbul
games.summary:
Beggar Simulator: Istanbul is a first-person job simulation set on the streets of a contemporary Istanbul. The player controls a man who is not destitute but performs destitution for money, renting a costume and an act each morning and choosing where to work. A traffic junction, a covered bazaar, a mosque courtyard, a nightlife avenue and a metro concourse each draw a different crowd and reward a different approach.

Begging is handled through a dialogue menu whose lines are weighed against the passer-by being read, while the act that was rented restricts which lines can be used without breaki

games.name: Catch Flex
games.summary:
Catch Flex is a full-body dance rhythm game played in front of a single camera, with no VR headset, no gamepad and no wearables. The camera sees your whole body, your moves are the input, and even the menus are gesture-controlled. Tracking runs locally on the device, or on a phone running the free Catch Flex: Controller app, which sends only movement data over the local network and never uploads video.

Six kinds of move make up a chart. Slash blocks in the direction of the arrow, catch rings with a hand or a foot, kick the balls or knock them back, stomp floor markers on the beat, ride slide

games.name: Chompy Party
games.summary:
Hungry? Your friends and enemies are on the menu!
Welcome to Chompy Party! A free online multiplayer fan game set in the world of Skylanders, where you can play as the beloved (or feared) Skylanders Chompy.

games.name: Code My Robot Vacuum
games.summary: Code My Robot Vacuum is a game where you learn to code while cleaning! Program your robot vacuum to solve increasingly complex cleaning challenges. Navigate mazes and upgrade your robot's abilities. Perfect for beginners learning to code and puzzle enthusiasts who love logical problem-solving.

games.name: Cursed Frontier
games.summary: A 2D platformer shooter with a somber linoleum-inspired art style, where you’ll face funeral creatures in a haunting Wild West setting.

games.name: Demon Kingdom
games.summary: Demon Kingdom is a strategy card game with elements of a interactive novel. Rule the kingdom, solve mysteries, build relationships, and defeat your enemies.

games.name: Depths' Tale
games.summary: Depths’ Tale is a short first-person cosmic horror experience about a lone fisherman working the night shift. Far from shore, only the waves keep you company... for now.

games.name: Divider Dave
games.summary:
Why be alone when you can be by yourself?
Dave wakes up in a facility. He can clone himself. A lot of (almost) identical Daves and a way out that requires all of them.

Divider Dave is a slapstick puzzle-platformer for puzzle fans and casual players alike where cloning yourself is the solution to everything. Launch your clones, stack them, turn them into boxes. Every copy of Dave is a tool, a platform, and a potential sacrifice. He doesn't mind. Probably...

games.name: Duck Collector
games.summary: Not just luck, a skill-based claw machine with real physics, arcade minigames, and dozens of ducks to collect.

games.name: Eldara
games.summary: Eldara is a single-player dark fantasy idle RPG inspired by classic MMORPGs. Train 17 interlocking skills — mining, smithing, fishing, combat, cultivating and more — to hunt monsters across the realm, raid dungeons, and challenge three mythic world bosses. Collect over 100 unique items, complete dozens of achievements, and tame 16 wild pets. Progress continues whether you play actively or step away, with rebirth and prestige systems for the endgame.

games.name: Fofumia
games.summary: Welcome to Fofumia! Clean up the mess left by the adorable Fofunos - playful, hyperactive one-eyed kittens who love scattering toys and objects everywhere. It's up to you to set everything straight...

games.name: Galactic Prospectors
games.summary: Galactic Prospectors is a 2D Space Survival Sandbox set 200 years in the future when all planets in the solar system were destroyed by a rogue AI (you can play as the Rogue AI, or as a regular Astronaut out in the universe). Take on the universe against rogue AIs, other humans and other life forms, all while trying to stay alive. Even as an AI if you wish to play as such, you too must survive the harsh elements of Space. Resources are still needed, requiring you to build factories, upgrade and maintain your ships and stations, and to live.

games.name: Go Next!
games.summary: Grow exponentially stronger as you survive hordes of monsters across 9 different worlds. Gather resources, level up, build your skill tree, and parkour your way out of chaos!

games.name: Guilds of Mountgate
games.summary: A living online RPG where economy, progression and world events shape your journey. Build your character, trade, craft and explore a persistent world that evolves over time — whether you are online or not.

games.name: Hashire Hebereke: EX
games.summary: Hashire Hebereke: EX is a modern remake of the 1994-released Super Famicom racing action game Hashire Hebereke by SUNSOFT. Players can choose from comical and cute characters like series protagonist Hebe and partake in extreme races across unique stages. While carrying over elements from the original game, it will add a new Time Attack mode, new characters, and new stages, as well as four-person online multiplayer support.

games.name: Helga the Viking Warrior 9: The Last Journey
Heroes of Retribution
games.summary: A rogue-like RPG set in a ruined world. Take on the role of a tank commander. Discover other heroes and factions. Upgrade your tank, acquire new skills, and find forgotten relics in this devastated world. Choose your side, get stronger and become humanity's savior.

games.name: Kumatopia
games.summary: Kumatopia is a cozy 2D pixel-art simulation game where you care for your Kuma companion, explore a relaxing world, grow magical fruits, collect treasures, play mini-games, unlock music, and upgrade your boomerang. Take your time exploring, build your collection, and eventually face the powerful boss, Bloomblastic.

games.name: Labhorror
games.summary: A first-person horror set in a locked mansion the size of a city block. Carry three scrolls out of a 200-metre labyrinth while a man with an axe walks its corridors. Your flashlight is the only thing he will not walk into.

games.name: Lost and Found: What if I Come and Find It
games.summary: "Lost and found - What if I come and find It" is a first-person narrative game whose story will take you to the depths of working in a great corporation. After finishing your studies, you have achieved an internship in the maintenance department of SilverCup, the most renowned technological company in your city. A unique opportunity which will bring you a promising future.

games.name: Lost Sanity: Cthulhu
games.summary:
Lost Sanity: Cthulhu is a horror and exploration game where each chapter is a new story.

A group of teenagers get together to tell horror stories, and each story is represented as a chapter of "Lost Sanity."
Starting with the tale of "Cthulhu," a cosmic entity that lies dormant in their city submerged in the sea, occultists gather with the goal of awakening the entity.

You play as Megan Claire, a former reporter, who wakes up in a prison-like place. Your goal is to understand what is happening there and escape as quickly as possible!

games.name: Martha's Dolls 2
games.summary: Return to the decaying halls of the Martha Estate in this bone chilling sequel to the viral horror hit. As an urban explorer obsessed with the "Disappeared," you step into a nightmare where the porcelain faces aren't just decorations they are silent hunters.

games.name: Megastore: Tidy Up Together
games.summary: Megastore: Tidy Up Together is a cozy sorting game for solo or co-op play. Take on 5 stores at any difficulty, from a Toy Store with 3,555 items to a massive Megastore with 13,357 items. Pick up, sort, shelve, and get ready to open!

games.name: Molluscarium
games.summary: Relax and collect over 500 unique molluscs in this cozy idle game. Watch larvae grow into stunning adults in real-time, customize vibrant aquatic habitats across 9 themed packs, and discover rare species from garden snails to deep-sea cephalopods.

games.name: ShipShaper
games.summary: ShipShaper is a creative game about the simple joy of designing ships. Nothing more. Nothing less. Export to Bulwark, 3D print, or use in your own games with a free commercial license.

games.name: Slime Well
games.summary: Slime Well is a Metroidvania-style puzzle game where players take control of a slime, skillfully using its abilities to solve puzzles, explore, and ultimately uncover the truth of this world.

games.name: Spellarium 14: Collector's Edition
games.summary: A new Match3 Puzzle game with a city to build and tons of extras (hidden object, spot the difference,mahjong,jigsaw)

games.name: Terminal Error
games.summary: Preyed upon by grotesque experiments, you must find a way out of the research centre alive in this first-person point-and-click horror game. However, to escape, you must first delve hopelessly deeper into the maddening corridors of the facility.

games.name: The Gutter
games.summary: Descend into 1801 China as an opium-addicted father who sold his daughter, now prowling a burned-out floating brothel for treasures. As you touch relics of the dead, violent memories reveal a sickening truth: the greatest monster in this tale has always been you.

games.name: The Last Curse
games.summary: The Last Curse is a first-person psychological horror game. Uncover terrifying secrets, solve intricate puzzles, and navigate dark, atmospheric environments where fear lurks around every corner. Trust your instincts to survive the night.

games.name: Top Check
games.summary: Collect cards, build decks, and battle fierce opponents in Top Check, a roguelike deckbuilder and online collectable card game inspired by the classic game of chess. With many unique pieces and abilities, only the best strategists will emerge victorious. Do you have what it takes to reach the top?

games.name: The Blood of Dawnwalker
games.summary: The Blood of Dawnwalker is an open-world dark fantasy action RPG set in 14th-century Europe. You play as Coen, human by day and vampire by night, fighting to save your family in a story shaped by your actions and the secrets you uncover.

games.name: Orbitals
games.summary:
Team up as Maki and Omura, two inseparable explorers with a whole lot more determination than experience. You’ll brave the perils of space in search of help for their crumbling station home, now trapped within a supernatural cosmic storm.

Orbitals captures the warmth and style of classic Japanese anime, brought to life with hand-crafted cinematic cutscenes from Studio Massket, full Japanese and English voice acting, and an original soundtrack that channels the magic of the era.

Built from the ground up for asymmetric 2-player co-op, either in local split-screen or online, Orbitals rewards sm

games.name: Keeper
games.summary: From Lee Petty and Double Fine Productions, Keeper is an atmospheric puzzle adventure in which a long-forgotten lighthouse is awakened and, joined by a spirited seabird, it embarks upon a heartening tale of unlikely companionship, and an unexpected journey into realms beyond understanding.

games.name: Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game
games.summary: Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game is a fast-paced 1v1 fighter where you battle as your favorite characters from the Avatar franchise. Featuring hand-drawn 2D animation true to the series’ roots, proprietary rollback netcode, and full cross-play for smooth, competitive gameplay.

games.name: Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty
games.summary:
Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty is a historical fantasy action role-playing video game developed by Team Ninja and published by Koei Tecmo.

Set during a fictionalised version of the fall of the Han Dynasty, the plot follows an unnamed protagonist who battles historical characters and Chinese mythological creatures corrupted by demonic qi.

games.name: BioEden
games.summary: Step into a cozy management journey as a Keeper and bring life back to a world quietly waiting to be healed. Craft the perfect biome for dozens of wonderful animal species and use your ingenuity to restore your planet, one ecosystem at a time.

games.name: SpeedRunners 2: King of Speed
games.summary: The ultimate competitive platformer is back! Outrun, outjump, and outsmart your rivals in cutthroat online/local races, now up to 8 players. Master the movement, learn meticulously designed maps, use powerful pick-ups, swing around with a grappling hook, and don't get knocked off-screen!

games.name: Marsupilami 2: Salsa Palombia
games.summary: Help the Marsupilamis save Palombia from the Mummy Queen and her minions in this fast-paced 2D platformer! A strange melody has swept across Palombia… and all the animals have suddenly started dancing, leaving chaos in their wake!

games.name: SoulQuest
games.summary: Carve your path through hordes of enemies, defying the gods to seize the power of Morrigan, Goddess of Death, and retrieve the soul of your beloved! SoulQuest combines the evergreen Metroidvania gameplay with the unique Celtic mythology into one, action-packed mixture!

games.name: Liminal Shroud
games.summary: A psychological exploration experience that takes you deep into the heart of uncanny, in-between spaces where reality unravels. There are no monsters here—only the shadows of your own mind. Navigate strangely layered rooms, interact with the environment and unlock secrets to escape.

games.name: Rogue Blight
games.summary: Rogue Blight is a rogue-lite with focus on souls-like combat, featuring a Slay The Spire-inspired map system. Fight your way through ever-changing maps. Customize your playstyle based on what you find. Death is punishing. Only skill and persistence will carry you forward.

games.name: Monk Took Book
games.summary: A game about organizing, stacking and remembering where you put hundreds of books in a cozy-creepy medieval library. Play solo or with up to three fellow monks.

games.name: Shoe it All!
games.summary: Launch shoes from a swing to solve clever physics puzzles. Master trick shots, uncover hidden secrets and discover smarter solutions with fewer throws.

games.name: Aerea
games.summary:
AereA is a music themed Action RPG in which you play as one of Great Maestro Guido’s disciples and explore Aezir; a floating island that was broken into pieces. Your mission is to find and return the nine primordial instruments to restore balance and peace to the world. You have to find your way through all parts of the scattered islands; complete quests, solve puzzles, defeat bosses and discover the truth behind the islands.
