games.summary: Merge buildings, upgrade your defenses, and protect your fortress from endless waves of zombies. Plan each move carefully, adapt your strategy, and survive as long as you can.

games.name: Fourvive
games.summary: FOURVIVE is an online co-op survival action game where up to four players team up, wield a variety of weapons, and fight off waves of enemies together.

games.name: Future? No Thanks!
games.summary: Future? No Thanks! is a narrative-driven, open-world adventure set in an ecosocialist utopia. You're old, bitter, and scheduled for euthanasia. Enjoy your last day in a future that works for everyone but you.

games.name: Hex
games.summary: Dive into unknown dungeons and fight “HEX”. Use many items to survive in the underworld, Hack & slash action RPG to survive in the underworld! Don't wander around, just keep going!

games.name: Hockey Beasts
games.summary: Choose your team, step onto the ice, and see what kind of beast you are when the puck starts moving.

games.name: Hug & Betray
games.summary: Hug, or betray. A psychological party game where everyone picks HUG, Sword, or Gun as the host calls each round. Taunt, bluff, and rack up points! A new kind of viewer-participation game — watch the stream, play from your phone! Who'll be the sore loser howling at the moon?

games.name: Kupala
games.summary: “Kupala” is a dark, non-linear horror visual novel inspired by Slavic folklore. Little Anya arrives at a village on the eve of Kupala Night — the sacred night of the ancient Slavs. In the quiet old house, her grandmother tells her tales of unclean spirits crossing into the living world...

games.name: Magic Quiz
games.summary: Magic Quiz is a fast-paced, competitive multiplayer quiz game for 2–6 players. Knowledge alone isn’t enough here—you’ll need strategy, cunning, and a pinch of chaos magic to outwit your opponents.

games.name: Monster Slingshot Smash
games.summary: Launch, smash, and conquer in a colorful slingshot adventure packed with action, destruction, and fun.

games.name: Moonbringer
games.summary: Moonbringer is a fast-paced action shmup with a skill tree. Kill the waves, stack the loot and upgrade your ship. Unlock a variety of new abilities and become more powerful every run. Shoot, die, upgrade, and dive into space one more time.

games.name: Museum 8
games.summary:
A museum after closing. You only ever walk forward — and the same hall keeps arriving. Look through your camera, read the hall, and open the right door.

Observe the museum. Spot what changed. Choose the right door.

Watch the official gameplay trailer for MUSEUM8 and get a closer look at its core anomaly-hunting gameplay—from subtle changes in the exhibits to encounters that become increasingly difficult to ignore.

Use your camcorder to reveal additional details and unsettling changes within certain anomalies.

games.name: NexusRPG
games.summary:
NexusRPG is a persistent text-based browser MMORPG in which players develop a lasting character through combat, gathering, crafting and trade. Main-hand and off-hand equipment determine the character's class, while stat allocation, crafted gear and Gems in permanent equipment sockets shape the build. Personal and clan dungeons retain progress between sessions.

Players can develop shared Clan Capitals in Heaven and Hell, lend equipment and Pets through a Clan Armory, and take part in personal and Clan Rifts. Pets can be fed, bred, assigned work or used in combat. The shared world also includes

games.name: Not Enough Space
games.summary: Shoot to move. Move to survive. A space action roguelike about momentum, chaotic battles, loot, builds, and bosses.

games.name: Operation: Outbreak Idle
games.summary: Command automated military defenses, upgrade your fortress, and survive massive zombie waves in this action-packed idle defense game. Build powerful defenses, unlock upgrades, and hold the line against endless undead hordes.

games.name: Paleo Dive
games.summary: Explore five prehistoric oceans in VR, photograph 48 species, collect DNA samples, and expand your walk-in aquarium. Swim using natural arm movements, upgrade your equipment, and return to base before your oxygen runs out.

games.name: Paper Airplane Flying Game
games.summary: A small flight. A big journey.

games.name: Pencils Down
games.summary: Pencils Down is an analog horror roguelike where you take a 44-question exam under the watch of an unseen proctor. Wager confidence chips on answers, risk erasers on red-ink questions, and face questions generated from your real-time mistakes. Three exam forms offer escalating dread, while a meta-progression system lets you buy study aids that may help or doom you. Five endings, 400+ period-authentic questions, and a creeping sense of being watched make this a uniquely personal nightmare. Played entirely offline with mouse and keyboard.

games.name: Penguin Fury
games.summary: Penguin Fury is a 2D roguelite auto-battler where players draft penguins, merge them into stronger forms, equip weapons, and survive endless waves of enemies. The game features interactive Twitch and Kick chat integration allowing viewers to join battles, 70 unlockable skins across 6 historical eras, a deck-building Joker relic system, and full localization in 39 languages.

games.name: Phantom: Phantom of Inferno
games.summary: Remake of Phantom of Inferno with completely redrawn art in the style of the 2009's anime. The voice cast was also replaced by the one used in the anime.

games.name: Phantom: Phantom of Inferno - Nitro Archive
games.summary:
A web of swirling conspiracies. A whirlwind of bullets. Amidst it all, a poignant tale of a boy and a girl unfolds...

The neo-noir visual novel Phantom PHANTOM OF INFERNO, originally released in 2000 as Nitroplus's (now NITRO ORIGIN) first title, is now on Steam!
The Steam port is available in three languages: Japanese, English and Simplified Chinese.
*Voiceover is only available in Japanese.

games.name: Proyecto Huemul
games.summary: First-person survival horror inspired by a real Argentine conspiracy. Explore abandoned underground facilities, manage scarce resources, and stay out of its sight. Survive whatever lurks beneath the surface.

games.name: Random Mix
games.summary:
The rhythm game that writes a brand-new song every time you press play. 50+ genres synthesized live. Tap it, remix it, or build your own: you are the DJ and the producer, no music knowledge needed. Fully offline.

A song that has never existed before builds itself around you: drums, bass, melody, all synthesized live on your machine. No downloads or song packs.

Random Mix is a rhythm game with a composer inside.

games.name: Reality Rivals: The First Season
games.summary: Reality Rivals is the reality show you can play. Compete in challenges, form alliances, and survive the vote in this social strategy game. Every choice shapes the drama. Will you avoid Exile, and beat your Rivals?

games.name: REM
games.summary:
REM is an atmospheric dream exploration game. Explore surreal spaces and architecture. Collect all of the dream seeds and plant them.

Every dream remembers the last one, and every dream is shaped by the garden you tend when you're awake.

games.name: Retro Arcade Shop Simulator
games.summary: Build and manage your ultimate retro arcade! Buy classic Arcade Machines, Galaxy Pinball, and Gift Claw games, or invest in Cinema 8D, Go-Karts, and Racing Simulators. Manage the economy, hire staff, and repair your machines to keep the tokens rolling in!

games.name: Serve or Die
games.summary: In Serve Or Die, you work alone in a small sandwich shop during the night shift. With a VHS-inspired style and an increasingly unsettling atmosphere, survive as simple orders turn into something far more disturbing.

games.name: Sigma World Online
games.summary: Sigma World Online - is an online sandbox with a huge world from many star systems. Choose who to be: space explorer, miner, merchant, farmer, culinary specialist, scientist, builder or hunter, or build your empire.

games.name: Sponge Hospital. Five Nights at Bob-Verse
games.summary: A Game Of Neighbor Escape

games.name: Tales of Formentera
games.summary: Explore the island of Formentera and uncover its stories and ancient legends

games.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Arcade: Wrath of The Mutants - Ninja Edition
games.summary: Arcade Beat ’Em Up Action with the Turtles + New Ninja Edition Content

games.name: The Boo Croo
games.summary: 4-player cooperative and competitive party game with various minigames where everyone can win... and everyone can lose!

games.name: The Clubies
games.summary: The Clubies is a party platformer where players navigate cute cube characters through the disco to reach the dancefloor! Encounter various hazards, puzzles, and shortcuts in a fun, colorful environment as you master user-built levels together.

games.name: The Last Good Boy
games.summary: A Cozy idle RPG inspired by my real-life dog called Ramon, the goodest boy in the world. Gather, craft, unlock new lands, enchant your gear, and battle monsters on a quest to find out where all the other good boys have gone.

games.name: The Night Route
games.summary: A night shift in a quiet suburb seemed like an easy way to earn some extra cash. You're a regular courier on foot. Deliver the orders and head home. But remember: the darkness hides those who stay awake at night, and someone is watching your route very closely.

games.name: The Quiet Flat
games.summary: The Quiet Flat is a first-person psychological horror game set in an atmospheric Soviet apartment. Uncover the mystery of your father’s death as your familiar home slowly transforms into a nightmare.

games.name: The Swashbugglers
games.summary: A cartoon-style 2D roguelike autochess focused on tactical strategy. Recruit insect "heroes" from the forest to form a team. Develop their skills, equipment, and stone inscriptions through battles to defeat the source of chaos within the time limit.

games.name: Thorgard
games.summary: Vikings, pirates, and suspiciously organized ducks all want a sip of your legendary mead. Grab your axe, mow down the horde, and defend Thorgard's finest brew.... one swing at a time.

games.name: Town Diggers
games.summary: Dig up items from the earth and trade them in your shop. To grow your business in a ruthless capitalist world: sell items, smuggle, forge items, expand your shop, hire workers. With strong financial power be the town’s mafia boss. Take down the rival mafia.

games.name: Trailmarks
games.summary:
Trailmarks is a globe-trotting trivia adventure where what you know pays for where you go. Answer questions to earn your fare, then pick the next flight, train, bus or boat out of whatever city you're standing in - and try to keep going. Your score is simply how far you got.

On iOS, Trailmarks is a card-based trivia roguelike inspired by Reigns, where players makes decision on one card at the time, deciding between answering a question, traveling to a new destination or drawing random cards. All while their mood must be constantly balanced to prevent burnout. It's a calm and casual trivia gam

games.name: UPG: Underground
games.summary: A first person fighting game where your mouse controls your fists and everyone's a bean. Try Multiplayer to punch zombies with your friends, or just punch your friends instead!

games.name: Vespera
games.summary: Vespera is a dark fantasy idle RPG. Fight hundreds of enemies, craft gear, build your character with talents, gems and elements, recruit mercenaries that fight with you, and take on world bosses with other players! Full offline progression. No microtransactions, you buy the game, you own the game.

games.name: Void Disciple
games.summary: VOID DISCIPLE is a lightning-fast, neon-vector arcade bullet-hell with deep roguelite progression. Pilot a cyber-drone, survive escalating waves, tear through multi-phase bosses, and stack weapon synergies to break the game before it breaks you.

games.name: When the Road Darkens
games.summary: A cooperative action game where up to 4 players battle through themed arenas, dodge deadly attacks, upgrade unique abilities, and survive raid-style encounters in fast paced combat.

games.name: Zedfall: Outbreak
games.summary: ZedFall: Outbreak is a fast‑paced co‑op wave survival shooter with twin‑stick controls, evolving upgrade cards, and roguelite progression. Fight through numerous undead swarms, build powerful class combinations, and hold out long enough for extraction. There are 3 main game modes to play; Wave Survival, Tower Defence, Scavenge. Each game mode offers a different objective and gameplay experience.

games.name: Pitchside Empire
games.summary: Pitchside Empire is a business management simulation in which the player runs a five-a-side football pitch rental facility. Customers phone in to book slots and the player quotes a price for each call, negotiating against a hidden customer budget, with regular clients and facility reputation affecting how much teams are willing to pay. Profits are reinvested into changing rooms, showers, a canteen, seating, floodlights that make evening slots sellable, and pitch surface upgrades, while additional plots such as an industrial yard, harbour district, lakeside complex, downtown arena and hilltop c

games.name: Alkurai
games.summary: Alkurai is a 4 player online co-op fantasy horror game. An infamous Alchemist has murdered the king and seized Alkurai's throne. It is up to you and your party to evade his horrid miscreations and restore the kingdom to what it once was.

games.name: Cinnabar Nights
games.summary: Cinnabar Nights is a first-person rpg with turn-based combat. Explore diverse landscapes, unearth powerful equipment, manage your resources, and harness otherworldly powers.

games.name: Color Lines
games.summary: Plan your moves, line up the colors.

games.name: Crustacean Station!
games.summary: Work a day job at Crustacean Station checking identification and sending a vibrant cast of sea creatures to their desired destinations!

games.name: Doors Closed
games.summary: To save your sick son, you take a job as a security inspector at a secretive lab, the very place rumored to be causing his illness. Inspect IDs, scan for contraband, and weed out impostors. Do your job, earn your paycheck, and save your family. Just don't let the wrong people in.

games.name: Exspelled
games.summary: Exspelled is a cozy fantasy life sim mixed with tower defense. Build and customize your village, gather resources, welcome outcast creatures, and prepare your defenses. Expand your settlement, strengthen your community, and protect your new home against increasingly dangerous waves of enemies.

games.name: FlyKnight
games.summary: Kings Field style bug-themed dungeon crawler with Runescape graphics

games.name: Frog Parkour Obby
games.summary: Hop, jump, and dodge your way through every level!

games.name: Hill Climb Legends
games.summary: Climb higher. Drive farther. Become a legend.

games.name: Kupar: Horror Mystery
games.summary: Some legends should never be disturbed.

games.name: Level Up, Tiny King!
games.summary: Level Up, Tiny King! is a solo survivors-like auto-shooter platformer. After being kidnapped and thrown into the dungeons, you must fight your way upward. Survive relentless waves of cute enemies while climbing. Grow stronger, recruit magical buddies, and reclaim your throne.

games.name: Racing Manager
games.summary: Manage your racing team: strategy, tires, staff, budget, and real-time decisions. Build the perfect crew and lead them to victory in this immersive motorsport management game.

games.name: Rakhem
games.summary: Rakhem is an action platformer roguelite where you decide the enemies you have to face! Collect treasure to progress throughout each of the game's varied areas, choosing between the many different upgrades and foes available at your disposal, as well as spending cash on useful permanent upgrades!

games.name: Sex King: From Rags to Sexcess
games.summary: Rise from street kid to tycoon in Sex King: From Rags to Sexcess! Build your empire, stack wealth with luxury cars and penthouses, collect sexy girl cards for hotter intimate rewards as your fortune grows! Ready to rule money, power and pleasure?

games.name: Squad Legends: Battle Royale
games.summary: Enter the battlefield and prove your combat skills.

games.name: The Shadows Of Eldergroove
games.summary:
20 years have passed since Agent Rebecca went missing.

The Fresterous Police Department gave up and the world moved on. But Sarah, the daughter of the lead investigator, Agent Rebecca, refuses to let the mystery rest. Firing up her car, she arrives in Eldergroove, a forsaken place where an entire town vanished without a trace.

Is she alone?

games.name: Worm in Village
games.summary: New part of worm adventures and walking simulation and survival game as player worm and mission to find stars in village and forest themed land

games.name: 67 Simulator
games.summary: 67 Simulator is a chaotic handtracking party game. No controllers needed. Use your webcam to play, compete with friends and strangers, unlock cosmetics and survive ever changing modes.

games.name: An Ecospace of Epochs
games.summary: You're a paleontologist in a far future from a different planet in an interconnected universe, you've got a new home that's yours in the sparsely populated part of the planet and you help with studying the past life and world spanning nearly a billion years ago

games.name: Don't Stop Mike
games.summary: Fight through 34 deadly rooms, each guarded by four enemies. Defeat them all to break through the barriers and advance. Dodge deadly spike traps, survive the intense combat, and clear all 34 rooms to conquer the ultimate challenge.

games.name: Fishing King: Legend of Black Lake
Grapplehook Midpoint Teleport Killer
games.summary: In this platformer game, Sylvie has a fluffy tail and can teleport to the midpoint of her Grapplehook. What could possibly go wrong? And does this world truly have a kitten?

games.name: My Dearest Direst Disaster
games.summary: A new verison of Sasasagu that adds 5 new post-game scenarios and new CGs, as well as revisions to all already existing CGs and character portraits.

games.name: Phantom 9
games.summary: Phantom 9 is a fast-paced, free-to-play multiplayer arena shooter powered by Unreal Engine 5. Players engage in Tactical, lightning-fast combat across diverse, dynamic maps featuring destructible environments and strategic chokepoints. Featuring zero-lag responsiveness and tick-perfect hit registration, the game offers extensive tactical loadout customization with dozens of weapons and attachments. Players can compete across 7 distinct game modes and 12 unique maps, climbing the global leaderboards through skill-based ranked matchmaking.

games.name: Poetic Trio
games.summary: A game about rain, a game about snow, and a game about wind. All in one.

games.name: Restcue
games.summary: You wake up in your familiar home, only to find yourself completely locked inside. Search for clues, evade an unknown presence, and piece together forgotten memories... In this confined space, the real terror is only just beginning. A intense 30-minute psychological horror experience.

games.name: Shalter 03
games.summary: Shalter 03 is an asymmetric first-person co-op puzzle-adventure game where three players take control of characters deprived of sight, hearing, and speech. Stranded in a hazardous facility, players must collaborate tightly to overcome their unique physical limitations, communicate through environmental cues, and balance real-time buffs and debuffs to solve complex puzzles before the clock runs out.

games.name: Stella
games.summary: A deckbuilder roguelike where you journey through space. Use star, planet, and moon cards to raise your score and harness the power of elements to reach even further. Discover synergies and combos to reach scores that are out of this world.

games.name: Sync Together
games.summary: SYNC TOGETHER is a parkour game focused on keeping a jet-powered flying vehicle balanced by working together. Use coordination, speed, and teamwork to finish the course as fast as possible.

games.name: TruWorlds
games.summary: TruWorlds is an interactive platform that let’s users sign up, and create their own worlds to share with other players. We have our own custom scripting language, our own custom game engine, and a full custom creator that lets you create your game.

games.name: Until Death Do We Part
games.summary: Wake up, ruin your anniversary, kill your husband. Lather, rinse, repeat.

games.name: Vacation Wonders: Hidden Quest - Collector's Edition
Hot Wheels Infinite Rush
games.summary: Jump into a Hot Wheels-sized world with four islands packed with events, challenges and full-throttle mayhem. Collect iconic vehicles, assemble your Rush Squad, build epic tracks, and earn the title of Rush Master.

games.name: The Well Is Not Empty
games.summary: The well has gone dry. It's up to you to find out why. Traverse through abandoned tunnels. Discover remnants of a ritual never meant to be seen. Power dying machinery to bring light into darkness. Dig into broken earth and crawl your way out. Down here you’re not exploring... you're trespassing.

games.name: Curse of Pirates
games.summary: Ahoy, matey! How about slicing up some sea beasts and sending a couple of rivals to feed the kraken? Curse of Pirates be a true action roguelike, inspired by Vampire Survivors and Hades! Set sail upon the high seas, gather ye brave crew, and stand firm against the relentless tides of foes!

games.name: Jenny LeClue: Detectivu
games.summary:
Jenny LeClue is a story focused exploration adventure game with memorable characters, a unique aesthetic, and an epic tangled mystery.

Jenny is a brilliant young detective, but nothing exciting happens in her small town of Arthurton, and she longs for real adventure. She gets more than she bargains for, when her mother is accused of murder. Jenny takes on the case of a lifetime and begins an unexpected, dangerous journey to uncover the truth. It’s also a coming-of-age meta-narrative about the blurred lines between right and wrong.

games.name: Nothing Strange Here
games.summary:
Nothing Strange Here is a single-player open-world adventure game with mystery and slice-of-life elements. Set in the small town of Larcenest Gap, players take on the role of a reporter exploring the community, documenting strange events, and interacting with townsfolk.

The game combines narrative discovery with photography and journaling mechanics. Players can photograph scenes, collect evidence, and publish their findings in a customizable in-game journal. NPCs follow daily routines, and the world changes based on the player's actions and the time of day. Additional features include hidden

games.name: Tiny Eden
games.summary: Tiny Eden is a peaceful first-person farming sim in the heart of a futuristic city. Turn your small apartment into a thriving smart garden. Grow plants, cook meals, sell your harvest, and expand your urban farm - from a single windowsill all the way to a rooftop paradise.

games.name: Hawked
games.summary: Hawked is a free-to-play online Extraction Shooter available on Windows PC, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S. Join the ultimate treasure hunt as you adventure and battle through a mysterious world in pursuit of ancient treasures.

games.name: Leap Tactics
games.summary: "Leap Tactics" is a pixel-art platform puzzle game where players alter mechanism states through jumping actions. Overcome obstacles and chart paths to the goal. Featuring 10+ jump-activated mechanisms, 100+ levels, a gentle difficulty curve, and an undo function.

games.name: The Ash Remembers
games.summary:
The Ash Remembers is a dark fantasy idle RPG set in Veyr, a world where ash has been falling for as long as the chronicles reach — and where the ash does not forget. The player arrives at the city of Emberwake as a nameless wanderer and builds a life there: fighting, gathering, cooking and forging.

Progress continues while the game is closed. Combat, gathering and crafting run offline, so a returning player finds work already done instead of a backlog to catch up on.

Sixteen professions feed into one another. Mining and smelting supply the forge, farming and fishing supply the kitchen, and c

games.name: Tower Lab
games.summary: Roguelite tower defense where enemies can’t be killed, knock them off with physics instead! Build devastating contraptions that push, pull, and launch enemies. Unlock towers, discover broken synergies, and dominate through creative combinations.

games.name: Veterum
games.summary: Turn-based tactical strategy with a detailed combat system and interactive environment. Explore the open world, complete quests, search for rare artifacts. Lead the last army of the Order of the Gatekeepers and stop the coming chaos!

games.name: Alchemy Factory
games.summary: "Alchemy Factory" is a first-person factory building & shop simulation game. You'll process raw materials, research new recipes, and build fully automated production lines to craft and sell a wide range of alchemical products.

games.name: Aquarium Anomaly
games.summary: Aquarium Anomaly is a short first-person observational game inspired by Exit 8 and Platform 8, set in an endless aquarium shark tunnel. Watch for anomalies, and trust what you think is normal.

games.name: Arcaneering: Beyond Automation
games.summary: Build spell-powered factories, reclaim ancient territories filled with magical secrets, and discover game-changing technology hidden across procedurally generated worlds. Master both engineering and magic in this cozy fusion of factory automation and RPG progression.

games.name: Bones and Coins
games.summary: An incremental auto battler dungeon crawler where you build a synergized hero party to slay enemies and loot items. Unlock weapons with unique attack styles. Gear up your hero team and explore new dungeon rooms filled with enemies and legendary drops.

games.name: Crazy Pocket
games.summary: Crazy Pocket is a roguelike deckbuilder inspired by classic pocket billiards! Chain diverse ball abilities together to build game-breaking synergies, and execute the ultimate shot to clear the table in a single turn!

games.name: Dataminers
games.summary: Dataminers is a fast turn-based roguelike where you climb and clear highly secured towers full of data. Outsmart guards and hack terminals in this unique combination of strategy, stealth and Minesweeper.

games.name: Deadzoned
games.summary: Deadzoned is a sci-fi turn-based action Roguelike. Blast your way through zones battling the beasts, bandits, and monsters that stalk the blackouts. But you'll need your wits to make best use of the gear you stumble upon to survive and save the fate of the planet!

games.name: Dealer's Dice
games.summary: Dealer's Dice is a high-stakes dice defense game engineered for true gamblers. Collect powerful dice, manage your betting table, and test your luck against an endless onslaught. Will you play it safe, or push your luck for the ultimate jackpot? Remember, you only have one life.

games.name: Dirty Laundry
games.summary: Unable to hold down a job, Emily tries her luck on the night shift at a local laundromat. However, what starts as an ordinary job quickly turns into a nightmare as bizarre customers arrive, and the dark secrets of one particularly suspicious nightly visitor change her life forever.

games.name: Discremental
games.summary: Discremental is a short idle and incremental game where you primarily upgrade your disk, along with other equipment.

games.name: Eco Volunteer
games.summary: A peaceful, cozy game about cleaning up trash and other eco-friendly activities in nature. Embark on a journey through stunning natural landscapes while doing good deeds!

games.name: Exit Ways
games.summary: Test your luck in the extraction shooter with survival elements. Build your camp, exterminate the contaminated and evacuate the civilians.

games.name: Little Ghosties
games.summary: Little Ghosties is a cozy idle desktop companion game where adorable ghosts live inside a glass terrarium on your desktop. Hatch, raise, and collect unique ghosts as they grow from eggs into fully grown adult ghosts.

games.name: Locktale
games.summary: Discover a tale about identity and love in this game of ciphers and puzzles... that may force you to think outside the (text)box.

games.name: Mournight
games.summary: Mournight is a horror game where 1-4 players collaborate to survive and solve the mystery. Explore locked rooms, collect cursed objects, and stay alert against a terrifying creature that hunts you in the dark.

games.name: Mythmon: Mythic Monsters
games.summary:
Mythmon is a hack-and-slash strategy game where you build the ultimate monster party to take down the Demon King's army.

As the commander, you'll combine Mythmon, equipment, and formations before heading into battle. Combat unfolds automatically, so careful preparation is the key to victory.

Recruit from a roster of 30 unique Mythmon, equip them with over 140 pieces of gear, and experiment with countless team combinations to forge the ultimate party and save the world from the Demon King's invasion!

games.name: Necrowhisper
games.summary: A tense investigative horror experience for solo or up to 4-player co-op, where you search for clues in the dark to uncover the truth behind a spirit’s death before something else finds you first.

games.name: Night Maniac: The Origin Of Steven
games.summary: A narrative horror set in Red Valley, 1948. Amidst the slaughterhouse, the rain, and the silence of a rotting town, follow Steven Watson in a dark story about isolation, control, and the origin of a legend.

games.name: No Sheep Left Behind
games.summary: No Sheep Left Behind, is a simple and casual game where you embody a valiant sheepdog on a procedural journey to gather and protect a growing flock of sheep. Enjoy the chill atmosphere and all the sheep bleats while you try to beat your top score.

games.name: Operation: Black Genesis - The Immortal Trials
games.summary: top-down co-op survival horror game where players deploy into deadly Quarantined Zones, fight mutated experiments, and extract with everything you can carry—because if you die, you lose it all.

games.name: Pierline
games.summary: Pierline is a short first-person psychological horror game about an ordinary night that takes an unexpected turn. You play as Daniel Hayes, a Florida traffic officer who decides to spend the night fishing at an old pier along the coast, after a friend recommends the place.

games.name: Port of Jumanah
games.summary: From a humble port, you set out to clean the ocean of troublemakers. Hack and harpoon through absurd foes, shady allies, and your own bad calls. The world wants a hero… your friends want you to punch an orca. Both valid. Choose wisely—or don’t. The sea remembers everything.

games.name: Pumpkin Woods
games.summary: Collect magical ingredients and build your cozy witch home while exploring the wonderful sights and secrets of these mysterious lands. Beware though, danger might be lurking deep in these woods...

games.name: Qumino
games.summary: Qumino is a cozy roguelike domino game. Lay back, grab your controller, and enjoy playing. There are different heroes with unique abilities that make every deck playthrough different. Build your deck with different domino tiles and think about what you need for the run.

games.name: She Never Left
games.summary: Return to an abandoned family home where old memories refuse to stay buried. Explore its dark rooms, uncover a forgotten tragedy, solve environmental puzzles, and survive the presence that has been waiting for you in this short first-person psychological horror.

games.name: Shelf Happens
games.summary: You (alone or with friends) need to place scattered vinyl records on the right genre crates in a retro record store. Complete crates and earn XP to unlock abilities that improve your efficiency. Use your skills and strategies to sort hundreds of records by genre fast!

games.name: Sir Galgano: A Medieval Tale
games.summary: Sir Galgano is a side-scrolling medieval beat ‘em up game with RPG elements

games.name: SmashCore
games.summary: SmashCore is a short, physics based incremental game about smashing asteroids into dust with your gravity cursor and feeding it to the Core. Discover ancient technology and new ores in deep space and use your cash to buy upgrades in the huge skill tree.

games.name: Soft(A)ware
games.summary: Soft(A)ware is a surreal puzzle-platformer set inside a vast, hostile system. You awaken in a virtual world that functions as a prison — a place designed to limit, to control, to erase any trace of freedom.

games.name: Soul Chained
games.summary: A co-op souls-lite adventure awaits in Soul Chained. Face brutal enemies, overcome complex platforming challenges, and learn to work together within the constraints of the Soul Chain. You will be chained to your co-op partner so remember to communicate!

games.name: Spellbound & Shelved
games.summary: A wizard-academy library has vanished under its own books. Hire gnomes, unlock shelves, and let the tidying run itself — a cozy idle game about turning magical chaos into calm, one neatly filed spellbook at a time.

games.name: The Ayna
games.summary: The Ayna is a psychological exploration game set in Türkiye, inspired by the music video aesthetics and lyrical themes of a female vocalist. The player is tasked with noticing anomalies in the concert venue and uncovering the truth.

games.name: Toilet 101
games.summary: A liminal space anomaly detection simulator.

games.name: TwwwT: The Witches Who Weave Timelines
games.summary: A 2D action-focused roguelite where you control “witches from history,” battling endless enemies and dense bullet-hell barrages to correct fractured timelines

games.name: Who Haunts the Haunters?
games.summary: "Who’s real when the air starts to rot? Who Haunts The Haunters? is an Eastern horror social deduction game. Don't just watch for movement; listen for the whispers and watch the candles flicker. Purify the manor before the intruders’ greed consumes every last spirit."

games.name: Wobble Ops!
games.summary: Wobble Ops! is a fun, physics-based co-op platformer. Complete the course as fast as possible and lead your team and country to the top of the leaderboard.

games.name: Halloween: The Game
games.summary: On Halloween night, 1978, no one is safe from Michael Myers. Become the Boogeyman or fight back against the face of evil itself in Halloween.

games.name: Mewgenics
games.summary:
From the creator of The Binding of Isaac, Super Meat Boy and The End is Nigh comes... Mewgenics! A game where you hoard, breed, train and set cats out on epic adventures through a sprawling world of complete chaos.
Level up your team as you venture further and further from your home, collect unique items, defeat epic bosses, gain mutations, and return home so you can breed and further your bloodline in this turn based legacy roguelike draft sim about cats!

games.name: Wanderburg
games.summary: Drive your Castle on Wheels into battle in this minimalist medieval roguelike of roaming fortresses! Devour entire villages, build your modular arsenal of siege weapons and arcane machinery as you grow with every stronghold you crush.

games.name: Sprawl Zero
games.summary: Sprawl Zero is a fast-paced shooter inspired by the Golden Age of 2000s FPS. Survive a brutal cyberpunk city collapsing under military rule and cult fanaticism. Use your Gravity-Gloves, augments, and an arsenal of over 40 weapons to crush those who stand in your way.

games.name: Bus Simulator 27
games.summary: Get ready for Bus Simulator 27, the most advanced entry in the history of the franchise. Look forward to our most comprehensive bus fleet yet, with new officially licensed brands and bus models, as well as iconic buses from the series.

games.name: Honeycomb: The World Beyond
games.summary: Honeycomb: The World Beyond is a sci-fi survival adventure set on the vibrant alien planet of Sota7. Adapt by building your base and crafting essential tools. Explore diverse biomes and use your bioengineering experience to uncover mysteries and secure humanity's future.

games.name: Between Adventures Idle
games.summary: An Idle RPG Strategy game where you gather resources in a magical world, battle powerful creatures, and upgrade your gear. Explore new locations through main and side quests; your progress continues even in the background. A simple and enjoyable idle experience awaits you.

games.name: Cat Me If You Can
games.summary: Cat Me If You Can is a charming and cozy game where you explore beautifully handcrafted black-and-white worlds, searching for hidden cats to photograph and bring their colours back into the world.

games.name: Chop Chop Together
games.summary: A chaotic 1–4 player co-op party game where housemates take on ridiculous jobs, earn cash, and put their friendships to the test during the wildest workdays imaginable. Work together under pressure, face unpredictable hazards, and survive fast-paced chaos where teamwork is the only way out.

games.name: Orc Incremental
games.summary: Start with a single orc and build an unstoppable dark army to conquer the realms in this incremental auto battler. Perfect your formation, summon mighty beasts, unlock powerful upgrades, and grow stronger with each rebirth.

games.name: Tangent
games.summary: TANGENT is a physics-driven climbing game where you’re a small marble grappling and swinging through a vertical world. Build speed, recover from bad falls, unlock new movement abilities, and reach the top faster as you master the movement.

games.name: Thousand Hells: The Underworld Heists
games.summary: Four heroes descend into hell in a tactical narrative game blending mythology and surrealism. Recruit your team, choose your path, and overcome the trials of the underworlds. A new systemic storybook experience from the designers of King of Dragon Pass and Six Ages.

games.name: Trudge
games.summary: A slow, minimalist psychological pixel experience about living the same empty routine in a silent city. Wake up. Work. Eat. Sleep. Beneath the depressing monotony and liminal surroundings, something slowly begins to break.

games.name: Acceptable Losses
games.summary: Acceptable Losses is a phase-based WWI management game. Assign squads to missions, face random events, and manage the endless paperwork of war. Navigate morale, fatigue, and cohesion across a brutal 20-day trench campaign.

games.name: Aerial_Knight's MrFreezy
games.summary: Play as a woman who's an axe-wielding serial killer in this light-hearted puzzle game about decapitating men, uncover the disturbing story behind New Detroit’s infamous serial killer, Mr. Freezy.

games.name: Aerovice Frutiger World
games.summary: A relaxing exploration adventure inspired by Frutiger Aero. Wander through dreamcore worlds, backrooms, poolrooms, and liminal spaces, uncover secrets, collect treasures, and experience a nostalgic journey in vibrant 3D.

games.name: Arcade Galaxy
games.summary: A fast-paced party platformer where you race, jump, and outplay rivals as customizable animal Cubs. Create and share your own levels with an intuitive editor, or tackle hundreds of player-made maps filled with traps, boosts, and surprises.

games.name: Bangkok: City of Legends
games.summary: Bangkok City of Legends is a choice-driven narrative RPG set in the vibrant streets and nightlife of Bangkok. Explore the city, meet memorable characters, complete quests, and make decisions that shape your relationships, reputation, story, and ending.

games.name: Card Revolution Soccer
games.summary: Card Revolution Soccer is a football card game that simulates on-field action through simple card reveals via clicking on them. Level up entire nations or yourself as a Head-coach and play World Tour- or Cup-Modes. Fine-tune the gameplay to your liking with customizable sliders.

games.name: Cyberpunk Store Simulator
games.summary: Cyberpunk Store Simulator puts you in charge of a neon lit shop in a dystopian city. Manage stock, serve customers, sell cybernetic implants, and explore the streets. Build, customize, and grow your store into a futuristic empire.

games.name: Desk Top Racer
games.summary: Turn your desktop into a living racetrack with this idle racing management game. Acquire cars, equip parts, and compete online against other players. Win championships and expand your garage through Mastery, Collections, and new rewards.

games.name: Dice Tavern: Farkle Roguelike
games.summary: Dice Tavern is a medieval Farkle dice roguelike. Roll, lock, and bank through six taverns, from village tables to the King's throne. Collect unique dice, equip badges and coatings to craft your build. Every run is new, every roll a gamble with fate.

games.name: Dicewayfarer
games.summary: A dice-building roguelike where you shape a 25-dice board to unleash powerful chained attacks.

games.name: Factory Default: Build, Trade, Repeat
games.summary: Build a global industrial empire on a 3D planet earth. Mine resources, manufacture complex goods, trade across continents, and shape your companys reputation through powerful policies. Control every step of the supply chain and turn industry into influence.

games.name: Far Primal Survival
games.summary: Can you become the ultimate hunter in a world ruled by nature?

games.name: Fill the Void
games.summary: Start Small. Consume. Get huge. 'Fill The Void' is a physics-driven incremental 3D platforming collectathon where you play as a black hole.

games.name: Flood With Friends
games.summary: Nail a raft (or a plane) out of junk, load it with everything valuable or ridiculous and sail for the next island before the water swallows you up. Co-op physics chaos for 1-8 friends.

games.name: Galactic Speed Legends
games.summary: Buy a craft or build a new one from the scratch, bet it, repair it, upgrade it, push it to the limit and take high-speed turns like never before. Prepare yourself to challenge elite drivers in the galaxy through a series of championships, and personal head to head races.

games.name: Goi Coins
games.summary: Roll coins engraved with Japanese kana and build words from what lands face-up — a calm tabletop word game set in a quiet Japanese room. A play of luck, vocabulary, and knowing when to stop. Solo high-score, local 2-player, and online versus.

games.name: Hidden Saga: Xamadeon Stone
games.summary: Are you good at finding things and like the interactive various levels? You are at the right address! You need to dig for artifacts, look inside a lion's mouth, beep-boop the cars and much more of them in Hidden Saga!

games.name: Horse Magic
games.summary: Horse Magic is a choice-driven visual novel about Kaiah and her roommate Iris, whose bond is tested by a surreal event. Navigate love, identity, and forbidden desire through branching choices, emotional drama, and futa-themed intimacy.

games.name: Kid Kirby Recreated
games.summary: A recreation of a cancelled Kirby game that Nintendo contracted DMA design to make in the mid-90's, using information and assets shared publically by some of the old developers.

games.name: Kitty Kitty Bounce Bounce
games.summary: Good old-fashioned arcade game in which you bop around a kitty using various cushions. Your goal is to break all breakable block without falling onto the floor. Difficulty levels, in-game shop where you can buy pick-me-ups with points you get for destruction, cute art and soundtrack, and much more!

games.name: KnitBone
games.summary: KnitBone is a story-driven psychological horror visual novel, where the therapist is more traumatized than the patient.

games.name: Mandato
games.summary: A short, first-person horror narrative set in the Philippines. While your journalist wife investigates town hall, you start uncovering brutal secrets tying your beloved mayor to local crime. In a place where the powerful control the law, knowing the truth is fatal.

games.name: Nuktedan: The Forgotten Emotions
games.summary: Rediscover the 7 emotions lost by a bird with Alzheimer's. Every memory is a color, every color is a power.

games.name: Ova Magica
games.summary: Experience a colorful farm game inspired by the classics! Train cute blob creatures, take care of your farm and make friends with the people of Clover Town.

games.name: Permaban
games.summary: It's 2007. You're a forum mod with dial-up, a rulebook that contradicts itself, and a community spiraling into chaos. Ban trolls, cite rules, survive burnout. Papers Please meets early internet culture.

games.name: Pinballers
games.summary: An incremental pinball roguelike to satisfy the flipping nostalgia of the 80s

games.name: Pit of Fears
games.summary: Pit of Fears is an atmospheric horror, mystery, 2D platform, puzzle, action and adventure game, face all the challenges and dangers of the Pit of Fears, survive the bizarre creatures and solve the mysteries of this distorted alternative dimension to the real world.

games.name: Pragma Twice
games.summary: You've awoken deep within a research facility in a new, programmable robot body. You have holes in your memories. At least you no longer have that hole in your head...

games.name: Razing Core
games.summary:
Razing Core is a vertically scrolling shoot 'em up for the SEGA Master System and Mark III console.

On a routine deep-space mission the Horizon encounters an unknown object, the Core. Without warning it pulls the Horizon into its slipstream at light speed and heads for Earth.

You are about to drop out of hyperspace into a war zone.

With the Horizon's firepower and the Core's unexpected aid at your disposal, you must destroy the invading alien armada to save humanity.

games.name: Seven Blasphemies
games.summary: Seven Blasphemies is a traditional turn-based roguelike where every dawn may curse your run forever. Explore a dying world, choose from doomed classes, survive lethal OSR-inspired encounters, and race against extinction before the seventh blasphemy ends all.

games.name: Suicide Mr. Fury
games.summary: Suicide Mr. Fury is a Meta-Otome adventure that deconstructs the absurdity of falling for someone who doesn’t exist. Navigate branching paths, meta-narratives, and a multiverse of madness with the overbearing CEO, Mr. Fury, between digital delusion and harsh reality.

games.name: Syntax: Overload
games.summary: Compile. Execute. Overload. A strategic roguelite where Syntax is Everything. Drag & drop modules to optimize your execution queue, install .EXE software to break the rules, and face off against legendary viruses like ILOVEYOU and WannaCry. Can you crash the system and escape?

games.name: Three's a Crowd
games.summary: A rogue-lite physics based match three!

games.name: Tiny Bakery
games.summary: Run a tiny bakery for sweet-toothed slime customers! Adapt to changing weather, seasons, and festivals as cravings shift. Unlock new recipes, welcome new guests, and prepare each night for the day ahead.

games.name: Undying Flame
games.summary: Survive a minimalist wave-survival rogue-lite. Keep the fire alive. Read its flame. Defend your fire against creatures that crawl from the dark across endless waves. Every wave survived, the fire grows. Over time, it consumes everything.

games.name: Voldark
games.summary: Voldark is an open-world survival crafting game set in a dangerous forest filled with mutant creatures. Gather resources, craft tools and weapons, level up your character, build and defend your base while surviving relentless nighttime attacks.

games.name: Wishing Well Simulator
games.summary: You are a wishing well in a small seaside town. Eight people return for eight days, tossing coins and whispering what they want most. Your power is limited: every wish you grant makes another impossible. The town remembers everything.

games.name: Wiz-herd
games.summary: Wiz-Herd is a local and online party game where 2-4 players compete in fast-paced minigames. Herd sheep, cast spells, and sabotage your friends to claim victory!

games.name: Zero Players Online
games.summary:
Zero Players Online is an interpretation of RuneScape (and Old School RuneScape) as a sort of fancy text-adventure, framed as a long abandoned MUD that nobody has played in a long time.

In the decades since any players joined things have started getting a little strange around Gielinor. NPCs aren't quite acting they way they should, and some areas have changed or become unkempt due to a lack of maintenance.

games.name: Cosmic Fear
games.summary: Since the dawn of mankind, mysterious phenomena beyond human comprehension have occurred. Your studies suggest that everything is part of one big picture. What lies hidden in the depths of the cosmos? Explore, solve puzzles and survive in this disturbing Lovecraftian horror adventure.

games.name: Earth Must Die
games.summary: These moronic Terranoids think they can just roll in here and take over my beautiful Tyrythian kingdom? The kingdom that I built from the ground up with my bare hands, and only sort of inherited from my dear, sweet, extremely dead father? This is complete bullsh*t, and I'm going to make them dead.

games.name: Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster
games.summary: A classic hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania action game, it's time for revenge! Use your Beastmaster skills to unleash your inner beast, fight with your heart-devouring sword and end the threat to Arborea, you decide the ending.

games.name: Crisis Core: Final Fantasy VII - Reunion
games.summary: Crisis Core: Final Fantasy VII - Reunion is an HD remaster of the smash hit prequel to Final Fantasy VII. In addition to all graphics being remastered in HD, fully voiced dialogue and new soundtrack arrangements make for a dynamic new retelling of a beloved classic.

games.name: Asgard's Fall: Viking Survivors
games.summary: Embark on an epic saga in Asgard's Fall, a norse Arena-Shooter-Roguelite. Fight your way through hordes of creatures and let the gods feel your relentless wrath. How will your saga unfold?

games.name: Golden Swirl
games.summary: GOLDEN SWIRL is a Roguelike Deck Builder blending fast-paced action with strategic card play in a dark fantasy world. Journey through shifting dungeons, uncover swirl secrets, and adapt to challenges with unique cards, relics, and a depravity system.

games.name: Sunset Summit
games.summary: A co-op group climbing game for 1-8 friends! Head out on a chill but challenging climb with regular checkpoints. Use axes, ropes, pogo sticks, item delivery drones and more to reach the summit. Just remember to watch your step!

games.name: Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic - The Embodiment of Scarlet Devil
games.summary: Dodge the barrage, defeat enemies, and brave the Scarlet Mist incident. The Embodiment of Scarlet Devil returns with fresh music and graphics.You control the shrine maiden Reimu and the magician Marisa, dodge barrages and shoot at enemies. The background music features complete rearrangements by ZUN.

games.name: Trash Goblin
games.summary: A cosy and moreish fantasy shop sim where you uncover, clean, upcycle and sell a vast variety of trinkets - both invaluable and unlovable - to a diverse cast of fascinating customers across a colourful fantasy city. Think Potionomics meets PowerWash Simulator, with a unique protagonist!

games.name: Backseat
games.summary: Backseat is a horror game where you play as a taxi driver forced to transport sinister passengers and survive the ride. An unknown man has kidnapped your wife and demands you gather information on each passenger. Can you survive the night and uncover the mystery behind your wife's kidnapping?

games.name: Code: Terraform
games.summary: A deep programming game on a frozen alien planet. Write real code to drive rovers, run power grids, fabricate parts, and fly drone fleets across the world. Your scripts run while you plan your next move. The more you terraform, the more the planet responds.

games.name: Cordels & Spells
games.summary: Cordels & Spells is a thrilling cooperative twin-stick shooter action adventure based in the culture of cordel literature. Explore procedurally generated maps, battle gangs of bandits, and recover the Enchanted Cordels, magical artifacts that hold the history and essence of Northeast Brazil.

games.name: Crosstalk
games.summary: Crosstalk is a hardware architecture design sandbox with a built-in simulator and emulator. Players build designs ranging from LED controllers to complex computers using SystemVerilog. It has a gate-level simulator, a terminal emulator, an oscilloscope, introspection tools, a compiler, and more.

games.name: In Falsus
games.summary: In a world bound by truths: connect. In Falsus is a mesmerizing rhythm game tied to an intricate card system brought together through a layered narrative. Taking place in a near-future world, traverse an atmospheric soundscape through the eyes of 5 interconnected protagonists.

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Karnov
games.summary: "Karnov" is an action game released by Data East in 1987. Defeat the Emperor of Darkness and reclaim the stolen treasures.

games.name: Aretias: Cursed Island
games.summary: Travel to an isolated island, use your camera to reveal what the naked eye cannot see, and uncover the truth behind a forgotten curse. Aretias: Cursed Island is a story-driven first-person horror game focused on exploration, environmental puzzles, and atmospheric tension.

games.name: BaseRogue
games.summary: BaseRogue is a turn-based baseball roguelike deckbuilder and dice battler. Draft historical baseball legends from over 150 years of baseball history, spanning from 1871 to 2025 across all classic eras. Build tactical era and franchise synergies to activate combat bonuses and shields, roll dice with dynamically calculated outcome thresholds against rival pitching rotations, and collect cards with retro foil packs and career stats across multiple game modes.

games.name: BeaterCore
games.summary: beaterCore is an arcade racing game for those who prefer cheap rusty beaters over specialized sports cars. Buy, repair, restore, and race your dream project car

games.name: Bookstore Incremental
games.summary: A cozy incremental game where you run your own bookstore! Buy hundreds of upgrades, unlock new customers and book types, hire different staff members and build the most profitable bookstore in the world!

games.name: Catal Carta
games.summary: A mystery visual novel set in a fading secondhand bookshop. Five childhood friends confront small-town scandals armed only with what they've read — drawing on the themes of unrelated books to unsettle the things people won't admit. 15 cases, 5–10 minutes each.

games.name: Detective VR
games.summary: Step into a thrilling narrative investigation in Virtual Reality! In DETECTIVE VR, you control time, collect crucial clues, and interview witnesses to unravel the plot.

games.name: Dragon Quest Heroes: Torneko's Mystery Dungeon Classic HD
games.summary:
A thousand adventures in one! — Discover the roots of the Mystery Dungeon series. Originally released only in Japan, the first entry in the Mystery Dungeon series and prequel to Torneko: The Last Hope is finally making its international debut!

Set after the events of DRAGON QUEST IV, this is the story of Torneko, a man who dreams of becoming the world's greatest weapons merchant. One day, he hears rumors of a mysterious dungeon said to contain incredible treasures. In search of a legendary treasure that no one has ever managed to bring back, Torneko sets out for the Mystery Dungeon.

games.name: Elemental Witches
games.summary: In Elemental Witches world, you command Fire, Wind, and Thunder to craft unique spells from three elemental orbs. Merge identical elements to summon powerful pets. After each battle, upgrade elements, unlock items, and shape your own playstyle as you face new adventures.

games.name: Folklands
games.summary: Folklands is a grid-based, relaxing settlement builder with simulated citizens. Grow your settlement from humble beginnings to a bustling town. Harvest resources, manage food supply and make sure your folks are happy, employed and safe.

games.name: Increvaders
games.summary: A short and chill incremental shooter where you destroy waves of thousands of aliens. Unlock upgrades and collect power-ups to become absurdly overpowered. No game overs, play at your own pace.

games.name: Iron Wasteland
games.summary: After the bombs fell, civilization collapsed into chaos. Scavenge the ruins of a shattered world, gather vital resources, and fight off hostile enemies determined to claim what little remains.

games.name: Just Coffee with the Café Guy
games.summary: A short narrative game where you talk with a café owner at a café that serves nothing but coffee.

games.name: Meccha Chameleon
games.summary: Paint yourself to blend in! "Meccha Chameleon" is a new-sensation hide-and-seek game where you paint your white body to mimic the stage. Spot, pose, and "artistic skill" are keys to survival. Deceive Seekers with techniques that put chameleons to shame! Supports public matches and streaming.

games.name: Model Kit Shop Simulator
games.summary: Build and run your own hobby shop in this first-person store management sim. Order stock, fill shelves, set prices, match kits with paints through the Hobby Basket System, and let customers bring their projects to life at Build Tables.

games.name: Moon Shop Simulator
games.summary:
Moon Shop Simulator is a first-person management game where you run a small shop beneath the lunar surface.

From your terminal, order goods from Earth, manage cargo taxes, receive deliveries, organize your stock in numbered racks, and prepare customer orders.

Each product has its own weight, volume, and size. Your purchasing, storage, and shipping decisions directly affect your shop’s profitability.

games.name: Olga: Episode 1
games.summary: Relive Olga's childhood memories as she visits her grandparents' home in Belovodica, a secluded mountain village where some discoveries last a lifetime.

games.name: One-inch Tactics
games.summary: Turn the tide of the war with nuanced strategies in One-inch Tactics.

games.name: Pegture
games.summary: Pegture is a peg solitaire-themed roguelike, deck-building game. Build your deck, enhance your pegs, perform frenetic combos, beat bosses, reach the highest score and get the best peg solitaire experience.

games.name: Pizza of the Gods
games.summary: A humorous 2D hand-drawn platformer where you’re on a quest to deliver a pizza to Zeus and pursue your dream of marrying your boss’s daughter. Fight funny enemies, switch between two characters to solve puzzles, and explore a world drawn entirely on paper.

games.name: Planet Killer
games.summary: A physics-driven sci-fi destruction roguelite. Orbit hostile worlds, unleash devastating weapons, and carve real craters into fully simulated planets while escalating planetary defenses fight back.

games.name: Planet Nine
games.summary: Planet Nine is a planet-merging puzzle game with billiards-inspired mechanics. Players aim shots to merge matching planets into larger ones and work toward creating Planet Nine. The game features short play sessions, online score leaderboards, and unlockable background themes and music.

games.name: Reverse T-gotchi
games.summary: What if the roles were reversed? In this first-person horror game, you are a Tamagotchi and your owner sets the rules. Satisfy their whims or your own needs will go unmet.

games.name: Roomrush Racer
games.summary: Race through 20 chaotic rooms with 27 characters in a fast-paced arcade racer. Play solo or with up to 4 players in local split-screen, collect items, master speed classes, and win cups together.

games.name: Silent Hill f x Urban Myth Dissolution Center
games.summary:
Konami's psychological horror game Silent Hill f joins forces with Urban Myth Dissolution Center, a mystery adventure that unravels paranormal phenomena!
This collaboration features a special mini-game created by Hakababunko, starring Hinako and Azami.
Hinako finds herself lost in a strange building amid an eerie fog, where she encounters a figure as she pursues the mystery behind the strange phenomena surrounding her.

games.name: Slay the Horde
games.summary: Slay the Horde is a roguelike deckbuilder about building a screen-clearing engine of destruction. Build a deck of spells, stack upgrades, abuse elemental effects, and annihilate increasingly unreasonable numbers of goblins.

games.name: Squingle Arcade
games.summary: Experience Squingle’s trippy VR/MR evolution in its FREE-TO-PLAY sequel, Squingle Arcade. Guide twin orbs through 100+ morphing 3D mazes in your room. Master hand-tracked “Squingles,” chase high scores, and climb global leaderboards in a psychedelic arcade puzzle journey.

games.name: Stall Quest
games.summary: A shopkeeping simulation RPG for those who loved leaving shops open in old-school MMOs! Open a stall in Rei's dream, sell items gathered from dungeons, buy gear, and dive back in.

games.name: The Forlorn
games.summary: Fight for your life through five nights (technically six) in this hand-drawn 2D game of resource-management and survival. Keep the fire lit, sharpen your sword, and fend off progressively angrier creatures in the Cursed Forest. Comes with a 4/20 mode, cryptic lore, how to draw, and many secrets!

games.name: Toro 2
games.summary: The ultimate Bullfighting experience

games.name: Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic - The Embodiment of Scarlet Devil: Deluxe Edition
Touhou Koumakyou: The Embodiment of Scarlet Devil
games.summary:
Embodiment of Scarlet Devil features two playable characters to choose from, with two Spell Card types each. Reimu Hakurei can cover a wide area of the screen with weaker attacks, while Marisa Kirisame relies on her speed and power to make up for her thinner attack spread. The bombs show different behavior and damage depending on the character and type chosen.

Unlike its predecessor, Mystic Square, Embodiment of Scarlet Devil comes with an "automatic item collection" feature, which allows you to collect all items on the screen by moving to the top of the screen if you are at full power, as we

games.name: Valheim
games.summary:
Valheim is an open-world survival and exploration game set in a procedurally generated world inspired by Norse mythology. Playing alone or with up to nine other players, you explore dangerous biomes, gather resources, craft weapons and armour, build Viking settlements and longships, and battle powerful creatures and bosses in order to prove yourself worthy of Odin.

Progression is tied to exploration and defeating the Forsaken, with each biome introducing new enemies, resources, crafting possibilities and challenges. From the peaceful Meadows to the frozen Deep North, players can build, farm,

games.name: Warlord: Awaji
games.summary: An army management simulator taking place in feudal japan made by Darkmatter games

games.name: When We Arrive
games.summary: When We Arrive is a co-op travel game set in a fantasy world, where you and your friends embark on a shared journey. Play as a hunter, mage, or warrior, manage your supplies, discover hidden treasures, and make sure you all reach your destination safely.

games.name: Wardogs
games.summary:
Wardogs is a first-person tactical multiplayer shooter built around large-scale combined-arms battles for up to 100 players. Three teams compete to control randomized objective zones across destructible battlefields, using infantry weapons, vehicles, logistics, fortifications, and proximity voice chat.

Players earn cash and XP through combat, support, transportation, and objective play, then spend persistent cash on custom loadouts, equipment, and vehicles across lives and matches.

games.name: Hot Wheels Infinite Rush
games.summary: Jump into a Hot Wheels-sized world with four islands packed with events, challenges and full-throttle mayhem. Collect iconic vehicles, assemble your Rush Squad, build epic tracks, and earn the title of Rush Master.

games.name: BrokenLore: Don't Lie
games.summary: BrokenLore: DON'T LIE is psychological horror spin-off of DON’T WATCH, where lies, medication and fragile bonds blur the line between reality and nightmare.

games.name: Welcome to Elderfield
games.summary: Welcome to Elderfield is a spooky farming RPG. You can farm, fish, mine, cook, craft, befriend townsfolk, beseech the old gods, investigate mysteries, watch unsettling news programs, get lost in the dead mall, die in your sleep and more. There's lots to do in Elderfield!

games.name: Shroom and Gloom
games.summary: Gather and grow cards in Shroom & Gloom, a moody first-person, roguelike double-deckbuilder bursting with fungal foes and mountains of mega-combos!

games.name: Ex Sanguis
games.summary: From the creators of Othercide, Ex Sanguis delivers what the studio is known for: dynamic & epic turn-based combat in a visually striking world. Bleed the world to life; fight the agents of perfection and stillness through strategic blood baths in this evolved roguelite tactical RPG game!

games.name: The Alighieri Circle: Dante’s Bloodline
games.summary: The world knows the Divine Comedy as a poem. For your family, it is a prison. As Gabriele Alighieri, you inherit a duty: reseal the gates of Hell. Burdened by fate, you descend into a psychological nightmare where the only escape is to uncover the dark secrets of your ancestors.

games.name: Effulgence RPG
games.summary: Effulgence is a party-based RPG in a sci-fi setting. Players will explore a distant, possibly extinct world, battle its hostile inhabitants, craft gear, and develop their characters. All graphics in Effulgence are made of text symbols, making it visually unique.

games.name: Train Sim World 7
games.summary: Live life on the tracks and discover the joy of train simulation. Whether looking for a relaxing run on the rails or seeking the thrill of mastering your virtual train driver career, find your way in Train Sim World 7.

games.name: A Night at Moka Efti: A Babylon Berlin Story
games.summary: Are you ready for the session? Let yourself be hypnotized and dive into the dazzling world of Moka Efti, known from the series *Babylon Berlin*. As a journalist, you’ll follow the clues to a mysterious case at the famous nightclub. But can you trust your memories?

games.name: Dumb Ways to Build
games.summary: Dumb Ways to Build is a chaotic, physics-based co-op game. Team up with friends to assemble your crew and take-on dangerous construction jobs. With all the gear and no idea, work together to build your path forward, or die trying!

games.name: Grandpa's Bee Haven
games.summary: Grandpa's Bee Haven is a desktop-idler and a beekeeping sim that sits at the bottom of your screen letting you to do other things while managing your bee haven.

games.name: Karjala
games.summary: VHS bodycam horror in the atmosphere of Soviet Backrooms. Karelia is a country of rivers, forests and lakes, where the modern world comes in contact with superstitions and ancient rituals. Soldier Solnyshkov agrees to take part in a strange experiment of his command.

games.name: Magical Blush
games.summary: Magical Blush is a top-down action-adventure where fast-paced elemental combat meets Metroidvania-style exploration. Chain spell combos, exploit elemental weaknesses, rescue survivors, and team up in local co-op as you battle the powerful Elemental Lords and explore the wondrous world of Wyn.

games.name: Spiritus Sancti
games.summary: Spiritus Sancti is a first-person psychological horror where your voice is your weapon. Speak sacred rites through your microphone to repel, stun, and exorcise the forces of darkness. Every encounter is real-time, every word a test of faith. An experience like no other.

games.name: Big Breakfast 2
games.summary: In a world without Breakfast, one man decides to challenge fate! The debut RPG from Stahmpin' Grounds Studios, Big Breakfast 2, is an old-school turn-based RPG in the style of classic fantasy RPGs from the 8 bit era.

games.name: Garden Ink
games.summary: Paint, merge, and explore! Garden Ink is a cozy sandbox/exploration game where you shape and grow your own world. Merging decorations and coloring tools help you customize your world. With hand-painted visuals and a soothing soundtrack, it’s time to discover every cute surprise.

games.name: Gunman Contracts: Stand Alone
games.summary: "Gunman Contracts - Stand Alone" is an action-movie inspired shooter playable both in VR and in Non-VR (First Person). As a professional hitman, the player takes on ruthless forces in the criminal underworld, bringing justice and order in the world beyond the reach of law - one contract at a time.

games.name: Hazard Pay
games.summary: In this dark and mysterious block-pushing puzzler, you'll navigate through a secret, hazardous laboratory complex. Discover creative methods to destroy evidence and cover up the crimes of your employer.

games.name: Infinity: HexaDome Tactics
games.summary: Pick your champions and fight in merciless 1v1 turn-based matches. Send your fighters in the arena, position them strategically, create synergies and give the crowd a brutal show! Unlock your ultimate attacks, influence the course of the game and dominate The Hexadome!

games.name: Resonant Blade
games.summary: Resonant Blade is a 2d sci-fi action adventure set in a dystopian world where sound is your greatest weapon. Battle the Dark Synths across a shattered planet using the power of Resonant Tones. Manipulate sound to solve puzzles, unleash devastating Triad abilities, and shape your own combat rhythm with customizable mods. With pixel art and fast paced gameplay, Resonant Blade challenges you to listen, adapt, and strike in harmony.

games.name: Sunken Engine
games.summary: Sunken Engine is a Lovecraftian Ship Repair Simulator. Restore the old shipyard you inherited from your father. Every arriving ship carries a dark mystery waiting to be uncovered. While keeping your customers happy, you must also deal with the strange and eerie events happening on the island.

games.name: The Royal Writ
games.summary:
In The Royal Writ, you don't just play cards - you command them on the battlefield. Place your loyal subjects strategically as they advance toward the enemy, dealing damage. But beware: any card that reaches the enemy base before victory is permanently destroyed and removed from your deck for the rest of your run.

Sacrifice isn't just a risk - it's an essential strategy that creates memorable sub-stories with each run. Will you honor the subjects who gave everything for your cause? Every fallen card tells a tale, and their glory lives on in the legacy you build.

Lead an army of diverse warri

games.name: Wardogs: Supporter Edition
games.summary:
Wardogs: Supporter Edition includes the base game and the Supporter Pack, a collection of cosmetic items for Wardogs.

The Supporter Pack includes the Valkyra A-91 Rifle camo, Lonestar Bushmaster camo, Manticore KH-2002 camo, Littlebird Helicopter "Taxi" camo, a supporter scoreboard icon, a grenade bobblehead, and a helmet bobblehead.

games.name: 2048 Battles: Sylvan Sirens
games.summary: Combine tiles and battle cute elves in a realm of fae!

games.name: After Work
games.summary: After Work is a short, atmospheric first-person exploration game. The workday is over and it's time to head home. But a familiar way out begins to lead somewhere unfamiliar, gradually taking you further from the ordinary.

games.name: Aim for 1 Million! Influencer Dream
games.summary: Will your post fly—or flop?

games.name: Arc Salvo
games.summary: Arc Salvo is a fast-paced online turn-based artillery game featuring explosive team battles, a growing arsenal, and deep character customization.

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Karnov
games.summary: "Karnov" is an action game released by Data East in 1987. Defeat the Emperor of Darkness and reclaim the stolen treasures.

games.name: Artillery Miner
games.summary: An incremental mining game, where you mine through massive blocks using guns, fire, lasers and nuclear missiles. Discover new ores, unlock new worlds and weapons as you progress through the upgrades tree and become the ultimate Artillery Miner!

games.name: Astralis: Dawnblades
games.summary: Astralis: Dawnblades is a turn-based tactical RPG that combines stronghold management, dungeon exploration, loot-based equipment crafting, and optional rhythm-based combat tied to an orchestral soundtrack.

games.name: Axe And Claw
games.summary: Axe and Claw is a challenging 2D pixel-art action-platformer. Follow the story of Samuel, a father who embarks on a perilous journey to climb an unclimbable mountain in search of his lost son, Jonah. Face dangerous terrains, master the flow of movement, and overcome intense escape sequences in this emotional quest for family.

games.name: Barko
games.summary:
A good boy never gives up.

Barko is a story-rich 2D adventure about a very good dog with a very questionable sense of direction.

Barko's story begins in a dog shelter. He doesn't know where he's going, what he'll find out there, or why the world seems to be getting progressively weirder.

He only knows one thing:

Somewhere out there, a human needs him.

games.name: Betrayal Banquet
games.summary:
Betrayal Banquet is an indie medieval multiplayer party game that combines cooking simulation with social deduction. Players take on the role of royal servants, preparing and serving meals for the kings while racing to complete orders before time runs out. At the same time, hidden Betrayers secretly work to poison the feast without revealing their identity. Every player must decide who to trust, watch for suspicious behavior, and work together to protect the banquet before it's too late.

Genres: Social Deduction, Party, Cooking Simulation, Multiplayer, Co-op.

games.name: Black Flower
games.summary: Black Flower is a strategic roguelike about surviving and growing a fragile garden through a magical calendar. Make tough daily choices, face unpredictable weather, and uncover the secret of a mysterious black seed.

games.name: Black Friday Janitor: Clean the Whole Mall
games.summary: Black Friday Janitor is a organization game that hands you the biggest clean up job of the year. Tens of thousands of items: misplaced products to return to their correct spots, rubbish to collect and dirt to tidy up. Don't expect to finish it all in one go!

games.name: Black Gold
games.summary: Join the early 20th century oil boom! In this game you will hire people, build your own oil field, extract crude oil, fight obstacles and crises what eventually will bring you fortune you’ve never dreamt of!

games.name: Black Plague
games.summary: A fast-paced bullet heaven roguelite where you battle endless plague hordes, collect powerful upgrades, and create game-breaking builds to survive as long as possible.

games.name: Black Wolves Saga: Weiβ und Schwarz - for Nintendo Switch
games.summary: A port for Nintendo Switch of the original Playstation Vita Bundle.

games.name: Brick by Brick
games.summary: Sort thousands of colorful bricks, organize them onto shelves, build whatever you can imagine, and unleash the occasional earthquake. Play at your own pace alone or invite friends to join you online in this relaxing first-person brick sorting and building sandbox.

games.name: Bug Error 404: Anime Boys Not Found
games.summary:
He shouldn't be there. The error screen says so.
Track him down and see for yourself.

games.name: Bug Error 404: Anime Girls Not Found
Bugs. Billions of Bugs.

games.name: Cats Around Us: Black Cat
games.summary: We've hidden a bunch of cats in a silent comic about a black cat that always blends into the shadows. Can you find them all?

games.name: Chicken Miner
games.summary:
Chicken Miner is an incremental game where you can gather massive amounts of resources with the help of chickens. Capture chickens in the hunting grounds, bring them back to your mine, and put them to work mining!
The chickens do the work for you!

games.name: Circuit Flow
games.summary: Route the signal. Power the board.

games.name: Clockwork Rabbit
games.summary: Tessa the bunny was hired at a textile factory as a mechanic. Create and program robots to solve logical puzzles.

games.name: Console Archives: Nobunaga's Ambition II
games.summary:
Nobunaga's Ambition II was released by Koei in 1990 for an 8 -bit home console.
In this authentic simulation war game, play as a Sengoku Daimyo (warlord), command a vast array of unique officers, and utilize every strategy and tactic at your disposal to unify all 38 fiefs spanning regions such as Kanto and Chubu.
Expanding upon its predecessor, "NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION", this entry features a multi-scenario system with two distinct scenarios, HEX battles expanded to include both open battles and siege battles, and a roster of approximately 400 real historical samurai!
Enrich your fief, skillfully

games.name: Core Runners

games.name: Destiny Spire

Not your traditional turn based combat: The battle continues even while you select your actions, you'll need reflexes and wits to survive. Pick your party and set off on a retro, non-hand holdy adventure!

games.summary: Dig For Riches is a realistic mining simulation. Dig the earth, extract valuable minerals, haul them to the surface by cart and sell them. Use your earnings to upgrade your equipment, dig deeper, and face increasing dangers.

games.name: Ding! Pocket It!: Rogue Simulator
games.summary: A Roguelite deck-builder with pool-style controls. Refine your cap combos, hone your shot skills, and use Base × Multiplier to rack up a high score!

games.name: Door Runners
games.summary: A 4-10 player online social deduction party game. Only one player knows the safe door, but that knowledge will not get them out early. Bluff and survive over live voice chat, round after round, until only two doors and two players remain.

games.name: Drag'n Wash
games.summary: Enjoy a narrative involving 3 male dragons. Wash them, chat with them, touch them, and more! A 3D dragon washing experience.

games.summary: Hack and optimize inefficient elevators in Elegorithm, a Sci-Fi simulation. Connect nodes to build custom algorithms and route endless passenger waves. Clear strict wait time and power targets to upgrade your system. If floors overflow, your hack is detected—game over!

games.name: Escape Toon Kingdom
games.summary: Escape From Toon Kingdom is a 1–4 player co-op horror game. Play as mascots trapped in a dying theme park. Explore. Solve. Suffer. Every attraction holds a secret—and a piece of your escape.

games.name: First Draft
games.summary: First Draft is an arcade flight shooter where you enter intense aerial battles with enemy paper airplanes, survive challenging encounters, and take on powerful bosses as you push your piloting skills to the limit.

games.summary: Lead a small football club through one unforgettable season. Make tough choices, face the media, manage morale and ambition — every decision shapes your story in this cinematic, story-driven football management drama.

games.name: Forsworn
games.summary: Step into a realm torn by divine conflict where every defeat is just another beginning in this rogue lite, turn-based tactics adventure where no hero fights alone. Build powerful synergies to overcome unforgiving battles and defy fate in a world controlled by the gods.
