games.summary: The critically acclaimed rhythm roguelite, Fresh Tracks, is now in VR! Jump, dodge, and fight to the rhythm of the gods in this thrilling music-action game on skis. Take on obstacles and menacing enemies as you ski further into the darkness that has befallen the snow-covered land of Norwyn.

games.name: Frontier: Path of Shadows

games.name: Fukakutei Sekai no Tantei Shinshi: Akugyou Futaasa no Jiken File
games.summary: Port of Fukakutei Sekai no Tantei Shinshi, heavily censored from the PC release and new content.

games.name: Fuyukuru.: Winter winds, adieu?
games.summary: A “denpa” visual novel about a grisly murder in a sealed institution for immortal girls. Wool needle, knitting needle, sewing machine needle. Silk needle, stitching needle, injection needle. Futon needle, clothing needle, hook for a fish. Follow the needles to your immortal death.

games.name: Gakkou de Atta Kowai Hanashi
games.summary: Gakkou de Atta Kowai Hanashi is an Adventure game, developed by Pandora Box and published by Banpresto, which was released in Japan in 1995.

games.name: Glyphwing: World Geography
games.summary: Glyphwing: World Geography is an educational world geography and cultural discovery game designed for elementary and middle school learners. games.name: Horrors Glade

games.name: Kollectomaniac
games.summary: A man offers you a job. Work at a log in the middle of the woods. Spend your money at the shop and improve your store. Don't stop collecting. Never miss collection day. Sell to the nine walkers. Stay away from the computer game.

games.name: Kubo 3
games.summary:
Kubo 3 is new homebrew NES game from SJ Games (a 7 year old from France and little help from his Dad).

The game is available in ROM version to download or can be ordered in complete NES CARTRIDGE edition in box with the manual.

games.name: Learn English with World Ghost Stories
Legends of Aria Eternal

games.name: Living on Plain Pasta
games.summary: A conversation adventure where you spend the worst, best summer visiting your booze-loving senpai, making weird food, and sneaking out together at midnight.

games.summary: Loop Miner is a mining incremental game where a cute mole miner endlessly digs through mines, gathers resources, collects artifacts, and ventures deeper underground. Experience the satisfaction of growing stronger through endless mining loops.

Millumi is a minimalist puzzle game where you are guided by a crow, directing light beams through mirrors to solve various puzzles. You'll face obstacles, mechanisms, and progressively challenging levels.

games.name: Monster Alchemy
games.summary:
Monster Alchemy is a Monster Collector RPG where instead of catching monsters, you create them using alchemy.
Create unique creatures, use them to gather rare resources, and fuse them into even more powerful beings! This RPG combines classic exploration with a deep crafting system where your monsters are your ultimate tool for looting, combat, and discovery.

games.name: Monster Shop Simulator

games.name: Octopticom 3D

Can you spot common sense?
Put your knowledge to the test.
Up to 8 players. Battle now!

‘PLATiNA :: LAB’ is a rhythm game that features a classic top-down note drop play style.
Play a variety of tracks across different genres, connect with unique and charming DB(character) units, and discover the distinctive appeal that only PLATiNA :: LAB can offer.

games.name: Project Cobalt
games.summary: ️ Project Cobalt is a survival action game set on a hostile island . Scavenge containers, mine resources, craft tools, hunt animals, and endure storms as you fight hunger, disease, and exhaustion all while uncovering the dark truth behind a failed experiment.

Red Galaxy is a massively multiplayer online space shooter for Windows, Android and iOS. Players pilot a customizable ship on behalf of one of three rival corporations, Orion, Helios and Nova, and compete for control of contested map sectors.

Gameplay combines player versus player combat, cooperative raids through multi stage gates, NPC hunting, and resource collection. Ore gathered in space can be refined into enrichment that boosts damage, shielding or speed for a limited time. games.name: Romance of the Three Kingdoms XIV Complete Edition

games.name: Slime Slayer: Endless Loot
games.summary: Click to aim, reap souls, enjoy pop-bubble hack-and-slash. An incremental ARPG focused on looting and build crafting. Build unique setups from 20+ classes and 100+ core talents. Change combat rules with hundreds of uniques and Gemword system.

games.summary: Top-down arena shooter roguelite where fallen Steam friends & Twitch chatters become your power. Control a squad, survive relentless waves and defeat powerful bosses. Compete on leaderboards! Bullet hell Brotato-like with wild builds, random events & high replayability.

games.name: Super Takoyaki Battle

Experience takoyaki-making like never before!
Make as many as you can in an all-out battle!

The game follows Lloyd Bannings and his colleagues Elie MacDowell, Randy Orlando, and Tio Plato. The four form the Special Support Section, a newly formed department of the Crossbell police in a city-state located between two great powers fighting for control over it.

The game follows the Special Support Section with more members and more cases to solve.

games.name: NHL 27

EA Sports NHL 27 brings the identity of every NHL team to life on the ice, in the arena, and through the broadcast.

Experience Authentic Atmospheres across all 32 NHL arenas, each designed to capture the sound, spectacle, and identity of its home team. Real-world goal songs, new pregame introductions, and a fully overhauled crowd bring every building closer to its real-world counterpart.

games.summary: Did you think going to the supermarket was easy? Ha! Welcome to Blurry Shopping, the ultimate simulator of getting lost between endless aisles, fluorescent lights, and products that all look the same… because they literally are, at least for you.

games.name: Bob-omb Blitz
games.summary:
Bob-omb Blitz is a remake/reimagining of the minigame Bob-omb Squad from Super Mario 64 DS and New Super Mario Bros.

Bob-ombs are attacking Peach's flowers! The Toads are counting on you to hold them off as much as you can. Use the slingshot to attack the enemies and blast them out of the sky!

games.name: Burger Shift: Team Rush
games.summary: Run the world's most chaotic fast food joint! Play solo or with up to 8 friends as you take orders, make burgers, and hustle to keep customers happy. Grow your business with every shift.

games.name: Chessplosion
games.summary: Chessplosion reinvents chess with an explosive Giant Pawn that occupies a 2×2 area. Face the AI or other players, solve puzzles, and customize special rules to create tactical, unpredictable matches filled with surprising turns.

games.name: Cursed District: Horror
games.summary: The curse never left.

games.name: Darkodai
games.summary: The land was absolved, it fell to an ancient darkness, a spell cast by a mysterious force. Two beings from a pure realm of light are the only hope for this consumed land. Many adventures against the darkness await you in this small, RPG adventure known as Darkodai!

games.name: Deep Sheol
games.summary: In a dystopian future, Agent Seth investigates a corporate geological facility where a biological gas turned people into bloodthirsty monsters. Fight through enemy hordes, uncover a dark corporate conspiracy, and face Lovecraftian nightmares in this tense retro FPS with survival horror!

games.name: Dig Raiders: Anomaly Extraction
games.summary: DIG Raiders: Anomaly Extraction is a co-op digging sim where you and your crew burrow through 10+ layers of the unknown—team up to uncover the truth, battle rivals, and race to secure alien gems. Dig deep. Extract the anomaly. Get out alive!

games.name: Drift Club: Street Legends
games.summary: Own the streets. Master every drift.

games.name: Dwarf Core
games.summary: Dwarf Core is an idle-management game about small colony of dwarves who love to mine. Send them to the mine to gather resources, gain experience, upgrade their stats and craft new pickaxes. Looking for more active gameplay than idle? Take control of one of the dwarves and help them mine!

games.name: Exitrance
games.summary: Exitrance is a single-player psychological horror game set in a constantly shifting loop. Explore a confined environment where each cycle subtly changes, altering objects, sounds, and events. Observe your surroundings, and solve environmental puzzles to break the loop and escape.

games.name: Gun Shop 3
games.summary: Do you like guns? Many people sure do! Gun Shop 3 is a real-time storefront simulator with a sprinkling of first person shooter mechanics on top. Choose your location, design your store, stock the shelves, and then flip that sign to “open for business”! The demand is there. Can you supply it?

games.name: Half Hour RPG
games.summary: Up to 30 minutes of epic adventure. Half Hour RPG is a hand-asset-flipped RPG designed with uncompromising respect for your time. Every unnecessary system was deliberately left unimplemented.

games.name: Hockey Beasts
games.summary: Choose your team, step onto the ice, and see what kind of beast you are when the puck starts moving.

games.name: Increbouncer
games.summary: Increbouncer is a short incremental ball game where you launch balls, earn two different currencies from wall bounces and ball collisions, unlock new balls, and level up a skill tree to maximize your income.

games.name: Kill Spewy
games.summary: Collect components. Build the flow. Kill Spewy. A cozy idle game where your only goal is to kill Spewy as many times as possible, earn Bread Slices, and unlock endlessly growing component builds.

games.name: Kumatopia
games.summary: Kumatopia is a cozy 2D pixel-art simulation game where you care for your Kuma companion, explore a relaxing world, grow magical fruits, collect treasures, play mini-games, unlock music, and upgrade your boomerang. Take your time exploring, build your collection, and eventually face the powerful boss, Bloomblastic.

games.name: Lichtung
games.summary: Enter a calm and unfamiliar world, lying dormant as you arrive. As you explore its surroundings, the world gradually opens up, revealing its light. The more you engage with it, the more you become enveloped in a soothing yet lively awakening, full of surprises.

games.name: Life of a Thug
games.summary: This game throws you into the shoes of a character struggling to survive in a corrupt ghetto overrun by gangs, mafia bosses, and crooked politicians. This is no ordinary RPG; Life of a Thug is designed for players who dare to delve into the heart of darkness and pay the price of their choices.

games.name: Lustpunk 69
games.summary: Lustpunk 69 is an explosive mix of roguelike action, card battles, and wicked pleasures in the neon slums of City77. Five years behind bars turned you into a weapon. Walk free under a new name, build a harem of the city’s most dangerous beauties, and make every traitor beg for mercy on her knees.

games.name: Master of Pottery
games.summary: Master of Pottery is a pottery-themed creation + simulation game. Create unique works and run your own exhibition hall.

games.name: Moon Garden
games.summary: A cozy incremental game about growing your way home. Strategically plant flowers, optimize machinery, and grow your tree tall enough to escape!

games.name: Nano Punk Mecht
games.summary: You are a young conscript extracted from a shelter and trained to pilot MECHTs in a future post-apocalyptic world of civil war and environmental collapse caused by an anomaly known as The Phage.

games.name: Nightpark Journal
games.summary: A dreamcore roguelike deck builder. Explore the mysterious Nightpark as three youths, each with distinct abilities. Build unique decks for each of them, defeat enemy adults and fiends, and uncover hidden secrets.

games.name: PegPigeon
games.summary: PegPigeon: casual physics peg action—launch through bright boards, chain hits, settle in slots. Limited shots; between rounds draft one upgrade or relic. Varied stages; gold funds meta upgrades, pigeons, skins; achievements and per‑stage bests add goals. Cute, snack‑sized, easy to replay.

games.name: Pieces of the Kingdom
games.summary: What if Chess…was a roguelite? Assemble your party and battle your way across a broken kingdom in a fantastical, tactical take on Chess. Loot epic gear, recruit powerful pieces with unique abilities, and strategize your way to victory.

games.name: Proper Tosser
games.summary: Proper Tosser is an incremental physics game where you toss boxes properly. Become a Proper Tosser by purchasing upgrades and tossing farther each time. Do you have what it takes to be a Proper Tosser?

games.name: Quinn
games.summary: Quinn is a chaotic 1–4 player co-op & solo game set in a high-tech AI research facility. Monitor the lab through your tablet, operate physical control panels, work together, and deal with whatever goes wrong. Quinn is always watching.

games.name: Ripgraze
games.summary: A few-minute deep-sea score attack. Flip gravity to rise or dive, graze reefs and jellyfish to charge OVERDRIVE, then spend it for a burst of slow-motion scoring. Playing it safe is the losing move. The deeper you go, the more the ocean changes.

games.name: Riruri Tachibana: Reincarnated
games.summary: Haruka, who streams as the popular virtual streamer Riruri Tachibana. After a streaming accident, her everyday life quietly begins to crumble. What awaits her is a new stage—or an endless nightmare. A short first-person horror story themed around “reincarnation.”

games.name: Rotfang: The House
games.summary: A short horror game where you play as the family dog. Everyone is gone from the house and the town. Set in a suburban house and small town, explore each room, complete tasks, and find the dark secrets hidden under the house.

games.name: Ruptured Floor
games.summary: Ruptured Floor is a puzzle horror game set in surreal office spaces. It tells a story about depression and work. The protagonist needs to find a way to escape, and uncover dark secrets in the process.

games.name: Scale2fit
games.summary: A simple puzzle game about scaling blocks to fit them together.

games.name: Sporting Goods Shop
games.summary: Run your sporting goods shop. Sign contracts with leading brands, order products, hire workers, expand your store, and run little contests to entertain your customers. Play with friends or go solo, and enjoy the growth of your shop.

games.name: Starweaver Express: Per Aspera Ad Astra
games.summary: "Starweaver Express " is a unique visual novel that blends poetic storytelling with dreamlike visuals. As the mysterious transfer student Tsubaki Ueshima, you'll step into a cloistered academy and follow the paths of girls searching for starlight, love, and meaning.

games.name: TomoTomo
games.summary: TomoTomo is a platformer semi-open world city with an early 2000s Japanese aesthetics. Roam freely through the streets and rooftops of Yōhōbakoto, our goal ? Collect batteries, unlock your RAM upgrades and restore your lost abilities, all while staying one step ahead of the city's patrol units.

games.name: Untergrund Raceways: Arena
games.summary: Untergrund Raceways Arena (short: URA) is a kart arena fighter from Vantech Studios, developed in cooperation with the AAP. URA covers a scope that seems somewhat atypical for a first PC game.

games.name: VR # Avoid
games.summary: AVOID THE GRID

games.name: Your Story: Games with Death
games.summary: A medieval text quest in the "Choose Your Own Adventure" genre, where each choice could be your last. Create your story with more than 2,000 events, 200 of which will prove fatal. In a world where death plays against you, can you outsmart it and write your own story?

games.name: Luduvo
games.summary: Luduvo is a user-generated content (UGC) sandbox gaming platform built on a proprietary engine. The platform allows players to create, share, and play community-designed games using a suite of built-in development tools and custom avatar configurations. Emphasizing digital safety and moderation, Luduvo features an in-game economy driven by virtual currency (Lunes).

games.name: Chud Logic's: Gockbound
games.summary: Chud Logic is isekai’d into a cursed commentary world. To escape, he must recover his leaked DMs and reach the elusive Princess Gock. A darkly comedic, turn-based RPG parody with retro pixel art and internet drama.

games.name: Cyborg Earthworm
games.summary: Ever played Snake and couldn't hit the fruit because it's going too fast? Automate it! Develop a strategy, let the computer do the hard work, sit back and watch it play the game for you.

games.name: Friendly Fire
games.summary: A story driven visual novel with interactive shooting challenges where you learn the fundamentals of modern FPS games while helping a cast of stranded characters save their new home from being shut down.

games.name: Hyranies CCG
games.summary: Hyranies CCG is a tactical and strategic card game where players build their deck, take control of the battlefield and face other players in strategic battles.

games.name: Kilnborn
games.summary: Test your platform fighting-game fundamentals in Kilnborn, a fast-paced platform fighting game where you die in one hit. Kilnborn's pottery protagonists may be fragile, but all play differently with depth to discover in every match.

games.name: Kirby: Soft & Wet
games.summary:
Welcome to Kirby ~ Soft & Wet! This is a game where you catch as many fish as you can!
Simply throw your bobber and click the right keys!
You can also come back in other times of day to get unique catches!
Can you collect them all and fill your Fishbook?

games.name: Level P
games.summary: You are trapped underground with one way out. Find your car, follow the sound, and dont let the car park fool you.

games.name: Mother;Above
games.summary: Matoki is about to flood to protect the inhabitants of the city above... Vik and his companions head for the flood controls, but his search for his missing mother threatens to consume him. A psychological horror VN about sacrifice, and what desperation makes people willing to do.

games.name: Next Girl, Please
games.summary: Screen fantasy girls for a bold urban adult studio in this “Papers, Please”-style experience. Make tough calls, build your reputation, and outshine your rival across 10 intense days to unlock multiple endings. Who’s in… and who’s out?

games.name: Paranormal Watcher
games.summary:
Paranormal Watcher invites you into the eerie world of paranormal hunting from a safe distance but don’t let the safety of the screen fool you. As a remote paranormal investigator, you’re tasked with monitoring haunted locations through surveillance cameras. Your mission: detect and report every unsettling anomaly that creeps into view, from flickering lights to ghostly apparitions.

Paranormal activity you capture isn’t always obvious objects might move, shadows could shift, and figures may emerge from the darkness. Only your sharp eye and quick reflexes can catch the disturbances in real tim

games.name: Pool Ball Battle Royale
games.summary: Control your own pool ball and try to knock your opponents into the holes in this action-packed game. Outmaneuver and defeat your opponents with strategy and quick reflexes to emerge victorious.

games.name: Space Parkour Obby
games.summary: One small hop for a frog, one giant leap through space!

games.name: Splimbo City
games.summary: By day, you're just another data entry drone at Splimbocorp. By night, you fight in underground clubs. But someone at the top is pulling both strings.

games.name: The Infectious Adventure
games.summary: You have to save the world, by destroying cases, avoid infected cars...

games.name: The Last Login
games.summary: The Last Login is a psychological hacker thriller where you use GHOST//OS to exploit websites, intercept data, control cameras, and make dangerous choices as the voice in your head pushes you deeper into crime.

games.name: Argonauts Agency: Patterns of Morpheus - Collector's Edition
Backyard Defenders
games.summary: Defend your picnic from hungry bugs in this strategic tower defense game! Place unique defenders, upgrade their abilities, and survive increasingly challenging waves of ants, beetles, mosquitoes, and epic boss battles. Can you protect your backyard feast?

games.name: Daemon
games.summary: Daemon is an action-packed first-person shooter with expressive and customizable gameplay that can be built for tactical assistance, controlling space, or dealing oppressive damage. Combine a wide variety of weapons and abilities to out-strategize your opponents and claim victory.

games.name: Gravity Knight
games.summary: Gravity Knight is a 3D, third-person puzzle platforming game that requires you to manipulate gravity and complete various puzzle rooms to escape the dungeon!

games.name: Gun of Fate: The Silver Gun of Ylia
games.summary: A shooting adventure RPG game, where you play as a gunslinger in Westland. The main combat system of the game is gun shooting. You can complete quest and side missions, unlock items and equipment, and also play fishing and horse racing mini games.

games.name: Mole Escape
games.summary: A little mole has had enough of living under the rule of the tyrannical Mole King. He wants only one thing — to escape the underground kingdom and finally be free.

games.name: Orba
games.summary: ORBA is a fast-paced 2D pixel-art action game where you race a fragile Orb up a deadly tower. Dash through shifting floors, use powerful Lucky Charms to outpace destruction, and push your limits before the Orb shatters.

games.name: Quest Industries
games.summary: An incremental factory builder where you build a factory that produces fantasy RPG gear for adventurers. Gather resources and craft items to sell. Invest your earnings to discover exotic resources and legendary items blueprints that will make you a fortune.

games.name: Spirit Animal Survival
games.summary:
SAS is a Open World Coop Multiplayer Game.
Set in a vast environment that features building,crafting,taming,riding,flying and exploring wildlife, dinos and dragons as well as horrific creatures and instances with the ability to morph into Spirit Animals.

games.name: TDS v0.1.3
games.summary:
TDS is definitely just your run-of-the-mill top-down shooter, nothing else to it at all!

...Or is it?

games.name: The Legend of Dark Witch Episode 2: The Price of Desire
games.summary:
The Legend of Dark Witch 2 retains its simple controls and enough challenges to satisfy the completist.

Created by indie games company INSIDE SYSTEM in 2014, The Legend of Dark Witch 2 is a 2D action story sequel to "The Legend of Dark Witch". True to its predecessor, Legend of the Dark Witch 2 retains its simple controls and enough challenges to satisfy the completist.

Players have 8 stages to choose from and must use SHOTs to make their way through a variety of obstacles to reach the boss enemy. Within each stage there are hidden "Pura Syega" which are helpful to power up player characters

games.name: The Zium Railway
games.summary:
In the Valley of the Underground Mountain.. In the picturesque land of Lyptch...

The Zium Railway is an open world gallery.

Experience a hand crafted open world, the open rails, a new collection of artists, a collaborative video game, and a new exhibition from The Zium Society.

Features works from Ada Null, Charlotte Madelon, Christopher Ferris, Farfama, Jacob Potterfield, John Flannelly & Virtual Neighbors, Julian Palacios, Michael Berto, Pippin Barr, and Zilasaule.

games.name: Ferocious
games.summary: Immerse yourself in a survival FPS adventure. Stranded on a dangerous island, face mercenaries, dinosaurs, and a vibrant yet hostile ecosystem. Explore breathtaking environments and survive the onslaught of intense, fast-paced encounters.

games.name: Dunebound Tactics
games.summary: Lead your band of survivors on a perilous trek across unforgiving sands in search of a new home. Battle ruthless factions, scavenge dwindling resources, reshape the terrain to your advantage and make life-or-death choices in Dunebound Tactics, a Roguelite Turn-Based Tactical RPG.

games.name: Rehaunted
games.summary: Enter a house where every clue feels wrong. Investigate a brutal crime scene, uncover hidden evidence, and use your detective tools to piece together a disturbing truth buried beneath the silence.

games.name: Cloudscrapers
games.summary:
Cloudscrapers is a minimalist strategy game with a relaxing atmosphere.

Start with simple tools and build the tallest tower you can. With each climb, you’ll improve, unlock upgrades, and reach new heights. As your tower rises, you’ll discover ancient relics and uncover secrets hidden deep within the clouds.

Designed for players who enjoy thoughtful gameplay without unnecessary complexity, the game blends replayable puzzle-strategy, meaningful progression, and a hand-drawn world you can get lost in.

games.name: Neat
games.summary: Neat is a game about helping people organize their lives by organizing their spaces.

games.name: Ragnar
games.summary: In this epic Norse myth-inspired roguelike dungeon crawler, wield divine power to challenge Loki and uncover the secrets of the Nine Realms through the branches of Yggdrasil. Grow stronger and reshape Ragnarok’s fate with legendary weapons of the gods.

games.name: Rig Riot
games.summary: A fast-paced third-person mech-action roguelike

games.name: Craftomation 101
games.summary: You land on a frozen planet in a tiny rocket with a robot inside. Harvest and combine materials to discover new ones. Use visual programming to make the robot do the tiresome work for you. Slowly build a gang of self-sustaining robot workers and watch them terraform the planet.

games.name: Creator Chronicles
games.summary: A game within a game. In this entirely new kind of simulation RPG, become a guild master, develop your town, recruit guild members, and conquer dungeons. Every decision you make becomes your own chronicle.

games.name: Meeple Incremental
games.summary: Roll dice to move Meeples around the board and collect money, skill points, and capsule tickets. Unlock unique skills and minigames, powerful collectibles, and automate dice rolls to increase your income.

games.name: Sigilfarer
games.summary: Sigilfarer is a roguelite adventure where every decision rests on the roll of your dice. Master a dice-building system while navigating a sprawling, procedurally generated world. Strategize your route, manage resources and push your luck to the limit!
"771" is a first-person psychological horror game consisting of 7 unique gameplay segments, each created by a different developer.

games.name: 911 Dispatcher: Unknown Caller
games.summary: 911 Dispatcher: Unknown Caller — a first-person psychological horror game in which you work as a night-shift emergency dispatcher. Take calls, decide when to send a police unit, and get to the bottom of a mysterious call connected to an old closed case.

games.name: Am I Cringe?
games.summary: Am I Cringe is a little web toy that calculates or clinically screens your posts' cringe score. But it has more packing to it; it features Cringe Battles where people can duel others to cringe battles, or Cringe Royale: 99 strangers competing to see who's the least cringe.

games.name: Animaly Bar: No Humanity!
games.summary: Run your bar as a gorilla and hunt down the humans in animal costumes hiding among your customers. Observe them closely, spot the clues that give their disguises away, test their slogans, and blow the imposters away with your shotgun. Choose your targets wisely... or become the hunted.

games.name: Apple Man Sam
games.summary: Apple Man Sam...is a little Apple Man! Shoot your way through hordes of moustached vegetables, as you level up, upgrade your weapons, and obtain items to grow absurdly strong. Defeat the final boss and complete quests to unlock more maps and loadouts, for endless fun!

games.name: Astrosaurox
games.summary: Astrosaurox is a tribute to the videogames of the late 70s and early 80s. Pilot an Astrosaurox tank and battle the space mafia. Depending on your age, either discover or relive the challenge, fun, and addictive nature of those classic games. Beat your highscore in solo or co-op mode.

games.name: Bar Darts Simulator
games.summary: In Bar Darts Simulator, grab a few beers with friends, crack a few jokes, and challenge each other across 10 fun dart games. Aim, throw, and take a sip of your drink while you listen to the lively bar atmosphere.

games.name: Battleships Simulator
games.summary: Battleships Simulator puts you in command of mighty shipsstrike, sink your opponent, and claim victory! Feel the thrill of naval battles and outsmart your foe in intense, turn-based war action!

games.name: Beyblade X Evobattle
games.summary: Three EVOLUTIONS have been unleashed in the "BEYBLADE ACTION" game that faithfully recreates the BEYBLADE X series (distributed by TOMY Company, Ltd.) that is popular among fans of all ages! Witness the power of EVOBATTLE, EVOSTORY, and EVOCUSTOMIZE!

games.name: Blood Lily: Killers Can't Sink a Yuri Ship
games.summary: A B-horror mystery comedy adventure game. Having a crush on your bestie is hard enough without serial killers in the way! Lily's vacay plan to romance her crush Sally goes wrong when killers keep cropping up and ruining the mood. And that means war. "How dare you come between Sally and me!"

games.name: Boxing Pro Simulator
games.summary: Boxing Pro Simulator throws you into the ring with the roar of the crowd in your ears! Unleash unstoppable punches, lightning jabs, and crushing hooks in adrenaline-fueled bouts where every hit could be the knockout blow!

games.name: Declan Moses
games.summary: You are Declan, and Declan kills thugs. Kick in the doors and clear the building of anyone who shoots at you. Night by night, Declan will use an array of weapons to clean an underworld one house, store front, or wherever at a time.

games.name: Depth of Mind
games.summary: In this turn-based strategy game, you must assemble the strongest team of mental operatives to overcome mental illnesses inside a person.

games.name: Dinosaur Hunting Simulator
games.summary: Go back in time in Dinosaur Hunting Simulator, grip your rifle tight, and feel the thrill as you track massive tyrannosaurus, triceratops, and more across wild, untamed landscapes. Every hunt is a heart-pounding adventure.

games.name: Distorted Minds
games.summary: Distorted Minds is a chilling anthology of SGG’s original psychological horror stories. Seemingly harmless tales twist into something far darker, each branching into multiple endings and hiding secrets that were never meant to be uncovered.

games.name: F1 Simulator
games.summary: F1 Simulator puts you in the cockpit, where every turn, every boost, and every second counts. Feel the adrenaline, chase insane speeds, and carve your name into the record books as the ultimate racing legend!

games.name: Gamble Life
games.summary:
Gamble Life is a four-player Five-Card Draw poker game that combines poker with special abilities and roguelike elements. Use powerful abilities to manipulate the rules of poker, build unique combinations, and win money from your opponents.

Play through a limited number of days, manage your funds, and fight to repay your debt before the deadline.

games.name: GameZone: Game Store Simulator
games.summary:
GameZone is a first-person store management simulation game playable solo or in online co-op for up to four players.

Players operate a game shop by ordering stock, arranging products, setting prices, scanning purchases, serving customers, and fulfilling online orders. Revenue and reputation can be used to expand the business and unlock new products and abilities.

The store, furniture and player characters can be customised, while physics-driven object handling is used for everyday shop tasks.

games.name: Grid
games.summary: Grid Slash is a fast-paced, grid-based visual debugging action game where you dive into consecutive battles and wipe out system-breaking bugs.

games.name: How to Grow Your Sausage
games.summary: Every [key]stroke makes your sausage bigger. Let it sit in the corner of your screen and watch it grow while you use your computer. Feed it different meats, upgrade your butcher, and see the magic happen. Have you ever dreamed of growing your sausage? Now it’s finally possible!

games.name: Hunting Pro Simulator
games.summary: In Hunting Pro Simulator, your hearts racing, hands shaking BAM! Take the perfect headshot! Feel the thrill, aim the target, and celebrate as the beast hits the ground. Hunting has never felt this easy!

games.name: Kas Mind
games.summary: The most lawless taunt-em-up has arrived! Smack them with a paper fan, then mock them while they're down, mock them from a distance, mock them out of pure spite — spam taunts and victory is yours. "So... how does it feel?"

games.name: Mini Golf Simulator
games.summary: Mini Golf Simulator is a calm, cozy mini golf experience made to help you slow down and unwind. Enjoy peaceful courses, the sound of birds on a fresh Saturday morning, and the simple satisfaction of mastering each hole and landing the perfect hole-in-one.

games.name: Mining Rail Adventure
games.summary: Mining Rail Adventure is a tunnel and railway game that combines free cavern exploration with high-speed roller coaster elements. Players travel through branching tunnels, vast caverns, and hidden chambers deep within a mountain to search for radiant crystals. The gameplay focuses on a mix of exploration, searching for collectibles, and fast-paced rail navigation.

games.name: Peacemaker: Bloody Emperor
games.summary: A dark fantasy JRPG. The imperial princess Chrysoberyl must fight the Bloody Emperor who has usurped the throne. However, her army is small and her allies are conniving. It is a bloody war where she will have to choose between peace and lives...

games.name: Pibcremental
games.summary: A cozy, chaotic idle-incremental clicker about growing a civilisation of tiny creatures called Pibbles in a giant tree, set in a post-human world. Gather resources, build wacky structures and play mini-games to push your production to its absolute limits!

games.name: Pilot Force Simulator
games.summary: Pilot Force Simulator throws you into the heart of a chaotic space battle. Dodge waves of bullets, feel the thrill of near-misses, and unleash powerful attacks in an intense, fast-paced fight through the stars!

games.name: Put Back Stuff
games.summary: Put Back Stuff is a cozy organisation simulator where you put items back where they belong. Enjoy peaceful, play at your pace organisation.

games.name: Rover’s Radventure: The New Millennium
games.summary: After a regular day at work transforms into a bizarre trip that turns his life upside down, a washed-up park ranger named Rover needs to step up and go on a journey that will take him far beyond his wildest fantasies and lead him to confronting uncomfortable truths about himself and his past.

games.name: Schedule Store Simulator
games.summary: Rise from a small-time drug dealer to a feared kingpin as you manufacture and distribute narcotics across the gritty underbelly of Tokyo. Grow your empire by acquiring properties, running businesses, hiring employees, and dominating the streets.

games.name: Shakugan no Shana: Blaze Edge
games.summary: Shakugan no Shana: Blaze Edge is an idle role-playing game based on the Shakugan no Shana anime series. The player raises Shana, a Flame Haze, through stages set in the Shadow World, enhancing equipment obtained in battle, collecting artifacts and learning Unrestricted Spells. Equipment can be worn for its appearance independently of its stats, so Shana's look is customized separately from her build. More than twenty characters from the series, including Yuji Sakai and Hecate, can be recruited as allies, among them figures who opposed her in the anime. Growth materials accumulate while the gam

games.name: Skate Felon
games.summary: Experience Classic Arcade Skateboarding in a small Action packed world. Discover a small city, skate throughout the world, and engage in an Immersive Storyline + Skateboarding Goals that can be discovered by exploring. The world is your playground.

games.name: Soul Injector Commando
games.summary: FPS where you are tasked by God to give souls to the wealthiest people on Earth, helping them get normal jobs and be productive members of society.

games.name: Spaceship Pro Simulator
games.summary: Spaceship Pro Simulator. Strapped in and ready. One ship, one missionsurvive the unknown. Enemies ahead, systems online. This is my journey through deep space, and I'm not going down easy.

games.name: Spiritus Astrum
games.summary: Spiritus Astrum is a persistent, open-world roleplaying sandbox with multiplayer support. It features an infinite, procedurally generated universe which players are free to explore without restriction. Spiritus Astrum is more than a game, it is a world.

games.name: Squirrel Day
games.summary: Squirrel Day is a non-violent VR platforming game that lets you climb, explore, and collect nuts through the eyes of a squirrel using an intuitive, physics-based movement system.

games.name: Stack Together: To the Moon
games.summary: Work together to build towering structures and reach the Moon! Build massive towers, launch rockets, slow down the incoming meteor, and discover anomaly boxes to keep your structure balanced. A chaotic physics-based co-op adventure for up to 4 players!

games.name: Suba Pogo
games.summary: An emergency call echoed through the peaceful Hololive!! Subaru from the Oozora Police Department picks up the phone and rushes out on an urgent dispatch...!!!

games.name: Supermarket Life Simulator
games.summary: Run your own supermarket! Buy, stock, and sell items, expand your store, and manage customers. Customize your layout, explore new locations, and hire staff. Keep things fresh with variety and new challenges as you grow your business.

games.name: Tenebris: Terra Incognita
games.summary: A turn-based tactical RPG in which you will explore a harsh planet teeming with terrifying monsters. Experiment with talent builds for 23 heroes. Combine abilities with equipment and other characters. Assemble a squad and learn the secrets of the planet Tenebris!

games.name: The Headlands
games.summary: A cozy top-down farming management game focused on planning and steady growth. Manage fields, machinery, and resources, upgrade your farm, and develop efficient processes at your own pace in a calm, strategic experience.

games.name: The Thrill of the Fight 2
games.summary: The fully reimagined sequel to the greatest VR boxing game ever made is now available. Glove up your fully personalizable avatar and test your skill while working up a sweat in the new online player-versus-player mode. Challenge friends or enter the ring through skill-based matchmaking as you battle through breathtaking arenas.

games.name: Marvel's Wolverine
games.summary: Marvel's Wolverine is a single-player action-adventure game and a standalone entry in the Marvel's Spider-Man series, sharing continuity with those titles while telling its own self-contained story. Players control Logan/Wolverine in close-quarters combat, using his adamantium claws against enemies drawn from the X-Men comic book mythology.

games.name: Fallout 76
games.summary: Fallout 76 is an online action role-playing game and the first multiplayer entry in the Fallout series. Set in 2102 in Appalachia, West Virginia, players control a resident of Vault 76 who ventures into the open world 25 years after a nuclear war. The game features exploration, questing, base building, and combat against mutated creatures and hostile factions. It can be played solo or cooperatively, with players sharing servers and engaging in trade or PvP combat.

games.name: Active Matter
games.summary:
You’re an operative stuck in a time loop, always brought back from the dead to the same point.

Choose your loadout and enter quantum unstable zones rich with active matter — a substance capable of warping and ripping the very fabric of space and time.

Fight against rivals from other timelines, survive physics-breaking anomalies and try to stay alive. Harvest active matter, gather loot and extract to a safe place before the whole zone ceases to exist with everything inside it.

games.name: TCG Card Shop Simulator
games.summary:
Open your own local game store. Stock shelves with the latest booster packs, or crack them and collect the cards for yourself. Set your own prices, hire staff, host events, and expand your card shop.

TCG Card Shop Simulator is a trading card shop simulation where you sell card booster packs to earn money and build your card shop business.

games.name: Dimraeth
games.summary: A 1-8 player fantasy RPG set in a handcrafted pixel world. Build your hero across 8 races and 6 classes. Explore ancient lands, master elemental combat, forge relationships, and shape a stronghold to call home. Fight for the fate of Dimraeth—together or alone.

games.name: RuneScape: Dragonwilds
games.summary: On RuneScape’s forgotten continent of Ashenfall, dragons have awoken. Gather, build, skill and craft to survive in this co-operative (1-4) survival crafting game. Only by mastering survival and uncovering ancient secrets can they hope to slay the Dragon Queen—alone or with allies.

games.name: Train Sim World 7
games.summary: Live life on the tracks and discover the joy of train simulation. Whether looking for a relaxing run on the rails or seeking the thrill of mastering your virtual train driver career, find your way in Train Sim World 7.

games.name: Fright Train
games.summary: Fight through a train overtaken by monsters and survive Antarctica’s cold as paranormal special agent Doug Barker in this chilling single-player third-person survival horror game.

games.name: Mixed Spirits
games.summary: Run a cozy bar, make cocktails for fun customers! Mixed Spirits is a Job Simulator where you work as a bartender. Take orders, mix custom drinks, and discover secret recipes in a chill, creative night-shift experience with no timers or stress, or rush orders in Happy Hour mode!

games.name: Secrets of Temple Isle
games.summary: Explore ancient ruins and diverse biomes, fight in third-person combat while collecting gear and powers. Design your space and decorate with items gathered in the world. Become the legend in this exciting single player adventure.

games.name: Death Penalty
games.summary: You are sentenced to death... Slither your way through an impenetrable fortress crawling with devils faster, stronger, and more cunning than any human. By sheer luck you've slipped through the cracks, but discovery means certain death. How long are you going to delay the inevitable?

games.name: Mega Man X: Command Mission
games.summary:
A port of Mega Man X: Command Mission, originally released on PlayStation 2, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Cyborg superhero Mega Man X must protect the endangered Giga City from the lethal attentions of the Liberion Army.

Fight across more than 50 missions in this full-throttle future-themed RPG. Joining the illustrious Mega Man on this colossal quest are familiar faces like Axl and Zero, together with a whole bunch of new characters.

Combine with your team-mates mid-battle to perform dynamic combat techniques - with challenging side quests to mas

games.name: The Event
games.summary: The Event is a first-person psychological horror game that offers immersive gameplay and a rich narrative. Find yourself stuck in mystery and struggle in the dark against paranormal activities, demons from other worlds and much more. Will you be able to find out the truth and return home?

games.name: A Game About Flipping Cards
games.summary: Did you read the title? That's the game, I promise. Flip cards to make money to buy upgrades to make more money to buy more upgrades to make more money. There is an arbitrary goal that has been set by the developer, but you can actually play indefinitely.

games.name: Airmash
games.summary: Multiplayer missile warfare browser game.

games.name: Ares: The Iron Vanguard
games.summary:
Ares: The Iron Vanguard is a sci-fi action RPG featuring fast-paced, suit-switching combat. Players can equip two different combat suits and switch between them in real time, combining weapons, skills, and combat styles to adapt to each battle.
Choose from multiple combat classes, including the Engineer, Warlock, Warlord, and Hunter, each with distinct weapons and abilities. Mix and match different suits to create your own combat style and take on hordes of enemies and powerful bosses.
Explore vast futuristic battlefields using advanced mobility options such as hover boards, the Goliath mech,

games.name: Batomon Showdown
games.summary: Batomon Showdown is a monster taming asynchronous pvp autobattler. Discover and battle with hundreds of Batomon! Assemble the ultimate team to take down other players! Play at your own pace while you discover new deadly team combos and synergies! Break the game by training your Batomon to overpowered levels.

games.name: Blue Sun Saga
games.summary: Go on a quest to restore life to the world in this retro inspired shooter! You must be skillful and tactical as many will try to stop you! You are an exile after all which is a death sentence. But things may be as they seem on this journey.

games.name: Bonitāka's Aquarium of Medusae
games.summary: Help a marine biologist's research by piloting a submarine, as you tune in to the souls of jellyfish... and maybe help her learn a thing or two about life too!

games.name: Cake Up
games.summary: Play as a cake courier who delivers an order to the king in the midst of a magical war! Dodge the magic projectiles, deliver the cake safely and try not to fall into the clutches of the evil cake robbers!

games.name: Cloudbreaker
games.summary: Cloudbreaker is a roguelite, inventory management, bullet heaven. Explore a sky-world, finding relics and defeating hordes of enemies. Unlock and upgrade airships, each with its own unique layout, abilities, and strategies, to grow your power over time.

games.name: Crescent Break
games.summary: Blast robots, use their pieces to start chain reactions, and navigate your way through destructible levels in this platformer ROGUELIKE. Crescent Break fuses together NES-era robot hero goodness with indie classics. Augment your cyborg suit for ridiculous synergies, and try over and over to survive!

games.name: Cube Boy
games.summary: A point-and-click puzzle adventure set in a surreal cursed house, with a whimsical spooky-comedy tone.

games.name: Destroy All Humans! 2: Reprobed
games.summary:
Destroy All Humans! 2: Reprobed is a video game in the open-world action-adventure genre, serving as a remake of the original 2006 game. It is the sequel to the remade Destroy All Humans! and marks the sixth instalment in the franchise.

In this game, players take on the role of Crypto, navigating through diverse global locations such as England, Russia, and the United States. The objective is to complete various missions and overcome human adversaries. The gameplay incorporates a range of weapons and abilities, allowing players to defeat enemies by employing tactics such as mind-controlling h

games.name: Detstvo
games.summary: Relive the last day of school before summer break in a nostalgic Soviet neighborhood. Wander through faded apartment buildings, dusty playgrounds, and forbidden construction sites, playing hide-and-seek with friends, scoring goals, watching cartoons, and rediscovering old games on an ancient phone. The world comes alive through period details, dynamic lighting, and an atmospheric soundtrack capturing everyday sounds—a neighbor's guitar, a tape recorder, the kitchen radio. This quiet experience asks you to simply be present in a day you'll always remember but can never return to.

games.name: DR Dominoes
games.summary: Dominican partner dominoes in 3D, with proximity voice chat: you hear every player from where they're sitting. Private rooms, a room browser, offline AI, and games to 100, 120, 150 or 200 points.

games.name: Eternal Memento
games.summary: Phasmophobia X Spelunky roguelike

games.name: Fleetbreakers
games.summary: Fleetbreakers is a modern blend of classic strategy and fast-paced combat. Build your fleet, upgrade your units, and manage your squadron as you battle through a unique roguelike campaign in the quest to liberate space from the evil Voltari.

games.name: Game of Mods
games.summary: Game of Mods is a voice-driven adventure and creation platform for Apple Silicon Macs in which every character is driven by a language model running on the player's machine. Players speak or type to characters, who answer aloud in their own voices, remember the conversation, and stay in character; nothing is sent to the cloud and no account is required. The game includes a spoken tutorial and short authored stories called journeys, plus a Studio for building NPCs, player characters, journeys and spaces as data-only mods (JSON with VRM and GLB assets) that can be shared through Steam Workshop.

games.name: Game Store Cleanup
games.summary: A cozy-chaotic first-person sim about restocking a wrecked game store. Sort every scattered item back onto its correct shelf and watch a total mess become a tidy, ready-to-open shop again.

games.name: Hand Cooking Simulator: Multi-Chef
games.summary: A fun physics based hand simulator in which you prepare food.

games.name: Heroes Suck
games.summary: Defend your dungeon against an onslaught of heroes in this physics-enabled tower defense. Build your dungeon tile by tile, placing deadly traps to protect your loot. Upgrade your defenses and powers as you amass wealth and unleash havoc on these cheese wheel-stealing 'heroes'.

games.name: Hope 01
games.summary: Hope 01 is a single player extraction survival RPG with multiple endings. Explore, Loot, and Fight your way through the dangers of the hab cluster and solve the mysteries of the legendary HAB 01.

games.name: Idle Bookstore
games.summary: A cozy idle bookstore you grow from a tiny shop into a thriving business — solo or with friends. Co-work together, write books as a group, and sell each other’s books for profit.

games.name: Ikebana Dones and the Great Adventure
Knuckle Jet
games.summary: What's this? An off-the-wall, riveting jetpunk nose-breaking ricochet action platformer, lovingly crafted by the oddballs behind the Teslagrad series?

games.name: Look to the Birds
games.summary: A cozy first-person birdwatching game about slowing down, noticing nature, and finding peace in small moments. Photograph 30+ bird species across five hand-crafted dioramas and fill your journal as you travel through the Canadian Maritimes.

games.name: Marvel's Wolverine: Digital Deluxe Edition
games.summary:
Marvel's Wolverine is a single-player action-adventure game and a standalone entry in the Marvel's Spider-Man series, sharing continuity with those titles while telling its own self-contained story. Players control Logan/Wolverine in close-quarters combat, using his adamantium claws against enemies drawn from the X-Men comic book mythology.

The Digital Deluxe Edition includes:
• Marvel’s Wolverine
• 5 exclusive suits: Incredible, Savage, Night Hunt, New Leather, Age of Apocalypse
• 5 exclusive claws: Smooth-Edged Claws, Hollow Blade Claws, Serrated Spine Claws, Tapered Claws, Thick Claws
• 4

games.name: Medieval Juice Crafter
games.summary: Craft your special recipe juices and sell them in medieval villages. Expand your business with new recipes, machines, properties, and workers. Play online with your friend or go solo, and enjoy the growth of your business.

games.name: Neo Trick
games.summary: Neo Trick is an addictive deck-building game! Each round you'll be delicately balancing dealing enough damage to the firewall and stealing enough money to spend in the shop! Card's can permanently affect other cards. Increasing their power or adding new effects will carry into future rounds.

games.name: Neon Dodge
games.summary: Neon Dodge is a frantic, vaporwave-themed bullet hell where you cannot shoot. Master the dodge to survive the impossible challenges that a mysterious Voice throws at you... Or watch your death counter ascend to infinity.

games.name: Nuclear Design Bureau
games.summary:
Nuclear Design Bureau is a hardcore sandbox engineering game where you design and test nuclear devices.

You are a junior engineer at the Kurchatov Institute. The State gives you a target and a warehouse full of dangerous materials. Some directives limit what you are allowed to use. Your job is to build a device that does what the directive asks.

games.name: Once Before Us
games.summary: A cooperative, narrative puzzle adventure for two players. Explore a mysterious world, solve interconnected challenges, and communicate to progress. Once Before Us is a game about thinking, perception, and discovery through exploration and problem-solving.

games.name: Paperman
games.summary: Want to become the new boss of a thriving paper company whose owner mysteriously died? Track down the culprit and catch them to become the new boss. But beware, your adventure will be littered with some tricky obstacles...

games.name: PawMart Tiny Market
games.summary: Build and manage a cozy idle supermarket run by cute animals at the bottom of your screen. Produce goods, stock shelves, automate your store, hire employees and expand your tiny market.

games.name: Rollout Inline
games.summary: Rollout Inline is a brand new Aggressive Inline game created by a solo dev who is passionate about the sport. This game aims to scratch the itch for those who have been craving a new, modern, and intuitive inline skating game!

games.name: Rushcremental
games.summary: Rushcremental is an active incremental journey about searching the wasteland for scrap resources and building a racecar to rule over all the territories.

games.name: Score
games.summary:
Warning, this game is in Early Access Alpha stage bugs and constant content changes are to be expected.
Score, is a Sport and Profession Driven Open World Multiplayer Game where players compete for fame, glory and wealth on a global scale on and off the pitch. Score's Legend City environment is a very large open world which is to 100% user controlled through their professions.

games.name: SCP: Antimemetics Division
games.summary: No, it's not your first day. The Amnestics have kicked in, and Site-48 has locked down. Scavenge restricted gear, gain clearance to forgotten levels, and bend reality to escape lethal SCP anomalies. Tactile survival horror where remembering too much will get you annihilated.

games.name: Side Out
games.summary: Hold one side of a collapsing arena and keep the ball out. Miss twice and you are gone, then you come back as a saboteur dropping traps on whoever is left. Up to 20 players, cross-play with web and mobile.

games.name: Snuggle Nightmare
games.summary: Snuggle Nightmare is a first-person mascot horror adventure set in an abandoned theme park. The player must solve puzzles, craft tools, avoid a deadly animatronic, and uncover the secrets hidden within Brain World Rots.

games.name: Starbase Tactics
games.summary: Starbase Tactics is a fast 1v1 rts autobattler about planning, scouting, timing, and tactical choices. Play compact, competitive matches designed around clear decision-making.

games.name: Station Command
games.summary: A strategy RPG autobattler with branching story set in a far future corporate dystopia

games.name: Sublight
games.summary: Sublight is a survivor-like game set in space. Upgrade, evade, and burn through waves of progressively stronger foes. Unlock new ships and make powerful builds: all to fend off the encroaching fleet.

games.name: Suqare: Hired Gun
games.summary: Take on mission after mission as you attempt to become the best Mercenary ever. Shoot, stab, protect, steal, lie, betray, and much more as you complete jobs from corporations and special interests. Will you assist or destroy them? The choice is yours... And watch out for that pesky Cricle.

games.name: Take Care of My Heifer
games.summary: "Take Care of My Heifer," reads the job listing. Sounds simple... until you step inside the house.

games.name: That Level Again 3
games.summary:
Continuation of the games "TLA" and "TLA2". This time, not levels, but a story (and several separate levels) are waiting for you.
There are still many different logic puzzles and interesting solutions!
Read the lettering, be smart and have fun!

games.name: The Bow: Ultimate Weapon
games.summary: A top-down shooter incremental game where you defeat enemies, sell loot, unlock powerful upgrades, defeat bosses for special items, and shape your own combat build through steady progression.

games.name: The Laundry That Won’t Open
games.summary: A short first-person horror game where strange anomalies slowly begin to appear in a laundromat you casually visit. As you return again and again, you move closer to the ending waiting in this place.

games.name: The Solyani's Code
games.summary: A Sci-Fi story set on the moon Selene, featuring LUMA, a glowing companion that assists you with unique abilities.

games.name: Throttle Trace
games.summary: Slot cars meets simulation racing. Master grip, timing, and race strategy using only throttle and brake. Push to the limit, outsmart rivals, and fight for every corner in intense wheel-to-wheel competition.

games.name: Aniimo
games.summary: Aniimo is a free-to-play, next-gen creature-catching open-world RPG. Explore the vast continent of Idyll, Twine with unique Aniimo, unlock new abilities. Travel to a sky-floating metropolis, meet other Pathfinders, and battle in exciting competitions. Choose your Aniimo and begin your epic journey!

games.name: Blackwood
games.summary: By day, you run a DVD store in 2012 New York. By night, you’re a ruthless assassin. BLACKWOOD is a cinematic third-person shooter with grounded melee combat, brutal takedowns, responsive gunplay, and a double life to manage.

games.name: Woodo
games.summary: Woodo is a cozy diorama puzzle game where you assemble wooden scenes piece by piece. As you place objects in their correct spots, each scene slowly fills with color and comes to life, revealing charming animations and small surprises. Follow the story of Foxy and Ben the frog through a series of interconnected dioramas, each capturing a unique moment from their shared adventure.

games.name: Two Point Hospital
games.summary:
Design stunning hospitals, cure peculiar illnesses and manage troublesome staff as you spread your budding healthcare organisation across Two Point County.
Build and customise your hospital - it is yours after all - with specialist diagnosis and treatment facilities, as well as the very latest in ornamental technology!

games.name: BloomKeeper
games.summary: Spread nature and breathe life back into a world of ash by guiding the Pouics, naive and curious little creatures. They dream of reawakening the world, but they can’t do it alone. Guide them, calm them, protect them and help them restore life to a forgotten land.

games.name: Good Heavens!
games.summary: Good Heavens! Is an open-world crafting and building RPG. Embark on a solo adventure or team up with up friends, picking your tool of choice – sword, wand, or carpenter's hammer. Navigate the quirky races and cultures of the promised lands and restore them to their, ahem, intended glory.

games.name: Brazilian Drug Dealer Before 4: Demons From the Portal to Hell I Opened Are Still in the Favela and Now I Have to Save Mamadas From Ronaldo
games.summary: The standalone sequel of the Brazilian boomer shooter game made using the id tech 2 engine! Shoot, jump, double jump and dash! Embark on a journey throughout the state of Rio De Janeiro, São Paulo, Salvador, hell and even heaven! Save Brazil!

games.name: Duo Quest
games.summary: Dive into a fantasy world where your bond is your greatest weapon! Team up with a friend to battle monsters by answering quirky and thought-provoking questions about each other, while building decks and exploring an ever-changing world. Can your relationship survive the ultimate test?

games.name: Little Witch in the Woods
games.summary: Little Witch in the Woods tells the story of Ellie, an apprentice witch. Explore the mystical forest, help the charming residents, and experience the daily life of the witch.

games.name: Night Club Simulator: Party King
games.summary: Step into the vibrant world of nightlife! Create, manage & customize your own nightclub, solo or co-op. From hiring staff and organizing events to setting the perfect atmosphere with music & lighting, every choice you make will shape your club. Are you ready to become the ultimate nightclub tycoon?

games.name: Patlabor the Case Files
games.summary: Relive iconic scenes from "Mobile Police Patlabor" in this 3D console action game. Experience dual perspectives: Main Missions as the SV2, and Another Side Missions as their rivals. Hone your pilot skills in Simulator Mode, featuring shooting ranges and Labor duels.

games.name: Professional Ship Simulator
games.summary: Take the helm in this realistic, large-scale maritime simulation. Command your fleet from agile rescue vessels to massive LNG tankers and perform precise maneuvers in challenging conditions. Navigate a living open world where weather, traffic, and every wave shape your career

games.name: Roman Sands RE:Build
games.summary: Washed up on the shores of a timeless luxury retreat, you find yourself acquainted with its unhinged inhabitants. They await the day that the Sun will swallow the world. You are obligated to serve their whims. There's more to this place than meets the eye. Can you uncover your exit?

games.name: We Are Football 2027
games.summary: We are football 2027 is the ultimate challenge for all football management fans! Accessible, deep, tactically demanding, and featuring over 200 simulated countries. Now with a comprehensive creative mode that lets you perfectly tailor the entire gameplay experience to your preferences.

games.name: Alex & Arty
games.summary: Two souls, one mission: restore a dying world together! A planet is on the brink. Two unexpected allies. Combine exploration, engineering, and magic to save a world devastated by greed… and build new hope.

games.name: Axiomatik
games.summary: VR action puzzle platformer. Beat the clock as a robot with a draining battery. Shoot to see: Use your light ray gun, find your way in the dark to a charging station before you shut down. Shoot glowing neons to solve spatial puzzles. And open a Schroedinger Box, get a cute kitten - dead or alive.

games.name: Dark Farts: Parody Smell Edition
games.summary: The most absurd Souls-like parody ever! You’re a blacksmith with bean-powered dragon abilities, taking on evil corporations with maximum gasitude! Fart-dash, demolish bosses, and break the fourth wall in this hilarious action RPG. Smell the legend!

games.name: Decide Your Fate
games.summary: Decide Your Fate is a tense psychological horror game about escaping a nightmarish house. You must navigate silently and secure your escape by evading a blind killer.

games.name: Dimensional Animals
games.summary: Five animal friends unite for one glorious purpose: recover the dog's... play ball? Explore beautiful dimensions in this metroidvania action platformer adventure!

games.name: Driving Test Simulator
games.summary: Test your driving skills by completing challenging driving tests and precise, skill-based scenarios. Offers various scenarios and environments.

games.name: G-Mode Archives+: Ridge Racer
games.summary: A legendary 3D car racing masterpiece that earned its place in gaming history. Blast through corners with spectacular drifting!

games.name: Garage: Tidy Up!
games.summary: Garage: Tidy Up! is a cozy first-person organizing simulator where you restore order in a messy auto workshop. Sort tools, parts, tires, paints, wires, and garage equipment into their proper zones, upgrade your skills, and turn chaos into the perfect dream garage.

games.name: Gladio Mori
games.summary: Gladio Mori is a cutting-edge physics-based multiplayer fighting game where you use razor-sharp weapons to cut down your enemies or die trying. Pick your blade, choose your armour and create a fighting style unique to you. Enter the arena to face your friends or hone your abilities against the AI.

games.name: Harvest Scream
games.summary: A co-op farming horror game about raiding unstable dimensions for seeds to grow and harvest for a hungry monster's daily quota.

games.name: Hostile Paths
games.summary: A challenging top-down survival roguelike where scarcity is the real enemy. Manage limited resources and inventory space, explore unknown procedural routes, learn from every death, and decide which risks are worth taking.

games.name: JettFuel+
games.summary: In JettFuel+, you play as Jett: a robot used by a factory until its sudden closure. You managed to escape the factory before it was destroyed, but the whereabouts of your brother and fellow coworker Brody, are unknown.

games.name: Liminal Sorting
games.summary: Liminal Sorting is a relaxing organizing simulator set in a mysterious liminal space. Sort more than 6,000 objects, discover strange rooms, unlock abilities, and enjoy a peaceful experience with moments of suspense and timed challenges. Who knows what secrets that mysterious cat is hiding...

games.name: Lucent
games.summary: Lucent is a logic-based puzzle game, where you aim to hit the target within the provided moves.

games.name: Midnight News Report
games.summary: You watch a news program in the middle of the night featuring an unsettling reporter. As you watch, the world around you begins to warp and become unrecognizable. This is one broadcast you won't soon forget.

games.name: Monowave
games.summary: MONOWAVE is a puzzle-adventure platformer built around four emotions: happiness, sorrow, anger, and anxiety. Players use each emotion's abilities and pass emotions to other spirits through song to solve puzzles and explore the world. The game supports solo play and two-player local co-op, with one player controlling Mono and the other controlling Prism.

games.name: Oops! You're the Hero!
games.summary: Oops! You’re the Hero! is a fantasy adventure about a Thief who has stolen an artifact that deems him the ‘Hero’. Choose to fight or avoid the bosses who have sworn to defeat you, explore the world of Othaya, and return the artifact before more shenanigans befell you because…Oops! You’re the Hero!

games.name: Paratopic: Overdub
games.summary: Paratopic: Overdub revives the award-winning 2018 liminal horror classic: a twisting 3-in-1 remaster, remix, and sequel to the original.

games.name: Phobos
games.summary:
A social deduction horror game for 4-8 players. Solve puzzles that need real coordination, outsmart infected players armed with unique abilities, and survive monsters that each hunt differently.

Play with a full friend group, or jump into a public lobby to fill out your crew.

games.name: R.I.P.: Reincarnation Insurance Program
games.summary: In this virus-ravaged, post-apocalyptic world, you will wield the power of infinite resurrection to delve into perilous ruins, gather legendary gear, and draw strength from the gods—growing stronger through endless cycles, until you become a true savior legend.

games.name: Ride Up Together
games.summary: Ride, climb, kick, and survive! Ride Up Together is an online co-op motorcycle climbing game for 1–8 players. As you try to reach the summit, kick your friends to knock them off, overcome crazy physics-based obstacles, and don’t let even the smallest mistake send you back to the bottom!

games.name: Runeomicon
games.summary: Cast runes to summon the goddess of death, unleash eldritch horrors to fend off villagers, and wield dark magic in this unique tower defense. Balance your power between summoning and fortifying as waves of enemies close in. Can you complete the ritual before your defenses crumble?

games.name: Sky Scaffold
games.summary: A semi-idle incremental factory game where you tame the void of space. Terraform planets, build a colossal Sky Scaffold, and create a galactic industrial empire. Hardcore sandbox gameplay with a blend of simulated markets. [!!]

games.name: Special Force Remastered
games.summary: Special Force Remastered is a modernized, team-based tactical first-person shooter (FPS) developed by DRAGONFLY GF CO., LTD. that officially launched in Early Access on March 24, 2026. Rebuilt completely in Unreal Engine 5, the game serves as a faithful visual and technical upgrade to the iconic 2004 classic military shooter Special Force 1. It preserves the nostalgic combat flow, precise skill-driven movement, and distinct gun recoil of the original while adding modern matchmaking, structural gameplay balance, and tactical progression layers.

games.name: The Plant Shop
games.summary: A cozy horror game where you craft plants for late-night customers while you manage a small plant shop. Expand your plant collection, upgrade your shop & grow your business.

games.name: Tidy or Treat
games.summary: Halloween is coming and a restless spirit has emptied every shelf onto the floor. Sort out the pumpkin toys, learn tricks to work faster, and bring friends in to help.

games.name: Tidy Up History
games.summary: Tidy Up History is a cozy cleaning sim where you inherit a chaotic museum. Tidy messy rooms, unlock new abilities, and find hidden keys to open new wings. Uncover historical knowledge to properly identify and showcase artifacts, returning the museum to its former glory.

games.name: Tinker Shot
games.summary: Tinker Shot is a turned-based Spell Building rogue-like, You fight enemies by creating custom spells and launching them at enemies. Grow an arsenal of spells and items to overcome the world of Tinker Shot.

games.name: Veridus: The Walking Nightmare
games.summary: Battle through fifteen escalating waves in a dark-fantasy action roguelite. Wield seven distinct weapons, combine abilities and imbuements, collect powerful equipment, rescue Abigail, and confront Lord Veydris before entering Nightmare Mode.

games.name: Welcome to Mars 9
games.summary: Welcome to Mars 9: The Tale of River is an old-school graphic adventure about a person adrift in space, rescued by a luxurious space station orbiting Mars. Playing as River, you will be drawn into a world of comfort and pleasure, only to soon discover that the station hides a dark secret.

games.name: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave
games.summary:
Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave is a turn-based strategy RPG centered around the Heroic Games, a tournament where warriors with different motivations compete for a chance to have their greatest wish granted by the Divine Sovereign. The game builds on the tactical foundation of previous Fire Emblem titles, featuring turn-based combat with combat arts, gambits, and crests. A new mechanic called Blaze Arts lets units spend health to perform powerful special abilities on the battlefield.
The game appears to be set in the same world as Fire Emblem: Three Houses, though in a different era, and follows

games.name: Absolum
games.summary: Crafted with passion by the dream team that redefined side-scrolling beat 'em ups, Absolum mixes top-of-the-class combat action with modern roguelite elements, bringing all the vibes of the fantasy arcade hits of the past into an immersive adventure set in the original world of Talamh.

games.name: Fading Echo
games.summary: Fading Echo is a fast-paced elemental action-adventure RPG where creativity fuels combat. Manipulate water, trigger chain reactions, and shift through surreal worlds as One, a young Legend on a mission to save a dying desertscape from the grip of the Paradox corruption.

games.name: Lily's World XD
games.summary: Lily was an ordinary teenager in 2004, and you just found her laptop. Read her diary, message her friends, and piece together what happened to her before it’s too late. But you're not the only one with access to her computer… A fourth wall-breaking psychological horror experience featuring LilyPichu.

games.name: Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter
games.summary: A remake of the second installment in the main Trails series, serving as a direct sequel of Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter. The game follows Estelle as she sets out on a new adventure following the events of the previous game, where she will be joined by comrades both old and new.

games.name: Endless Legend 2
games.summary: With a mysterious, ever-changing world, unique factions, and epic storytelling, the much-awaited sequel to the strategy game classic ENDLESS Legend is here, opening a new chapter of the award-winning ENDLESS universe. Write your legend and unveil the secrets of a dreamlike ocean-planet on the verge of extinction.

games.name: The Guild 1 Remake: Europa 1410
games.summary: Forge your path to power in medieval Europe. Choose your profession and master trade, politics, and intrigue to climb the social ladder and found a dynasty. Secure your legacy and dominate history in this immersive economic simulation.

games.name: OpenFront
games.summary: Free RTS Point and Click

games.name: Kernel Hearts
games.summary: Gather your allies. Eliminate Angels. Transform into a Magical Girl. Slay god. Kernel Hearts is a Multiplayer Co-Op Roguelike Action RPG about four magical girls and their attempt to save a world that's drowning in ashes

games.name: World of Warcraft: Forever
games.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever is an invitation to take your first steps in a legendary world of untamed frontiers, warring factions, untold perils, and unseen mysteries. Experience an Azeroth that grows from the roots of WoW’s first age, continually evolving through regular content patches and updates that promise never-ending adventure.

games.name: Artis Impact
games.summary: Artis Impact is a story-rich, adventure pixel RPG that features classic turn-based combat, upgrading your home, and exploring uniquely hand-drawn environments. Players will take on the role of official Akane, teaming up with Bot to unravel the mysteries of a future utopian world.

games.name: Rooster
games.summary: A heartfelt, story-rich casual puzzle adventure celebrating the best of ancient Chinese culture. Explore an exquisitely hand-drawn world with delightful surprises, from cooking, finding hidden objects, paper crafting, and more. Guide Rooster in an emotionally rewarding tale about family and love.

games.name: Another Eden Begins
games.summary: Embark on a time-traveling RPG adventure featuring command battles presented by Masato Kato, creator of numerous RPG classics. With New Game+, embark on a new adventure with your upgraded characters and discover more than 10 different endings.

games.name: Mr. Sleepy Man
games.summary: In Mr. Sleepy Man, you play as a sleepy guy who's up way past his bedtime and out of control! Make a mess of everything you find and turn Bedtime Town against you! This sandbox adventure is filled with comical hijinks, outrageous characters, and platforming action!

games.name: Die in the Dungeon
games.summary: Fight your way through a mysterious dungeon in this deck-building, turn-based roguelike where you don't use cards, but dice! Deal with enemies by combining powerful dice on your board, boost their effects with magical relics, and risk it all hoping for a good roll on unexpected encounters.

games.name: Shape of Dreams
games.summary: Shape of Dreams is an action rogue-lite infused with MOBA-esque elements. Venture into a vivid dream world, and create your own champion by freely swapping skills with whatever you like. Play solo against all odds, or with friends in a 4-player co-op game.

games.name: Sniper Dan
games.summary:
Meet Dan. Dan has a sniper rifle. Don’t panic, he’s not here to harm anyone. Dan’s a professional and his job is fixing things. From a distance. With pinpoint accuracy and good intentions.

Sniper Dan is a hidden object game unlike any other. Objects aren’t always well hidden and the solution involves shooting them. Each job follows a simple and highly respected method.

1. Figure out the problem. Use the clues. HMM…
2. Find the problem. Scope the area. AHA!
3. Fix the problem. Shoot. WHEE!

You’re not hunting enemies. You’re hunting problems. Fixing rusty taps, machines behaving badly, and ev

games.name: Trivia Murder Party 3
games.summary: Your favorite trivia-obsessed serial killer is heading to summer camp to put you through a sinister new set of minigames and murder. Take a stab at answering questions correctly, engage in luck and skill-based activities, and sabotage your fellow campers in order to survive the summer.

games.name: Pop! Pachinko
games.summary: Pop! Pachinko is a pachinko roguelite with city pop vibes. Build up your collection of enchanted balls to fire into the machine. Collect charms to build up powerful synergies between your balls. Listen to some pop music as you expand your Chibi Pop collection!

games.name: The Posthumous Investigation
games.summary: Travel to a noir Rio de Janeiro in 1937 and investigate the mystery behind the murder of Bras Cubas, the famed character created by Machado de Assis. Until the truth is out, you'll be trapped in a time loop, amidst a plot full of conspiracy and treason.

games.name: Convrgence
games.summary: Convrgence is an immersive single-player VR shooter with survival and horror elements. Explore the Chernokamensk exclusion zone: scavenge for loot, fight bandits and hunt for mystical artifacts. However be sure to return to base before duskfall, for when night arrives the hunter becomes the hunted.

games.name: Driving Rogue
games.summary: Arcade driving meets roguelike chaos - fast, intense, and ridiculously addictive. In Driving Rogue, every run is a new story: the city keeps changing, and you’ll need pure focus to push your score to the limit. After each race, hit the shop and craft your build for the longest streak possible.

games.name: Flamecraft
games.summary: Flamecraft is a 1-5 player cozy strategy game filled with magic. Become a Flamekeeper and help adorable dragon artisans find the perfect home. Enchant the town’s stores and fill them with dragon cards as you watch the whimsical shopping district come to life.

games.name: Fountains
games.summary: Master high-skilled combat to uncover the secrets of an ancient, interconnected world.

games.name: Shiba Sweet
games.summary: Woof! You step into the paws of a novice Shiba chef who inherits a dessert shop from your retired grandma. You'll buy ingredients, bake desserts, and sell them in bento boxes. Use your earnings to upgrade the kitchen, decorate the shop, and unlock new recipes to create the best bakery ever!

games.name: YesterSol
games.summary: Unleash your magical spear! Explore a vast inter-connected world, battling enemies sent by Culex, the dark mosquito deity. Throw, recall, and use your spear as a platform through this minimalistic metroidvania made by one developer!

games.name: 20 More, Somehow Even Smaller, Mazes
games.summary: This is a puzzle game with twenty small mazes.

games.name: Airport Baggage Simulator
games.summary: Inspect and sort baggage at the airport! Check suitcases for illegal contents, weight, and destination. Build your own fully automated baggage handling and optimize your terminal's efficiency for maximum profit!

games.name: Akiba Lost
