games.summary: Thirteen years ago, six girls vanished in Akihabara in the unsolved case “Akiba’s Spirited Away”. Daiki Shinjo announces a live-action game based on the incident, gathering six women who embody Akihabara’s subculture. But their story begins to seep into reality. Can AKIBA LOST be finished?

games.name: Au Revoir
games.summary: Use your investigative skills in this point-and-click adventure to retrieve human minds stored in synthetic brains in 2071. Immerse yourself in a retro-futuristic world with neon-noir graphics from the 90s, and uncover a conspiracy that will challenge everything you know.

games.name: Concrete Burial
games.summary: Equipped only with a weapon that consumes your own blood, explore an ancient brutalist catacomb. Beware the Eyes of The Whispering Crypt. Find the 4 artifacts of desire. Confront God.

games.name: Dawson Oaks Trailer Park
games.summary: A proximity voice chat social deduction game where criminals must commit secret crimes while a Supervisor hunts them, and a hidden Snitch betrays them from within.

games.name: Huglings
games.summary: Huglings is a cozy adventure for 1-4 players where you can help the huglings restore their village, which was damaged by the goblins. Create peace as you farm, craft, and decorate your dream home. No pressure, just a peaceful world to explore and a heartwarming journey of friendship and helpfulness!

games.name: Hunter: The Reckoning - Day for Night
games.summary: These monsters aren’t just in the movies! Will you hunt the vampires, werewolves and others stalking Hollywood, or will you become a monster instead? An interactive, text-based game set in the World of Darkness shared story universe.

games.name: Little Witch in the Woods
games.summary: Little Witch in the Woods tells the story of Ellie, an apprentice witch. Explore the mystical forest, help the charming residents, and experience the daily life of the witch.

games.name: Patlabor the Case Files
games.summary: Relive iconic scenes from "Mobile Police Patlabor" in this 3D console action game. Experience dual perspectives: Main Missions as the SV2, and Another Side Missions as their rivals. Hone your pilot skills in Simulator Mode, featuring shooting ranges and Labor duels.

games.name: Police Chief Simulator
games.summary: Welcome to Winston Springs, Officer! The local police station is in urgent need of a Chief of Police, and you’ve been chosen for the job! Handle incoming reports, renovate and expand the station, solve cases, and fight crime!

games.name: United Heist: Facility Zero
games.summary: Work together in separate locations, each filled with unique puzzles that only your partner can help solve. Every move depends on sharp communication through in-game voice chat. Can you crack the code and escape before time runs out?

games.name: Warag
games.summary: Old-school boomer shooter in a world where Slavic myths have merged with technocult. Cut, shoot and survive among cultists, cyber-mutants and traitors in armor. Restore the glory of the Varangian Guard - through blood, steel and ancient wrath.

games.name: 13 Playing Cards of Demon
games.summary: This is a strategy game. Collect and use demon‘s poker skills (similar to Texas Poker rules), regular card skills, abilities, and equipment to defeat enemies.

games.name: 33 Days till Extraction
games.summary: 33 Days till Extraction is a top-down sci-fi action RPG shooter with roguelike progression. Harness brutal firepower and necromantic skills to survive.

games.name: Annie's Dineinn
games.summary:
DineInn is a cooking game where you manage a kitchen and motel while maintaining a relationship with your daughter and the local communities.
Your choices and decisions show impact in the real world. Work hard through the tough times and restore the building for a grand opening.

The gameplay can be described as a combination of elements from farming, poultry, cooking, cleaning, inventory management, restoration,etc together to make a fun gameplay.

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Dacholer
games.summary:
"Dacholer" is an action game released by Nichibutsu in 1983.
Kick a turtle with your powerful legs and take down enemy animals! Watch out for the kappa jumping out of the river!

This title also includes a slightly modified version, Kick Boy, so you can enjoy the differences in visuals and gameplay.

games.name: Bebe Miner
games.summary: Bebe Miner is a fast-paced arcade mining game where every level brings new surprises. Swing your hook, collect valuable treasures, avoid hazards, defeat bosses, unlock characters and climb the online leaderboard.

games.name: Brixonia
games.summary: A cozy multiplayer building sandbox where every world is shared and persistent. Place and break blocks, farm crops, fish, craft gear, and decorate your space alongside other players. No combat, no death penalty, just building at your own pace.

games.name: Bullet Train
games.summary: Welcome on the Bullet Train: destroy enemy towers, collect powerful orbs and improve your train! Fight through escalating enemy territory to defeat the creatures that destroyed your town!

games.name: Cards Everywhere!
games.summary: Cards Everywhere! is a cozy organizing game where you sort through 2,000 scattered cards, collect over 1,500 unique ones, and place them in your collection album. Discover dozens of unique sets and unlock helpful abilities as your collection grows.

games.name: Chill Drive Together
games.summary: An endless road that builds itself as you drive, and no reason to hurry down it. Playable with 1 or 2 players. Press B and the world around you changes on the spot, with no loading. Rain, snow, night skies, real traffic, photo mode.

games.name: Civics Scribble
games.summary: Test your knowledge of U.S. Civics while drawing lines for the inquisitive Mr. Apple to roll on or bounce off of to navigate challenges such as spikes, bouncy blocks and teleporters. Make your way through 96 levels across nine scenic locations based on real-life state and National Parks.

games.name: Condemned: Nightfall
games.summary: A survival horror PvE and PvP set in a Noir Futuristic NYC! Team up with up to two others, or go in alone, and search creature-filled semi open-world map for arcane clues that lead you to a lucrative Bounty. Featuring permadeath consequences, only the best hunters will make it out alive..

games.name: Condo
games.summary: Condo is a short, moody experience about wandering, distracting yourself, and getting lost. Unable to sleep, you navigate a quiet condo complex. There's no rush - just you, the building, its inhabitants, and the stories they hold.

games.name: Console Archives: Crazy Climber
games.summary:
Crazy Climber was released by Nichibutsu in 1986 for an 8 -bit home console.
Watch out for falling objects from above! Ascend a skyscraper while dodging annoying enemies such as Ojamaman, Iron ball, and Gorillas. Successfully reaching the rooftop of the building completes the level. Keep going, climber!!

games.name: Dig & Deal
games.summary: Dig & Deal is a game where you dig underground to find valuable items and bargain with customers to sell what you find. Upgrade your tools, grow your shop, and make the best deals to build your fortune.

games.name: Dub Rumble
games.summary: Dub Rumble is a voice-dubbing party game where you and your friends are the voice actors. Pick a scene, listen to each line once, then record your own performance over the backing track. Solo Booth lets one player dub every character; Couch Party passes the mic around a single PC; Online Party uses room codes, Steam invites and built-in voice chat, ending with a shared screening of the finished dub, "voiced by" credits and automatic performance scoring. Scenes come from community-made dub packs shared through the Steam Workshop, and the game is compatible with existing Choicer Voicer packs. Fi

games.name: Eco Balance
games.summary: The object is to keep a balance of O2 and CO2 in your world as you build it.

games.name: Emberward
games.summary: Emberward is a unique tower defense game that focuses on maze building and interesting tower mechanics. Construct mazes with blocks of different shapes and set up defense towers on them to withstand the onslaught of monsters!

games.name: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave - Dagdan Collection
games.summary: Special edition of Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave with a steelbook case, character art cards, a map of Dagda, and an artbook.

games.name: Frog It Up
games.summary: Frog It Up is an incremental clicker game where you lure frogs to a pond and help them build their own cozy little city. As the pond grows, you’ll decide which upgrades to unlock, shaping how the city expands over time and steering progress in the direction you prefer.

games.name: Gem Quest: Rush
games.summary: A short and replayable time attack game. Enter the dungeon and collect all of the gems as quickly as possible.

games.name: Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising - Legendary Edition
games.summary:
The definitive fighting game experience for beginners and veterans alike—now available in a complete Legendary Edition!

Set Contents:
• Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising base game
• Deluxe Character Pass 1
• Deluxe Character Pass 2
• Additional Character Set (Id)

games.name: Hollow Parish: Dead Frequency
games.summary: Supernatural investigation and management, played from one desk. Read the evidence, identify what is out there, choose who to send, then guide them by radio while the timer runs. A wrong theory kills the people who trusted you. You hear the horror; you never see it.

games.name: Jane Austen's 8-bit Adventure
games.summary: Play as Jane Austen, English novelist, in this 2D platforming adventure. Explore 8-bit England, fight enemies with your quill, and confront characters from Jane Austen's novels!

games.name: Jigsaw Puzzle: Fun Shapes
games.summary: Discover a fresh twist on classic jigsaw puzzles in Jigsaw Puzzle Fun Shapes! Complete 30 colorful and entertaining levels featuring unique puzzle pieces in all kinds of fun and creative shapes.

games.name: Le Mirage Mystique
games.summary: On that beautiful island, a girl witnesses a terrifying miracle.

games.name: Maestro
games.summary: Step into a gorgeous opera house with Maestro, the VR orchestra conducting rhythm game that's the essence of elegance, control, and high-society french sophistication.

games.name: Mepekyon Racing
games.summary: "Mepekyon Racing" is a casual racing game where you can freely drive around an open world. Explore the vast map to discover race courses and aim to place in the races. Enjoy customizing your car and its parts as you strive for the overall Grand Prix championship!

games.name: O.B.O.L
games.summary: Gamble your life on a coin flip against a mysterious old man sent by the CORPORATE to decide whether you keep your job. Trapped in a claustrophobic collapsing metal coffin deep under the ocean, you'll slowly lose your sanity in this eldritch, Lovecraftian horror.

games.name: Operation Eventide
games.summary: Adelle, a former magical girl, wakes up in a robotic body. Still picking up the pieces after her untimely demise, she seeks the truth of her new life. Experience as this 'love song' resounds in the rift of magic and logic in this nostalgic, thrilling yuri sci-fi visual novel.

games.name: Pixel Hunters: Turn Retro Consoles into your Boyfriend
games.summary:
Your dusty old console just blinked.
Catch it before it runs and it might just become your boyfriend.

games.name: Pixel Hunters: Turn Retro Consoles into your Girlfriend
Raiders 1941
games.summary: Raiders 1941 is a fast-paced, vertical scrolling shoot ‘em up that blends exciting retro action of arcade classics, with modern gameplay up to 120hz refresh rate.

games.name: Shape Wars
games.summary: Command. Build. Conquer.

games.name: Shockface
games.summary: The job interview from hell. Chelsea enters a nearly abandoned office building for an interview and gets trapped inside with a serial killer. Explore, solve item-based puzzles, hide when he gets close, and escape. A short 90s-style survival horror with fixed cameras, tank controls and no combat.

games.name: Slash-Out: Fantasy Dueling
games.summary: In Slash-Out, master the sword and shield to survive in a land where every fight is a boss fight. Darkness is rising. An ancient evil has returned. Embark on a quest to restore peace, but be warned, a gauntlet of fearsome opponents stand in your way. Many have tried and failed, will you prevail?

games.name: Spartan VR
games.summary: Welcome to Ancient Greece! Become the main hero of the story of the battle of the Titans, defeat Medusa and save Hermes from death!

games.name: SuperSharket
games.summary: Welcome to the supermarket where fish shop and sharks work!

games.name: Tap Monster Duel
games.summary:
Thrilling timing battles with just one finger!
An adventure to find the ultimate legendary card!

games.name: The Alchemist of Ars Magna
games.summary: The main character enters a school and gains experience in research, study, and love. This is the adventure story of an alchemist who grows through encounters and experiences and paves the way.

games.name: The Bird of the North
games.summary: In 1921: a kidnapping, a revolution... Investigate and uncover the truth behind a dark, mysterious story.

games.name: The Dead We Knew: Open World Survival
games.summary: Explore a dangerous open world, loot abandoned places, build your shelter, produce food, and manage your resources. Survive alone or in co-op against zombies, hostile humans, and the growing dangers that come with the fog.

games.name: Tiny Ramen Shop
games.summary: Run your own Tiny Ramen Shop! It's tiny, yes, but customers are already lining up to try your delicious ramen. Prepare food, stock your warehouse with fresh ingredients, upgrade and decorate your establishment. Hungry customers are waiting for their favorite ramen chef!

games.name: Tower of Dreams
games.summary: Climb your way to the top of the tower in this vertical platforming roguelike! Bound off walls, discover fantastical items, and make use of Dream Knight's sword to bounce off of obstacles!

games.name: Tristia: Chronicles
games.summary: Revitalize Tristia in this updated collection!

games.name: Tristia: Legacy
games.summary: 20 years after its initial release on PC in July 2002, Kogado Studio’s simulation game makes its debut on Switch. While the graphics have been overhauled for the modern era, Eeji Komatsu’s cute and sexy illustrations live on. Experience the origin story and roots of the long-running Tristia series.

games.name: Tristia: Restore
games.summary: Happening in parallel to Tristia:legacy, the story of Tristia:restore follows the genius inventor girl Nanoca Flanka, granddaughter of the legendary inventor and crafter Prospero Flanka, as she is working to revitalize the floundering marine city of Tristia alongside her trusty companions! But this game focuses more on the day to day of running the shop: She has some major crafting projects to complete, but all the while, new orders for smaller objects are coming in for her to complete!

games.name: Tumblebee
games.summary: Captured and lost, you search for your scattered family as you tumble through a hostile cave of silk.

games.name: Two Sides of Hell
games.summary: Blast through procedurally generated alien hellscapes in this twin-stick roguelite platformer. Transform between human and demon to unleash devastating combat and survive the endless cycle of chaos.

games.name: Unmourned VR
games.summary: Unmourned is a first-person psychological horror game where Jason moves into a new house only to be haunted by escalating paranormal events. Driven by fear, he must uncover the truth behind the previous owners' disappearance. Can he solve the mystery before it's too late?

games.name: Witch Please!
games.summary: Help Petra navigate her new life as Head Witch of Fenloft Academy! Juggle classes, train skills, make friends, and solve mysteries in this charming choose-your-own-adventure-style visual novel.

games.name: LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight
games.summary: Rise as the Dark Knight and experience the essential Batman story in a bold, action-packed adventure with hard-hitting combat, an open-world Gotham City, and the signature LEGO charm that fans know and love.

games.name: Aion 2
games.summary: Aion 2 is the only MMORPG built around a world where the sky is the battlefield. Choose your faction, ascend as a Daeva, and fight a faction war across a world 36 times larger than the original.

games.name: Moomintroll: Winter's Warmth
games.summary: From the creators of Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley comes a heartwarming new adventure inspired by the beloved Moomin stories by Tove Jansson. This time, join Moomintroll himself on a charming but cold winter journey.

games.name: EA Sports FC 27
games.summary: Welcome to The World’s Game in EA Sports FC 27. Step into The Grounds to experience a football playground where the streets meet the stadium, and feel greater control in every mode as community-driven innovations deliver more true-to-football gameplay.

games.name: The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival
games.summary: Fight walkers as Rick Grimes, Daryl Dixon and Michonne in a brutal arcade brawler set in the world of AMC’s The Walking Dead. Face ruthless enemies like the Saviors and overwhelming walker swarms as you unleash relentless combos, signature weapon attacks, and crushing finishers.

games.name: NASCAR 26
games.summary: The official game of NASCAR is back and better than ever with NASCAR 26! Battle your way through all four NASCAR National Series in Career, Quick Race, Championship, Multiplayer, or our all new mode featuring The Chase!

games.name: Bot Slash Bot
games.summary: You click - You dash - You slash. Bot slash Bot is a fast-paced, top-down Hack n‘ Slash in which you control a rogue robot slashing & dashing through your former co-machines holding you captive! It's all about speed. Time is running out.

games.name: Deeplanders
games.summary: DEEPLANDERS is a relaxing, minimalist strategic building game where you must satisfy the needs of the Deeplanders to populate the depths. Explore, build, and decorate your own underground kingdom... and when you're ready, embark on a journey to new, unexplored depths!

games.name: Fortune Avenue
games.summary: A competitive board game where players vote to shape their destiny. Transform caravans into 5-star hotels, collect wonders, and earn bounties for bankrupting opponents. Use airports to outmaneuver rivals, organize World Cups to multiply your rent. Can you turn your empire into a global monopoly?

games.name: Nightwater
games.summary: Forage, craft and automate to grow your factory, unlock new technologies and expand your island to discover new biomes. Progress through the ages from sticks and stones to the Bronze Age, the Industrial Era and into the future to uncover the secret of the Lighthouse and escape this reality.

games.name: Sharehouse
games.summary: An otome horror visual novel set in a mysterious sharehouse filled with strange rules. Forge bonds with your fellow housemates as you unravel the secrets hidden within the house, where breaking the rules may mean losing more than your life.

games.name: Sunken Realms
games.summary: Descend into an abandoned underground city to battle orcs, solve puzzles, collect loot, and then return to the surface to upgrade your gear and stats in this modern, old-school dungeon-crawler.

games.name: The Grinch 2: Saving Christmas
games.summary: Play as the Grinch, collect ornaments, master gadgets, and tackle festive challenges to decorate the ultimate Christmas tree for the Whos.

games.name: There Is More
games.summary: In this procedurally generated mining roguelite you dig for precious ores by day and defend your city from relentless monsters by night. Each night the waves attacking the core are getting deadlier - upgrade your gear, unlock powerful spells, and descend deeper. Can you survive 10 nights?

games.name: 100 Goldmine Cats
games.summary: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️ Can you find them all? ️

games.name: Aetherfall
games.summary: Jump, explore, and master new mechanics as you make your way deeper into the world of Aetherfall.

games.name: Amanatsu Location
games.summary:
You visit a private resort on a southern island.
There, you find several girls enjoying their vacation...
The character creation feature has been revamped!
The feel remains the same, but even more beautiful girls await your encounter!

In addition to normal communication, you can tease them with massages and water guns, and sometimes share intimate moments to deepen your bond with each other.
You can fully enjoy a sweet and stimulating summer!

games.name: Anymaker
games.summary: Embark on your creative journey of vehicle design, as you create and operate vehicles to navigate this dangerous open world. Anymaker is a detailed and technical vehicle building game. Design your chassis, build your engine, connect components and cables, program controllers, and test performance.

games.name: Backlot: Hollywood Studio Tycoon
games.summary: A deep Hollywood studio simulation, 1930 to the streaming age. A back lot, a million dollars and no pictures. Commission scripts, sign stars to seven-year contracts, book dates against rival studios, and survive television, home video and everything else that came for the movies.

games.name: Biovoid
games.summary: Biovoid is a creature-building roguelike game that tests your creativity. As a fragile hatchling alone in the abyss, your only objective is to consume and adapt. Will you survive the perils that await and evolve to the top of this alien foodchain?

games.name: Black Hole Grow Forever
games.summary: Shatter drifting matter, feed a growing black hole, and build a sprawling web of permanent upgrades. Every short run unlocks wilder skills, from screen-wide lasers to chain lightning, bombs, and gravity.

games.name: Boardlike
games.summary: Classic tabletop games meet roguelite elements and card-based combat. Dice rolls, fate cards, deadly encounters, minigames, and countless unknowns await you in this strange adventure.

games.name: Cat a Loop
games.summary: Lead a cat in a tactical roguelike auto-battler! Fight your way through 4 dangerous biomes, combine 200+ items to create powerful synergies, and unlock passive abilities. Unravel the mystery of the portal, defeat unique bosses, and save the feline world from the encroaching evil!

games.name: Catskill Mine: 10,000ft Below
games.summary: A single-player horror game set in a decrepit roadside mine attraction. Descend to uncover the mine's dark history, and find a way to escape from the lurking horrors within.

games.name: Chief Cenab: Şahmaran
games.summary: Follow Chief Cenab on the trail of the Şahmaran legend. Told in a black-and-white comic book style with color accents unique to each part, this point-and-click adventure draws you into a deep atmosphere and mysterious events.

games.name: Cozy Fishing Life
games.summary: A cozy little fishing game that lives on your desktop. Adorable animals fish on your wallpaper while you work — collect 300+ fish, grow an aquarium, build your boat fleet, and relax. Idle-friendly, wholesome, always cozy

games.name: Crown Siege
games.summary: A short incremental siege game centered around growing and strengthening an army to defend your kingdom. Seize the crown from an endless wave of enemies for your best chance at survival!

games.name: Cube Crusaders
games.summary: Mow down all who stand in the way of your Crusade. Become a benevolent conqueror, or a brutal oppressor to those you achieve victory over. Your actions decide the fate of the planet.

games.name: Dead Margin
games.summary: Survival is optional, rent is mandatory. Team up in Dead Margin, a brutal 1-4 player co-op horror. Whisper to survive, avoid anomalies, and scavenge scraps. Sell it to pay the greedy customer. Out here, everything has a price. Especially you.

games.name: Dewdrop
games.summary: A physics-based generative music sandbox where droplets collide with hand-drawn vines to create evolving, melodic soundscapes. Create music easily with no prior experience in a calming and ethereal atmosphere.

games.name: Draco and the Seven Scales
games.summary: Take on the role of a pirate captain as he sets sail to save his greatest treasure of all. Draco and the Seven Scales is a retro-inspired adventure that hearkens back to an age of top-down dungeon crawlers and lovable, crunchy pixel art. Melodic shanties will guide your way through this sprawling world full of dangerous enemies, items to collect, and a dark force that seeks to corrupt. Will you break free from a kraken's dooming bargain, or be another victim?

games.name: Dravo's Twisted Show
games.summary: You and up to 4 players are victims of a horror show, having to collaborate to solve multiple puzzles and use cooperative dynamics to find your way out, while surviving the creatures lurking around, hunting you, watching out for haunted events that can be a blessing or a bane for your survival.

games.name: EA Sports FC 27: Ultimate Edition
games.summary:
Ultimate Edition includes:
- 6,000 FC Points over 3 months
- FUT Player Evo slot
- 5 Manager Live Challenge Creation Slots
- 5-Star Senior Scout in Manager Career

Ultimate Edition pre-orders includes:
- Up to 7 days Early Access
- Season 1 Premium Pass

games.name: Eternity Lost: Mystery of Aurum - Collector's Edition
games.summary: Follow a mysterious girl into a hidden underground city built centuries ago by a secret order of Alchemists. Reveal a dangerous conspiracy, search for clues and items, solve puzzles and mini-games, and uncover the secrets of a forgotten world. Will you bring truth to the light?

games.name: Gyaru to Papakatsu: Yarichin Chuunen Oji no Enjoy PacoPaco Life
games.summary:
Middle-aged, still single, no lover, no hobbies, only dull, unsatisfying and repeating work-filled days.
One day, you meet a group of unique gals through a certain matching app, and you end up forming secret relationships with them.

games.name: Havelyn
games.summary:
The game is a relaxed open-world building and exploration experience set in a large, quiet landscape. Players can explore alone or with up to four friends in co-op.

You choose where to settle and build a home anywhere in the world. Resources are gathered from the surrounding land, crops can be planted and harvested, and daily life is shaped by farming, crafting, and expanding your settlement. Nearby villages allow trading and interaction, and over time new residents can join, turning a small home into a growing community.

The world includes forests, meadows, villages, ruins, and hidden locat

games.name: Litter ShiFu
games.summary: Little ShiFu is a first person horror puzzle game. A sudden night visit broke Zhang Qingyi originally quiet high school life. Think the little girl Xuanxuan looking for the lost little Mi as the source, the old community in a strange murder unexpectedly slowly surfaced...

games.name: Medieval Squad Tactics
games.summary: This game is focused on turn based tactical combats. The complexity of the game comes from having to carefully manage your various formations in order to defeat your enemies. Carefully plan your actions to win the battle.

games.name: Megastore Chaos
games.summary: Turn massive messes into perfect order. Sort 30,281 items across 6 unique stores — from supermarkets and bookstores to electronics, games, wine and shoes — while unlocking skills that make organizing faster and more satisfying.

games.name: Neighbor Fight
games.summary: Multiplayer first person strategy game with lots of destruction. Destroy the house of your neighbor by throwing furniture and build a business by selling weed!

games.name: Neural Maze
games.summary: 2 neurons. 2 joysticks. One brain must control both at the same time: yours. Guide your lost neurons through increasingly convoluted mazes – reversed controls, power cuts, memory mode – under the watchful eye of an overwhelmed doctor. Is your brain ready?

games.name: Night Alley
games.summary: Every night in this narrow alley is never the same. Light all 10 candles before something in the dark decides you shouldn't. One mistake... and the flame goes out for good.

games.name: Noctiria
games.summary: Noctiria is a horror roguelite deckbuilder set in a decaying 1990s city. Choose one of six heroes, combine brutal status effects, manage your Sanity and consumable relics, and permanently upgrade your arsenal between descents.

games.name: Noxcode
games.summary: Reach the TOP by any means possible. Run, jump, climb, fly, or even fall your way up in this chaotic jump quest platformer. Master crazy movement, discover wild shortcuts, and push your skills to the limit!

games.name: Parasite Elevator
games.summary: A space where parasites in human form lurk. You are trapped inside this bizarre and unsettling place. Count the number of parasites hidden throughout the corridor, then use the elevator to proceed to the correct floor. Choose the wrong floor, and the elevator will begin to consume you.

games.name: Parisian Brasserie Simulator
games.summary: Manage your own bistro in Paris and turn it into the place to be! Create menus, serve customers, and master every detail to grow your restaurant. Manage supplies, ensure top-notch service, and make your mark on the city of lights. Will you become the next Parisian brasserie institution?

games.name: Paver: Tidy Up Together
games.summary: Transform a chaotic area into a satisfying work of art. Follow the paver layout plan and place 4,064 pavers in their correct locations. Work alone or together with friends, develop useful skills, and restore the plaza piece by piece.

games.name: Pillagers: The Poisoned Throne
games.summary: Lead a band of goblin rebels through a brutal turn-based tactics campaign. Train your roster, rebuild your fortress, manage scarce resources, and survive a war where every mistake can leave your army weaker than before.

games.name: Poopy's Playland
games.summary: Play as a grieving mother whose child went missing in a playland one year ago. Use your trusty flashlight to navigate through the dark, solve replayable puzzles to progress forward, and hide from the unstable killer mascots! Investigate the mysteries and find out the truth...

games.name: Rogue Racer
games.summary: Race across the continent against the police and rival racers alike, survive bizarre encounters and become the Rogue Racer.

games.name: Runner Gunner
games.summary: Race through the streets in this third-person action runner, dodging obstacles or shooting them out of the way. Collect points, buy powerful upgrades, and optimize your run to beat your high score.

games.name: Save Mom
games.summary: A cartoon-inspired co-op action game where you and your siblings must protect Mom as she drives her old motorhome across a bizarre post-apocalyptic America. Gather resources, upgrade the RV, build defenses, and fight off mutants and cultists — all while Mom insists on seeing the good in everyone. Play solo or with up to 3 friends in chaotic family co-op fun.

games.name: Skyreach
games.summary: Climb a 960-metre tower in this single-player 3D precision platformer. Every platform moves, crumbles or blinks on a rhythm you can learn. There are no checkpoints and no fall damage: one misjudged jump can drop you all the way back to the ground.

games.name: Tape 101
games.summary: A psychological horror descending through liminal spaces shaped by the Kübler-Ross model - the five stages of grief: denial, anger, bargaining, depression, and acceptance - where your perception and an RC car are the only tools to grasp what’s real

games.name: The Door Factory
games.summary: The Door Factory is a first-person horror game where you inspect mysterious doors before they are sent into production. Step inside, observe the environment, spot anomalies, and decide whether each door should be approved or reported.

games.name: The Rhapsody of Zephyr Remastered
games.summary: 28 years later, Cyrano’s tragic journey of revenge begins anew. The War of Genesis: The Rhapsody of Zephyr returns in a remastered edition with HD 16:9 widescreen, full voice acting, and quality-of-life improvements. Rediscover an epic tale of tragedy and destiny.

games.name: Too Many Balls
games.summary: Too Many Balls is a satisfying incremental clean-up simulator. Start small with basic pickup tools and a tiny basket. Collect golf balls, basketballs, tennis balls, ping-pong balls, and more. Drop them off, earn money, and reinvest every run into faster tools, bigger hauls, and better upgrades.

games.name: Tooned Out Duo Dippin
games.summary: Welcome To Tooned Out Duo Dippin!!! This game is a body of work that has been painfully derived from years of suffering/studying Become A Monster Player! In this All Out Fantasy Arcade Racing heart pumping new franchise. Let your jaw drop as you duo dip through Pure Imagination and Hard work.

games.name: Toxic Yuri
games.summary: An overworked office lady discovers a sludge girl abandoned in a box in an alleyway and takes her home. A poisonous and fluffy romance begins. Experience the most toxic love story the world has ever seen.

games.name: Unmurk
games.summary: You only see the outer edges of the puzzle. Put the puzzles back into place to reveal a hidden voxel object.

games.name: Wail of Despair
games.summary: "Wail of Despair" follows a non-binary shut-in, trying to recover from their isolation and face the world once again. Facing a horrific, overstimulating, colorful and judgmental world Confronted with their past scars and mistakes, taunted with everything they've lost by a strange shadow that won't leave them alone and always follows. Can they readapt and learn to return to being something resembling okay? Or will they be swept away by the vibrant pulsating horror that threatens them back into the darkness?

games.name: Waterjacked!
games.summary: Waterjacked! is a roguelike puzzler where you are a cactus with a gun. Chosen to wield the GRID, construct ever-more complex Rube Goldberg machines to outwit the invading robots keen on stealing all the water in The Valley. Will you be the hero to save your people?

games.name: We Are Sisters
games.summary: We Are Sisters is a psychological horror experience that takes you deep beneath the forests of Eastbane. Solve puzzles and uncover dark secrets as you venture further underground, drawing ever closer to discovering what happened to your childhood friend, Aleks

games.name: WomboCombo
games.summary: Fight through hordes of mobs in a roguelike-style challenge by hitting the correct key sequence. Test your reflexes, build your character, and survive the chaos as each stage ramps up. Rack up massive combos and push your limits with every run.

games.name: Word Sylla
games.summary: Hexa Word Sylla Word Submit Puzzle offers a dynamic gameplay experience that will keep you hooked for hours. Delve into the depths of your vocabulary and logic skills as you unravel syllabic mysteries and unlock the full potential of the English language.

games.name: Youkashi no Haitokuai: Junshin Tenshi ha Dakarete Iromeku
ZuOnline
games.summary: Return to the legendary world of Zu Online - a martial arts MMORPG reborn. Explore ancient skies, master cultivation, and battle for immortality in a world inspired by Chinese mythology.

games.name: Night Record: Thin Walls
games.summary: Vadim, a maintenance worker in a decaying post-Soviet apartment, leaves town to care for his sick mother, asking his wife to take over his duties. As she settles into the routine, the building begins to feel off quiet in all the wrong ways.

games.name: Rusted Awakening
games.summary: A gothic horror shooter set in a rusted industrial nightmare. Inspired by John Romero, David Lynch, and Doom 64.

games.name: Toonsouls
games.summary: Create, play, and share your own chaotic 2D platforming levels! Inspired by classic cartoons, powered by your creativity, and fueled by one simple truth: My game is good. The algorithm just ignores me.

games.name: Bound by Destiny
games.summary: Control a dark dungeon as the Viber Lord, in an attempt to trap Princess Mistynail. Place and trigger traps, unleash creatures, and strike at key moments to block her path as she tries to find the exit. Prevent her escape and pave the way for your rebirth and revenge on her bloodline!

games.name: Day Off Simulator
games.summary: Unwind and have a blast in the "Day Off Simulator"! Give your boss a slap, relax with interactive musical instruments, and enjoy various leisure activities. A unique blend of excitement, relaxation, and creativity awaits you!

games.name: Deep Nightmare: Phobias
games.summary: Travel between the real world and your dreams, dive into your subconscious, and survive your own fears. In this mix of Survival Horror and Psychological Horror, you'll play through a collection of the scariest phobias out there while being constantly hunted by fear itself.

games.name: Emberwall
games.summary: Emberwall is a roguelite tower defense game where you reshape enemy paths with tetromino walls, harvest resources, reveal a fog-covered wilderness, and combine powerful towers and elemental upgrades to defend your castle.

games.name: Night of the Living Bubble
games.summary: NOT YOUR AVERAGE NIGHT SHIFT... When clocking into work, you find that your business has been overrun by monsters borne from the products on the shelves. Constructed by a mad scientist bent on world domination, only YOU can stop them and save the world by shooting monsters with your Nailgun.

games.name: Panic Files: Buried Sanity
games.summary: Your first day at the local mine got a hell of a twist when the tunnels caved in. Can you escape when the only way out is going deeper? Avoid the deadly creatures, push through hallucinations and remember: Don't panic.

games.name: Parkour Obby: Magma Run
games.summary: Keep moving!

games.name: Red Hallways: Horror
games.summary: The exit is right there... but you can't leave.

games.name: Screw It
games.summary: Screw It is a cozy, realistic organizing simulator where you sort 777 nails + 1 screw and tidy up your workbench. Use different tools to fix and organize various types of nails. No abilities No pressure, just fix, sort, stock and enjoy the satisfaction of stocking nails in a relaxing environment.

games.name: Server-Admin Simulator
games.summary: Build your datacenter empire from scratch. Buy hardware, manage contracts, hire staff and outsmart rivals. Face random events, hack the competition and survive the market. Moddable. Multiplayer. No two runs alike.

games.name: That Cloud Looks Like
games.summary: Huh? This cloud looks like... something! What do you see in a randomly generated cloud? The drawer adds clues inside the cloud, while the other players try to guess the answer from as few clues as possible. Compete using your imagination and intuition in this online drawing quiz game.

games.name: The Furry Protocol
games.summary: Survive and escape from the scientific research complex in the Siberian forests and uncover the secrets of the corporation that built this complex.

games.name: The Options Menu
games.summary: The Options Menu is a game where you play as a 'Player' and experience a life filled with Options. Explore countless endings to uncover a game that may surprise you as the real friend all along was your Options Menu in this Comedic Story.

games.name: Trash Wars
games.summary: A 3D hybrid tower defense game! Defend against trash, send trash. Manage resources, build turrets, automate defenses, and survive against pollution.

games.name: Darby is Here Forever
games.summary: Help our little vampire Darby getting out from his eternal prison. Log on into a difficult 2D pixel platformer, find out secret rooms, defeat great bosses and end up discovering why Darby has been imprisoned in his own castle!

games.name: Dear Journey...
games.summary: Run your own little travel agency. Plan itineraries with the cards you are dealt. Satisfying traveller moods and needs to help grow your agency’s reputation.

games.name: DIY Dadish
games.summary: Create your own adventure and share it with the world! Everyone's favorite radish dad is back, but this time the story is up to you! in DIY Dadish gives players the ability to design any Dadish level they can imagine.

games.name: Lumiric Stage
games.summary: Create musical content with real-time MIDI visualization, Magic Piano, real-time sheet music, built-in camera tools, and cinematic Stages. Design and share custom particle effects as portable .mvfx files. Built for creators, pianists, educators, performers, and streamers.

games.name: The Confined: Basement
games.summary: Wake up in a dark basement as a victim with no memory of your past. Can you uncover your true identity and solve the mystery of your past by collecting the cryptic notes left by your captor? Face the brutal truths and find a way to escape this nightmare alive.

games.name: Samson
games.summary: Samson returns to Tyndalston, a city that shaped him hard, where every fight is close and every escape is earned. He owes dangerous people more than he can pay, and they’re using his sister to force his hand. The clock is running. The only way out is through anyone who stands in his way.

games.name: Dressmaker
games.summary:
Dressmaker is a cozy game inspired by real dressmaking.

Become a dressmaker, choose dress designs, cut out fabric and sew them all together to satisfy (or sabotage!) customers.

games.name: Eagle Knight Paradox
games.summary: Eagle knight paradox takes you (the player) into a doble experience, one of them is the role of a powerful mecha trying to protect a space city from space fanatics. On the other hand, the game sets you as the role of Ian (the pilot) building relationships around the city or whats left of it.

games.name: The Rabbit Haul
games.summary: The Rabbit Haul is a tower defense farming game with roguelite elements where you grow a healthy ecosystem of plants that yield crops during the day and that will help defend your farm from the Trash Panda Posse at night.

games.name: Brave New Wonders
games.summary: Automate, optimize, and build vast factories in a post-apocalyptic automation game for those who have evolved beyond conveyor belts. Command intelligent robots that obey your plain-text commands in any language, explore the ruins of a lost civilization, and rebuild humanity one machine at a time.

games.name: Ghoul Fright
games.summary: Ghoul Fright is a physics based FPS Survival Beat em up with a 90/2000s cartoon vibe, fight dangerous Ghouls as you cause destruction and chaos in your way while hell unleashes in heated Ghoul waves. ¿Ready to Fright?

games.name: Soggy Beans
games.summary: Fish will come, fish will go. Take photos, collect beans, decorate your seascape, then relax or do other things while your friends swim by in this calming side-idler.

games.name: The Stickman
games.summary: The Stickman is a movement-based FPS inspired by Titanfall 2 and Trackmania! Shatter PvE leaderboard records, battle friends in PvP, or create custom stages with the built-in Level Editor!

games.name: Back to 21
games.summary: A narrative RPG life-sim about the dreams you talked yourself out of. You’ve been given a chance to go back to 21. Build relationships, explore new paths, and pursue the passion you once buried. Beneath it all lies a deeper truth about the world that contains you. Or perhaps… that you contain.

games.name: Backframes: Escape Together
games.summary: Backframes: Escape Together is a cooperative horror game for 1–4 players. Explore dark levels, solve dangerous puzzles, and escape from sinister entities. Use your voice to interact with objects, uncovering unexpected paths to survival.

games.name: Backrooms: Code Yellow
games.summary: An online 1-6 player co-op game about investigating and collecting data in the infinitely massive Backrooms with your fellow employees. Explore. Do your job. Return alive.

games.name: Citadel
games.summary: Awake from your slumber and venture out to the mighty Citadel.

games.name: Deified
games.summary: Forge your strategy around powerful relics in this turn-based tactical roguelite. Choose your slots, manage their constraints, and face formidable bosses.

games.name: Delverium
games.summary: Explore, Build, Farm, Craft and Fight in this vast procedurally generated survival adventure for up to 4 players. What you do is up to you, but the deeper you delve, the more you uncover the hidden truth. Could you be the hero to restore stability to the land and put an end to the invading "Faults"?

games.name: Echoes of Mora
games.summary: Embark on a mysterious journey, filled with intriguing interactions and meaningful encounters, as you explore a sunken village and travel through time to help Mora find her lost brother. Playable in VR and non-VR on PC.

games.name: Eon Survivor
games.summary: Harvest vital resources behind enemy lines and survive relentless waves! Deploy from a carrier forced to retreat, collect fast, and secure your cargo before time runs out. Push your luck in this fast-paced rogue-lite space shooter—or be left behind.

games.name: Fruitbearer
games.summary: A visceral reimagining of the Suika-style physics puzzler, rebuilt as a punishing dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder. Awaken as forgotten deity of bounty, stripped of grandeur, now facing sunless barrens and monsters. To restore balance, you must grow. To grow, you must sacrifice.

games.name: Guinea Pig Gunner
games.summary: Guinea Pig Gunner is a run-and-gun platformer with boomer shooter DNA. It fuses skill-based action platforming with a massive arsenal of weapons.

games.name: Guys with Magnets
games.summary: Guys with Magnets is a co-op physics parkour game about using a supercharged magnet to move through island courses with up to 8 players. Pull, repel, swing, explode, solve magnetic puzzles, and try to reach the finish together, even when everything goes wrong.

games.name: Happy Wheels
games.summary: Try to get to the finish line in this twisted game's user-created tracks. Having your limbs still attached is optional.

games.name: IGTAP: An Incremental Game That's Also a Platformer
games.summary: Amass an army of clones to follow your tightly-optimised path. Generate massive amounts of power to upgrade your production and movement abilities.

games.name: Invasion Survivors
games.summary: Invasion Survivors is a fast-paced bullet heaven and bullet hell arena shooter with roguelike elements. Explore a colorful and chaotic world where survival depends on your skills, quick reflexes, and every choice you make.

games.name: Lootborne
games.summary: Lootborne is a dark fantasy desktop autobattler. Build your character, loot gear, push through PvE stages, and challenge other players in async PvP duels while battle rages at the edge of your screen.

games.name: Mad Metal
games.summary: Mad Metal is a vehicle combat roguelite set in a dying America. Customize your vehicle, master precision car-to-car combat, and fight through dynamic arenas as a broken cop races to rescue his daughter and stop an AI-driven apocalypse.

games.name: Museum Disarter
games.summary: The Museum is a complete disARTer! Organize hundreds of paintings, figure out which absurdly informal description belongs to each artwork, and restore order to the gallery. Deduce and sort in this cozy single-player first-person simulator.

games.name: Non-League Manager
games.summary: Manage one of over 1,000 real non-league clubs through the English football pyramid. Day jobs, ground grading, gate receipts, cup runs, and a world where clubs can fold around you. Football management at its most real.

games.name: Normal Golf Game
games.summary: A very normal golf simulator. Hit anything. Shoot from anywhere. But remember: you’re not leaving until Luke Muscat himself (Fruit Ninja, Jetpack Joyride) is satisfied.

games.name: Roadhouse Simulator
games.summary:
Roadhouse is the prelude to Gas Station Simulator where you take on the role of the uncle and explore his humble beginnings. Start as a bouncer at a roadhouse on Route 66 and work your way up to running the entire business.

In this 1st person view simulator game you deal with a multitude of customers and various biker gangs, manage the roadhouse, tend to the bar, master the grill, stock the right supplies and acquire more territories to widen your influence.

games.name: Rogue Kingdom
games.summary: In Rogue Kingdom, Online Roguelike meets Settlement Building! Clear dungeons, claim them, fill them with NPCs, and defend them in an online world. Grow stronger through loot, mining, crafting, magic, and help from other players.

games.name: Street Fighter Alpha: Warriors' Dreams
games.summary: This version of Street Fighter Alpha: Warriors' Dreams features an arranged soundtrack, a dedicated two-player Versus Mode and also a Training Mode allowing players to practice their techniques and combos on a non-hostile character.

games.name: Sylv and the Ancient Tree
games.summary: The balance of Sunroot Island is fading. Join Sylv, guardian of the Ancestral Tree, in a vibrant platforming RPG adventure. Reclaim the elemental energy stolen by the egocentric Umbra before the biomes collapse and the corrupted wildlife takes full control.

games.name: Thanks for the Soup
games.summary: The job's simple: Go around town and satisfy your customers with some nice and hot soup. Hop on your bicycle and go around town, make some money, buy items, take care of your cat, and much more in this immersive horror simulator.

games.name: The Decree
games.summary:
The Decree is a 1–3 player cooperative horror game about hunting souls, surviving a relentless 90-second clock, and making impossible choices when The Button appears.

Track wandering souls, capture them under pressure, fight Soul Drainers, and fulfill each Order before time runs out.

When The Button appears, choose PROCEED or STAY without knowing what either choice will cause.

Push your run further, survive the Orders, and decide when to extract—or keep going until the Decree breaks you.

games.name: Veil of the Damned
games.summary: Beyond the veil of the damned, face danger and treasure. Master your skills to survive the labyrinth.

games.name: Yandere Virus
games.summary: An online co-op horror game for up to 4 players. Play solo or with your friends to collect Platonic Pumpkins and save your precious friend infected by the terrifying Yandere Virus.

games.name: Control Resonant
games.summary: Explore a warped Manhattan on the brink of paranatural annihilation in this thrilling action-adventure RPG. Unleash the extraordinary powers of Dylan Faden as he fights for his humanity and survival against a reality-bending cosmic threat.

games.name: Dune: Awakening
games.summary: Dune: Awakening is an open-world survival game set on the desert planet Arrakis. Players create a custom character and must manage thirst, maintain stillsuits, and contend with environmental hazards like sandstorms, extreme heat, and roaming sandworms. The game involves scavenging resources, crafting equipment, building shelters, and competing with other players to harvest and transport spice. As players progress, they advance through phases from basic survival to leading a guild, eventually participating in faction warfare between House Atreides and House Harkonnen. The game features single-p

games.name: Silent Hill: Townfall
games.summary:
Silent Hill: Townfall is a full-length, self-contained psychological horror set against the cold, isolated backdrop of Scotland, 1996.

Players can explore St. Amelia, where fog-soaked streets, abandoned communities, and forgotten corners tell their story through atmosphere and history. Reality and delusion subtly intertwine, luring players into the depths of St. Amelia's grounded, tangible world.

games.name: Graveyard Keeper II
games.summary: The most inaccurate medieval cemetery sim is back! Restore The Town, manage the graveyard, automate production, lead your undead army into battle and turn the zombie problem into a thriving business! Graveyard Keeper 2 is the grotesque sequel that's deeper than six feet, and more unhinged than ever!

games.name: Rivage
games.summary: Rivage is an immersive sci-fi puzzle adventure set aboard the A.R.E.S. space station trapped in a space phenomenon. Wake up as Miranda, forced to explore, solve intricate puzzles to unravel the fate of your missing crew.

games.name: Well Dweller
games.summary: Well Dweller is a dark fairy-tale metroidvania full of charming characters living in a wretched kingdom. Play as Glimmer- a tiny bird armed with a matchstick- who must burn the wicked queen to save his family.

games.name: False Hero
games.summary: False Hero is a fast-paced soulslike adventure where you steal your enemies’ attacks and chain them into deadly combos. Explore the corrupted Land of the Gods and put your combat skills to the true test in challenging boss fights. Will you fight for the Gods or become an apostle of Death?

games.name: Nocturne
games.summary: The afterlife is now digital. Discover that eternal life comes with sacrifice in a genre-defying RPG with unique rhythm combat.

games.name: Ved: Recure
games.summary: Ved: Recure is a fast-paced action roguelite where you play as an adult trapped in the 1000th game you bought but never played. You’ll wield fully customizable buff chains to face off against formidable foes and strategic builds to conquer this 1000th game and make your way back to reality.

games.name: Nighthawks
games.summary:
"Nighthawks is the brand new urban fantasy RPG from Wadjet Eye Games (The Blackwell Legacy, Unavowed, Technobabylon) and writer/designer Richard Cobbett (Sunless Sea/Sunless Skies, The Long Journey Home)."

"Nighthawks is a mix of story-driven RPG and undead life-simulation, where every decision you make is another move in your chess game against the world. Invest your time into learning new skills or honing your fighting style as you uncover the city's mysteries and venture deep into its darkest secrets. Gather fellow outcasts to your side, binding them with favours and choosing when to cash

games.name: Stuntboost
games.summary: Race against time on tracks of cardboard and toys to break records, climb leaderboards and become the fastest skater your online-neighborhood has ever seen!

games.name: EbiTapes
games.summary: Go on an adventure to meet fun new friends, help them out, and create delicious beats along the way! Record the sounds of the world and make your own cool music.

games.name: Little Ghost
games.summary: Chill metroidvania maximizes non-linear exploration & puzzle-platforming. Frequent checkpoints, no currency, no combat. Gain friends & abilities. Collectables-as-media; tarot cards, weird podcasts, and songs from over 20 bands; all found within a surreal papercraft world.

games.name: Obscurity: Unknown Threat
games.summary: Obscurity: Unknown Threat is a horror shooter game where a team of soldiers must survive against a hidden foe. The game contains both conventional symmetrical FPS game modes as well as asymmetrical battles vs the Obscurity.

games.name: PSI: Pressure Climbing
games.summary: A movement-based climbing game where you ascend on a suicide mission to save an amphibian cargo cult.

games.name: Silent Hill: Townfall Deluxe Edition
games.summary:
Silent Hill: Townfall is a full-length, self-contained psychological horror set against the cold, isolated backdrop of Scotland, 1996.

Players can explore St. Amelia, where fog-soaked streets, abandoned communities, and forgotten corners tell their story through atmosphere and history. Reality and delusion subtly intertwine, luring players into the depths of St. Amelia's grounded, tangible world.

The Deluxe Edition contains the following content.

Pre-order bonuses:
- CRTV Style: Rusted
- CRTV Style: Beach Edition
- 48-hour early access

Deluxe Edition contents:
- Full game
- Digital artbook

games.name: Woman Simulator
games.summary: Experience life as a woman - cleaning, cooking, laundry, and no time to rest. Full immersion into the world of everyday chaos!

games.name: Astromental Incremental
games.summary: Mesmerizing idle clicker incremental game where you build your own star systems and mine matter amid the ever-rising chaos of colliding asteroids, comets, and planets. Upgrades, Skill Tree, Abilities, Research, Perks, crits, chain lightning, burns, and more. Idle build or clicker build - you choose.

games.name: Breakout Garage
games.summary: Breakout Garage is an open-world driving and racing simulator built around old-school American muscle, deep tuning, drag racing, and the garage life.

games.name: BuGarden
games.summary: 《BuGarden》 is a cozy idle flower-growing game that lives in the corner of your desktop. Plant seeds, water and fertilize them at your own pace, harvest cute flowers and fruits, and deal with a few playful bugs—nothing messy, just a calm little garden keeping you company.

games.name: CatstaC
games.summary: A puzzle game where the goal is to reunite two cats with symetric movement, in as few moves as possible, while you collect very green (and shiny) stars!

games.name: Control Resonant: Digital Deluxe Edition
games.summary:
Expand your experience with the CONTROL Resonant Digital Deluxe Edition which includes:
- Main Game
- Digital Artbook
- Original Soundtrack
- Untapped Artifact (Wallet)
- Starter Resource Bundle
- AWE Mission Outfit

games.name: Crown of Hispania
games.summary: Rewrite the Reconquista in a grand strategy game set in 11th-century Iberia, where population, religion, and war evolve dynamically based on your decisions. Move armies freely across 300 hand-built provinces, manage a deep medieval economy, and face an AI that actually fights back.

games.name: Cupid Parasite
games.summary:
Sent to the Human Realm on her heavenly mission of “matchmaking”, Lynette meets her biggest challenge yet: the infamous Parasite 5. In order to help these five hopeless men find true love, Lynette and her team concoct the perfect matchmaking plan… REALITY TV.

Will Lynette be able to live up to her name as top bridal advisor and Cupid, or will her dreams get cancelled?

games.name: Curve Fever
games.summary: Curve Fever is a high-energy, multiplayer snake game with powers. Survive each round and battle-it-out online against opponents, utilizing your own customized ship to win. Climb the ranked ladder and level up, earning new powers with each new level!

games.name: Dash Dot Die
games.summary: Dash Dot Die is a first-person Morse puzzle game set in a maze of forgotten rooms, hallways, and airducts. Your past has caught up with you. Someone is determined to make you suffer just as they once did. Trapped in their twisted game, you must endure the same fate and overcome every challenge.

games.name: DinoBones: Tidy Up the Museum
games.summary: Dino Bones: Tidy Up the Museum! is a cozy skeleton restoration sim. Identify, collect, and piece together around 2,000 scattered dinosaur bones. Feel chaos turn into order, and with every skeleton you rebuild, the museum reveals another secret.

games.name: Galvatein: Adventurer’s Guild
games.summary: "Welcome, adventurer! What quest have you completed today?” A classic fantasy guild reception simulation — 『Galvatein: Adventurer’s Guild』

games.name: Gunclone Arena
games.summary: Gunclone Arena is a top-down looter-shooter roguelite. Fight as a super-clone that can wield 6 weapons, a Beam and Shield in a dystopian TV show! Loot thousands of weapon variants with ricochet, detonate, shock, pierce and more. Stack build-changing Mods. Notice: Escape is grounds for perma-recycle.

games.name: Important People of History: Presidents - Abraham Lincoln
games.summary:
Learn all about Abraham Lincoln in this visual novel biography containing rare photos of Lincoln’s hat from the day he was shot, the Lincoln Memorial, where he gave the Gettysburg address, and much more. Lawyer, President, Emancipator - this is Abraham Lincoln!

Part of the Important People of History series:
1. George Washington
2. Thomas Jefferson
3. Abraham Lincoln

All three games about US Presidents releasing in 2026 to commemorate the 250th anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence back in 1776

Proudly made in the Washington DC area

games.name: Isernsmith
games.summary: Isernsmith is a gothic action-adventure RPG where you have to explore dungeons, gather resources, and forge new weapons and tools to overcome a tyrannical order.

games.name: It's Fine
games.summary: It’s Fine is an active incremental/upgrade clicker game about releasing v1.0 of your game on time.

games.name: Jarred Defense
games.summary: A difficult maze-building tower defense about Yuki, a cat trapped in a teleporting jar. Protect it from robots and endure its unhelpful comments. Build your own paths, adapt as levels change, unlock powerful items, and uncover Yuki’s story. A love letter to Warcraft III custom maps.

games.name: Lucky Break
games.summary: In this roguelike deckbuilder you’re an addict. Deep in debt to the mob, a little drunk, and out of time. Just one more spin, and then you'll quit.

games.name: Packed Lair
games.summary: You are an evil lord with a hero problem and not nearly enough floor space. Draft buildings, pack them into your cramped lair, toil to earn money to expand, create powerful monster synergies, and send your chaotic army of minions to repel wave after wave of heroic do-gooder pests.

games.name: Panzer Deck
games.summary: Panzer Deck is a tactical card-based war game. Deploy resources to recruit units and equipment. Use maneuver cards to reposition forces, maximize their potential, and synergize units for powerful combos. Secure victory on WWII’s Western Front battlefields.

games.name: Pool Loop
games.summary:
You are trapped in an endlessly looping indoor swimming pool. Inspect the pool carefully and look for anomalies.

If anything feels wrong, press the RED button.
If everything seems normal, press the GREEN button.

Make the wrong call, and the loop continues.

games.name: Questfarers of the Stone
games.summary: a Dark fantasy themed 2D hand-drawn point and click adventure, following Kabe on a quest into a corrupted part of the Stone. Solve the puzzles of this world, or be lost in it.

games.name: Realindustry
games.summary: Realindustry is a hyper-realistic industrial automation simulator that blends deep strategy with authentic scientific principles, challenging players to build, automate, and optimize complex production chains using 236 real-world materials and 354 production processes. Developed by AssemblyPrime, the game features a unique "mystery" theme where your industrial expansion is monitored by an unknown entity, adding narrative tension to the core loop of resource management, automation, and technological progression. Across multiple technological tiers, players must master genuine chemical engineeri

games.name: Rogue Hanafuda
games.summary: A roguelike deckbuilding game meets Hanafuda. Never played Hanafuda before? No problem. Jump right in and discover an addictive roguelike card game that's easy to learn but impossible to put down.

games.name: Screenside Fisher
games.summary: Sit back and relax with a desktop fishing game that stays in the corner of your screen. Catch fish, cook recipes, upgrade your gear, and complete your collection guide. Customize your character’s look and even design your very own custom fish to catch!

games.name: Seekers Alliance: Hero's Journey
games.summary: Seekers Alliance: Hero's Journey is a role-playing card game set in the Seekers Alliance universe. Venture into the mysterious Sovereign's Island with a diverse cast of Heroes, strengthening your decks through battles and encounters; confront powerful foes and uncover the Island's hidden secrets.

games.name: Slay the King
games.summary: Lead a tribe of warriors to defeat a corrupt king and reclaim your land

games.name: Somnius
games.summary: Somnius is a chaotic co-op extraction game for up to 6 players. Dive into collapsing dreams, turn anything into ammo, feed the portal to buy more time, and save the Dreamer before the dream burns away.

games.name: Sproutmart: Farm & Grocery Sim
games.summary: Run your own grocery store. Stock shelves, scan items at the checkout, and keep the store moving — solo or with friends. Farm, process, and fish for goods to expand what you can sell.

games.name: True Vikings
games.summary: Choose your own path: become a powerful jarl or a legendary king, or perhaps switch sides and follow the path of a knight, reliving the story of the Duke of Normandy.

games.name: Aniimo
games.summary: Aniimo is a free-to-play, next-gen creature-catching open-world RPG. Explore the vast continent of Idyll, Twine with unique Aniimo, unlock new abilities. Travel to a sky-floating metropolis, meet other Pathfinders, and battle in exciting competitions. Choose your Aniimo and begin your epic journey!

games.name: Stick It to the Stickman
games.summary: Stick it to the Stickman is a practical guide for anybody seeking to climb the corporate ladder in the fastest way possible. A groin-kicking, staple-gunning, chainsaw-wielding roguelike brawler loaded with high-impact, physics-based combat, copious amounts of coffee, and weaponized farts!

games.name: Fallen Tear: The Ascension
games.summary: Fallen Tear: The Ascension is an epic adventure set in a vast magical world where you’ll fight dangerous beasts, defy corrupt gods, and face many challenges, all in an attempt to bring balance back to your world.​Embark on this journey with Hira, a mysterious young boy who seeks the truth about his forgotten past. Along the way, bond with many fully-voiced characters to unlock new skills and abilities that will aid you in your battle through environments that constantly change and react to your choices - all in classic, hand-drawn animation.

games.name: Otterly Lost
games.summary: Play as Otto, a curious sea otter swept far from home. In this story-rich adventure, explore wild forests, dive underwater, glide over rocky canyons, and climb your way back. Meet friendly animals, complete heartfelt quests, and enjoy soft challenges, at your own pace!

games.name: Bunker Tidy Up
games.summary: Bunker Tidy Up is a relaxing game about organizing a bunker. Arrange 17,276 supplies on shelves, categorize resources, and relax!

games.name: Furyball: Rogue Revenge
games.summary: Furyball is a fast-paced action roguelite where your only weapon is a bouncing bullet ball. Control the chaos, shatter enemies, and survive sport-themed arenas inspired by pinball and grindhouse cinema.

games.name: Island Restoration
games.summary: Bring procedurally generated islands back to life. Explore different biomes and damage scenarios. Relax as you clean, upgrade your tools, rescue wildlife, and watch each island return to its natural beauty. Customize your ship and decorate your own private island.

games.name: Lawn Mowing Simulator 2
games.summary: Head to the USA and grow your own business with a realistic and relaxing lawn mowing experience! With brand new grass tech and reworked systems based on player feedback to the original, plus licensed equipment from around the world.

games.name: Nomori
games.summary: Nomori is a mind-bending puzzle game where you need to control time and space to journey through a shattered spirit world. Take shortcuts through portals, rotate your perspective, and control the flow of time to move forward, whichever way that is.

games.name: Thalia
games.summary: Thalia is a fast paced roguelike action game. You as Thalia has been summoned to this ancient place where death is not the end, it is only the beginning. Fight hoards of enemies, giant bosses and improve in an infinite mechanic where death only makes you stronger!

games.name: Absolutely Nothing Good
games.summary: Do you believe that on Halloween night, the line between the world of the living and the dead becomes thinner? If not, then youre probably used to simply buying children off with candy. But imagine being stuck on a night shift in an ordinary roadside minimarket...

games.name: Bait Soul
games.summary: Bait Soul is a top-down Dungeon Crawler Roguelike. It blends dungeon exploration with Survivors-style auto-attacks. Accessible yet deep, it retains the thrill of looting, with unique, game-changing mechanics hidden everywhere.

games.name: Bibi & Tina: Ready, Set, Ride!
games.summary: A summer full of friendship, tournament excitement and horse-filled happiness: Ride with Bibi, Tina and Alex as they compete for the cup, stand together against unfair rivals – and dive into varied horse-riding adventures. Action-packed carriage races are among the special highlights.

games.name: Big Dig
games.summary: Big Dig is a short incremental narrative game about digging up artifacts to help Mayor Dog win the election! Recover artifacts, grow your museum, and upgrade your tools while building a highway spanning the entire Animal Republic!

games.name: Birdcage
games.summary:
BIRDCAGE is an arcade-style vertical scrolling shoot’em up inspired by genre classics, blending gritty pixel art sprites with 2.5D backdrops and a pumping retro soundtrack! Blast through 6 unique stages of bullet hell mayhem, facing off against enemy swarms using multiple shot types and rechargeable specials.

Chase high scores by maintaining chains and kill rate. Strategically activate Hyperblade mode in tense situations, and take down screen-filling bosses! Can you break free of your cage and redeem humanity?

games.name: Bonetox
games.summary: A fast-paced arena shooter where you grind demons into piles of bones and meat. Choose your favorite weapon and unleash uncompromising carnage. Survive as long as you can, break your limits, and drown the arena in blood.

games.name: Corpus et Spiritus
games.summary: Corpus et Spiritus is a roguelite deckbuilder about alchemy. You signed a pact with a Homunculus, and it was a bad idea: it will guide you on the path of alchemy, but as the cost of your life force. Use your workshop to craft new cards, transmute metals and discover magical talismans. Become smarter than your dangerous partner before it kills you!

games.name: Evergrow: Shards of Tomorrow
games.summary: Explore the ruined world of Evergrow, where echoes of a lost civilization whisper through the remnants of a once-thriving planet. Solve puzzles to piece together the truth of what led to its downfall. Can you restore what was lost, or will the shards of tomorrow shape its fate forever?

games.name: FluxWerks
games.summary:
FluxWerks combines the logistics of a large-scale factory game with a procedural voxel world in which every block can be mined, moved or built on. Players start with a swarm of nanobots that harvests terrain and 3D-prints structures. From there they build a production chain that runs from hand-fed smelters to automated science and computing.

The world is a simulation that the factory works with, not a backdrop. Fluids such as water and lava flow through one shared simulation and react when they meet. Heat spreads block by block through the terrain and into machines, so where and how a factory

games.name: Foole's World
games.summary: An absurd personality testing experience with a whole lot of questions for you.

games.name: Ghost Villa
games.summary: In Ghost Villa you farm and cook during the day, by night you fight hordes of ghosts that want to haunt and take possession of your home.

games.name: Gobble
games.summary: Gobble is a 2D action platformer with eating as its central theme. Venture out into the world searching for your missing family, armed with a “sickle” that devours monsters to get stronger.

games.name: Idle Monkey Theorem
games.summary: **Idle Monkey Theorem** is a charming idle/clicker game that brings the famous *Infinite Monkey Theorem* to life. Watch as your adorable team of monkeys frantically type away on their typewriters, randomly producing words that against all odds slowly but surely recreate the complete works of William Shakespeare.

games.name: Mad King Redemption
games.summary: Mad King Redemption is a unique blend of a traditional beat'em'up game with strong roguelite progression, mixed in a pixelated graphic style in a 2.5D world. Relieve the king from his madness while beating up corrupted enemies, in a fresh way at every run!

games.name: Monitor State
games.summary: You are an operator in a dystopia world, watch and punish citizens. Experience a deep narrative with moral dilemmas. Obey, resist or find another path.

games.name: Nature Hike
games.summary: A short and sweet fully voice-acted Visual Novel where you'll join Tendou, a recent friend and local tanuki hunk, on a hiking date... though, perhaps, just "friends" is not exactly what you'll end up being.

games.name: Sento Survivor: Slip, Grab, and Bathe in Glory!
games.summary: Slide, Shoot, and Send Your Rivals Flying!Chaotic, tumbling shooter battle set in a Japanese Sento (public bathhouse). On these super slippery floors, you'll slide, shoot, and stumble to victory. Defeat your rivals and soak in the sublime bath reserved only for the winner!

games.name: Silky Road
games.summary: Take on a roguelike adventure along the dangerous Silky Road. Build your train with unique carts, fight tough enemies, and collect new weapons for your character. Each run is full of strange events and deadly zones. Can you make it to the end, or will the Silky Road defeat you like so many before?

games.name: Stella Supernova: The Astral Vale
games.summary: Jump, dash, dodge, and battle numerous stellar bosses in a 2D action-platformer playable solo or with up to 8 players locally, featuring unlockable powers, upgrades, cinematic QTEs, and an emotional story.

games.name: Stunted Gravity
games.summary: Stunted Gravity is a hovercraft stunt-driving game set in a neon-dystopian future. Race, jump, and improvise lines across arenas where gravity pulls in any and every direction. Execute stunts, evade hazards, and battle enemy drones as you pilot though the interplanetary Stunted Gravity Circuit.

games.name: Tattoo Shop Simulator
games.summary: Run your dream tattoo shop! Provide tattoo and piercing services, customize your shop, and manage staff. Unlock new skills and roam the living city freely on your motorcycle. Buy real estate, fight off thugs, and grow from a small shop into the city's biggest brand!

games.name: The Piper of Dawn
games.summary: Welcome to Diamond City—a sealed-off “Paradise”. You play the role of an alchemist running a one-stop empire: farming, "people farming," shopkeeping, and alchemy. Choose your companion and set out on a fantastical journey where rich storytelling blends seamlessly with deep simulation gameplay.

games.name: Union Max
games.summary:
Union Max is a Gay Adult / Yaoi Visual Novel that features the adventures of Max, the unlikely hero chosen to become the next Light of the Kosmos!
Join Max on his journey across the Realms of the Kosmos, gathering the sparks of Romance, Desire, Angst and Happiness.
Reclaim the lost sparks – together as one!

games.name: Waaaaaa: A Prehistoric Adventure With Aliens
games.summary: WAAAAAA is a silent, funny prehistoric adventure full of grunts. Solve puzzles, recruit quirky companions, and save the world in this 'Solo Dev' labor of love. Sometimes, a scream is all you need to make yourself heard!

games.name: Wand & Order: Tidy Up the Magic Shop!
games.summary: Cozy first person co-op organizing and cleaning simulator! Sort wands, tarot decks and potions. Tidy up the shop to earn points and unlock powerful spells that help you restore order before the Alchemist returns!

games.name: Yami Kids
games.summary: Play as "The Yami Twins" and uncover the mystery behind your family's killers. Yami Kids is a tale of tragedy, familial bonds, and revenge. Face off against trainers in "Shadow Duels", and make contracts with Oni to aid you on your quest.

games.name: Control Resonant
games.summary: Explore a warped Manhattan on the brink of paranatural annihilation in this thrilling action-adventure RPG. Unleash the extraordinary powers of Dylan Faden as he fights for his humanity and survival against a reality-bending cosmic threat.

games.name: Silent Hill: Townfall
games.summary:
Silent Hill: Townfall is a full-length, self-contained psychological horror set against the cold, isolated backdrop of Scotland, 1996.

Players can explore St. Amelia, where fog-soaked streets, abandoned communities, and forgotten corners tell their story through atmosphere and history. Reality and delusion subtly intertwine, luring players into the depths of St. Amelia's grounded, tangible world.

games.name: Shinobi: Art of Vengeance
games.summary: Slay the enemies in the silence of the moment. Run through the world of Shinobi full of monsters and ninja actions. Grab Oborozuki, the legendary sword, and slay evil once more. Your clan and the world are counting on you.

games.name: Sin: Reloaded
games.summary: Nightdive Studios and 3D Realms have joined forces to bring you SiN: Reloaded, a completely remastered experience of the classic 1998 shooter from Ritual Entertainment. SiN was a groundbreaking story driven FPS brimming with memorable characters, horrific enemies and a devastating arsenal that pushed the Quake II Engine to its limits. Now in 2020 SiN has been Reloaded!

games.name: Dragon Shelter
games.summary: Dragon Shelter is a farm sim set in a fantasy world. Take on the role of a hero who will revive the long-lost friendship between humans and dragons. Take care of wondrous creatures, explore the magical world, and restore destroyed biomes!

games.name: Farming Camp
games.summary: Every summer, Evertree Farming Camp searches for the next best Evertree Farmer, someone ready to raise the bar in agriculture. In hopes of a better future, young Alessandra enters the contest to claim the title, but she will have to face her peers and discover what it means to be an Evertree Farmer.

games.name: Armed Fantasia: To the End of the Wilderness
games.summary: Created by veteran game designer Akifumi Kaneko, Armed Fantasia is an RPG built as a spiritual successor to the classic Wild Arms franchise.

games.name: Dragon Quest XI S: Echoes of an Elusive Age - Definitive Edition
games.summary: The Definitive Edition includes all the content from the original release of the acclaimed DRAGON QUEST XI, and adds extra character-specific scenarios, the choice of playing with the original soundtrack or a grand orchestral version of the music, the ability to switch between 2D and 3D graphic modes, a Japanese voice-acting option, and much more.

games.name: The Magus Circle
games.summary: Magic is Art. The Magus Circle is a vampire-survivors, rogue-lite game where you draw to cast spells! Meet other mages and unlock their abilities. Discover the secrets hidden inside the Circle. Draw the sigil, protect the circle, save the cosmos.

games.name: Directorate Novitiate
games.summary: Become Mercury, a ruthless enforcer with deadly arcane power in this thrilling third-person action RPG. By night, hunt killers and battle supernatural Syndicates in the underworld of early 2000s Los Angeles. By day, keep your real life from falling apart.

games.name: Sandwalkers
