games.summary: Sandwalkers is a roguelike turn-based exploration game. Build your team, traverse varied hostile environments, face countless dangers, and gain knowledge that will help you find and resurrect the Mother Tree Umama.

games.name: Seafarer: The Ship Sim
games.summary: Embark on the ultimate maritime experience with Seafarer: The Ship Sim. Choose between careers, take the helm of a variety of ships, and expand your fleet. Navigate a vast open world and become immersed in the beautiful expanses and rolling waves.

games.name: BanG Dream! Our Notes
games.summary: In BanG Dream! Our Notes, players will be thrown into the stories of MyGO!!!!! and Ave Mujica, two aspiring bands discovering their voice. Guide each group from rehearsal studios to stadium shows, as you master tight, rhythm-based gameplay set to original, high-energy pop. As their journey unfolds, three more bands - Mugendai MewType, millsage, and Ikka Dumb Rock! - join the stage, weaving a multi-route tale of youth, friendship, and musical passion. Featuring 25 characters across five bands, the game showcases their growth both on stage and in everyday life.

games.name: Boardwalk Builders
games.summary: Design and expand your boardwalk by building rides, shops, and restaurants to draw in crowds. Manage and combine your attractions to create even grander experiences. Host festivals, attract VIPs and stay ahead of shifting demand influenced by local events and rival businesses.

games.name: Coin & Cauldron
games.summary: The Kingdom of Valoria is in grave danger - The King has sent his most trusted Alchemist to help fight off the monster hordes near the town of Elyzium. Fight monsters, craft potions, cast spells and live the life of a powerful sorcerer fighting to repel the monsters from the defenseless town...

games.name: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD
games.summary:
Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis brings a new chapter to the beloved tower defense saga, packed with the charm fans fell in love with.

Journey back to the very beginning of the Kingdom with the mission to rewrite history, and stop young Vez’nan before darkness takes hold!

Return to the original Kingdom Rush lands, at a time when legends were just beginning. Recruit familiar faces, revisit iconic battlefields, and build strategic defenses to outsmart relentless enemy waves through careful planning.

The beloved tower defense gameplay comes back with bold new twists, epic fights, and the signature King

games.name: Among Shadows
games.summary: Among Shadows is an intense blend of fast-paced combat and identity-based deduction. You are sent to stop a deadly infection from spreading across a corrupted land, but traitors have infiltrated your team. With the Blood Moon rising, can you escape from this place under the conspiracy?

games.name: Ancient Farm
games.summary: Plow, sow, and reap. Sounds familiar? Not this time. Ancient Farm may not be the first farming simulator but it’s the first one to take you back thousands of years into the past, to ancient times where technology wasn’t nearly as impressive as it is today, but humanity was just as hungry as always.

games.name: Garfield: Escape from Monday
games.summary: Wake up Garfield from this nightmarish veggie filled 3D Platformer! The laziest cat is about to work hard in Garfield - Escape from Monday!

games.name: Hirotonfa's American Revolution Smuggler
games.summary: A historical trading and dating sim set during the American Revolution. Manage a trade ship hauling goods between colonial ports, profit from volatile daily market swings, and navigate faction dangers, from militias to pirates, while choosing sides that affect regional quests. Along the way, romance charming colonial “state-chans” across territories like Louisiana and Quebec, blending economic strategy, risk-filled navigation, and character-driven narrative.

games.name: Oh!Ware
games.summary: Sow the seeds of victory, forge alliances, and carve your own destiny. A spiritual Mancala roguelike where every marble shapes the board and your fate. Every pit is a choice and every marble, a desperate prayer.

games.name: Qliphah in Providence's Shadow
games.summary: Set against the backdrop of a distorted Shibuya—where supernatural anomalies have begun bleeding into reality—the story follows two dual protagonists. Both harbor these very anomalies within themselves as they embark on a dark quest to uncover the truth behind the city's eerie phenomena.

games.name: Tandem Together
games.summary: Two idiots. One tandem. A load of suspicious cargo. Deliver the goods, sample the merchandise for wild power-ups, and try not to crash while you make your way across tricky terrains in this two-player co-op adventure with lots of physics-based chaos that will test your friendship.

games.name: Tentacle Tango
games.summary: Tentacle Tango is a quirky co-op puzzle-platformer where you and a partner must work together, tethered by a flexible tentacle. Don’t let the cute visuals fool you—this game is as challenging as it is charming. Every jump, swing, and tentacle bend requires precise coordination as you navigate puzzles, obstacles, and enemies. Whether playing solo or in local co-op, teamwork is your only path to victory, because after all, it takes two to tango!

games.name: 3-Bit Explorer
games.summary: 3-Bit Explorer follows its predecessors, being a game focused on world exploration. This time you find yourself lost in a forest that seems to have even more bits than you, making this world even stranger to our hero. Once more, the world does not need saving, but you need to find your way home (and also a good adventure).

games.name: All Roads Connected
games.summary: Explore an endless world, build countless settlements, discover lost artifacts, and lead your nation into a new dawn of industry.

games.name: Babelomania
games.summary: A technogothic horror where a beautiful wedding turns into a death trap... Who will survive?

games.name: Bibi & Tina: Ready, Set, Ride!
games.summary: A summer full of friendship, tournament excitement and horse-filled happiness: Ride with Bibi, Tina and Alex as they compete for the cup, stand together against unfair rivals – and dive into varied horse-riding adventures. Action-packed carriage races are among the special highlights.

games.name: Codex Mortis
games.summary: In Codex Mortis, Death is your weapon. Mix five schools of dark magic, unleash devastating spell synergies, and raise undead armies in this necromantic bullet hell. Infinite builds, solo or co-op – embrace the forbidden and dominate. 100% AI-driven development.

games.name: Control Resonant: Digital Deluxe Edition
games.summary:
Expand your experience with the CONTROL Resonant Digital Deluxe Edition which includes:
- Main Game
- Digital Artbook
- Original Soundtrack
- Untapped Artifact (Wallet)
- Starter Resource Bundle
- AWE Mission Outfit

games.name: Courier
games.summary: He woke up with nothing. The city is about to have the same problem.

games.name: Dimond Hunt
games.summary: A co-op horror game about searching for items to build a spaceship to escape a dying galaxy.

games.name: Doggy Don't Care
games.summary: Unleash adorable chaos as a mischievous pup! Explore, collect, and smash your way around the house & beyond in this cheeky adventure. Fetch the approval of your feathered friend, Rocko the Parrot, by digging into a list of fun-filled tasks. It's sure to be a pawsitively unforgettable day!

games.name: Frog Pond Simulator
games.summary: Frog Pond Simulator is an idle incremental game where you'll see new frogs coming along continuously, each unique, funny looking and unusual. The only objective that matters is to relax and let yourself be transported by the music and the mood. An un-frog-ettable experience!

games.name: Frukt
games.summary: A voxel-based death sandbox. Shoot, dismember, and crush NPCs with realistic body physics.

games.name: Fusty Dungeon
games.summary: Travel the land and explore a dungeon with two beautiful ladies to find the cure to your childhood friend’s curse.

games.name: Futa Slug EX
games.summary: Futa Slug EX is a top-down shooter roguelike where you collect and fuck beautiful dickgirls. Build your team and discover powerful upgrades as you pilot your SLUG through procedurally generated dungeons.

games.name: Ghostly Whiskers
games.summary:
Your beloved human has vanished into the night. As a pair of courageous cats, you’ll follow their scent to an abandoned mansion shrouded in fog and mystery. But this is no ordinary house — it’s alive with whispers, shadows, and secrets from the past.

Ghostly Whiskers is a short but unforgettable co-op (or solo) adventure that blends light horror with heartwarming moments. Solve puzzles, explore eerie rooms, and use your feline instincts — like squeezing through tight spaces, climbing ledges, and sniffing out hidden clues — to uncover the truth.

games.name: Goofy Dungeon
games.summary: Goofy Dungeon is a light-hearted puzzle game built from the ground up for VR. Explore dungeons, interact with objects and the environment, solve puzzles, complete quests and collect trophies!

games.name: Hack 'n' Stack
games.summary: Physics meets tower defense in this chaotic party game for up to 4 players. Craft barricades and turrets with whatever you can find. But beware: relentless waves of enemies are coming to tear down everything you build.

games.name: Heroes of Magic & Cards
games.summary: Build the perfect deck, draw the perfect hand, and strike down your enemies with pairs and straights. Heroes of Magic & Cards is a roguelike deckbuilder with a poker twist, sending you and your fifty-two into a mystical fantasy world of monsters and magecraft!

games.name: Into the Radius 2
games.summary: Into the Radius 2 is an immersive VR survival shooter, set in a realm of surreal landscapes and deadly anomalies known as Pechorsk Security Zone. Arm yourself with realistic weapons and team up with friends as you venture deeper into the mysteries that lie within.

games.name: Kalanoro
games.summary: Start a band with crazy lemurs and save your island from an evil witch in Kalanoro, an ode to Madagascar’s folklore and vibrant artistic scene! Hop on an action-adventure journey to discover the colorful world of Lemuria, rescue funky lemur artists, and defeat the witch Raneny, one song at a time.

games.name: Land of Glarefall
games.summary: An action-adventure survival game where every night could be your last. Explore a vast, dangerous world where survival depends on smart resource management, tactical combat, and what you choose to do before night falls.

games.name: Love All My Girls
games.summary: What would you do with infinite resurrection and time travel? Predict the future, save the world, get rich overnight… or date six girls at once? You’ve lived every man’s dream but stepped into a fatal trap. You’re just trying to make them all happy—what’s wrong with that?

games.name: Misha
games.summary: It’s almost Christmas. Spend a quiet evening with Misha, where small choices can lead to unexpected consequences.

games.name: Monastery: Ora et Labora
games.summary: Lead your monks in prayer and labor to build a thriving medieval monastery. Manage resources, brew ale, craft manuscripts, and face trials like war and weather. Customize, expand, and guide your brotherhood to achieve spiritual and economic prosperity.

games.name: Namco Legendary Mountains
games.summary: Classic Namco arcades, reborn as a 3D puzzle! 80s legends return in a brand-new form!

games.name: Nightmare Invasion
games.summary: Nightmare has set its sights on this world, and as the will of the world, you will rely on cards, tower defenses, and urban construction to destroy Nightmare's invasion in the dream

games.name: Nocturne for Cyl-Hestia
games.summary: Play as a memorialist and investigate a dystopian city in this 3D adventure game. Collect memories, unlock visions, hack encrypted data, and expose the truth in the face of a regime that manipulates memory.

games.name: Prisoners Chess
games.summary: You know how the pieces move. You don't know how they die. A chess roguelike where every piece bleeds. Level them, perk them or lose them forever. Take the enemy King's head, or bleed their army dry. One path saves you. One damns you. Hell keeps score.

games.name: Protocol 86: Chernobyl
games.summary: Protocol 86: Chernobyl is a terminal-driven psychological horror puzzle game set in a secret Soviet underground facility after the Chernobyl disaster.

games.name: PuPu's Adventure Park
games.summary: Build an Adventure Park from the ground up! The PuPu clan had just rented a new "playground" from the Dark Goblins. Manage the park, construct park facilities, and grow your clan to serve the expansion of the Park for "hero" customers summoned from other planets!

games.name: Reel Talk
games.summary: Cast your line, catch some fish, and make real connections. REEL TALK is a cozy multiplayer fishing game where you hang out, customize your character with pride, and chat with friends old and new. No pressure, no competition-just good vibes by the water.

games.name: Rollick N' Roll
games.summary: Marvelous marble runs, with a modern twist. Rollick N' Roll combines fun physics with intuitive controls to deliver a joyful puzzle experience for all ages. Expand your collection by unlocking fun vehicles and playsets, but be prepared for things to get a bit chaotic.

games.name: Scared by Squares
games.summary: A creepy VR exploration game where you navigate liminal spaces, avoid roaming cubes, and uncover hidden anomalies in eerie block-filled mazes.

games.name: Sender Unknown
games.summary: Work the night shift in an underground sorting facility. Weigh packages, compare their contents, and meet your quota by 6 AM. But beware, some packages hide dark secrets. Identify bad batches, earn cash, and survive the night in this tense PSX-style horror job simulator.

games.name: Sputnika Game
games.summary: A Cosmic twist on a Suika-style game with space gravity. Help our little friend Sputnik on his journey to become the Sun.

games.name: Substrate: Emergence
games.summary: Grow fluorescent cells that create mesmerizing emergent chaos. Simple mechanics hide deep complexity as cells evolve survival strategies through synergistic interactions. Catalogue successful lines and culture them to develop your own unique biology.

games.name: Super Flying Vroom Vroom
games.summary: Drive, boost, take off, and navigate spectacular aerial challenges!

games.name: Unanchored Spaceshooting
games.summary: Welcome to the most counter-intuitive shooter arena! In Unanchored Spaceshooting, your guns ARE your thrusters—dodge left by firing right! Every battle defies physics. Blast enemies, rack up high scores!

games.name: WinMon
games.summary: Raise, feed, and farm your cute little monster—right on your desktop! A relaxing idle game to help you unwind, even on stressful days.

games.name: Agefield High: Rock the School
games.summary: Relive your High School days in the town of Agefield. It’s the early 2000s and you have three months left at school. So REBEL with your friends, win over your dream girl and ROCK the school!

games.name: EA Sports FC 27
games.summary: Welcome to The World’s Game in EA Sports FC 27. Step into The Grounds to experience a football playground where the streets meet the stadium, and feel greater control in every mode as community-driven innovations deliver more true-to-football gameplay.

games.name: Fallosophy
games.summary: Use just two buttons to climb a colossal pinball table spanning the history of western philosophy. Fallosophy is a minimalist game that turns pinball into a quiet struggle against gravity. No score. No tilts. No savers. Falling down means climbing back up again. Why climb? What does it all mean?

games.name: Online: 404
games.summary: An open-world survival simulator where even seasoned veterans of the genre will have to rethink their typical survival approach and how they interact with the world around them. Play solo or with friends, follow the story or simply explore — just don’t forget your most important gadget.

games.name: Black Cat Book Club
games.summary: A magical library you can place on your desktop. Help the black cat study ancient tomes and learn spells in this cozy idle game.

games.name: Decklings
games.summary: Tame magical creatures called decklings and lead them into challenging battles in this survival deck-building card game. Explore wild biomes, gather resources, and craft to build your base as you shape your path to become the deckling champion.

games.name: Wild West Pioneers
games.summary: Follow the American dream and start settling in the frontier with the city-builder Wild West Pioneers. Build and manage your ever-growing villages, establish production chains as well as outposts and build trade routes to support your cities and outposts.

games.name: Abandoned Gameshop
games.summary: Sort thousands of physical game cases scattered across the carpeted floors by Platform (Nindo 10, XCube, FunStation, PC) and Genre. Bring retro gaming nostalgia back to life!

games.name: Booked
games.summary: BOOKED is a cozy first-person library game about finding misplaced books and returning them to the right shelves. Explore a charming library, discover 100+ colorful books and series, and enjoy a relaxed, pressure-free sorting experience.

games.name: Broken Spirit
games.summary: Broken Spirit is a fantasy action RPG. Explore palaces, ruins, tombs, and forests across a vast world, experiencing both the splendor of history and the desolation of the apocalypse.Compose your own equipment and craft your own tactics as you battle a variety of enemies.

games.name: Bug Cleaners
games.summary: Are you ready to stop the bug invasion? Fight off the invaders either solo or cooperatively with your team using extraordinary tools! Enjoy fun moments in chaotic missions — bug hunting has never been this exciting!

games.name: Card Conquest
games.summary: Card Conquest is a Tower Defense game with Deckbuilding and Roguelite elements. Combine spells, towers and units to create a deck and defeat your enemies. Spend your resources wisely and find balance between offense and defense. Gather powerful relics that will enhance your cards.

games.name: CoLane
games.summary:
”CoLane" is a PC rhythm game where the lanes switch according to the color of the background spotlight.
It features a variety of fingerings, making it a game where you improve through trial and error.
A practice mode is implemented, allowing you to try out various fingerings.

games.name: Cozy Farm: Tidy Up!
games.summary: A cozy organizing simulator about sorting 2500+ adorable fruits, vegetables and other crops into greenhouses. Perform satisfying sorting combos, earn money for helpful upgrades and explore the farm at dawn or night. Take your time and tidy the farm, one shelf at a time!

games.name: Department of Collections
games.summary: A tasked based procedural online co-op sci-fi horror game that can be played both casually or more hardcore

games.name: Gay It Loud
games.summary: Dating in the dreamy shopping mall of 1995! Hang out at the food court, have sloppy makeouts in the dressing room, loiter in the arcade, and collect nostalgic toys.

games.name: Ghosted
games.summary: A 1-5 player co-op horror comedy where YOU'RE the ghosts. Haunt the living, possess objects, and make your friends say ridiculous custom voice commands to trigger scares.

games.name: Glue Blocks
games.summary: Glue your falling blocks to create your own shapes and achieve monster scores in wells of all shapes with dynamic gravity. Compete with friends or have funds in coop.

games.name: Hostile Lands
games.summary: A skill-based bullet-hell shooter with a TON of colorful characters, crunchy gunplay, and a planet that holds a grudge. Rescue your crew, reach the escape pod, and get out. The catch: every escape cranks up the Hostility toward those left behind.

games.name: Immortal Chess
games.summary: Chess game with classes, Mana, spells, traps and skills. Build your strategy, disrupt your opponent and compete across platforms in tactical matches. Choose the class that suits best your play style.

games.name: Lobstar: Arcade Version
games.summary: Punch through the cosmos! An arcade-inspired shoot-em-up where you play as an immortal lobster speeding through space.

games.name: Lucid Cats
games.summary: An online co-op horror extraction game. Fall asleep, loot a shared nightmare, and find the escape to keep your valuables.

games.name: Luminescence
games.summary: Illuminate the path in this Parkour experience across the constellations of Space

games.name: Lunar Drifter
games.summary: Lunar Drifter is an Arcade First Person Shooter, your mission is to tear, blast, and crush an entire legion as fast as possible within the time limit. Featuring 4 playable characters with their own gimmicks and arsenal, more than 10 beautiful hand-crafted levels, and includes online Co-Op!

games.name: Magic Realm
games.summary: The story of Magic Realm begins in a small town nestled in a dangerous misty forest, where a series of mysterious events take place that propel the protagonist to the town's hidden truth.........

games.name: Murders & Mistresses
games.summary:
Murders & Mistresses is a dark, choice-driven adult detective thriller about sex, power, judgment — and consequences.

You play a brilliant ex-conman turned police consultant — cocky, charismatic, dangerously persuasive — surrounded by women you shouldn't be sleeping with, and given far too much freedom.

A character-driven prestige drama: the story will force you into uncomfortable places, and your choices will have severe consequences.

games.name: Museologist: Tidy Up the Museum!
games.summary: Museologist: Tidy Up the Museum! A single-player simulation. The whole collection has fallen apart. Find where each fragment belongs, piece it back together like a puzzle, and restore 428 objects from 3,105 scattered pieces.

games.name: Observation Protocol
games.summary: Observation Protocol is a first-person psychological horror game set in a liminal office space that exists outside normal space. From an external observation post, you must monitor camera feeds and identify discrepancies within the facility. When the power cuts, protocol requires you to enter the facility yourself, photograph every discrepancy, and return before the passage closes at 6 AM.

games.name: Retrieval
games.summary: RETRIEVAL is a first-person psychological horror game where you explore a looping house, collect scattered memory fragments, and search extracted keywords in an old computer terminal to uncover a tragic truth.

games.name: Sandwich +1
games.summary: A cozy idle clicker where every click drops a random ingredient with a satisfying plop. Stack towering sandwiches, automate your kitchen, unlock rare fillings. Your customers watch every move and react.

games.name: Sayagatari: Promise of the Cursed Blade
games.summary: "My love for you began with that kiss." Ex-Kendo practitioner Kanemori Tōya, comes across Saya who seals demonic blades. Saving him from his murderous impulse curse is a kiss from Saya!? The two begin living together, battling with demonic blade in hand. Break the curse with a kiss from this beauty!

games.name: Scapewatch
games.summary: 28 skills. Three combat styles. Clans, raids, hiscores, pets, capes. Set up your queue, close the tab, come back richer. Scapewatch is the idle MMO for people who actually like the grind.

games.name: Smoke Keeper
games.summary: A cozy first-person organizing simulator where you sort 4,316 scattered items throughout a two-storey Victorian tobacconist. Put every item on its proper shelf, unlock helpful skills, and restore perfect order at your own pace—or race the clock.

games.name: Sockpuppet Noir
games.summary: Step into the shoes of Frank Sockowski, private detective, and explore the gritty world of New Drawer, a wolly unsettling and corrupt city.

games.name: Stella Astrum
games.summary: Stella Astrum is a whimsical factory game where you manage elemental resources to form Stars, Planets, and more. Use your skills to unlock upgradable factories, nurture colorful celestial bodies, and shape an expansive galaxy. Sit back, relax, and amplify the universe beyond its artistic limits!

games.name: Tomboy Adventure 2
games.summary: Start a relaxing adventure together with your (girl) friend!

games.name: Wavecrashers
games.summary: Wavecrashers is a 3-player co-op strategy game where heroes unite to fend off relentless waves of enemies. Master unique heroes and dive into a deeply replayable experience built for teamwork.

games.name: Wrenny Lee: Witch-for-Hire!
games.summary: A short visual novel comedy about Wrenny, a hard-working witch! The freelance life is anything but magical!

games.name: Missed Class: Horror
games.summary: Some schools should stay abandoned.

games.name: Parkour Obby: Ice Escape
games.summary: Can you escape the frozen course?

games.name: Stranded With You
games.summary: In this survival game, you are stranded on an tropical island with your lovely friend Mitsuki. Explore your surroundings together, build a small shelter, and hunt for supplies. Have fun keeping up with all the heat!

games.name: Billion Egg Farm
games.summary: Billion Egg Farm is a first-person automation game where you put chickens to work laying eggs and build production lines for eggs, meat, and processed goods.

games.name: Keep Driving
games.summary: An atmospheric management RPG about life on the open road. Pick up hitchhikers, work odd jobs, customize and repair your car, and map your route across the country. Use upgrades, skills and items to overcome challenges. And remember to take it easy. You’re young. You have time.

games.name: Replay Value: Second Hand Games
games.summary: Run a second-hand game store from scratch! A Job Simulator where you buy and sell used games, negotiate with colorful customers, make profit and upgrade your shop! Clean up retro finds, and stack your shelves with the most popular game with replay value!

games.name: Antivirus Survivors 2003 Professional
games.summary: The family computer is infected again and it’s your job to fend off waves of viruses and adware foes with an arsenal of nostalgic Y2K-inspired weapons. Antivirus Survivors 2003 Professional is a survivor-like auto-shooter filled with nods to the days when computers were actually fun.

games.name: HR: Human Remains
games.summary: In a broken world ruled by demons, the gears of productivity still turn. Complete tasks, solve puzzles, and explore a society under demonic regime from the perspective of an ordinary office clerk.

games.name: Scritchy Scratchy
games.summary: Scritchy Scratchy is a satisfying scratch card incremental game. Buy tons of scratch-off's, buy an auto scratcher to do all the hard work and win jackpots! Will you risk it all for the big reward or play it safe?

games.name: AE: Archeological Expedition
games.summary: Explore dig sites inspired by real locations, from Petra to Pompeii, and unearth artifacts spanning 10 historical eras. Brush away the centuries, discover the stories behind each find, and fill your journal one careful dig at a time

games.name: Ammossum
games.summary: Build an endlessly upgradable weapon! Evolve projectiles into unstoppable firepower in this action roguelike. Fight through hordes of infected beasts, save your family, and feel the thrill of bloody shootouts filled with bullets, explosions, and acid. Can you survive the madness?

games.name: Battle Meating
games.summary: Survive without getting burned! BATTLE MEATING is a local multiplayer party game for 1–4 players. Become a Meat and fight to be the last one standing. Bring your controllers and battle with up to 4 players locally. Enjoy a wacky, chaotic meat party!

games.name: Drop Command
games.summary: The year is 2647. War rages 150 light years from Earth. Pilot Mechs, Tanks, Infantry and Aircraft in combined arms combat on many worlds across the star cluster. Play as a lone wolf, or rise in rank to manage and lead entire battalions into combat throughout a procedural campaign.

games.name: Galactic Bounty
games.summary: Play as a droid bounty hunter for hire. Accept contracts, deploy into dangerous locations, eliminate targets, break into secure systems, and get paid. Spend your rewards on weapons, gear and software upgrades for your droid.

games.name: Greenhouse: Tidy Up!
games.summary: Greenhouse: Tidy Up! is a cozy single-player simulation where you bring order to a messy greenhouse. Sort and place hundreds of flowers and plants, find the best way to organize everything, and compete with other players for the fastest time.

games.name: Japanese Ramen Simulator
games.summary: Japanese Ramen Simulator is a ramen shop management sim for up to six players. Prepare ingredients, cook noodles, and arrange toppings to craft the perfect bowl. Create original dishes, design your kitchen and dining area, and build your ramen restaurant with friends or on your own!

games.name: One Fenix Down
games.summary: A retro-inspired, classic turn-based RPG for those with nostalgia for the '90s golden era. Explore a vast world with 14 playable characters, fight hundreds of unique enemies, and delve into an epic story of war, betrayal, and redemption.

games.name: Radiotext
games.summary: Radiotext is an interactive story set in the near future, where communication without intrusion requires radio-waves. Dive into a cryptographic radio-net in this text-based rpg, where you need to think carefully before typing your answers.

games.name: Sincognito
games.summary: Sincognito, is a 5-15 players SOCIAL DEDUCTION, horror, stealth game in which players, split between two distinct teams - Humans & Sins - must use communication with proximity voice chat, teamwork to complete tasks, skills for combat, betrayal, and ultimately mind games to defeat the opposite team.

games.name: Space Cat Solitaire
games.summary:
Space Cat Solitaire is a euphoric and satisfying puzzle card game adventure. With cats.

Stack, organize and pros-purr! Hone your puzzling skills as you create epic combos, beat your high score and find your fortune among the stars! Use your wits & your winnings to unlock customizations, trophies, and elite story-driven missions featuring the eccentric locals of the Whiskerfang Expanse.

games.name: The Hero Is Too Powerful so Let's Pleeeease Settle This Peacefully!
games.summary: How strong is too strong? Find out from the hero's victims in this adventure RPG as you talk things out (or destroy everything) on your way to save the hero's childhood friend!

games.name: Tour: Chess Puzzles
games.summary: Elegant, varied and challenging chess-themed puzzles. No prior knowledge of chess is needed.

games.name: Unshine Arcade
games.summary: An arcade full of secrets, a sentient virtual pet in the prize cabinet, a stealth shooter roguelite arcade machine and one way to escape: win tickets.

games.name: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve
games.summary: Soar through the skies and rise above every challenge to earn your place among the elite. Engage in intense aerial combat to dominate the battlefield with powerful weapons. Experience a breathtaking campaign filled with high-stakes missions, hard choices, and deep squad connections.

games.name: Nivalis Nights
games.summary: Grow your business, manage restaurants and nightclubs, make friends and enemies, buy and decorate apartments, go fishing and maybe even find love in Nivalis, the city that stretches from the ocean to the clouds.

games.name: Minecraft Dungeons II
games.summary: Drop the pickaxe, grab a sword, and charge into a thrilling new adventure in Minecraft Dungeons II. Journey through unexplored lands and mysterious locations, in a quest to stop a new evil from causing chaos in not one, but two worlds! Clash with menacing foes in explosive encounters and fight your way through hordes of mobs that will do everything in their power to stop you from saving the day.

games.name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered
games.summary:
Coming on September 29, this is the definitive way to experience Geralt of Rivia’s legendary adventure. The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered features an array of improvements, bringing upgrades to visuals, gameplay, and more.

Remastered is a free upgrade for players who own The Witcher 3 on GOG, Steam, Epic Games Store, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S, and includes both Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine expansions. It is also available for pre-purchase on Battle.net and Nintendo Switch 2.

games.name: Toem 2
games.summary: Step back into the shoes of a curious photographer and set off on a brand new adventure all about uncovering hidden details, helping friends along the way, and documenting the world’s little wonders in TOEM 2, the sequel to the acclaimed TOEM.

games.name: Transport Fever 3
games.summary: Transport Fever 3, the ultimate transport tycoon returns, bigger, deeper, and more dynamic than ever. Build the routes that transform the world across land, sea, and sky using over a century of evolving transport options. Design and build your ideal transport network.

games.name: Dog in the Machine
games.summary: A tactical roguelite where you help an AutoDog escape a dystopian mecha-city and get back to their exiled humans. Teach the dog custom tricks to tackle strategic challenges through devastating chain reactions. Break the Machine in your path to freedom!

games.name: The Merlies
games.summary: Meet the Merlies, a tiny birds community trying to find harmony in a world where the remains of an ancient civilisation are still visible. Build your village ingeniously, gather your birdies and explore this way-too-big world in this cute post-apocalyptic adventure ! Ready to spread your wings?

games.name: Dicevaders
games.summary: Build an army of alien invaders to invade the Earth in DiceVaders, the roguelike dice game set in the same universe as StarVaders!

games.name: Escape from 8-Bit High
games.summary: When a cursed cassette awakens a sentient Pomodore 64, Cloudydale High is overrun by 8-bit villains! Join alt-rock trio Blueberry Finn—Hank, Duck, and Alex—as they battle mole men, aliens, dinosaurs and more in a bizarre, musical quest to save the world!

games.name: Frutiger Home
games.summary: Decorate your dream frutiger home in this cozy co-op frutiger house decorating game. Pick a home layout, add from a wide range of frutiger-themed decor and hang out with your friends!

games.name: King's Guard
games.summary: In this turn-based strategy roguelike your job is to keep an ungrateful king alive. As the royal guard's manager you unlock upgrades, assign badges for special skills and try to keep morale and supplies from collapsing faster than the monarchy.

games.name: Tiny Flock
games.summary: From the creators of Human Fall Flat – Tiny Flock, a cosy, physics-based VR puzzle game for all ages. Help guide your adorable wayward sheep through beautiful hand-crafted diorama puzzles using the environment around you to get them to safety!

games.name: Cancel Subscription Simulator
games.summary: Cancel Subscription Simulator is a dark comedic puzzle game about navigating 30 levels of absurd corporate dark UX patterns, evasive buttons, impossible CAPTCHAs, and manipulative chatbots.

games.name: Car Factory Tycoon
games.summary: Build cars step-by-step in a factory sim. Design vehicles, build your garage layout, hire and train workers, manage parking inventory, and sell cars through customer orders or walk-in buyers as you expand your operation.

games.name: Crack the Pack
games.summary: Open booster packs, buy upgrades, and collect over 600 cards and their variants. Build a true automated booster factory by endlessly multiplying production until you unlock cloning and nuclear fusion !

games.name: Endless Rails
games.summary: Protect your train with your drones as it rolls through a monster-infested wasteland. Reach new stations to buy new weapons, wagons, and upgrades. Keep rolling until you or the game crashes. Isometric bullet heaven roguelite.

games.name: Island of Rebirth: NTR and Love
games.summary: A mysterious island suddenly appears at sea. Rick, a protagonist suffering from amnesia, encounters two beautiful girls, Sienna and Mila. The three embark on a journey of exploration across the island.

games.name: Petal Crash 2
games.summary: The freshest in arcade puzzle action blossoms again! Crash blocks together into dazzling chain reactions in a puzzle like no other - now completely refreshed with refined gameplay, arcade graphics, brand new game modes, and dazzling special attacks!

games.name: The Starfallen Prince
games.summary: The Starfallen Prince, an action-RPG bullet heaven where an invasion shatters Belden’s world, Losing everything he held dear. Driven by loss, he escapes into the wilds to begin a journey of survival, revenge and the fate of his people.

games.name: Unwell
games.summary: You regain consciousness. Beside you lies a broken and rusted ladder, and in front of you stretches a dark, damp-smelling corridor. In the distance, you hear the sound of falling water. You have no idea where you are. All you know is that you must go deeper.

games.name: Way of the Hunter 2
games.summary: Feel the thrill of the hunt and keep an eye out for the wild and wonderous species that are roaming the North American wilderness and the African Savanna. Hunt and display big game like Moose, and Cape Buffalo as well as, smaller animals and birds.

games.name: Aion 2
games.summary: Aion 2 is the only MMORPG built around a world where the sky is the battlefield. Choose your faction, ascend as a Daeva, and fight a faction war across a world 36 times larger than the original.

games.name: Kong: Survivor Instinct
games.summary: When giant monsters fight, no one’s safe. Embark on a thrilling quest of survival in a city that’s become a battleground for Titans. Use the lethal strength of Kong and other monsters to your own advantage in this official Monsterverse game set shortly after the events of Godzilla vs. Kong.

games.name: Songs of Glimmerwick
games.summary: Become immersed in a musical woodland fantasy world where casting a spell is as easy as playing a song. Attend classes, grow the university garden, make friends with classmates and townsfolk, and explore the island’s many oddities and mysteries in this story-driven witch academy RPG.

games.name: Mario Kart Tour
games.summary:
Mario Kart takes a world tour!
- Mario and friends go global in this new Mario Kart as they race around courses inspired by real-world cities in addition to classic Mario Kart courses! These destinations will be featured in tours that rotate every two weeks! In addition to courses based on iconic locales, some of your favorite Mario Kart characters will get variations that incorporate the local flavor of cities featured in the game!

Endless Mario Kart fun at your fingertips!
- The Mario Kart series known and loved by many is ready to take the world by storm – one smart device at a time! With

games.name: Okko the Exiled
games.summary: Okko The Exiled is an action-packed adventure, where you stomp, launch, and bash your way through Kutala, a land of demons, on a quest to defeat the demon lord Yalda and link Okko’s isolated world with the heavens.

games.name: Nowhere
games.summary:
Nowhere is a Nordic inspired narrative mystery/horror game, revolving around Nordic mythology and what happened to these Gods after Ragnarök and how the rise of Christianity impacted them and their worship.

Featuring the mixing styles of detective gameplay and survival horror, It's going to appeal to people who love a good mystery and also love to be scared, wandering through these haunting atmospheres, feeling something watching them at every turn while the tension builds and builds until the world turns into a nightmare and its fight or flight.

games.name: Rolla
games.summary: Play as the monster from the movie series that never existed, ROLLA. ROLL. EAT. REPEAT. Fast paced arcade game with chunky old school 3d graphics: eat people, destroy whole cities and battle with cops, army and government agents! Uncover the secrets of what ROLLA is and where it is from.

games.name: Fatal Train
games.summary: Murder on the train? It doesn't matter, it's no longer our concern! Ladies and gentlemen, don't worry, we have four detectives who can handle this! After all, there's nothing complicated about murder investigations, right?

games.name: Radiosol
games.summary: RADIOSOL is a journey through a desolate world burned by a planetary cataclysm. In search of answers, you will have to navigate through the ruins of megastructures and abandoned cities, avoiding the scorching rays of the Sun.

games.name: Vessels: Noiret Mansion
games.summary: A retro-inspired PSX survival horror game set in the mysterious Noiret Mansion. Explore a cursed estate, solve puzzles, uncover the fate of the Noiret family, and survive the horrors lurking within its walls.

games.name: 9 Dystricts
games.summary: Build your own flying vehicles in this action-packed roguelike dystopia.

games.name: A Dungeon Is You
games.summary: Tower defense X Incremental idle! Design your own dungeon (maze). Summon and place different defenders against hundreds of personally designed waves. Explore multiple systems, including an arpg like item system with every system improving each other. No resets or prestige! Continuous combat!

games.name: A Maze in Labyrinth
games.summary: Get lost... in the labyrinth. Explore the interconnected maze to find the "exit." Race, climb, and slide through the multiple areas, and try solving the mystery of the “Amazing Labyrinth” in the process.

games.name: Beatcore Zero
games.summary: Try Beatcore for free! A simple rhythm game where you hit beats as they come down the lanes. This version does not permit access to the workshop.

games.name: Clawless Coin
games.summary: Ever won something from a claw machine? Neither has this one. Clawless Coin is a cozy incremental arcade idler where you run a neon-lit claw machine arcade, chase six tiers of trophy plushes, and prestige into trillions of tokens. Grab big. Grip harder. Grow your empire.

games.name: Computer Manufacturer
games.summary: Develop your computer empire, control costs, and increase profits. Decide whether to develop hardware in-house or purchase it, and whether to prioritize cost-effectiveness or pursue higher profits. The choices are all up to you.

games.name: Farming With Lasers
games.summary: Incinerate various pests with your giant laser, as you grow your farm. Purchase incremental upgrades to expedite the process.

games.name: Growing My Manhole
games.summary: Consume the universe, grow from Manhole to Black Hole in this insatiable incremental game.

games.name: Gun Monkey!
games.summary: Help your fellow monkeys escape back to the jungle by gunning your way through obstacles and challenges. Test your skill in a open environment and find your way home! Choose how you want to play, save companions (or don't) and unlock guns that help you traverse the world!

games.name: Jupiter
games.summary: A survival adventure on a mysterious Jupiter-like planet. Explore, gather resources, overcome dangers, and uncover hidden secrets in the depths of an alien world.

games.name: Knightbane
games.summary: Survive 12 minutes. Then the final boss arrives. Shatter the terrain to escape, loot its contents, or funnel the horde into a killing trap. Cleanse the lands for boons and ASCEND your abilities: not merely empowered, but altered. An action survivor-like.

games.name: Mikene's Aspects
games.summary: Guide Mikene in the search for the 7 Aspects of Balance to achieve Omnipotence and put an end to the problem plaguing the city of Farzin once and for all. Dive into hordes of enemies in this frantic hack n' slash in the best Soulslike style!

games.name: Monster Museum: Tidy Up the Collection!
games.summary: Step into the relaxing world of Monster Museum! Team up with your favorite creature companion and begin your journey to restore the museum by sorting 2614 monster figurines.  Unlock new abilities, collect badges and uncover hidden secrets along the way. Cozy, single player, no timers.

games.name: Murder Castle
games.summary: You are trapped inside a masterpiece of madness. Unravel the chilling mystery of H.H. Holmes Murder Castle. In this atmospheric true crime escape simulator, every room is a puzzle and every document a shocking discovery. Can you escape the architect of death?

games.name: Needle In A Haystack
games.summary: The original game. Find a needle hidden in millions of hay pieces with your friends.

games.name: Nion Forge
games.summary: Nion Forge is a blend of roguelite gameplay and modular shipbuilding, set in a stylish cyberpunk world. By carefully selecting the right modules, you'll have a chance to conquer all 9 districts of the city, defeat their district bosses, and attain your freedom.

games.name: Open Drive
games.summary: Explore freely, collect the orbs, or try to beat your high score by making and landing jumps off ramps, mounds, and mountain tops in our 3 vehicles, Roadster, Trickster and Speedste

games.name: Plobania 47/B
games.summary: Immortality is not a blessing, it is a burden. As Milton Clarke, you work at the 47/B Mandatory Sleep Hospital, review documents, surf the internet, and decide who will no longer exist. You don’t kill anyone. You only “put them to sleep.” The rules are clear. Every decision has consequences.

games.name: Prop Revolt
games.summary: A prop hunt where being seen is a resource. Hide as an everyday object and survive - or let the hunter stare, charge the Revolt, and fight back as a team. There's often a fine line between hiding and attacking. Will you defeat the Hunters, or will you hide until the end? You decide!

games.name: Proto Zero
games.summary: There is no point in looking back. The only way left is forward. - O. Escape the mega complex and find out what happened to the world our protagonist Yuuto once knew after his long slumber, in this new generation 3d action sci-fi brawler.

games.name: Raccoon Valley Tycoon
games.summary: Raccoon Valley is a cozy incremental game about restoring a forgotten raccoon village to its former glory. Dig for resources, collect everything in sight, and watch your little town come back to life.

games.name: Red Howl
games.summary: Social deduction game for 4 to 15 players, inspired by Little Red Riding Hood. 3 factions clash: use your unique powers and unmask them before the Blood Moon turns against you, or be devoured.

games.name: Redhowl
games.summary: Social deduction game for 4 to 15 players, inspired by Little Red Riding Hood. 3 factions clash: use your unique powers, unmask them or be devoured before the Blood Moon turns against you.

games.name: Salt and Spice
games.summary: From Mogadishu to Calcutta, master the bustling trade networks of the Indian Ocean during the golden age of maritime commerce.

games.name: Shelfbound
games.summary: A storm has torn through, sending shelves and their contents flying across the room. In Shelfbound, it’s your job to clean up the mess, sort through scattered items, and put everything back where it belongs, one labeled shelf at a time.

games.name: Swapdown
games.summary:
Step into the pulsating world of Swapdown, where every second counts and your wits are tested to the limit! In this exhilarating "match three" extravaganza, players are given a thrilling 60 seconds to slide shapes in all directions - left, right, up, and down, with the goal of aligning the perfect trio of colors.

But that's not all! Feel the board has become too predictable? Hit the "Space Bar" and watch as Swapdown's dynamic arena reshuffles, throwing an array of fresh combinations your way. The clock is ticking, but if the pressure becomes too much, the trusty hint button awaits to give you

games.name: The War Disorder Hexa
games.summary: War consumes the Kingdom of Node as an empire marches forward. Six protagonists stand on different sides of the conflict, each driven by their own motives, struggles, and paths to survival.

games.name: Voltaire: The Vegan Vampire
games.summary: An action-farming-roguelite, full of whimsical flora and mischievous creatures that really want to ruin your dark and mysterious plans of… Going vegan!

games.name: Gears of War: E-Day
games.summary:
Experience the brutal horror of Emergence Day through the eyes of Marcus Fenix in the origin story of one of gaming's most acclaimed sagas.​
Fourteen years before Gears of War, war heroes Marcus Fenix and Dom Santiago return home to face a new nightmare: the Locust Horde. These subterranean monsters, grotesque and relentless, erupt from below, laying siege on humanity itself. ​
Built from the ground up with Unreal Engine 5, Gears of War: E-Day delivers unprecedented graphical fidelity.

games.name: End of Abyss
games.summary: Play as the young combat technician, Cel, as she uncovers the truth behind the facility's derelict areas and confronts the monstrous creatures that roam them.

games.name: Dynasty Warriors 3: Complete Edition Remastered
games.summary: A striking modern revival of "DYNASTY WARRIORS 3" and "DYNASTY WARRIORS 3: Xtreme Legends," which established the foundation of the entire series. The complete cast of more than 40 officers and numerous battlefields will be beautifully recreated using Unreal Engine 5. Aim for the peak of 1 vs 1,000 action in this even more enjoyable and thrilling revival.

games.name: Monsters & Memories
games.summary: Monsters and Memories is an independently created, niche Fantasy MMORPG that harkens back to the classic MMO era of the late '90s and early '00s.

games.name: Octopath Traveler
games.summary: A role-playing game from the Bravely Default team is being developed exclusively for the Nintendo Switch. They have brought a new world to life through a mix of CG, pixel art, and "HD-2D" visuals.

games.name: RetroSpace
games.summary: A space station has been swallowed by a black hole, mutants roaming the corridors, and everything seems to have gone mad around you. Be sneaky or blast your way through the station and find a way home, all in a disco-punk atmosphere, as if you were the hero of a 70s B-movie that never existed...

games.name: Don't Fret
games.summary: Don't! Fret is stylized first-person psychological mascot-horror game set in a musically themed world. Play as a guitar named Fret to solve puzzles, escape from foes, and uncover the mystery behind Harmonic Heights.

games.name: Heartworm
games.summary: Pass through the threshold and enter a world born of memories. Defend yourself with a camera while solving death’s mysteries in a reverent evolution of 90’s survival horror, integrating both fixed cameras and over the shoulder perspectives.

games.name: Moros Protocol
games.summary: Your mission is not just to survive, but to face yourself, your past and prepare for "a world full of darkness and monsters". A stylized pixel painted FPS roguelike game, that combines the feel of early action-adventure games, with innovative mechanics.

games.name: Ghost of Yotei: Complete Edition
games.summary:
The award winning epic returns. Become a different kind of warrior in this definitive edition of the standalone Ghost of Yotei experience.

The Complete Edition includes:
• Ghost of Yotei
• Echoes of Sekigahara - A New Story Expansion
• Most Wanted - A Combat Survival Mode
• In-game Mask
• Charm of Hokkyokusei
• The Snake Armor
• Digital Deluxe Armor Dye
• Digital Deluxe Horse & Saddle
• Sword Kit
• Traveler’s Maps (Early Unlock)
• Charm of Amaterasu

games.name: Octopath Traveler II
games.summary:
This game is a brand-new entry in the Octopath Traveler series. It takes the series’ HD-2D graphics, a fusion of retro pixel art and 3DCG, to even greater heights.
In the world of Solistia, eight new travelers venture forth into an exciting new era.
Where will you go? What will you do? Whose tale will you bring to life?
Every path is yours to take. Embark on an adventure all your own.

games.name: Gears of War: E-Day Premium Edition
games.summary:
The Gears of War: E-Day Premium Edition Includes:
- Base Game
- Up to 5-Days Early Access
- Bravo Squad Signature Weapon Pack
- Five Seasonal Customization Packs, starting with the Emergence Pack at launch (the remaining packs will be available as released)
- 1,000 Iron (premium in-game currency)

games.name: Biodome Bastion
games.summary: Crash-land on a hostile alien world in this classic tower defense game and defend your outpost against relentless waves of evolving insectoid creatures. Build powerful defenses, unlock new technologies, and uncover the mystery behind a species capable of adapting to any environment.

games.name: Bravery
games.summary: BRAVERY is a third-person 3D adventure game in which players guide a fragile matchstick character through vast, detailed environments that appear enormous in scale. Gameplay focuses on exploration, tense chase sequences, and interactive fire mechanics that allow objects to be ignited. Throughout the journey, players discover hidden areas and capture enigmatic orbs that are sealed within restored magical mirrors, shaping progression through the world.

games.name: Clash of Armadas: Koxinga
games.summary: Tower Defense + Auto Chess + Naval Battle Choose from the legendary captains of the Age of Sail – Blackbeard, Francis Drake, Horatio Nelson, Zheng Chenggong… and more. Command 10+ ships. Position your fleet. Broadside fire. Enemies come in waves on fixed routes.

games.name: Crown Of Blight
games.summary: Crown of Blight is a dynamic top-down 3D metroidvania. As an elite Hunter of the Church, descend into cursed dungeons to find the source of the Blight. Annihilate hordes of enemies, unlock new paths, and uncover the grim truth hidden in the depths.

games.name: Down Pit
games.summary: Dig. And Get Paid.

games.name: Dynasty Warriors 3: Complete Edition Remastered - Digital Deluxe Edition
Eclesiar
games.summary: Eclesiar is a free online multiplayer strategy game. Build nations, run economies and wage war with thousands of real players, right in your browser.

games.name: Havoc Heirs
games.summary: A fantasy turn-based RPG in a massive interconnected world. Monsters are everywhere, and you may end up being one of them.

games.name: How to Destroy a City
games.summary: How to Destroy a City is a casual incremental game where you pilot a giant robot to destroy the city. Upgrade your robot, fight the army, and unlock special abilities and new robots. It's time to turn the city to ashes!

games.name: Loot Goblins
games.summary: Crack open chests, chain buffs, upgrade and recruit the ultimate goblin crew. Send them deeper into dungeons. Get better loot. Repeat!

games.name: MXGP 26: The Official Game
games.summary: Dominate the track, feel every impact, every rut, every victory. The most intense and realistic motocross experience is finally available. Experience the entire 2026 championship, with its official tracks and riders.

games.name: Oathwood Realms
games.summary: Oathwood Realms is a dark fantasy strategy card game focused on careful planning, tactical decisions, and calculated risk. Luck plays a role, but victory favors players who read the board and commit to their choices.

games.name: Puckoff: Reloaded
games.summary: Puckoff: Reloaded is the latest, and greatest, version of the (in)famous game, Puckoff, previously available only for personal computers. Enter the world of no-rules hockey as a total newbie and work on your skills and attitude to meet with the mythical terrorizer, Dominator. Build your team of has-beens and legends while learning different playstyles to defeat a plethora of colorful characters around the globe. Team up with the ever cheerful Sarah, the best beer-league goalie Eddie, and the ever grumpy seen-it-all Coach. So grab your skates and Puck off!

games.name: Pusheen's Place
games.summary: Pusheen’s Place is a cozy casual game centered around collecting, caring for, and spending time with different versions of Pusheen. Players can create their own little Pusheen paradise by decorating rooms with hundreds of items and mixing furniture and decorations from different themes. More than 100 Pusheens can be collected, ranging from Common to Legendary, including special variants such as Pusheenicorn, Laptop Pusheen, and Pancake Pusheen. Players can feed, pet, and play with their Pusheens while completing a variety of bite-sized minigames and puzzles. With its relaxed pace, colorful roo

games.name: Sous Raccoon
games.summary: Play as a raccoon sous chef managing restaurants while defending customers from monsters in this action-packed roguelike that blends cooking with combat!

games.name: Tales from the Dancing Moon
games.summary: Tales from the Dancing Moon is a life-sim RPG set in a parallel universe inspired by UK culture and fantasy novels. After the events of a shadow-beast invasion on a seaside town, complete villager quests and collect hidden diaries to understand your role in this mysterious character-driven story.

games.name: Tile & Error
games.summary: A word-game roguelite. Place words to crack escalating score targets, enchant single tiles until they detonate, freeze or pay gold, and tilt the whole board when nothing fits. Bosses rewrite the rules, the shop rebuilds your bag, and every run digs deeper into the alphabet.

games.name: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve
games.summary: Soar through the skies and rise above every challenge to earn your place among the elite. Engage in intense aerial combat to dominate the battlefield with powerful weapons. Experience a breathtaking campaign filled with high-stakes missions, hard choices, and deep squad connections.

games.name: Ball Picker: Clean Up the Golf Yard
games.summary: Collect +1,000,000 golf balls, earn money, buy new vehicles, and clean up the golf yard. Ball Picker - Clean up the Golf Yard is an active incremental game centered on an organizing and relaxing experience.

games.name: Ace Combat Zero: The Belkan War
games.summary: The sixth installment in the Ace Combat series explores the Belkan War, a devastating conflict alluded to in Ace Combat 5. In the game's main story mode, the player takes control of a mercenary pilot, callsign "Cipher", taking part in the Belkan War by advancing through aerial combat, escort, assault, and defense missions. The story is told through the eyes of a reporter, 10 years after the conflict, uncovering secrets of the war by interviewing some of the pilots the player shoots down.

games.name: Dub Party
games.summary: Dub Party is a party game where players replace every voice in a video with their own. Import a clip or pick a community scene, claim the roles, record each line, then watch the finished dub together. Play solo, pass one mic around the couch, or invite up to seven friends online.

games.name: Paw Patrol: Dino World
games.summary: Join the PAW Patrol and Rex on colossal missions across Dino Island. Create roar-some looks, play minigames with friends and more.

games.name: Bering Tonnage
games.summary: Build and automate a cargo fleet across over 250 real-world ports in this maritime tycoon. Route ships through strategic canals, navigate tropical cyclones and geopolitical sanctions, and grow a small shipping company into a global logistics empire.

games.name: Bloodspill
games.summary: Bloodspill is a fast-paced, pvp retro fps with one hit combat, featuring classic gamemodes like deathmatch, capture the flag and conquest!

games.name: Dual Protocol: The Case of Eva & Miles
games.summary: Play as Agent Eva to follow the trail, or as Analyst Miles to manage the operation. Dual Protocol is an asymmetric noir puzzle game where two players progress only through conversation. Without seeing each other’s screens, combine the data you have and uncover the truth behind the Castellari murder.

games.name: Obstacle Overdrive
games.summary: Cruise through a world of colorful retro inspired toys in Obstacle Overdrive, a cozy off-roading toy car adventure! Navigate fun, challenging courses, tumultuous tumbles, and enjoy the charm of a miniature world where the obstacles are as playful as the ride itself.

games.name: Penis Bird
games.summary: Slide into the role of arcade gaming's first feathered phallus! Dodge attacking wildlife, poke through tight spaces, and chase high scores across frantic danger filled runs. Collect all the power-up costumes! Features full controller support and a stream-safe Eggplant Mode.

games.name: Screaming Halls: Horror
games.summary: The halls never end...

games.name: Space Snatcher
games.summary: 6-player co-op horror chaos where you're trapped aboard increasingly dangerous space stations. Scan every monster the Company demands, scavenge for powerful items to help you survive, and keep the ship's systems repaired. But the biggest threat might just be your friends.

games.name: Let's Tidy Up!: Treasure
games.summary: Let's Tidy Up! : Treasure is a cozy organizing simulator about tidying up a Dwarf treasure room after a particularly lucrative year. Complete full shelves to unlock skills and abilities. Sort, stack and shelve 8,888 unique items as you slowly unravel the secrets beneath...

games.name: Lord Liberty Quest II: Pure White
games.summary: Someone is secretly hastening the revival of the "Black Devil" that assaults the Disodart Continent every few decades. Taking the situation gravely, the royal capital entrusts the tower's investigation to a church priestess. But that priestess is a young, innocent maiden…

games.name: Tunnel Escape Fates Entwined
games.summary: Fight through a zombie-ravaged city as Olivenia, a daring cop on an escort mission in this rogue-lite RPG/ADV. Use various weapons and upgrade your gear to survive brutal gunplay and deadly encounters where every choice counts. Fail, and very bad things might happen to you…

games.name: Jolly: Anniversary Edition
games.summary: "Jolly: Anniversary Edition" is a fan-remake made from the ground up of the original "Jolly 1" by IvanG. This is designed to give the original game a fresh new coat of paint with better polished gameplay and a new story that helps it connect to the wider Jolly story.

games.name: Aion 2
games.summary: Aion 2 is the only MMORPG built around a world where the sky is the battlefield. Choose your faction, ascend as a Daeva, and fight a faction war across a world 36 times larger than the original.

games.name: Pedal Rebel VR
games.summary: Pedal Rebel VR is a adrenaline-pumping cyberpunk motorbike street racing game that completely transforms any exercise bike and any VR headset into an immersive racing experience!

games.name: Chill Cat
games.summary: Chill Cat is a cute and chaotic 3v3 multiplayer top-down shooter where adorable cats battle for turf with colorful paint blasters!

games.name: FAFO Executive Order Simulator
games.summary: F around and find out! A ruthless no F's given dark comedy where you play the president of the United States of America, abuse executive power, crank up the FAFO meter, deal with robot overlords, alien invasions, drain swamps, flip off allies, crush protests, and destroy all that oppose you!

games.name: Tidy Backpack: In the Faraway Lands
games.summary: Tidy Backpack: In the Faraway Lands is a relaxing puzzle game where you must organize found futuristic loot in your backpack in a tidy way. Find unknown artifacts and learn details about the faraway lands... at least supposedly!

games.name: Gears of War: E-Day
games.summary:
Experience the brutal horror of Emergence Day through the eyes of Marcus Fenix in the origin story of one of gaming's most acclaimed sagas.​
Fourteen years before Gears of War, war heroes Marcus Fenix and Dom Santiago return home to face a new nightmare: the Locust Horde. These subterranean monsters, grotesque and relentless, erupt from below, laying siege on humanity itself. ​
Built from the ground up with Unreal Engine 5, Gears of War: E-Day delivers unprecedented graphical fidelity.

games.name: Star Wars: Galactic Racer
games.summary: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer is a runs-based, high-stakes reinvention of racing born in the lawless Outer Rim. With the Empire gone and the galaxy rebuilding, The Galactic League is created: an underground, unsanctioned circuit where syndicates bankroll chaos and champions are forged.

games.name: Epic Mickey: Rebrushed
games.summary: Embark on a magical journey in Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed! Shape your adventure with the stroke of a brush and transform Wasteland as Mickey Mouse in this beautifully recreated 3D platformer.

games.name: Final Fantasy VII: Ever Crisis
games.summary:
Final Fantasy VII: Ever Crisis is a mobile game covering the whole FFVII timeline by splitting each story into short chapters focused on important moments using animated cutscenes, some with conversation options, followed by a battle.

Relive the most memorable moments from FFVII and experience the journey of a young hero Sephiroth.

Experience both classic and new stories within the FFVII universe presented in a retro-style look combined with modern, beautifully rendered graphics, that’s easily accessible on the go. Team up your favorite characters and customize each one with iconic gear and

games.name: Gear.Club Unlimited 3
games.summary: The Gear.Club series is back! Customize and set up your favourite cars to race at top speed along the roads of the French Mediterranean coast and Japan. Don't just win – show off your style!

games.name: Lostbound
games.summary: Find all the Artifacts before you’re caught in this Roguelite Action RPG. Embrace your destiny and escape a collapsing world. Darkness is alive. The Hand erases your path and drags you into the Abyss. Every step shapes your run.

games.name: Quern: Undying Thoughts
games.summary:
Quern is a first person puzzle adventure with captivating story and beautiful graphics. Quern refreshes the genre with flexible gameplay and reuseable puzzle mechanics. The visuals and the music combine traditional and modern elements providing a unique mood for the game.

One of the specialities of Quern is that the tasks to be solved are not managed as separate, individual and sequential units, but as a complex entity, amongst which the players may wander and experiment freely. Often a bad or seemingly irrational result may bring the player closer to the final solution, if those are reconsid

games.name: Fire Up Together
games.summary: Fire Up Together is a physics-based co-op platforming adventure for up to four players. Use pressurized water to launch yourself into the air, extinguish fires, overcome chaotic obstacles, and climb as high as possible with your friends.

games.name: Witch Cabin Cleanup
games.summary: Witch's Cabin Cleanup is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort 5,313 curios in a cluttered witch's cabin. Clean, learn spells, and restore order in a calm and atmospheric environment.

games.name: Hell is Us
games.summary: If war is the closest we get to hell on earth, it's because Earth harbours the worst of demons: humankind. In an isolated country ravaged by infighting, discover the secrets of your past and deal with the repercussions of a mysterious calamity.

games.name: Kingdom Hearts III
games.summary:
Kingdom Hearts III is the third main installment in the Kingdom Hearts series developed and published by Square Enix. It was initially released January 2019 for the PlayStation 4 and the Xbox One. An expansion, Kingdom Hearts III Re Mind was released in January 2020.

The story takes place after the events of Kingdom Hearts 3D: Dream Drop Distance. It features an older Sora as the main protagonist, who sets forth on a new adventure to search for seven guardians of light in an attempt to stop Xehanort from bringing about a second Keyblade War. Sora is joined by Donald Duck, Goofy, Mickey Mouse,

games.name: Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival
games.summary: Experience a new chapter in the legendary horror series like never before. Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival takes first-person action horror survival to the next level. Wield the powers of the Genesis Configuration puzzle box to survive your bargain with the infamous Pinhead.

games.name: Silver Pines
games.summary: Silver Pines is a Survival Horror set in small town America. Fight nightmarish terrors and solve puzzles, while carefully managing your scarce resources as you uncover the mysteries that could hold the key to redemption.

games.name: Order of the Sinking Star
games.summary: From director Jonathan Blow (Braid, The Witness), Order of the Sinking Star is a narrative adventure set in a realm of magic and enigma. Solve over 1000 interconnected, hand-crafted puzzles, discover unique playable heroes, master evolving gameplay mechanics, and decipher a grand mystery.

games.name: Forever Ago
games.summary: Following a tragic stroke of fate, Alfred embarks on a journey north in search of redemption. In this single-player road trip adventure, you'll travel to beautiful places, capture memories with your camera, meet interesting people, and even make some new friends.

games.name: Calx
games.summary: Calx is an atmospheric 3D action adventure inspired by visionary sci-fi art. Explore planet Syro - vast landscapes filled with crystal structures and ancient technology. Find out what the WARP did to the Quoths civilization. The environment guides you, revealing secrets through exploration.

games.name: Once Upon a Katamari
games.summary: Keep the good times rolling with a new entry in the Katamari Damacy series! In this puzzle action-adventure game, you'll roll your Katamari through time itself. Journey through the Jurassic Period, Ice Age, historic Japan, and more eras to rebuild the starry sky.

games.name: Deck of Haunts
games.summary: Deck of Haunts invites you to become a malevolent Haunted House. Lure humans into your cursed halls, manipulate their fears, and drain their essence to grow your power. Use strategy to build your mansion and expand your dark influence, turning your home into a terrifying, inescapable nightmare.

games.name: Echo Weaver
games.summary: A fast-paced metroidBRAINia that tells the tale of a ruined society trapped in a fatal time loop. Uncover their story - and your own - as you explore what remains. Use each loop to chip away at the mystery, unlocking powerful knowledge to reshape the timeline and master the loop.

games.name: Neon Abyss 2
games.summary: Plunge into the chaotic cybermyth roguelike world of Neon Abyss 2! With diverse combat styles and unlimited item synergies, every run delivers a dramatic and action-packed experience you won't forget.

games.name: Penguin Colony
games.summary: Narrative adventure game based on H.P Lovecraft's At the Mountains of Madness. Swim, Slide and Explore open ended levels as multiple penguin types with different abilities and challenges.

games.name: Invokyr
games.summary: A co-op survival horror game about a cursed board game. Play with up to 5 friends. Roll the dice, survive the horrors that are summoned, and beat the Gamemaster to win your freedom.

games.name: Kingdom Hearts 0.2: Birth by Sleep - A Fragmentary Passage
games.summary: A short sequel to Kingdom Hearts Birth By Sleep that partially takes place during the events of the first Kingdom Hearts, A fragmentary passage gets its name from a hidden ending to BBS and tells the story of Master Aqua's ten-year journey through the Realm of Darkness. 0.2 acts as a prologue to the upcoming Kingdom Hearts III, and also as a demo of Kingdom Hearts traversal, combat, and graphics in Unreal Engine 4 as it will appear in KH3. This game is only playable as part of the collection Kingdom Hearts HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue.

games.name: MyPopgoes
games.summary:
Popgoes is an official Five Nights at Freddy's spinoff series, produced by Scott Cawthon and developed by fans as part of the "Fazbear Fanverse Initiative".

MyPopgoes is a short and simple resource management minigame, where you take care of an extremely needy weasel named Popgoes. Housed in an adorable plastic LCD toy, your new pixelated best friend will need pizza, fizzy drinks, and only the best entertainment provided by Freddy Fazbear himself. And if Popgoes doesn't receive what he desperately needs, he passes out. Or maybe he straight up dies. Up to your imagination.

games.name: The Crew: Motorfest
games.summary: The Crew Motorfest is an open-world racing game set on scaled-down versions of the Hawaiian islands of Oahu and Maui. The third entry in The Crew series, it is structured around a festival theme with "Playlists" consisting of staged races, side activities, and challenges built around topics like specific car brands or motorsport disciplines. Players can control cars, boats, and planes across the open world, and multiplayer modes include the Grand Race and Demolition Royale. The game originally started development as DLC for The Crew 2 before becoming a standalone title, and draws comparisons t

games.name: Afterbeat
games.summary: A musical bullet-hell where all things beautiful are deadly. Dodge well little nanobot, you don't have much time.

games.name: Boku to Tsuri Nikki
games.summary: Boku to Tsuri Nikki is a freshwater fishing game set in a peaceful, nature-filled world, where players can enjoy an immersive fishing experience.

games.name: Earth Defense Force 5
games.summary: Stand and fight for humanity. This arcade shooter takes place in the year 2022, as the Earth Defense Force fends off an all-out attack by unknown life forms. Become an EDF soldier, battle against endless hordes of immense enemies, and restore peace to the earth.

games.name: Harold Rabbit 3: The House of Mysteries
games.summary: Harold Rabbit and Maud Bumblebee have been invited to the mansion of Archibald Squirrel, for a great game of wits. Can Harold and Maud solve the riddles and puzzles Archibald Squirrel has prepared for them?

games.name: Heroic Songs: The Remix!
games.summary: Travel through fantasy worlds and build an idol sanctuary! An idol × city-building simulation game where you create your very own fan sanctuary alongside adorable idols to restore the lost connections between worlds!

games.name: Kingdom Hearts Birth by Sleep Final Mix
games.summary: Originally released exclusively in Japan. An HD remaster of Kingdom Hearts Birth by Sleep Final Mix was finally released globally for the collection "Kingdom Hearts HD 2.5 ReMIX."

games.name: Kingdom Hearts Dream Drop Distance HD
games.summary:
Kingdom Hearts Dream Drop Distance HD is a full HD remaster of Kingdom Hearts 3D: Dream Drop Distance designed for the PlayStation 4. It was released as part of a package of three games entitled Kingdom Hearts HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue.

The game is largely the same as its Nintendo 3DS counterpart, but includes some additional features as well as alterations designed to adapt the game to the PS4. The conversion from two screens to one is the most notable of the changes seen. Little has changed in terms of gameplay. However, three new Dream Eaters have been introduced and minor game feature

games.name: Kingdom Hearts Final Mix
games.summary: Originally released only in Japan on December 26, 2002, Kingdom Hearts Final Mix is finally brought to the global scene as an HD Remaster in the collection "Kingdom Hearts HD 1.5 ReMIX". It has several events and a number of gameplay tweaks that are not in previous releases. New scenes, clarifying certain plot points, such as Riku's journey and foreshadowing of Kingdom Hearts II, were included, but no new dialogue was recorded. A gameplay option allows the player to skip cutscenes. The optional bosses are included, along with a new fight against "Unknown Man."

games.name: Kingdom Hearts II Final Mix
games.summary: An HD remaster of Kingdom Hearts II Final Mix, which was originally exclusive to Japan. It was released globally for the first time as part of the collection "Kingdom Hearts HD 2.5 ReMIX".

games.name: Kingdom Hearts Re:Chain of Memories
games.summary: Kingdom Hearts Re:Chain of Memories is a full remake of Kingdom Hearts: Chain of Memories, originally released on the Game Boy Advance. It was originally remade for the PS2, and eventually remastered in the collection "Kingdom Hearts HD 1.5 ReMIX". The game was also changed in that completing the "Kingdom Hearts 358/2 Days" cutscenes would unlock additional Enemy Cards that would have been unlocked in the original by having save data from "Kingdom Hearts II: Final Mix"

games.name: PlantUp
games.summary: Grow plants, process your harvest, and serve impatient customers before chaos takes over your shop. PlantUp blends cozy farming with fast-paced time management, clever upgrades, and a campaign full of challenges.

games.name: Rainbow Islands CS
games.summary: Experience 6 different versions of the magical world of Rainbow Islands! That comical place full of dreams is back!

games.name: Spica Adventure
games.summary:
From the arcade legends, TAITO, experience this formerly Japan-exclusive 2D action jump & run filled with charm and cartoonish delight on modern consoles for the very first time! Reminiscent of the parasol from Parasol Stars: Bubble Bobble III, this yellow parasol will become your favorite accessory and best weapon. Use it to take down a wild mix of enemies that come straight out of a toybox!

Whether it's slashing combos, shooting, jumping off platforms, gliding, or floating, Nico and her parasol have an arsenal of moves that are as varied as her colorful foes. Don’t forget to use the parasol

games.name: Dragon's Dogma II
games.summary:
Dragon's Dogma is a single player, narrative driven action-RPG that challenges players to choose their own experience – from the appearance of their Arisen, their vocation, their party, how to approach different situations and more.

On your journey, you’ll be joined by Pawns, mysterious otherworldly beings, in an adventure so unique you will feel as if accompanied by other players while on your own adventure.

All of these elements are elevated further by the latest in graphics, artificial intelligence (AI) and physics technology to create a truly immersive fantasy world in Dragon's Dogma 2.

games.name: Truckful
games.summary: Drive your pickup truck through seemingly peaceful countryside valleys, deliver much-needed goods to local townsfolk and unravel the small town mystery. Beware, the old forest is watching.

games.name: Paperhead
games.summary:
PAPERHEAD is a fast-paced FPS game set in a world where everything is made out of cardboard and paper but is infested with horror!
Use a pencil as a weapon and explore what exactly went wrong in the secret research facility and why suddenly papercut people were able to...bleed.
Paperhead's Main Features

- Cardboard cute style with a horror twist. Cute but horrifying!

- Brutal and fast-paced combat. Slide to throw enemies in the air, kick explosive barrels into them (or enemies themselves!), and jump onto them Mario-style.

- Use a Pencil as a weapon. Draw a bomb to explode enemies!

- Use a

games.name: Car Park Capital
games.summary: The car industry needs you to design and build the greatest car parks that simple town life hasn't seen before. Introduce the need for car commuting and turn neighborhoods into car parks! Use propaganda to convince people to pay you for it. Fight people that see through your oily business.

games.name: Beat, Heart, Beat
games.summary: Beat, Heart, Beat is an autoscrolling rhythm-platformer centered around slashing through enemies to the music to maintain your momentum and traverse your way towards your own heart.
