games.summary: Restore order to a massive armory. Find and sort over 1,500 weapons, ammunition, grenades, and military equipment scattered throughout the facility, placing every item on its correct rack. As you organize the armory, unlock abilities that help you sort faster and more efficiently.

games.name: Corposlop
games.summary: Corposlop is an automation game that lives on your desktop. Harvesting resources using bureaucracy, and refine it into components to feed the corporate machine. Make advanced factories and efficient pipelines to make the most out the limited land you have.

games.name: Fjordal
games.summary: A Viking colony sim with production chains and resource management. Establish a Norse village and refine the land's resources. Pay tribute to the King, or grow strong enough to fight back.

games.name: Node Crown
games.summary: Node Crown is a roguelite focused on building a node-based kingdom. Quick runs designed for replayability, deep synergies, hundreds of nodes, and builds that make every run unique - you will find it here!

games.name: On The Hook
games.summary: You owe the casino boss a debt you can never repay—one that snowballs with compounding interest, growing heavier by the night. Several young female agents, themselves ensnared in the trap, are ready to take your orders. Make it out of the casino before the debt buries you alive.

games.name: Slots & Skulls
games.summary: A turn-based roguelite built on a slot machine. Spin to attack, open chests for new symbols, strike deals with cats, and risk your symbols at the anvil.

games.name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
games.summary: The evil Ganondorf is scheming to steal the mythical Triforce from the Sacred Realm and take over the world. Now Link must become the hero of time and save the kingdom in this classic tale, built from the ground up for the Nintendo Switch 2 system.

games.name: Edge of Memories
games.summary: The Corrosion, a plague of unparalleled proportions, has already ravaged the Astryan continent. On the other side of the world, the continent of Avaris and its nomadic peoples—so far spared from the horrors spawned by this abomination—now stand on the brink of extinction. Eline, an itinerant Soul Whisperer, relentlessly battles the force that turns the once-thriving fauna, flora and humans of this lush land into grotesque abominations. Following a mysterious encounter, a dark power awakens within her, one that may hold the key to ending this apocalypse: the ability to control the Corrosion wit

games.name: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy
games.summary: Fire up a wild ride across the cosmos with a fresh take on Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy. In this action-adventure game, you are Star-Lord leading the unpredictable Guardians from one explosion of chaos to the next. You got this. Probably.

games.name: Wielders of the Essence
games.summary: Single-player horde survival with a touch of incremental base building. Eight-minute runs. Eight hours to complete.

games.name: Where the Seeds Fall
games.summary: Blight has infected the land, forcing humanity to live upon the branches of the World Tree. After a chance encounter with a strange child, your world begins to fall apart. Navigate ruins, read the wind, and take a leap of faith into this thrilling action-adventure game.

games.name: Emery Hearts
games.summary: Immerse yourself in this thrilling action JRPG and uncover the secrets of Emery crystals as you face challenging enemies that will demand all your skill and ingenuity to defeat them.

games.name: Kingdom of Night
games.summary:
Kingdom of Night is an 80s-inspired isometric action RPG where coming-of-age drama meets cosmic horror.

When a satanic cult unleashes the ancient evil Baphomet on the small town of Miami, Arizona, high school student John must fight through a night of demonic chaos to rescue his friends before the town is lost forever.

Choose from five distinct classes—Barbarian, Knight, Rogue, Necromancer, or Sorcerer—and customize your build with expansive skill trees, powerful loot, and unique equipment. Explore the town freely, battle terrifying Demon Generals in any order, uncover the stories of Miami's

games.name: Yomawari: Midnight Shadows
games.summary: The dark is no place to be alone. After a beautiful show of summer fireworks, two young girls begin to make their way home. However, a mysterious attacker separates them, and both must brave the haunting night filled with unspeakable terrors and survive the darkness.

games.name: Yomawari: Night Alone
games.summary: Yomawari is a Japanese horror action game and features a female protagonist that is searching for her older sister and pet dog, while exploring a creepy town at night. She only has a flashlight at her disposal, and using said flash light will let her “see things that shouldn’t be seen.”

games.name: Crymelight
games.summary: CRYMELIGHT is a roguelike action game set in the world of the afterlife, where girls confront their sins as they fight to gain their freedom.

games.name: Glory On Pluto
games.summary: Bring prestige back to Earth by building your engines and finding Glory on Pluto in this offbeat and unique deckbuilding rougelike.

games.name: Blood of Rations
games.summary: Blood of Rations is a WW2 extraction shooter set in 1944 occupied Europe. Deploy alone into solo PvPvE raids, scavenge what the dead left behind, and extract alive — or lose everything you carried in. No minimap, all-diegetic audio, a grid inventory where every slot is a decision, and an 8-second extraction window. Between raids you rebuild the underground bunker you call home.

games.name: Bros of Bench
games.summary: Bros of Bench is a chaotic co-op platformer where two players form a dumbbell connected by an adjustable bar. Alternate between lifting each other and flying with jetpacks while mastering coordination, physics, and timing.

games.name: Build a Bot
games.summary: A top-down shooter rogue-like that sees its player take control of a mechanized weapons platform designed for one thing and one thing only: “Take down the corporation, by any means necessary. . .”

games.name: Celeste Blue Wizard Luna
games.summary: Help Luna form a resistance to take down Princess Lucia the Black Witch and free the skyborne land of Jupiterno from her tyranny!

games.name: Dialshift
games.summary: Dialshift is a single-player score-attack arcade game played on a circular dial. Players control a continuously moving cursor with two directional inputs and time hit attempts against targets while maintaining combos and Stability. Seven modes vary the rules with directional targets, forced reversals, sustained holds, and multi-hit targets. Each mode has its own scores, ranks, and leaderboard.

games.name: Dominus Gladiatus
games.summary: Dominus Gladiatus is a brutal gladiator management simulator where you recruit, train and equip gladiators and make life or death decisions throughout a deadly 160-day tournament against rival Domini.

games.name: Dust & Diamonds
games.summary: Humans are extinct, and Goblins proudly stand at the top of the food chain! Take over a mine, expand your surface base, and automate logistics. Manage workers, trade, avoid cave-ins and lava, and above all – try to endure your father's constant grumbling!

games.name: Feed Me More Brains
games.summary: A silly first-person incremental game about feeding an ancient god with brains. Grab, throw and automate their delivery as you unlock mutations, summon loyal cultists, and transform your temple into the ultimate brain-feeding machine.

games.name: K-Pop Rising: Dream to Shine
games.summary: Make your dream come true and become a K-Pop Star in this exciting life sim and rhythm game! Dance and sing your way through the competition and rise to glory. Customise your character to your image, it is your time to shine!

games.name: Manala: Equinox War
games.summary:
Manala: Equinox War is a LARP world where you build your combat deck and fight other players. Pick up your foam sword, put on your wizard hat and let's go kill the bad guys.

Depending on your point of view, that's either the person in the orc mask or the dwarf with a glued-on beard. The player characters are modeled on real LARPers' costumes.

If you're losing badly, you can always cheat. Just ignore the rules for a bit and be prepared to live with the shame.

games.name: Manic Miner
games.summary:
The legendary platforming classic is back!
Jump, collect, survive - Rediscover one of the greatest and most challenging video game classics of all time!

games.name: Plucked
games.summary: Up to 12 players, one pond. A top-down bullet-heaven roguelite where you merge your guns into increasingly stupid firepower, then find out how much of it one duck can hold. Survive the waves, outlive the swarm, quack responsibly.

games.name: Psycho-Sleuth
games.summary: Psycho-Sleuth is a psychological mystery where cognitive disorders twist the logic of murder. 13 afflicted participants — each bound by strange rules like “no lying,” “no left side,” or “no faces” — are trapped in a deadly game where the sickness spreads and truth itself becomes unreliable.

games.name: Swarm Harvest
games.summary:
Congratulations, you're hired!
Blast bugs, deploy defensive towers, and command a pack of powerful attack drones to carve through endless alien swarms. Evolve into an unstoppable bug-blasting machine with absurdly overpowered builds to generate massive profits and make the corporation proud.

games.name: TerraLounge
games.summary:
Players decorate and spend time in a terrarium, and play match-3 puzzles to earn currency to use in the terrarium. This currency is used to buy toys, decorations, music, and floors.

The game features 3 game modes: Endless, with procedurally generated boards; Story, hand-crafted levels across 5 worlds; Terrarium, where players decorate and spend time with slimes.

The intent of the game is to be a second screen, fish tank kind of game, where it exists with the player as a companion, but not draw attention to itself.

games.name: Yomawari: Lost in the Dark
games.summary: Another chapter of the atmospheric horror series has emerged from the shadows! Eerie sound design and shadowy environments set the stage for gruesome and terrifying ghosts never seen before in the series.

games.name: American Gold Rush
games.summary: Dahlonega, Georgia. 1829. You've got a shovel, a day's food, and a hole in the ground that gets richer the deeper you're willing to go. Every step and every swing costs energy and daylight, so the real game is deciding when to push one more swing of the axe, and when to climb out.

games.name: Apotheosis Engine
games.summary: An accident causes a lost space probe to become self aware. Apotheosis Engine is a lore-rich incremental game. Grow from a piece of engineering into a galactic superdeity by navigating an alien OS.

games.name: Boneyard Bounce!
games.summary: All four edges of the board are your paddle — a block breaker unfolded in four directions. Fire a spell-ball into a monster-packed graveyard maze and watch it carom through the horde. Elemental kills chain-detonate straight through walls. Smash the headstones too; the landlord pays for wreckage.

games.name: Brothel Virgin: The Crimson Reverie
games.summary: Your first night in a brothel. Nervous? Excited? You’ve got one night to pick your companion — or unlock a hidden VIP experience. Animated scenes, wild choices, and more secrets than you can handle.

games.name: Hasbro Games Junior Collection
games.summary: Get ready for a big, colorful game night full of laughs, surprises, and “just one more turn!” moments! This collection brings 3 classic junior board games; Monopoly, The Game of Life, and Clue to life in one exciting video game made for kids and families.

games.name: High Voltage
games.summary: High Voltage is a first-person incremental game about building your power grid. Start with a pedal-powered generator, expand with wind and solar power and keep the city supplied with electricity. Upgrade, complete contracts and see how far you can grow your network.

games.name: Lost Media Agency
games.summary: A found footage horror game where you need to piece together a timeline in chronological order of a Kaiju incident that occurred.

games.name: Pith
games.summary: Traverse a wonderful and strange world, find playful tools, and uncover secrets in PITH, a metroidbrainia/puzzle-platforming adventure full of twists and surprises.

games.name: Siege of Akanor
games.summary: Siege of Akanor is a third-person medieval tower defense game in which players prepare a castle's defenses, command troops, and fight directly on the battlefield. Between waves, players can deploy and upgrade defenses before joining the battle with melee and ranged weapons. The game features a single-player campaign, cooperative multiplayer, progression systems, multiple enemy types, siege weapons, and fantasy elements including dragons.

games.name: To Be Besieged
games.summary: Defend the war torn civilians with allies against the 1 hour siege until rescue helicopter arrives

games.name: Ho Ho Ho Sokoban
games.summary: A cozy Christmas-themed Sokoban puzzle game where Santa must push presents into the right places. Solve 50 handcrafted pixel art levels full of festive charm.

games.name: Borbs
games.summary: Reunite chonky borbs with their flock in this relaxing puzzle game, brought to life by hand-drawn artwork from a longtime bird keeper.

games.name: Funeral for the Sun
games.summary: Search the ashes of an abandoned Latin American town and uncover 400 years of secrets. An epic non-linear mystery where you travel back in time and untangle the history of a community cursed by generations of supernatural forces.

games.name: Hantu and Hunted
games.summary: Morph into props to survive as a human or hunt as the legendary ghosts of Southeast Asian folklore. Asymmetric horror prop hunt with proximity voice chat. Hide, hunt and escape.

games.name: Just A Dice Game
games.summary: A relaxing dice rolling roguelike about chasing score targets and trying to break the game. Build up your collection of dice while buying upgrades, relics and other powerups to build wild synergies and laugh in the face of RNG.

games.name: Mini Mart Survivors
games.summary: SHIFT24 is a mysterious convenience store chain. As night deepens, strange customers swarm endlessly. Ramen, snacks, and coffee become weapons. Fight them off, and clues hidden in branches worldwide begin to emerge. Follow the clues and pay down your debt to uncover the truth behind SHIFT24.

games.name: The Big Suck
games.summary: An incremental game where you ARE the tornado. Destroy fields, cars and buildings, gather wreck to grow, and spend the payday on upgrades in a huge skill tree. Past a certain size the storm stops being weather and picks its catastrophe — fire, flood, winter, or the void — while the county answers with fire crews, bomb squads, tanks and jets.

games.name: Tome of Talis: A Dice Conquest Game
games.summary: Command your dice to glorious victory in this strategic rogue-lite dicebuilder. Cast devastating spells, recruit powerful dice, and prove yourself worthy to challenge the great Commander Talis.

games.name: Nocturnal II
games.summary: Nocturnal 2 is an action-adventure game that lets you explore and rekindle the dark depths and towering heights of the city of Ytash.

games.name: Hope in the City
games.summary: 17-year-old Hope Song returns home from school to find her parents missing. Use Hope’s observant eye as an artist to investigate, piece together clues, and uncover a dark world beneath the surface of her peaceful life in this non-linear narrative mystery game.

games.name: Never Sort By Color
games.summary:
Never Sort By Color is a first-person zen organization game where you use magnet gloves, part detection, sieves, and quick hotkey tossing to sort an enormous pile of plastic bricks into a labeled workshop. Instead of sorting by color, you sort by part type, rebuilding drawers and organizing bays as the floor area opens up.
As you complete categories, instruction books guide you to pull exact parts from the right drawers to assemble MOCs that snap together brick by brick, turning the quiet sorting loop into satisfying, functional model building.

games.name: Carve The Cave Together
games.summary: Dig a cave with a friend, one cell at a time. Throw balls into solid rock in zero gravity and they never stop, so the more cave you open the further everything flies. Mine ore, feed the machine, unlock a roster of balls that each dig differently.

games.name: Clogwork
games.summary: CLOGWORK is a factory-automation game where you turn random pieces into final shapes. Build conveyor belts, glue, cut and rotate parts, wire logic signals, and send the finished shape to the hub to fulfil ever-changing orders.

games.name: Drawmi: Creature Collector
games.summary: A creature collector auto-battler where you can draw all the creatures you collect while battling your way to a Scribble Fighting art degree.

games.name: Dustbloom
games.summary: Team up with friends in this 1-4 player co-op survival game. Build a massive mobile base, automate your production, and terraform a dead red desert into a lush green world. Craft weapons to survive nightly skeleton attacks and uncover the dark mystery of the lost 14th team.

games.name: Elixir of Moonglow
games.summary: Ella & Umbra — Ella wakes in a strange world with no memory, just a wolf by her side. Uncover and explore a cozy story-rich adventure as an apprentice alchemist through hand-drawn biomes. Gather ingredients, solve thoughtful puzzles as Ella accepts a world of chaos, wonder, and forgotten alchemy.

games.name: Fragments
games.summary: Your mind is shattered. Step into a first-person psychological horror where you must relive your deepest trauma, uncover fragments of your past, piece them back together and face the tormentors that haunt your mind.

games.name: It Thinks!
games.summary: Design the chip that powers AI. Start with a single logic gate and build a computer: wire circuits, cast designs into reusable chips, program tiny kernels, and scale your architecture into a working GPU.

games.name: Patience Balls
games.summary: Patience Balls is a minimalist physics-based puzzle game focused on tilt mechanics and precision. Players navigate one or more balls through intricate labyrinths and mazes to reach designated goal spots. The gameplay emphasizes steady control and logic across multiple themed worlds. It includes global leaderboards and unlockable achievements within a performance-optimized, clean visual style designed for short, meditative sessions.

games.name: Piggy Monte
games.summary: Three little banks, one golden coin, and a heavy steel hammer. Track the coin through the shuffle, pick right, and crack the bank open. Climb fourteen rooms from a kitchen table to the last table, where nine banks move at once. Play money only.

games.name: Rense
games.summary: A fast roguelite FPS. Make your build from level-up power choices and chest items, and fight through three maps of hostile drones. The longer a run goes, the stronger they get. Die, unlock more, come back stronger.

games.name: Torawase: The Girl in the Mirror
games.summary: After his fiancée returns to Japan for work in this visual novel by Dark One!, our protagonist begins dreaming of being a woman in the Middle Ages. The more he has these dreams, the more he becomes a woman in real life. Can he reverse his transformation, or will his life take a different turn?

games.name: Bottled by Bears
games.summary: Join a family of bears and run the buzziest little honey farm! Collect and discover rare bees, bottle honey jars, expand your farm, and watch your flowery field bloom in this cozy idle management game.

games.name: Monomoon
games.summary: In MONOMOON, the way forward is reserved for the knowing and the daring. Guided by moonlight, you’ll uncover hidden truths and wander through a tiny and mysterious open world.

games.name: Wetter
games.summary: Step into the paws of Luna and explore a rain-soaked archipelago. Uncover pieces of your forgotten past and decide which memories will shape who you become.

games.name: Corridors
games.summary: A shooter / gem collection game that lives in your files. Corridors combines high-score action with a fully functional, intuitive file and media explorer. Play in our preset world for competition, or turn your PC and its files into the setting. Lightweight, portable, runs native on most systems.

games.name: Gas N Cars
games.summary: Run a chaotic gas station sandbox: fuel cars, clean and repair vehicles, buy wild tools, catch wanted drivers, earn reviews, unlock upgrades, climb the leaderboard, or turn every stop into total mayhem.

games.name: Headshot Holdout
games.summary: Headshot Holdout is a retro styled co-op shooter where squads of 1-4 players slaughter their way across a hand-authored, zombie infested stronghold on a quest to rescue DEATH itself.

games.name: Hill-Z
games.summary: Zombie wave survival meets King of the hill. Survive, Upgrade, and Protect your flag. Face the unexpected through special rounds, endure the constantly growing horde, and customize your loadout. How many rounds will you survive?

games.name: Mythfall
games.summary: Mythfall is a fast-paced bullet hell MMO where skill and strategy determine survival. Battle relentless monsters, loot powerful gear, and grow stronger as you fight to defend your homeland from the mighty wizard Alivarg. Face deadly bosses, forge alliances, and carve your legacy in a world where every fight could be your last.

games.name: Prinny Party: Going Overboard!
games.summary: Get your friends together for Prinny Party: Going Overboard! In this party game, you’ll traverse the board as you take down demons, earn experience, and buy new equipment—all to make sure you’re strong enough to defeat the Supreme Overboard!

games.name: There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R.
games.summary:
Secret agent Franklin Benjamin will stop at nothing to save the world.

In the single-player interactive novel villain team-up game "There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R.," you play as his greatest adversaries. Can the criminal enterprise known as V.I.C.T.O.R. (short for a "Very Important Collective of Terrorists, Operatives, and Rogues") defeat the only man standing between them and world domination?

To the V.I.C.T.O.R. go the spoils!

games.name: Thronefall
games.summary: A minimalist game about building and defending a little kingdom. Thronefall is a classic strategy game without unnecessary complexity, just some healthy hack-and-slay. Build up your base during the day, and defend it ‘til your last breath at night.

games.name: Metaphor: ReFantazio
games.summary:
From the creative minds of the Persona series – Metaphor: ReFantazio marks ATLUS’ first ever, full-scale fantasy RPG, brought to you by director Katsura Hashino, character designer Shigenori Soejima, and composer Shoji Meguro.

Write your destiny and rise above fear as you step into a fantasy world unlike anything you’ve seen before. Fraught with unsettling mystery, the kingdom stands on a precipice. Now, you must embark on a journey, overcoming obstacles and forging bonds with friends.

games.name: Shadow of the Road
games.summary: Shadow of the Road is a story-driven, turn-based RPG where feudal Japan meets magic and machine. Assemble your team from a diverse set of characters and test your skills against yōkai and steampunk contraptions. Carve your own path through an immersive story and change the fate of the Empire.

games.name: Portabellows
games.summary: Explore a whimsical island to find… pie recipes?! Bake them by gathering or growing ingredients, which may be the key to helping out your new found quirky friends leave the island! In this wholesome 3D platformer collectathon, you can enjoy discovering the world freely at your own pace.

games.name: Sonic Pico Park
games.summary: The co-op action puzzle game series PICO PARK is back... and this time, we're teaming up with SEGA's legendary Sonic the Hedgehog! This collaboration is packed with co-op gameplay that combines the flair of Sonic with the puzzle teamwork fun of PICO PARK! Play locally or online with 2 to 8 players!

games.name: Ballzy: PvP Block Puzzle
games.summary: Build the longest route, solve handcrafted and community puzzles, then outthink rivals in hidden-block PvP. Ballzy is a premium pixel-art strategy puzzler with Classic, Story, Puzzle, and asynchronous Battle modes.

games.name: Beyond The Blight
games.summary: A short first person, 2.5d incremental dungeon-crawler where you loot, upgrade, and grow stronger on the quest to find and defeat the source of the blight.

games.name: ChromaFlow
games.summary: Build a color-powered factory. Extract red, green, and blue, transport them across networks of conveyor belts, and blend them to create an expanding spectrum. Fulfill the demands of the Chroma Core, unlock technology, and optimize every production line.

games.name: Desktop Plinko
games.summary: An idle incremental plinko game that sits in the corner of your screen while you do other things.

games.name: Echo 9
games.summary: Echo 9 is a tense first-person horror. You are Yon, a maintenance android. Navigate a failing shuttle through deep space, stabilize the dying reactor, and bring Eva to the evacuation point. Radiation is rising, the evacuation point far. Eva is in stasis. You are all she has.

games.name: Find Kittens 12: Pirates
games.summary: Yo-ho-ho and a bottle of rum! Are you ready to travel on an exciting journey with pirates? What are you waiting for? Explore and find cute cats to fill the black-and-white world with bright colors.

games.name: Hordia
games.summary: Cut down endless hordes of monsters and become absurdly powerful! Loot, upgrade, and stack augments into wild builds. Hold the island with cannons and traps, hunt down the bosses waiting out on the map, and survive as long as you can. Solo or online co-op!

games.name: Lost Zion
games.summary: Lost Zion is an atmospheric cyberpunk horror game. Awakened by a faint signal as a service bot, explore the forsaken megacity of Lost Zion. Uncover the Emperor's horrific secrets. Obey your sole command: Activate the Gravity Core.

games.name: Metaphor: ReFantazio - Atlus 35th Digital Anniversary Edition
games.summary:
The ATLUS 35th Digital Anniversary Edition includes exclusive DLCs to further enhance your Metaphor: ReFantazio journey and commemorate past ATLUS titles.

1. Digital Base Game
2. Digital Artbook
3. Digital Soundtrack
4. Atlus 35th Digital History Book
5. Atlus 35th Digital All-Time Best Soundtrack
6. Over 50 DLC costumes, Battle BGMs, and Jingle Sets including:
- Shujin Academy School Uniform
- Golden Yasogami High School Uniform
- Gekkoukan High School Uniform
- Seven Sisters High School Uniform
- St. Hermelin High School Uniform
- Jouin High School Uniform
- Samurai Garb
- Etrian Odyssey Se

games.name: Metaphor: ReFantazio Guidebook Edition
games.summary:
Forge bonds and win over a kingdom divided in this award-winning fantasy RPG.

The Metaphor: ReFantazio Guidebook Edition includes a 55-page Essential Digital Strategy Guide (available in English only). The Essential Digital Strategy Guide is a carefully curated and re-edited version of the printed complete 592-page Official Strategy Guide by Future Press and features an in-depth introduction to the game's story and mechanics, along with a walkthrough of the game's first arc. As players advance, the guide provides an optimized schedule for the remainder of the journey, helping them maximize th

games.name: Phantom Gear
games.summary: Gear up in your battle armor and take on the sinister Ocular Force! Become Josephine and put a stop to the power-mad cult and the mysterious phantom force behind their spree of carnage!

games.name: Pikmin 4: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy
games.summary: Give Oatchi commands using your voice and put your Dandori skills to the test in Pikmin 4 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy.

games.name: PlanetOrbit
games.summary: Turn a bare rock into a neon-lit casino planet. Win chips at poker, baccarat, blackjack, chinchiro, roulette and slots, then spend them on buildings and watch the dry ground turn green. Drawn by the lights, NPCs begin to visit. Grow the liveliest planet in the galaxy, your way.

games.name: Princessfall
games.summary: Betrayed, broke, and packing twin magic hand cannons, ex-noble Alice is fighting to survive with her one-armed butler in a ruthless world where the strong rule the weak. A dark fantasy JRPG with full voice acting, nostalgic doujin-style visuals, and 20+ hours of story-driven adventure.

games.name: Pro Basketball Manager 2027
games.summary: Take charge of a basketball club and oversee every aspect of its development. Build your roster, discover emerging talent, develop future stars, and implement the tactical vision that will define your team's identity.

games.name: Silent Authority: Blood & Bourbon
games.summary: Strategy meets action RPG in the 1920s New York underworld of crime. Collect protection money, trade, and expand your criminal empire while leading your crew in brutal tactical combat. Rule the city with cunning diplomacy or pure bloodshed.

games.name: Ski-E-O! Ski Resort Tycoon
games.summary: Build the cozy ski resort of your dreams in this management game where no two winters are the same. Paint trails onto real mountains, connect lifts, and place the lodges and après bars that keep thousands of skiers warm, fed, and happy.

games.name: The Totemist
games.summary: Run an occult shop in a quietly strange town, crafting totems and talismans inspired by real witchcraft. Help townspeople with their burdens at your own pace while uncovering an ancient darkness beneath the town, one only you can stop.

games.name: Warrior Quest
games.summary: Warrior Quest is a single-player, text-driven dark-fantasy RPG where old-school dungeon crawling meets next-gen, free-form, offline AI diplomacy. Fight, sneak, negotiate in your own words, recruit unlikely companions... and whatever you do, roll well.

games.name: Bonebuilder
games.summary: In this action roguelike you will fight imposing enemies in heavy, deliberate third-person 3D action combat. Collect bones and weapons from defeated enemies to build the most powerful skeleton possible through Bonebuilder's unique crafting and talent systems!

games.name: Fancy Farm Brawl
games.summary: Closed Playtest Now Live! Mix relaxing farming & tower defense. Early testers average over 98 minutes per play session. Click Request Access on store page to apply for limited slots.

games.name: Netherwake
games.summary: Experience a nerve-racking adventure as a thick, dark fog begins to roll into the small town from the surrounding forests, and with it come ancient, cosmic beings from outside our reality. Try to survive and pray that you will one day see the sunlight again.

games.name: Powerfuel
games.summary: Powerfuel is an action FPS set in a gritty dieselpunk world. Play as the legendary ex-criminal known as the Cricket, and harness the mystical properties of powerfuels. Fight your way through the gangs of New Lyon and shed light on the conspiracy plaguing the city.

games.name: Trees Hate You
games.summary: Hike through the worst forest full of the most horrible trees. Do not trust them. The trees will trick you. They will bully you. They will hurt you. If only you could find an axe...

games.name: Fool King
games.summary: Dethrone the Fool King in this tactical autobattler with asynchronous PvP! Amass your troops, apply powerful upgrades and set your battle formations. Watch your plans come together or fall apart in frantic simulated combat.

games.name: Trafficity
games.summary: A city builder focused on traffic. Build out your city with gridless road tools. Fix traffic jams with roundabouts, fully-customizable traffic lights, or sprawling highway interchanges. Keep traffic flowing as you expand to a vast metropolis.

games.name: World 23
games.summary: Battle through decaying mega-cities, abandoned metro tunnels, and guarded enemy facilities in this fast-paced top-down hack and slash. As Theo and Leo, you master abilities and switch weapons during combat to match your play style and the challenge ahead.

games.name: Milki Delivery
games.summary: Grab your bike and milk bottles, let's hit the road! Explore the countryside in this short cozy delivery adventure. Befriend folks and gently help them rebuild their community, one bottle at a time. Upgrade your bike, your dairy farm, and venture deeper into a once-lively region.

games.name: Ranger’s Path: National Park Simulator
games.summary: Begin your park ranger journey in Ranger’s Path: National Park Simulator. Maintain trails, assist visitors, check permits and respond to emergencies. Explore diverse biomes and observe varied animal behaviors across a wide range of species.

games.name: AsterMaster
games.summary: A beat-driven roguelite shooter on a hex grid. Every step, shot and dodge lands on the rhythm as you dig into a dead mining asteroid — stack weapon mods, chase synergies, break bosses, and haul your ore back out alive. Full controller support, Steam Deck friendly.

games.name: Steel Gullet
games.summary: Build a massive factory aboard a moving ark. Melt, separate, and refine chaotic scrap using realistic thermodynamics. Process materials by mass instead of items, craft based on material properties, and optimize complex production lines in strictly limited space.

games.name: Unicorn Academy: Island of Magic
games.summary: You are invited to join Unicorn Academy! Create a magical connection with your own unicorn and forge friendship bonds with Sophia, Ava, Layla and the other heroes from the series. Wield unicorn magic and discover every corner of Unicorn Island.

games.name: Zero Sum
games.summary: A hand-drawn twin-stick roguelite where every bullet is an equation and every enemy is a number. Subtract, divide, root, modulo. 7 operators, 22 firing modes, 9 bosses, 80+ upgrades. Reduce them all to zero. No health bars, just raw arithmetic violence. You failed math class. Math didn't forget.

games.name: Space Station Designer
games.summary: Space Station Designer is a construction and management game that puts you in charge of creating and expanding a network of orbital outposts in Earth and Lunar orbits.

games.name: Grand Theft Auto VI
games.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI heads to the state of Leonida, home to the neon-soaked streets of Vice City and beyond in the biggest, most immersive evolution of the Grand Theft Auto series yet.

games.name: Grand Theft Auto VI: Ultimate Edition
games.summary:
Grand Theft Auto VI: Ultimate Edition amplifies the deepest and most immersive GTA experience yet with an exclusive collection of premium vehicles, weapons, apparel, and action threaded across all aspects of Jason and Lucia’s story.

The Ultimate Edition includes:
• Grand Theft Auto VI
• ’95 Grotti Cheetah (Vehicle)
• Hawk & Little Morgan Revolvers (Weapons)
• Personalized Variants (Weapons)
• Vice City Style (Looks)
• Jason’s Safehouse Vehicles (Vehicles)
• Ganado Retro Build (Modkit)
• Rideout Customs (Mod Shop)
• Sara's Unisex Salon (Hair Salon)
• Shitzu Squalo (Watercraft)
• Stock 305 (Clo

games.name: Axyn Adventure
games.summary: Axyn Adventure is a retro style 3D platformer. You take control of the titular character Axyn and embark on many adventures with your friends Yunn and Leaf. Play in the vast open levels using your big set of moves to get around. Collect as many items as you can to advance the story and unlock tons of content.

games.name: Iona's Island
games.summary: Restore a vibrant island paradise atop a giant sea turtle! As the Leshen Iona, wield ancient spells to heal the land and befriend islanders and help them with their quests. Create your own enchanting sandbox style sanctuary. Uncover secrets and reshape a world with accompanied by cozy, lofi vibes.

games.name: Lord of Undead
games.summary: Destroy the castle on the hill in this grim RPG where you play as the Dark Lord. Collect souls, summon an undead army, master dark abilities, craft powerful gear, build your base, and desecrate the lands of a vast open world.

games.name: Phantom Vice Auto
games.summary: Experience entertainment blockbusters Phantom Vice Auto and Phantom Vice Auto Online — now upgraded for a new generation with stunning visuals, faster loading, 3D audio, and more, plus exclusive content for Phantom Vice Auto Online players.

games.name: Volvy’s Adventure: Reslimed
games.summary: Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed is a spectacular remaster of the original remake of the unreleased action-platformer starring the most famous video game mascot of all time.

games.name: CyberKitty: Neon Merge
games.summary: Suika games have evolved! CyberKitty: Neon Merge is a cozy, yet action-driven, dynamic 2D physics puzzle game for 90s retro, pixel art, and match-3 fans! Instead of watermelons, merge a cast of colourful cats. With the CatCade system, swiftly match kitties to boost your multiplier for mega scores!

games.name: Dungeon of Departure
games.summary: an independently developed, pixel art, visual novel set in an original universe which follows the silent, player protagonist and three companion characters as they struggle to find a way out of an increasingly puzzling, underground world.

games.name: Flick
games.summary: Shift realities with the flick of a light switch and plunge into the grotesque to uncover your family's twisted past. A psychological horror game where you must balance the light you need to progress with the terrifying nightmares it summons.

games.name: G.E.M. Grab & Exit
games.summary: Hand-Drawn Twin-Stick Shooter in space where one must survive the robotic ships onslaught and extract with the loot to exchange for ship upgrades.

games.name: Hold the Dawn
games.summary: Build by day. Survive the horde by night. Hold the Dawn is a 3D wasteland tower defense with unique auto-fighting heroes, tactical towers, zombie waves, and co-op over Steam, LAN, or local play.

games.name: Let Me Die
games.summary: Let Me Die is a short incremental game about a hero trapped in a loop, fighting a monster. Unable to win, unable to die. Unlock upgrades, complete quests, create unique builds and maybe you will find a way to break the loop.

games.name: Microscape
games.summary: Heavily inspired by Runescape, Microscape is a tiny community idle game for Twitch streams. Channel owners can add their community to the world. Players then earn playtime by being in these communities.

games.name: Psycasso
games.summary:
Take on the role of a serial killer who creates paintings with their victims blood! Sell your creations to earn money while trying to avoid capture by the police and other civilians.

In this pixel art adventure you'll play as Psycasso, a struggling gallery artist living in an open world city. By day you'll work a day job to earn money and level up skills, seamlessly blending into society. By night you'll be on the lookout to harvest 'red paint' from one of the 'walking meat-bags' to help you create original 2D art. Sell your artwork to art galleries for huge profits! Become rich from your uni

games.name: Salt of the Earth
games.summary: An isometric medieval city builder. You hold one manor by charter: lay the roads, work the fields, and raise hovels into town houses by meeting what each household needs. Winters take stores, the Crown takes dues, and raiders take whatever will burn.

games.name: The Legend of the 4 Elements
games.summary: The Legend of the 4 Elements is a platformer with elemental combat. Control heroes of Fire, Water, Earth, and Air, use unique abilities, overcome challenges, battle dangerous enemies, and restore balance to the world of the elements.

games.name: Witch the Showdown
games.summary: A high-difficulty action game combining parry mechanics and deck-building. Fight your way through and aim to become the champion of the tournament.

games.name: Witch on the Holy Night
games.summary: Set in 1980s Japan, Witch on the Holy Night tells the story of fan-favorite Type-Moon character Aoko Aozaki as she attempts to navigate the complex world of magecraft while also dealing with the everyday struggles of life as a high school student! Players will experience the thrilling origin story of this much-beloved character, penned by Kinoko Nasu, famed creator of the Fate series, himself.

games.name: Football Survivors
games.summary: THE FOOTBALL WAR HAS STARTED! Thousands of raging fans are storming the field. Defend against the fan invasion! 50+ unique heroes and abilities, 50+ upgrade items, position your heroes strategically, crush the waves of fans!

games.name: Nightmare Conquest
games.summary: Nightmare Conquest is a game focused on strategy, planning, and build creation. Assemble your team of monsters, position them intelligently, and evolve their abilities to face increasingly difficult challenges. Every decision matters — from the upgrades you choose to how you combine your monsters on the battlefield.

games.name: Zombie Police: Midsummer Unhappy New Year
games.summary: Ancient customs vs. Detective Zomby—what could possibly happen? Investigate a tragedy caught on a VTuber’s livestream in a village frozen in midsummer. Dive into minds, connect testimony in your Journal, and crack the case in this comedy-mystery adventure.

games.name: Circuit Keep
games.summary: Circuit Keep is a grid‑based tower defense game where players build and upgrade circuit‑themed defenses to repel escalating waves of intrusions. The game features a campaign of handcrafted lattices, a research system, and multiple enemy types with unique behaviors. Players manage resources, optimize layouts, and adapt to changing threats across increasingly complex maps.

games.name: Gothic 3 Classic
games.summary: This overhauled console version of the Cult Classic RPG integrates the community patch 1.75 and further gameplay improvements, features tailor-made gamepad UI & controls and delivers advanced optimization to offer the smoothest Gothic 3 experience yet.

games.name: Derby Dynasty: Horse Racing RPG
games.summary: Horse stable management and realistic race simulation in one. Draft, lane position and energy management run on real physics — and you ride the race yourself. Buy, train and breed horses to build a bloodline that lasts for generations.

games.name: Destruction AllStars
games.summary:
Dominate the glittering global phenomenon of Destruction AllStars – the spectacular prime-time sport for dangerous drivers!

Master the art of intense vehicle-based combat through timing, tactics and skills to cause colossal amounts of damage, destruction and devastation in vibrant arenas across the globe.

Pile-on the destruction from behind the wheel or leap into the arena with a breathtaking reel of parkour action by dodging attacks, taking over vehicles or using abilities to disrupt the onslaught of incoming vehicles.

Cause enough mayhem to power up your AllStars game-changing hero vehicl

games.name: Ages of Cataria
games.summary: Care for generations of townsfolk in a land of mystique and wonder. Build colonies along side your friends in this multiplayer colony sim and narrative RPG.

games.name: Arctic Drive
games.summary: Explore and survive in the Arctic, where your car is the only thing keeping you alive. Arctic Drive is a 1–4 player co-op survival sim set in a procedurally generated winter wilderness. Find supplies, repair your rig, and haul it all onwards with only one hope left: there must be safety out there.

games.name: Expelled from Paradise: The Stellar Angel
games.summary: A brand-new sequel depicting the aftermath of the theatrical anime Expelled from Paradise. The story of Angela and Dingo begins to move once more. This is a full-scale visual novel that weaves a grand science-fiction vision through evocative text and immersive direction.

games.name: Project Atlas
games.summary: In a universe where everything is falling into chaos, one person and their new found companion are out to save the universe from total destruction. Experience heart pounding battle action, animal handling skills, survival skills, and even some fishing along the way. Includes solo story mode, multiplayer 6v6 team death match, and a battle royale. Set in the near future where humans battle resource deprivation, and climate change on worlds. Yet off world threats are the real danger! Battle through countless missions with your customizable K-9 companion. Can the universe be saved or was it doomed

games.name: Turbo Turkey
games.summary: Thanksgiving is coming and you're on the menu. Run, jump, and shoot your way through 16 levels of Turkeyland in this collectathon platformer inspired by Banjo Kazooie, Donkey Kong Country and Crash Bandicoot. Collect pumpkins, race time trials, and prove you're no one's dinner.

games.name: Everlasting Flowers: First Press Limited Special Edition
games.summary: Contains a 2-discs soundtrack and a visual book.

games.name: Happy Weekend
games.summary: An all ages port of Happy Weekend

games.name: Koganei-sou to Konjiki no Agehachou
games.summary: Sprite's 15th anniversary game. A share house receives an odd purchase offer one day and, around the same time, a new girl with suspicious behavior moves in.

games.name: Koganei-sou to Konjiki no Agehachou: First Press Limited Special Edition
games.summary: Includes a visual book, a 2-disc soundtrack and 3 acrylic keyholders.

games.name: Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure
games.summary: A tilt-based platformer game for everyone. Players control Marupoyo’s momentum as he rolls through 120 vibrant levels, avoiding obstacles, exploring, and rescuing his lost siblings.

games.name: Mix Dunk: King of Basketball
games.summary: A new project in collaboration between B.LEAGUE’s professional basketball club Kawasaki Brave Thunders, the idol group AKB48, and the otome game brand Otomate.

games.name: Ship Miner
games.summary: Relaxing mining experience that merges combat elements and 1-bit pixel art aesthetics. Collect minerals from procedurally generated asteroids, improve your ship and survive The Anomaly, an unknown entity threatening The Galaxy. Can a simple miner stop The Anomaly and save everyone?

games.name: Am I Nima
games.summary: Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you must convince your mom that you really are her daughter. Combine words together in your brain and use them to talk. Get her to trust you.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV
games.summary: Return to the RTS series’ roots with deeply satisfying strategy gameplay. Take command of four unique Warhammer 40,000 factions, including the Adeptus Mechanicus in their series debut! Fight through 70+ epic campaign missions, as well as the replayable Last Stand, Skirmish and multiplayer modes.

games.name: Paradise Beyond the Nightmare
games.summary: Paradise Beyond the Nightmare is a 2D exploration horror game where you explore and solve puzzles in a 2D space with depth. You can experience moving both sideways and forwards through eerie paintings.

games.name: Hela: Of Mice & Magic
games.summary: See the world through the eyes of a brave little mouse in this enchanting 3D co-op adventure. Explore breathtaking landscapes inspired by Northern Sweden, solve puzzles, and be a force for good in a land where heartwarming storytelling and the beauty of nature intertwine.

games.name: Silicone Heart
games.summary: Survive on a junkyard planet filled with broken robots, machinery, and resources in this adventure sandbox game. Recycle resources, repair robots, invent items, create new plant species, grow them, and uncover the mysteries of this planet.

games.name: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World - Digital Deluxe Edition
Fishing Fever
games.summary: An incremental roguelike fishing game. Start with one tool, end with five. Draft, upgrade and stack them, then hunt 70 species across eight oceans until the whole sea is biting at once. Rivals steal your cards. Something in the dark already knows your name. One more round. Always one more round.

games.name: Kaperfahrt
games.summary:
Kaperfahrt is an open world pirate sandbox set in a simulated Caribbean during the age of sail. Around 200 AI captains sail, trade and wage their own wars independently of the player, so conflicts and trade routes exist whether the player takes part in them or not.

Players engage in naval combat, board and capture enemy vessels, and command a fleet of up to four ships that fight in formation. Trade runs between five rival houses whose economy reacts to player actions, so blockading a harbour shifts prices across the map. A bounty list of 23 named pirates, each with their own crew and fighting

games.name: Lunadun: Lunatic Dungeon
games.summary: You choose a favorite and walk beside them. But those you left behind — where do they go while you're gone? Lunadun: Lunatic Dungeon is an emotional VN where choices shape the fate of four characters. 'The ones you loved, the ones you ignored — you don't get to walk away from either of them.'

games.name: One More Tower
games.summary: One More Tower is a horde survival TD set in a medieval fantasy world. Pioneer an unexplored forest, build your town and defenses, and hold out against the onslaught of enemies. How long can you survive?

games.name: Pistol Cat
games.summary: A cat. A gun. Recoil-powered movement, leg kicks, and a fart thruster. Shoot your way through a living open world town, smash everything in sight, and survive the Blood Moon: all as a small, physics-driven cat with a big pistol.

games.name: They Are Rising
games.summary: They Are Rising is an RTS strategy game set against the backdrop of the apocalypse. Combine skills, build a massive army, establish shelters, and fight against large numbers of enemies. How long can you survive?

games.name: Wizalign
games.summary: A match-3 adventure RPG where every action happens on the puzzle board. Battle monsters, collect keys, discover powerful dungeon items, manage health and shields, and defeat bosses as you explore overworlds and dungeons inspired by classic adventure games.

games.name: Rayman Legends Retold
games.summary: Embark on a bold reimagining of the beloved platformer, with new visuals and a retold story. Play solo or up to 4‑player couch co‑op, explore a mysterious new realm, jam through new musical stages, and more!

games.name: Eriksholm: The Stolen Dream
games.summary:
Experience an isometric, narrative-driven stealth game set in the stunning city of Eriksholm. When Hanna’s brother, Herman, disappears and the police begin to pursue him, her search sets off a chain of catastrophic events that will not only alter their lives but also the destiny of the entire city. Join your allies, outsmart relentless enemies, and use your cunning to uncover the truth behind Herman’s disappearance — where greater powers are at play than you ever imagined.

Follow Hanna’s adventure through the vibrant streets of Eriksholm, a sprawling Nordic city inspired by the elegance and g

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV
games.summary: Return to the RTS series’ roots with deeply satisfying strategy gameplay. Take command of four unique Warhammer 40,000 factions, including the Adeptus Mechanicus in their series debut! Fight through 70+ epic campaign missions, as well as the replayable Last Stand, Skirmish and multiplayer modes.

games.name: Rayman Origins: Enhanced Edition
games.summary:
When the Glade of Dreams is overrun by “nefurrious” Darktoons, the Fairy Council summons Rayman to save the day. Joined by his best friend, Globox, and two crafty wizards, the Teensies, this unlikely team must restore balance before their world fades away like a bad dream.

Enjoy Rayman Origins like never before with 4K resolution, 60 FPS, and modern enhancements, including new quality-of-life features. Discover 60 hidden Relics across the adventure and track your progress in the Snoring Tree.

games.name: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World
games.summary: In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the Dragon Quest series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle. Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.

games.name: Aeterna Lucis
games.summary: Aeterna Lucis is the highly anticipated sequel to Aeterna Noctis. Following the gameplay steps of the first entry in the series, Aeterna Lucis is a Metroidvania that combines fast-paced combat, a large interconnected map, secret hunting, optional challenges, and a rich and deep story.

games.name: Xenoblade Chronicles 3: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
games.summary: Traverse massive, fantastical landscapes and master seamless real-time RPG combat that has all been enhanced to run at 4K* resolution in TV mode, and full HD in handheld mode, at 60 frames per second with smoother and sharper cutscenes.

games.name: Akashic Slingshot
games.summary: Fight your way through a diverse world in this action-adventure side scroller, where you are given one weapon and die in one hit. Can you earn the right to peer beyond the Zeroed Abyss?

games.name: Million Depth
games.summary: Embark on an adventure, exploring a million subterranean floors of a fallen Earth. Trace the remnants of humanity that once dwelled below, all in search of "YOU". Utilize a crafting system that transforms your drawings into weapons to survive the challenging underground world.

games.name: Fall Up
games.summary: Take a leap into a lost world of mechanical wonders and embark on a hopping adventure with our adorable Labi! You need to traverse this cartoonish world with a variety of jumps and moves, meet squishy creatures and clumsy robots and reveal the secrets of this world.

games.name: Sombras: Negative Frames
games.summary: ‘Sombras: Negative Frames’ is a first person narrative game with a focus on photography and light horror elements. Follow Shiomi, a Japanese-Spanish photography student, as she is spirited away in a dark mirror of her 2000s Japanese town and must confront fragments of her own psyche.

games.name: Step Theater
games.summary: Welcome to the "step theater". "Step theater" is a vibrant rhythm game where the story unfolds and the screen comes closer to success with every step you take. Dive in and enjoy this charming, vibrant drama!

games.name: Monster Hunter Wilds
games.summary: The unbridled force of nature runs wild and relentless, with environments transforming drastically from one moment to the next. This is a story of monsters and humans and their struggles to live in harmony in a world of duality.

games.name: Death and Tactics
games.summary: A post apocalyptic turn-based strategy game. Permanent death is a primary mechanic, with unique events being unlocked based on how you play the game. And there are many ways to play! Such as: selling the organs of party members you don't like, turning your enemies into monsters, and much, much more!

games.name: Goojeegoop
games.summary: Click ClIcK CLICK your way through endless rounds of enemies in an exciting new point and click roguelike and become insanely strong! Click on enemies to unlock new slots, increase your level and create crazy and spectacular builds!

games.name: Nullbreak Protocol
games.summary: A sci-fi arcade roguelite of fast, escalating runs. Launch your core, shatter every block, survive what the room fires back. Draw stacking protocols to build your run, push deeper into the system, and beat your record — the descent never ends.

games.name: Pirate Royalty
games.summary: Pirate Royalty is a free-to-play fantasy pirate MMORPG set on Saltbreak Isle. Players choose from four classes, build their own stats and skills, hunt rare gear, forge gems into equipment, and team up for timed dungeons. It includes PvE, PvP, trading, and a cosmetics-only shop—combat power has to be earned.

games.name: Space Industry
games.summary:
Manage your own modular space fleet by gathering resources, processing them, and expanding your fully automated drones.
Space Industry is a 2D space automation sandbox game in which players build and expand a modular spaceship, mine asteroids, automate production with drones, research new technologies and explore a galaxy filled with hostile fleets. The objective is to prepare the ship for humanity's most dangerous expedition: a journey to the black hole.

games.name: Dadi Kingdom
games.summary:
You are the king. Pass judgment on your people, ride into your own realm sword in hand, and decide who hands you the power to do it. You will not rule forever. Father an heir before your time runs out, and leave behind a dynasty worth remembering.

Dadi Kingdom is a medieval action RPG where you rule and fight. Every day new cases land before your throne: release, gold fine or dungeon. Your verdicts follow you. Outside the walls, the kingdom waits: the Far Lands, the cathedral of Sanktum, the desert bastion, the pirate bay, the ash forests and the mage ruins of Thyrn. Stone golems, lizardmen a

games.name: Abductables
games.summary: An arcade game about abducting humans, turning them into alien human hybrids to make money and get the highest score possible.

games.name: Squid Hunt 1923
games.summary: Experience a unique flow that echoes the early icons of the shooter genre. Captivated by grotesque atmosphere, driven by ever-growing numbers you plunge into portals, eliminate aliens, collect loot and gather experience. At a pace you set yourself.

games.name: The Industrial Council
games.summary: A cozy AI driven game where you play a journalist in a steampunk fantasy city. Change is coming to Raversul, and with the help of your imp and your newspaper you will play a powerful role in shaping it. Solve mysteries, uncover stories, and shape politics in this revolutionary new game.

games.name: The Glued
games.summary: The peg doll faces from your childhood bedroom reappear at every turn. Struggle to find a path forward through your own personal hell in this bleak visual novel with light puzzles and point-and-click elements.

games.name: Castles & Castellans
games.summary: Castles & Castellans is a hybrid of real-time strategy and third-person action. Rule from the castle-building RTS view - construct, manage, and fortify against looming threats. Then step into the castellan’s boots in TPP, fighting side by side with your soldiers atop the very walls you built.

games.name: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam
games.summary:
Professor Layton and the New World of Steam depicts the world one year after the events of "Professor Layton and the Unwound Future".

Due to a mysterious incident in Steam Bison, a new adventure for Layton and Luke begins!

games.name: Attack on Titan 3
games.summary: Experience the story from beginning to end in the ultimate culmination of the Attack on Titan game series. The ODM action has been further refined, delivering the most exhilarating and stylish combat the series has ever seen.

games.name: Stage Tour
games.summary: Stage Tour is a rhythm-action game that blends familiar, accessible note-highway gameplay with exciting modern twists. It’s poised to rekindle the flame of plastic-instrument rhythm gaming with new features and modes, diverse bandmates and instruments, competitive depth, and seasonal events.

games.name: Hakuoki Ibun: Berezinskii no Majo
games.summary: A new Hakuoki game for Nintendo Switch, set in 19th century Europe.

games.name: Ninja Baseball League-Man: Bases Loaded
games.summary:
Ninja Baseball League-Man: Bases Loaded is an arcade-style beat ’em up that combines baseball and martial arts, this action game has players battling through side-scrolling stages with pitches, swings, grabs, throws, combos, and special attacks. Up to four players can team up in shared-screen co-op to reclaim a stolen trophy.

Expanding on the original arcade release, the game adds a playable character, new stages, an arranged mode with revised enemy layouts, minigames, and newly arranged music alongside the original soundtrack.

games.name: Aeruta
games.summary:
A bread revolution across the world now begins!
Aeruta is a side-scrolling action game with a shop management twist, fight monsters for materials and use them to make breads, then finally make the deserted town popular again!

games.name: Caladrius 2: Dark Element
games.summary: A dark gothic world ruled by beauty and darkness... Over a decade after its debut, the infamous Shame Break system returns. Discover striking characters brought to life by acclaimed illustrators, and master enhanced Element Shot and Shame Break systems in this exhilarating 2D bullet-hell shooter.

games.name: Find Kittens 13: Cave Town
games.summary: Light your lantern, traveler, for a journey into the depths of the earth awaits you! What are you waiting for?! Explore and find cute cats to fill this black-and-white world with different colors.

games.name: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend
games.summary: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend is a single-player basketball career simulator set in an original fictional universe. Create a prospect, choose a College, International, or Pro path, shape skills and mentality through RPG decisions, and earn a role through performance, form, and consistency. Play or simulate games in the Live 2D Match Center while teams, rosters, markets, standings, playoffs, records, contracts, coaches, agents, sponsors, injuries, media pressure, and national-team selections evolve across multiple seasons.

games.name: Wilder World: Super Early Access
games.summary: Interdimensional refugees known as the Wilders flee Our Base Reality, which has become an AI-controlled dystopia to Wiami, a digital sanctuary in Wilder World. When the authoritarian FORUM attempts to conquer Wiami, the Wilders strategize a defence.

games.name: Path of Exile 2
games.summary: Path of Exile 2 is a next generation Action RPG created by Grinding Gear Games. Set years after the original Path of Exile, you will return to the dark world of Wraeclast and seek to end the corruption that is spreading. Path of Exile 2 is a free-to-play online multiplayer game with co-op for up to six players.

games.name: Maneki Mania
games.summary: Pet the lucky cat, spin the charm slots and chase the golden koban jackpot. Maneki Mania is a kawaii fortune shrine where you unlock lucky charms, grow your luck and watch the gold pile up. Cute on the outside, casino on the inside.

games.name: Fall off Reach
games.summary: Fall Off Reach is a first-person narrative survival game and the sequel to Drift Into Eternity. Alone in the wreck of the WANDERER IV, explore, repair failing systems, and delay the inevitable as everything keeping you alive collapses.

games.name: Project Atlas
games.summary: In a universe where everything is falling into chaos, one person and their new found companion are out to save the universe from total destruction. Experience heart pounding battle action, animal handling skills, survival skills, and even some fishing along the way. Includes solo story mode, multiplayer 6v6 team death match, and a battle royale. Set in the near future where humans battle resource deprivation, and climate change on worlds. Yet off world threats are the real danger! Battle through countless missions with your customizable K-9 companion. Can the universe be saved or was it doomed

games.name: Hunter From Hell
games.summary: With your friends, form a team of paranormal experts to unravel the mysteries of the most terrifying places. Armed with sophisticated gadgets like EMF detectors, infrared cameras, and incantation books, your mission is simple: gather evidence of the beyond and survive chilling encounters.

games.name: Demon With a Candy Crisis
games.summary: A quick and easy 3d platformer playing as a demon that needs to quench its thirst for candy. Travel through hell to get to the surface to find someone's secret stash of candy.

games.name: PBA Pro Bowling 2027
games.summary: Dominate the lanes in PBA Pro Bowling 2027! Customize your bowler’s unique style and arsenal with in-depth ball mechanics and Perks. Forge your legacy in PBA Tour Mode and Online Leagues, and defend your title in Online Tournaments and Ranked Play. This is where champions are made.

games.name: Sakurairo Prism: Beyond the Bloom
games.summary: A coming-of-age romance visual novel set in a disbanded high school photography club. Three fully voiced heroines — a childhood friend, a playful junior, a mysterious senior. As love refracts like a prism, what will Hikaru's camera capture? A remake of Sakurairo Prism. "You can always start over."

games.name: Santa's Legacy
games.summary: Step into Santa's boots and manage the most magical workshop on Earth! Build, craft, and deliver gifts before Christmas morning in this cozy holiday management adventure. The spirit of Christmas is in your hands!

games.name: Power Racing Bundle 4
games.summary: Enjoy 4 games in 1 with this irresistible games pack!

games.name: Heavy Duty
games.summary: Heavy Duty isn’t just about driving. It’s about controlling the toughest machines on Earth and leading a crew through high-stakes missions. Pick your cargo carefully, balance every load, and be ready to drop, crack, break, and try again until the job gets done.

games.name: Rest Stop
games.summary: Abandoned and alone at a highway rest stop in the middle of the Appalachian Mountains, the night breeze begins to caress your cheek. The scent of wet pine whispers that you’re home. The taste of iron in your mouth reminds you that you can’t stay here forever.

games.name: True Love For Her
games.summary: True Love For Her (TLFH) is a Yandere game inspired by Yandere Simulator and Life Is Strange that doesn’t compete with the original games. This game involves murder and other methods of killing, so it is not suitable for kids. We are not responsible for any actions taken by kids replicating activities from TLFH in real life.

games.name: Divine Tactics
games.summary: Lead your team of divine allies to victory in this roguelike autobattler. Position your units, unleash their unique powers, and outsmart rivals in this asynchronous multiplayer competition.

games.name: Ikarus
games.summary: IKARUS blends the bullet-hell chaos of arcade shmups with the strategic edge of a roguelike deck-builder. Dodge, parry, and shoot through waves of hostile machines while crafting game-breaking card synergies. How close to the sun will you fly?

games.name: Jump Frog
games.summary: A determined frog leaps ever higher, risking its life in a perilous climb where every slip could send it tumbling back to the start. driven by the call to find the perfect mate. Will this frog have what it takes?

games.name: Built by Force
games.summary: Merge Titanfall-style gunplay with Satisfactory base-building and Minecraft exploration in a living, randomized world. Transform at will, master a single-resource economy, and join with up to 11 friends to face adaptive AI enemies.

games.name: ConOps21: Subversion Protocol
games.summary: Neo-London remembers nothing. The Dominion made certain of it. You are Cipher Reeve — the man their erasure failed to take - and the buried Signal you've touched carries the memory of everyone they erased. A psychological techno-thriller where truth is contraband and every choice is recorded.

games.name: Crash and Conquer
games.summary: A thrilling, Carmageddon/Twisted metal-inspired roguelite game blending high-octane driving and action with strategic elements.

games.name: Long Shadow
games.summary: Guide one family across centuries of collapse, evacuation, settlement and interstellar expansion. Preserve memories, establish laws, command crews, inherit ships and face the Afterless as every choice becomes part of history.

games.name: Wizard 64
games.summary: Destroy incoming enemies as a flying wizard. Collect points to grow stronger. Unlock new weapons and abilities, and use different builds to defeat endless monster hordes.

games.name: Stranded in the Abyss
games.summary: Stranded in the abyss is a shoot-em-up in a unique sci-fi sci-environment where you command a massive squad of ships in an endless war Against an evil rebellion. Shoot command and bomb your way through hundreds of enemy fighters, capital ships, and skirmishes.

games.name: Armatus
games.summary: ARMATUS is a third-person roguelite shooter set in the demon-infested ruins of Paris. As the last supernatural warrior of an ancient order, armed with powerful firearms and incredible celestial powers, scour the city in search of a lost gateway to heaven - the Sunless Gate.

games.name: Stellarch
games.summary: Stellarch is a deterministic, provably-fair trading-card game on the Hive blockchain. Draft a seven-card team of Fighters across eight elemental affinities and let a seeded combat engine resolve the battle; every match replays byte-identically from its seed, so any result can be verified. You own your cards on-chain, and a smart deck beats a deep wallet. Fair, not free. The alpha is ongoing at stellarch.io.

games.name: Danganronpa 2x2
games.summary:
A new killing game begins in the same setting and with the same characters as Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair. A brand-new scenario with different victims, culprits, and tricks! Reveal the truth by shooting down contradictions in a Class Trial and uncover the culprit of a murder.

The original scenario from Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair, with revamped visuals and presentation for modern consoles, is also included.

games.name: 13Z: The Zodiac Trials
games.summary: Go solo or team up with up to three friends in online co-op for this fast-paced, anime-inspired action roguelike. Master stylish hack and slash combat, craft overpowered builds, and conquer mythological trials to claim the title of the thirteenth Zodiac.

games.name: Terranigma
games.summary: Thematic boldness. Stunning character design. Excellent music. Smooth gameplay. Terranigma had it all... except a modern re-release. Now, the beloved action JRPG classic is back for the first time since 1995!

games.name: Stranger Than Heaven
games.summary: Stranger Than Heaven is an upcoming action-adventure game developed by Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio and published by Sega. The game follows a multi-decade story across five eras and five cities, centered on men searching for a place to belong. It combines close-quarters action with narrative elements, historical urban settings, and activities connected to music and performance.

games.name: Ananta
games.summary: Take on the role of an elite Agent within the A.C.D. (Anti-Chaos Directorate) embarking on an exhilarating adventure through a world that breaks all the rules. Meet a variety of interesting characters, jump into exciting combat, solve challenges and safeguard the balance by overcoming threats to humanity, all while enjoying unparalleled freedom to traverse and discover Nova City on a journey to find out who you really are.

games.name: TankRat
games.summary: A dying world, flesh given way to steel. Swarms of corrupted mech-monsters roam a desolated land. Search and destroy, scavenge and dismantle, rebuild yourself from the wreckage. What you take becomes what you are. Survive the wasteland. Make it to Highpoint.

games.name: Fit Boxing: Touken Ranbu - Shutsujin! Exercise Honmaru
Stranger Than Heaven: Collector's Edition
games.summary:
Stranger Than Heaven Collector's Edition includes:

Stranger Than Heaven Base Game (PlayStation 5)
Deluxe Upgrade & Pre-Order Bonus DLC Codes
Exclusive SteelBook Case
Exclusive 12-Inch Vinyl Record
Exclusive Collector’s Edition Box

games.name: Sorrow: Rise of Divinity
games.summary: An open-world action survival game combining fast-paced battle royale, competitive deathmatches, trophy hunting, and intense missions—where strategy and skill determine your fate.

games.name: Cogito: Requiem
games.summary:
Cogito: Requiem is a 2D action game where you dash freely through a harmony of music and sound effects.

The setting: a world where humanity has migrated into the digital realm and vanished, leaving behind only the SI—artificial intelligences who once had humans as their masters. As Cogito, you race through this world where their remnants linger, set on "ending" the SI that have fallen into error.

games.name: Titan Quest II
games.summary: Nemesis, Goddess of Retribution, is out of control. She is corrupting the Threads of Fate and punishing all those who oppose her. Take up your weapon, fight alongside gods, and change fate itself in Titan Quest 2, an action RPG inspired by Greek mythology.

games.name: DevilConnection
games.summary: "Shall we do something immoral?" A demon-teasing adventure where you summon unique kemono and gather magical powers to restore the naughty demon "Debirun's" form!

games.name: Shell Soldier
games.summary: Shell Soldier is a high‑octane first‑person shooter set in a bleak dystopian future. Featuring frenetic firefights against a diverse range of enemy combatants, each employing unique tactics and weaponry, and offering a wide arsenal of lethal tools at your disposal.

games.name: Fallgrade
games.summary: Bend gravity. Twist architecture. Survive the impossible. A first-person exploration game set in an analog concrete nightmare, where reality shifts around you and Karl waits for your next mistake.

games.name: Monster Nursery
games.summary: A relaxing idle monster collection game (with offline progress). Features 200 monster entries and 10 Lo-fi tracks.

games.name: Until Dawn 2
games.summary:
Ready to die for likes? Join a team of ambitious ghost hunters as they chase their next viral hit on a remote island haunted by a woman’s chilling story of demons and ghostly phenomena.

When the tale begins to manifest in terrifying ways, the group will have to fight their own fear—and anything else that gets in their way – to get off the island alive. Their lives are in your hands. Make every choice count.

games.name: Metroid Ravenous
games.summary: It’s eat or be eaten! Take control of Samus Aran, a renowned bounty hunter ambushed by unknown attackers and marooned on an unfamiliar moon. Gather your arsenal, navigate a maze of corridors, hunt down powerful bosses, and use your newly awakened Metroid instincts to devour your foes. You’ll need to strike quickly and aggressively with beams, missiles, and more—lest you become the enemy’s next meal.

games.name: Tropico 7
games.summary: Get rich or die trying! In Tropico 7, you step into El Presidente’s shiny boots again to build your island nation and – literally – move mountains. As glorious leader you guide your loyal citizens (and your Swiss Bank Account) through the ages toward untold prosperity.

games.name: Fate/Extra Record
games.summary:
The “Moon Holy Grail War” begins anew…

The setting is a Spiritron virtual world called “SE.RA.PH.” built on the moon. Masters and Servants team up and fight for survival in pursuit of the “Holy Grail,” an omnipotent wish-granting device, in the Moon Holy Grail War which begins once again…

This is a remake of Fate/EXTRA, the first Fate series RPG originally released on July 22, 2010, now revamped for modern hardware with an expanded scenario, refreshed character graphics, and dramatic command battles utilizing a highly strategic deck-building system.

games.name: Aria Blue I: Natsuoto
games.summary: Aria Blue I: Natsuoto is a coming-of-age fantasy visual novel that depicts the summer of nine boys and girls. The game will be released in multiple installments, with each installment focusing on one protagonist and two heroines, together weaving a single story that unfolds over the same period of time.

games.name: Metroid Ravenous: Special Edition
games.summary:
It’s eat or be eaten! Survive against vicious assailants to escape labyrinthine ruins

Take control of Samus Aran, a renowned bounty hunter ambushed by unknown attackers and marooned on an unfamiliar moon. Gather your arsenal, navigate a maze of corridors, hunt down powerful bosses, and use your newly awakened Metroid instincts to devour your foes. You’ll need to strike quickly and aggressively with beams, missiles, and more—lest you become the enemy’s next meal.

Get an amiibo figure and more with Metroid Ravenous: Special Edition

This Special Edition includes the Samus (Metroid Suit) – Metr

games.name: Alien Agent X
games.summary: Players can obtain materials and exchange them for corresponding characters, costumes, weapons, actions, etc. Supports body adjustment, taking photos, scene scanning, player chain connection.All multiplayer online. Currently in the early access most Unreal the scene will be changed later.

games.name: Alchemist
games.summary: A magic-focused action battle* RPG where research and alchemy shape your path through combat encounters, puzzles, and challenges across diverse locations.

games.name: Game Quest: The Backlog Battler
games.summary: This Arcade Hack & Slash answers the age old question: "What if the games you never play could attack you?" Fight back your backlog! The more you paid, the more damage they will do to you! (just like in real life).

games.name: C3 Nightfall
games.summary: Collect relics. Combine their powers. Forge magical weapons. Fight monsters from beyond the skies in a third-person medieval fantasy adventure. Survive the night, harvest Cosmic Crystals, and reclaim the King's castle from the creatures that fell from the comet cloud.

games.name: Shatterswarm
games.summary:
Shatterswarm is a narrative-driven 2D space shooter that combines direct ship combat, fleet command, tower defense, and base building into a strategic colony survival experience. Command Captain Hope's hero ship as you defend Earth's last bastion, The Citadel, against the relentless Voxan Empire.

Take control of your hero ship in intense 2D space combat while simultaneously building and managing a fleet of ships, constructing defensive networks around your citadel, and managing resources to survive wave after wave of alien invaders. Every decision matters as you balance offensive capabilities

games.name: Metro 2039
games.summary:
METRO 2039 is the next landmark FPS from acclaimed storytellers, 4A Games. Journey into the dark heart of post-apocalyptic Moscow in a harrowing conflict for the very soul of the Metro.

The year is 2039. For a quarter century, the last survivors of nuclear war have been locked in bitter conflict deep in the Metro tunnels beneath the poisoned city of Moscow.

Now, finally, they have been united by a single leader, a fanatical Spartan known as Hunter. But this is no peace: Hunter’s Novoreich regime rules through propaganda and fear, subjugating the population in the name of a new war for the su

games.name: Muramasa: Revenant Blades
games.summary: Vanillaware x Marvelous present an action RPG for the ages. Hack and slash your way through a world of restless spirits and Demon Blades. The tales of six fabled protagonists of Japan's Genroku era, each with their own unique fighting style, are about to unfold.

games.name: Vanguard Exiles
games.summary: Vanguard Exiles is a new style of auto-battler designed by legendary game designer, Richard Garfield. Each player pits their Squad against their opponent in an ever-changing environment. Each Squad has its own unique identity and is comprised of Units and Actions, each with traits and abilities that can shape your battle strategy. You are the general, guide your troops to victory!

games.name: Sagas of Lumin
