games.summary: Sagas of Lumin is a single-player, semi-open-world action RPG. Master dragon riding as you soar across the skies, engage in thrilling aerial battles, and explore a vast world. Seamlessly switch to ground combat with swords, spells, and firearms. Your choices will shape the fate of this world.

games.name: Wild Life
games.summary: Become the heroine Maya - strong, beautiful and able to call upon her wings, her tribal heritage - in this gripping Adult Action-RPG. Roam the world from fertile forests to dry and sun-soaked deserts, spread your wings and cut through the skies of a world torn by greed and vanity. Find your own way to ensure your survival and embrace the possibilities of fighting and sex.

games.name: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis - Deluxe Edition
games.summary:
The Deluxe Edition includes:
- Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis
- Parisian Fugitive Outfit (early unlock)
- DLC Story Pack
- Pre-Order Bonus: 48-Hour Early Access

games.name: Let's Build a Dungeon
games.summary: Manage a game studio making the world’s greatest MMORPG. Hire designers, coders, and testers, create a fantasy world, then welcome hundreds of virtual players. If they get bored they will cancel their subscription and your investors will have your head. You can even play the game you create.

games.name: Astonishia Story
games.summary:
Follow Lloyd von Reuental on his quest to recover a stolen relic and regain his honor in this tale of prejudice, manipulation, and duty. The Elven Queen is set on claiming the powers of an ancient god, and it'll be up to you to stop her!

Astonishia Story is an updated version of the classic Korean RPG, featuring enhanced visuals and refined mechanics. Master grid-based battles, recruit mercenaries, and do whatever it takes to see your duty through, even if that means saving the world in the process.

games.name: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis
games.summary: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis is a reimagining of Lara Croft’s 1996 genre-defining game with visuals powered by Unreal Engine 5, modern gameplay, and new surprises that honor the spirit of the original.

games.name: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United - Digital Deluxe Version
Wake Up
games.summary:
Wake Up is a thrilling 2D/3D adventure game made by R16studio. Dive into a world full of mystery, puzzles, psychological horror, and tension where every choice matters.
Are you ready to wake up and find the truth or maybe not.

games.name: God of War Laufey
games.summary: God of War: Laufey is an upcoming action-adventure game developed by Santa Monica Studio for PlayStation 5. The game follows Laufey, also known as Faye, after she awakens in a strange afterlife realm following her death. To protect Kratos and Atreus, she travels through the Everywhen, an afterlife of the gods where deities from different mythologies compete for power. The game shifts the focus from Kratos to Faye and features sword-based combat, magic, and new supporting characters.

games.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Tag Force GX
games.summary: Duel Alongside Your Partner and Forge Your Own Future!

games.name: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United
games.summary: Experience a full remake of Romancing SaGa 3, featuring fully realized 3D graphics, refined gameplay systems, new musical arrangements, voice acting, and more. Choose from eight different protagonists and embark on a turn-based RPG adventure as you uncover the fate of the Child of Destiny.

games.name: Fable
games.summary: Become the Hero you want to be in an immersive open-world action-RPG where each choice shapes your journey, reputation is everything, and fairytale endings are never guaranteed.

games.name: Persona 4 Revival
games.summary: Who’s on Air? Legend has it that a mysterious broadcast known as the "Midnight Channel" appears only on rainy nights. The day after it airs, a corpse is found in Inaba, a quiet and peaceful town in rural Japan suddenly thrown into turmoil. To uncover the truth behind these chilling mysteries, you and your friends form an investigation team to unravel the secrets of the Midnight Channel and the bizarre murders. As your adventure unfolds, you face off against "Shadows," eerie manifestations of individuals' darker selves. Together, you awaken a hidden power called "Persona" and embark on a journe

games.name: Fable: Premium Edition
games.summary: Fable Premium Edition includes the full game with Early Access, letting you play up to 5 days before launch, and Premium Edition Content Pack (featuring Splendid Armour, Bastard Armour, and in-game gifts), Fable Digital Artbook & Soundtrack, and the Fable: Order of the Hero expansion coming post-launch.

games.name: Persona 4 Revival: Digital Premium Edition
games.summary:
Persona 4 Revival: P3R & P5R Extra BGM Set

Persona 3 Reload BGMs include:
1. Dungeon BGM: Basement (P3R ver.)
2. Boss Battle BGM: Heartful Cry
3. Result BGM: After the Battle (P3R ver.)

Persona 5 Royal BGMs include:
1. Dungeon BGM: The Whims of Fate
2. Normal Battle BGM: Will Power
3. Result BGM: Triumph

games.name: Persona 4 Revival: Limited Box
games.summary: Contains a Mayonaka TV-style smartphone pouch, a limited edition original T-Shirt (size L), a 48-pages artbook and Persona 4 Revival: Ultramarine Costume Set

games.name: Yuna and the Spirit Forest
games.summary: A 2D pixel-art metroidvania where you fight using elemental spirits instead of basic attacks. Explore, collect, and solve puzzles in a magical forest.

games.name: Fable
games.summary: Become the Hero you want to be in an immersive open-world action-RPG where each choice shapes your journey, reputation is everything, and fairytale endings are never guaranteed.

games.name: Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories
games.summary: Atelier Karia tells the story of Karia, who has no memories, as she faces her past. New features add to the strategy of battles and depth of alchemy. Synthesized items take on new roles during exploration, and ingredients can be eaten to gain effects.

games.name: Hyrule Warriors: Age of Calamity - Definitive Edition
games.summary: Experience the events of the Great Calamity with higher resolution visuals and smoother performance on Nintendo Switch 2!

games.name: Coven: All Powerful
games.summary: A chaotic spell-slinging party brawler where Sages clash in ever-changing magical realms. Stack wild enchantments, unleash devastating spells and combos, and outlast your friends in fast, unpredictable battles full of pure arcane mayhem.

games.name: Blossoming Yandere
games.summary: You've moved into your first apartment. A girl gazes at you, craving your love. What are you to do when you're the center of someone's world? Make choices, explore your new home, piece together a mystery, and be careful. Your actions and words have consequences.

games.name: Gasoline
games.summary: Gasoline is frenetic boomer shooter inspired by 1997 classics You wake up in grim hospital with bandages wrapped around your face and an axe in your hand. Fight twisted creatures, hunt for secrets and explore malevolent levels. Can you keep your cool when everyone around you is smiling far too wide?

games.name: Fox Arcana
games.summary: Delve into the mystical depths of the Forest in this captivating roguelike. You play as a courageous fox, wielder of powerful spells, the last bulwark against the growing corruption.

games.name: Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember
games.summary: Born from war's flames, a Phoenix ascends. In this dark fantasy Three Kingdoms action RPG from Team NINJA, players use offensive and defensive Chinese martial arts to fight back against mighty demons on the battlefields of the Three Kingdoms.

games.name: Trine 6: Together in Time
games.summary: Trine 6: Together in Time is a co-op puzzle platformer for 1-4 players. Wit, timing, and teamwork collide as you solve perplexing puzzles, engage cunning creatures, and traverse perilous paths in the next adventure through Trines iconic fantasy world.

games.name: Eternal Anima
games.summary: Yearning for a better future is considered a capital offense in the kingdom of Urvis Ael. After Wade questions this key tenet of his society, he finds himself on the run in an era-spanning adventure that challenges his core beliefs and reveals an unknown world filled with hidden truths. Alongside an eclectic group of new allies trying to survive a dangerous journey, Wade must travel through time to save civilizations of the past from catastrophes and unravel the secrets of a lost history.

games.name: Gundam Rogue Orbit
games.summary: Become the pilot you were born to be. Change humanity’s fate in GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT, a high-mobility action game that delivers a bold new take on Gundam, blending a fast-paced cinematic story with intense, hard-hitting combat in an all-new universe.

games.name: Byte Bistro
games.summary: Program a little robot crew and bring a neighborhood café to life. Cook, serve, restock, and refine your routines across 24 services. Mix visual programming with hands-on minigames, then keep your kitchen humming in Desktop Companion mode.

games.name: Backrooms: The Savior
games.summary: That's a co-op horror exploration shooter set in the Backrooms. This time, you won’t just hide—grab your weapon and fight back against the entities. Explore classic and original levels, scavenge supplies, rescue survivors, and survive. Ammo is scarce. Noise is deadly. This time, fear goes both ways.

games.name: Road Kings
games.summary: Drive a 40-ton semi hauling cargo across the coastal plains of the American South, managing multiple jobs, trailers, and routes. Grow reputation from rookie to veteran owner-operator, dodging disasters and rivals to become the hero of the open road.

games.name: Altiros
games.summary: Build! Craft! Destroy! Jump on clouds and fight cute monsters in skill-based battles of steel, magic and spirit in this online sandbox adventure set in a fantastical world of sky islands!

games.name: Ash and Flame
games.summary: Ash and Flame is an interactive cinematic thriller set in the dark fantasy world of Erwintal. You are Raynar, a war veteran who takes up his sword once more to face an ancient evil. Your choices shape the kingdom’s fate: ashes… or the flame of hope.

games.name: Tremble of Towers
games.summary: Tremble of Towers is a CO-OP tower defense game where you can build any structure with any resource. Countless of combinations are waiting for you and your friends to be discovered in order to protect your beloved Goal Stone from all kinds of enemies in various maps!

games.name: Bon Voyage
games.summary: Bon Voyage is an idle game where you conduct your steam train through 19th cent. Belgium. Choose your route and manage your train to deliver the best train service for your passengers. A companion game where the gameplay occurs at stops, allowing you to focus on other things in life during travel.

games.name: Deck Breaker
games.summary: Deck Breaker is a single-player roguelike deckbuilder in which players choose a hero, build a deck during branching quests, combine spells, characters, and artifacts, and preserve selected foil cards across runs.

games.name: M.A.Y.A
games.summary: Take on the role of sci-fi warrior Maya. Capture uplinks, master a complex move-set along with weapon upgrades, and survive on a hostile planet.
